body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.1) Now we shall explain the <s>vidhi</s> (ritual injunction).
(KauśS_1,1.2) That [injunction] is based on the <s>āmnāya</s> (sacred tradition).

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.3) āmnāyaḥ punar mantrāś ca brāhmaṇāni ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.3) The <s>āmnāya</s> (sacred tradition), in turn, consists of <s>mantras</s> (sacred formulas) and <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> (explanatory texts).

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.4) tad yathābrāhmaṇaṃ vidhir evaṃ karmaliṅgā mantrāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.4) Just as the <s>vidhi</s> (injunction) accords with the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (explanatory text), so [are there] <s>mantras</s> whose mark is the ritual act.
(KauśS_1,1.5) Likewise [there are mantras] serving another purpose.
(KauśS_1,1.6) Likewise [there are] <s>mantras</s> whose mark is the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (explanatory text).
(KauśS_1,1.7) In the absence of that [textual authority], the <s>saṃpradāya</s> (tradition of transmission) [is the authority].
(KauśS_1,1.8) Because the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> (explanatory texts) have been set forth [as primary authority].
(KauśS_1,1.9) We shall explain the <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice).
(KauśS_1,1.10) [The sacrifice] for the gods and for the ancestors.
(KauśS_1,1.11) Facing east, one performs [the rite] in a low voice.
(KauśS_1,1.12) Wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder (<s>yajñopavītī</s>) for rites of the gods.
(KauśS_1,1.13) Wearing the sacred thread over the right shoulder (<s>prācīnavītī</s>) for rites of the ancestors.
(KauśS_1,1.14) [The direction is] east or north for rites of the gods.
(KauśS_1,1.15) South for rites of the ancestors.
(KauśS_1,1.16) Concluding toward the east or north for rites of the gods.
(KauśS_1,1.17) Concluding toward the south or west for rites of the ancestors.
(KauśS_1,1.18) The ritual act for the ancestors is performed once.
(KauśS_1,1.19) Three times at minimum for the gods.
(KauśS_1,1.20) Or as specifically enjoined.
(KauśS_1,1.21) The procedure for the gods is clockwise (toward the right).
(KauśS_1,1.22) Counter-clockwise (toward the left) for the ancestors.
(KauśS_1,1.23) The gods receive offerings with the exclamation <s>svāhā</s> and <s>vaṣaṭ</s>.
(KauśS_1,1.24) The ancestors receive offerings with the exclamation <s>svadhā</s> and <s>namas</s> (obeisance).
(KauśS_1,1.25) The <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass) for the ancestors is cut near the root.
(KauśS_1,1.26) [Cut] at the joints for the gods.

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.27) <pra yacha parśum [12.3.31a]> iti darbhāhārāya dātraṃ prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.27) With <pra yacha parśum [12.3.31a]> he hands over the sickle for gathering the <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass).

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.28) <oṣadhīr dāntu parvan [12.3.31b-part]> iti_upari parvaṇāṃ lūtvā tūṣṇīm āhṛtya_uttarato_agner upasādayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.28) With <oṣadhīr dāntu parvan [12.3.31b-part]>, having cut above the joints, he silently gathers [the grass] and places it to the north of the fire.
(KauśS_1,1.29) One should not turn around past the fire [while carrying the grass].
(KauśS_1,1.30) One should not pass between the implements of the sacrifice.
(KauśS_1,1.31) Bending the right knee, one offers the oblation.

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.32) yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī sānumatir yā_uttarā sā rākā [cf. AitB 7.11.2]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.32) The full-moon day that comes first is <s>Anumatī</s>; the one that comes after is <s>Rākā</s>. [cf. AitB 7.11.2]

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.33) yā pūrvāmāvāsyā sā sinīvālī yā_uttarā sā kuhūḥ [cf. AitB 7.11.2]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.33) The new-moon day that comes first is <s>Sinīvālī</s>; the one that comes after is <s>Kuhū</s>. [cf. AitB 7.11.2]
(KauśS_1,1.34) Saying "today is the <s>upavasatha</s> (fast-day)," one eats the meal of one who is about to observe the fast.
(KauśS_1,1.35) Abstaining from honey, salt, meat, and <s>māṣa</s> (black gram).

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.36) <mamāgne varcaḥ [5.3.1]> iti samidha ādhāya vratam upaiti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.36) With <mamāgne varcaḥ [5.3.1]>, having placed the fuel-sticks, one undertakes the <s>vrata</s> (observance).
(KauśS_1,1.37) Or with <vratena tvāṃ vratapate [7.74.4]>.
(KauśS_1,1.38) One observing the vow is a <s>brahmacārī</s> (celibate student), a <s>vratī</s> (one bound by a vow).
(KauśS_1,1.39) He should sleep on the ground.

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.40) prātarhute_agnau <karmaṇe vāṃ veṣāya vāṃ sukṛtāya vām [cf. TS 1.1.4.1 etc., KauśS 58.5]> iti pāṇī prakṣālyāpareṇāgner darbhān āstīrya teṣūttaram ānaḍuhaṃ rohitaṃ carma prāggrīvam uttaraloma prastīrya pavitre kurute
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.40) When the morning oblation to the fire has been made, with <karmaṇe vāṃ veṣāya vāṃ sukṛtāya vām [cf. TS 1.1.4.1 etc., KauśS 58.5]>, having washed the hands, to the west of the fire, having spread <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass), on them he spreads a red bull-hide with its neck toward the east and hair upward, and prepares the <s>pavitras</s> (purifiers).

body.text: (KauśS_1,1.41) darbhau_aprachinnāntau prakṣālyānulomam anumārṣṭi <viṣṇor manasā pūte sthaḥ [PS 20.45.6, MS 4.1.5:7.15 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,1.41) Two <s>darbha</s> blades with uncut tips, having washed them, he wipes them along the grain [of the grass] with <viṣṇor manasā pūte sthaḥ [PS 20.45.6, MS 4.1.5:7.15 etc.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.1) <tvaṃ bhūmim aty eṣy ojasā tvaṃ vedyāṃ sīdasi cārur adhvare | tvāṃ pavitram ṛṣayo bharantas tvaṃ punīhi duritāny asmat || [PS 11.13.3 = ;SS 19.33.3 (but sakalapāṭha!)]> iti pavitre antardhāya havir nirvapati <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave_aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi [sakala - cf. 19.51.2, PS 5.40.1, TS 1.1.4.2 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.1) With <tvaṃ bhūmim aty eṣy ojasā tvaṃ vedyāṃ sīdasi cārur adhvare | tvāṃ pavitram ṛṣayo bharantas tvaṃ punīhi duritāny asmat || [PS 11.13.3 = ;SS 19.33.3 (but sakalapāṭha!)]>, having placed [the grain] between the two <s>pavitras</s> (purifiers), he offers the <s>havis</s> (oblation) with <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave_aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi [sakala - cf. 19.51.2, PS 5.40.1, TS 1.1.4.2 etc.]>.
(KauśS_1,2.2) Likewise with <agniṣomābhyām [ibid.]>.
(KauśS_1,2.3) With <indrāgnibhyām [-]> on the new-moon day.
(KauśS_1,2.4) The first [offering] is always for <s>Agni</s> (<s>āgneya</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.5) niruptaṃ pavitrābhyāṃ prokṣati <amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam [-]> yathādevatam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.5) The offered [grain], he sprinkles with the two <s>pavitras</s> (purifiers), [saying] <amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam [-]>, according to the deity.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.6) ulūkhalamusalaṃ śūrpaṃ prakṣālitaṃ carmaṇi_ādhāya vrīhīn ulūkhala opyāvaghnaṃs trir haviṣkṛtā vācaṃ visṛjati <haviṣkṛd ā dravehi [cf. Aap;SS 1.19.9 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.6) Having placed the mortar, pestle, and winnowing basket, washed, upon the hide, pounding the rice in the mortar, he utters the <s>haviṣkṛt</s> call three times: <haviṣkṛd ā dravehi [cf. Aap;SS 1.19.9 etc.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.7) +avahatya [ed. apahatya] suphalīkṛtān kṛtvā triḥ prakṣālya taṇḍulān <agne varur yajñiyas tvādhi arukṣat [11.1.16]> iti carum adhidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.7) +Having removed [the husks] [ed. apahatya], having made [the grains] well-husked, having washed the rice grains three times, with <agne varur yajñiyas tvādhi arukṣat [11.1.16]> he places the <s>caru</s> (sacrificial porridge) on [the fire].
(KauśS_1,2.8) With <śuddhāḥ pūtāḥ [11.1.17]> he pours in water.
(KauśS_1,2.9) With <brahmaṇā śuddhāḥ [11.1.18]> [he pours in] the rice grains.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.10) <pari tvāgne puraṃ vayam [7.71.1]> iti triḥ paryagni karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.10) With <pari tvāgne puraṃ vayam [7.71.1]> he performs the <s>paryagni</s> (circumambulation with fire) three times.
(KauśS_1,2.11) With a stirring stick he stirs three times clockwise.
(KauśS_1,2.12) From that point onward, as one wishes.
(KauśS_1,2.13) He places the <s>idhma</s> (fuel-wood) to the north of the fire.
(KauśS_1,2.14) Beyond [that], the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).
(KauśS_1,2.15) With <agnaye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi [i.a. KS 1.10:5.22]>, [he sprinkles] the <s>idhma</s> (fuel-wood).
(KauśS_1,2.16) With <pṛthivyai [-]>, [he sprinkles] the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.17) darbhamuṣṭim abhyukṣya paścād agneḥ prāgagraṃ nidadhāti <ūrṇamradaṃ prathasva svāsasthaṃ devebhyaḥ [corrupt: cf. i.a. KS 1.11:6.2-3]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.17) Having sprinkled a handful of <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass), he places it to the west of the fire with tips pointing east, [saying] <ūrṇamradaṃ prathasva svāsasthaṃ devebhyaḥ [corrupt: cf. i.a. KS 1.11:6.2-3]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.18) darbhāṇām apādāya <ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro_asi [16.2.6]> iti dakṣiṇato_agner brahmāsanaṃ nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.18) Having taken some of the <s>darbha</s> blades, with <ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro_asi [16.2.6]> he places the <s>brahmāsana</s> (seat of the Brahman priest) to the south of the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.19) purastād agner āstīrya teṣāṃ mūlāni_apareṣāṃ prāntair avachādayan parisarpati dakṣiṇenāgnim ā paścārdhāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.19) Having spread [darbha grass] in front of the fire, covering the roots of the first [blades] with the tips of those placed after, he goes around clockwise south of the fire up to the western half.
(KauśS_1,2.20) With <pari stṛṇīhi [7.99.1]> he gives the command.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.21) <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave_aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā paristṛṇāmi [-]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.21) With <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave_aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā paristṛṇāmi [-]>.
(KauśS_1,2.22) Likewise to the north, making uneven layers.
(KauśS_1,2.23) Where [the layers] meet, that he arranges in a north-south direction.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.24) stīrṇaṃ prokṣati <haviṣāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi [-]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.24) He sprinkles the spread [grass] with <haviṣāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi [-]>.
(KauśS_1,2.25) What has not been sprinkled should not be used when spread as a layer.
(KauśS_1,2.26) [There should be] no placing of fuel without [prior] kindling.
(KauśS_1,2.27) No <s>havis</s> (oblation) that has not been purified by straining.
(KauśS_1,2.28) No implement of the sacrifice that has not been sprinkled.
(KauśS_1,2.29) On that [grass], he places the washed utensils sheltered from the wind.
(KauśS_1,2.30) The <s>sruva</s> (offering ladle) and the <s>ājyadhānī</s> (ghee container).

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.31) vilīnapūtam ājyaṃ gṛhītvādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvā_udag udvāsya paścād agner upasādya_udagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyām utpunāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.31) Having taken the melted and strained <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter), having placed it on the fire, having performed <s>paryagni</s> (circumambulation with fire), having removed it to the north, having placed it to the west of the fire, he purifies it with the two <s>pavitras</s> (purifiers) held with tips pointing north.
(KauśS_1,2.32) <viṣṇor manasā pūtam asi [PS 20.45.7a]>.
(KauśS_1,2.33) <devas tvā savitā_ut punātu [PS 20.45.7b]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.34) <achidreṇa tvā pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa sahasradhāreṇa supvot punāmi [PS 20.45.7cd]> iti tṛtīyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.34) <achidreṇa tvā pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa sahasradhāreṇa supvot punāmi [PS 20.45.7cd]> — this is the third [straining].
(KauśS_1,2.35) The fourth [straining is done] silently.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.36) śṛtaṃ havir abhighārayati <madhvā samañjan ghṛtavat karātha [cf. PS 5.16.3d]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.36) He pours ghee over the cooked <s>havis</s> (oblation), [saying] <madhvā samañjan ghṛtavat karātha [cf. PS 5.16.3d]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.37) abhighārya_udañcam udvāsayati <ud vāsayāgneḥ śṛtam akarma havyam ā sīda pṛṣṭham amṛtasya dhāma [cf. PS 5.16.3ab]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.37) Having poured ghee over it, he removes it upward [from the fire], [saying] <ud vāsayāgneḥ śṛtam akarma havyam ā sīda pṛṣṭham amṛtasya dhāma [cf. PS 5.16.3ab]>.
(KauśS_1,2.38) Having set it down to the west of the <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter) and having adorned it, he purifies it with the same [procedure].
(KauśS_1,2.39) With <adārasṛt [1.20.1]> he looks upon [the offering].
(KauśS_1,2.40) With <ut tiṣṭhata [7.72.1-3]>, the hymn to <s>Indra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,2.41) <agnir bhūyām [12.1.19-21]> iti tisṛbhir upasamādadhāti <asmai kṣatrāṇi [7.78.2]> <etam idhmam [10.6.35]> iti vā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,2.41) With <agnir bhūyām [12.1.19-21]>, three [verses], he adds fuel to the fire; or with <asmai kṣatrāṇi [7.78.2]> and <etam idhmam [10.6.35]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.1) <yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena havyāyāsmai voḍheva [ed. voḍhave: misprint. Cf. Zehnder 1999: 191. Mss.: voḍheva] jātavedaḥ | indhānās tvā suprajasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvema balihṛto vayaṃ te [MS 1.4.1:47.6 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.1) With <yunajmi tvā brahmaṇā daivyena havyāyāsmai voḍheva [ed. voḍhave: misprint. Cf. Zehnder 1999: 191. Mss.: voḍheva] jātavedaḥ | indhānās tvā suprajasaḥ suvīrā jyog jīvema balihṛto vayaṃ te [MS 1.4.1:47.6 etc.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.2) dakṣiṇato jāṅmāyanam udapātram upasādyābhimantrayate <tathodapātraṃ dhāraya yathāgre brahmaṇaspatiḥ | satyadharmā adīdharad devasya savituḥ save [-]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.2) To the south, he places a water vessel on a <s>jāṅmāyana</s> (knee-high stand) and consecrates it with <tathodapātraṃ dhāraya yathāgre brahmaṇaspatiḥ | satyadharmā adīdharad devasya savituḥ save [-]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.3) atha_udakam āsiñcati <iheta devīr amṛtaṃ vasānā hiraṇyavarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ | āpaḥ samudro varuṇaś ca rājā saṃpātabhāgān haviṣo juṣantām [-, cf. PS 2.40.1a] || indrapraśiṣṭā varuṇaprasūtā apaḥ samudrād divam ud vahantu | indrapraśiṣṭā varuṇaprasūtā divas pṛthivyā śriyam ud vahantu [-, cf. 4.27.4a, RV 10.66.2a]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.3) Then he pours in water with <iheta devīr amṛtaṃ vasānā hiraṇyavarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ | āpaḥ samudro varuṇaś ca rājā saṃpātabhāgān haviṣo juṣantām [-, cf. PS 2.40.1a] || indrapraśiṣṭā varuṇaprasūtā apaḥ samudrād divam ud vahantu | indrapraśiṣṭā varuṇaprasūtā divas pṛthivyā śriyam ud vahantu [-, cf. 4.27.4a, RV 10.66.2a]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.4) <ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmi jātavedaḥ [cf. VaitS 7.4, TB 2.1.11.1 etc.]> iti saha havirbhiḥ paryukṣya jīvābhir <[19.69.1-4]> ācamya_utthāya vedaprapadbhiḥ prapadyate_<o;m prapadye bhūḥ prapadye bhuvaḥ prapadye svaḥ prapadye janat prapadye [TA 4.42.2-4]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.4) With <ṛtaṃ tvā satyena pariṣiñcāmi jātavedaḥ [cf. VaitS 7.4, TB 2.1.11.1 etc.]>, having sprinkled [the fire] together with the oblations, having sipped water with the <s>jīvā</s> [mantras] <[19.69.1-4]>, having risen, he approaches with the <s>vedaprapad</s> (approach to the altar) formulas: <o;m prapadye bhūḥ prapadye bhuvaḥ prapadye svaḥ prapadye janat prapadye [TA 4.42.2-4]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.5) prapadya paścāt stīrṇasya darbhān āstīrya <ahe daidhiṣavyod atas tiṣṭhāny asya sadane sīda yo 'smat pākataraḥ [TS 3.2.4.4, VaitS 1.20]>_iti brahmāsanam anvīkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.5) Having approached, to the west of the spread [grass], having spread <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass), with <ahe daidhiṣavyod atas tiṣṭhāny asya sadane sīda yo 'smat pākataraḥ [TS 3.2.4.4, VaitS 1.20]> he inspects the <s>brahmāsana</s> (seat of the Brahman priest).

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.6) <nirastaḥ parāgvasuḥ saha pāpmanā nirastaḥ so 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ [GobhGS 1.6.14, ;SBM 1.5.1.23 etc.]>_iti dakṣiṇā tṛṇaṃ nirasyati (cf. 139.38ff.)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.6) With <nirastaḥ parāgvasuḥ saha pāpmanā nirastaḥ so 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ [GobhGS 1.6.14, ;SBM 1.5.1.23 etc.]> he casts away a blade of grass to the south. (cf. 139.38ff.)

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.7) tad anvālabhya japati <idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi_[GB 2.1.1, ;SBM 1.5.1.24]_ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi satyasya sadane sīdāmi_[PB 1.2.2 etc.]_iṣṭasya sadane sīdāmi pūrtasya sadane sīdāmi [-] māmṛṣad deva [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. eva] barhiḥ svāsasthaṃ tvādhyāsadeyam ūrṇamradam anabhiśokam [cf. AAśv;SS 1.4.7]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.7) Having touched that [seat], he murmurs <idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi_[GB 2.1.1, ;SBM 1.5.1.24]_ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi satyasya sadane sīdāmi_[PB 1.2.2 etc.]_iṣṭasya sadane sīdāmi pūrtasya sadane sīdāmi [-] māmṛṣad deva [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. eva] barhiḥ svāsasthaṃ tvādhyāsadeyam ūrṇamradam anabhiśokam [cf. AAśv;SS 1.4.7]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.8) <vimṛgvarīṃ [12.1.29]>_ity upaviśyāsanīyaṃ brahmajapaṃ japati <bṛhaspatir brahmā brahmasadana āsiṣyate (thus Bl.) [AAśv;SS 1.12.9]> <bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya [AAśv;SS 1.12.9, TB 3.7.6.3]> <yad ud udvata un nivataḥ śakeyam [TS 3.2.4.4]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.8) With <vimṛgvarīṃ [12.1.29]>, having sat down, he recites the <s>āsanīya brahma</s> (seated Brahman-recitation): <bṛhaspatir brahmā brahmasadana āsiṣyate (thus Bl.) [AAśv;SS 1.12.9]> <bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya [AAśv;SS 1.12.9, TB 3.7.6.3]> <yad ud udvata un nivataḥ śakeyam [TS 3.2.4.4]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.9) darbhaiḥ sruvaṃ nirmṛjya <niṣṭaptaṃ rakṣo niṣṭaptā arātayaḥ pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātayaḥ [TS 1.1.2.1, TB 3.7.6.3]> iti pratapya mūle sruvaṃ gṛhītvā japati <viṣṇor hasto_asi dakṣiṇaḥ pūṣṇā datto bṛhaspateḥ | taṃ tvāhaṃ sruvam ā dade devānāṃ havyavāhanam [SankhGS 1.9.3] || ayaṃ sruvo vi dadhāti homān_śatākṣarachandasā jāgatena | sarvā yajñasya samanakti viṣṭhā bārhaspatyā_iṣṭiḥ śarmaṇā daivyena [ApSS 4.7.2]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.9) Having wiped the <s>sruva</s> (offering ladle) with <s>darbha</s> blades, with <niṣṭaptaṃ rakṣo niṣṭaptā arātayaḥ pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātayaḥ [TS 1.1.2.1, TB 3.7.6.3]> having heated it [in the fire], grasping the ladle at its base, he murmurs <viṣṇor hasto_asi dakṣiṇaḥ pūṣṇā datto bṛhaspateḥ | taṃ tvāhaṃ sruvam ā dade devānāṃ havyavāhanam [SankhGS 1.9.3] || ayaṃ sruvo vi dadhāti homān_śatākṣarachandasā jāgatena | sarvā yajñasya samanakti viṣṭhā bārhaspatyā_iṣṭiḥ śarmaṇā daivyena [ApSS 4.7.2]>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.10) <oṃ bhūḥ śaṃ bhūtyai tvā gṛhṇe bhūtaye [-]> iti prathamaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.10) With <oṃ bhūḥ śaṃ bhūtyai tvā gṛhṇe bhūtaye [-]> he takes the first ladleful of offering.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.11) <oṃ bhuvaḥ śaṃ puṣṭyai tvā gṛhṇe puṣṭaye [-]> iti dvitīyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.11) With <oṃ bhuvaḥ śaṃ puṣṭyai tvā gṛhṇe puṣṭaye [-]> the second.

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.12) <oṃ svaḥ śaṃ tvā gṛhṇe sahasrapoṣāya [-]> iti tṛtīyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_1,3.12) With <oṃ svaḥ śaṃ tvā gṛhṇe sahasrapoṣāya [-]> the third.
(KauśS 1.3.13) 'Oṃ, O <s>Jagat</s> (world), I grasp you for unlimited nourishment' — thus [is] the fourth [grasping].

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.14) rājakarmābhicārikeṣu <amuṣya tvā prāṇāya gṛhṇe_apānāya vyānāya samānāya_udānāya [-]> iti pañcamam
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.3.14) In rites pertaining to royal duties and sorcery (<s>abhicāra</s>): 'I grasp you for the <s>prāṇa</s> (in-breath), <s>apāna</s> (out-breath), <s>vyāna</s> (diffused breath), <s>samāna</s> (equalizing breath), and <s>udāna</s> (upward breath) of so-and-so' — thus [is] the fifth [grasping].

body.text: (KauśS_1,3.15) <agnāv agniḥ hṛdā pūtam [4.39.9-10]> <purastād yuktaḥ [5.29.1]> <yajñasya cakṣuḥ [2.35.5 = 19.58.5]> iti juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.3.15) With [the verses] 'In <s>Agni</s>, [there is] <s>Agni</s>, purified by the heart' [AV 4.39.9-10], 'Yoked in front' [AV 5.29.1], 'The eye of the sacrifice' [AV 2.35.5 = 19.58.5] — he makes oblations.
(KauśS 1.3.16) Behind the fire, in the middle region, in the same place [as] the offerings [made] in front.
(KauśS 1.3.17) South of the fire, [in] the water-vessel, he brings the remainders of the <s>ājya</s> (ghee) oblations.
(KauśS 1.3.18) The offering [made] in front, the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portion), the concluding oblation, [and] the completion — [these pertain to] the pacificatory [rites].
(KauśS 1.3.19) These are the two <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (ghee-portions).

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.1) <vṛṣṇe bṛhate svarvide agnaye śulkaṃ harāmi tviṣīmate | sa na sthirān balavataḥ kṛṇotu jyok ca no jīvātave dadhāti || [PS 19.52.7]> <agnaye svāhā> iti_uttarapūrvārdhe_āgneyam ājyabhāgaṃ juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.1) 'To <s>Agni</s>, the bull, the mighty, the knower of heaven, I bring the offering; to the radiant one. May he make us firm and strong, and may he grant us long life.' [PS 19.52.7] 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — Thus in the north-eastern quarter he offers the <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portion) to <s>Agni</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.2) dakṣiṇapūrvārdhe somāya <tvaṃ soma divyo nṛcakṣāḥ sugā;m asmabhyaṃ patho anu khyaḥ | abhi no gotraṃ viduṣa iva neṣo 'chā no vācam uśatīṃ jigāsi || [PS 1.51.3]> <somāya svāhā> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.2) In the south-eastern quarter, to <s>Soma</s>: 'You, O <s>Soma</s>, divine, beholder of men, point out to us the good paths. Lead us to our settlement like a knower; you approach our eager speech.' [PS 1.51.3] 'To <s>Soma</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — thus.
(KauśS 1.4.3) The oblation [is placed] in the middle.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.4) upastīryājyaṃ saṃhatābhyām aṅgulibhyāṃ dvir haviṣo_avadyati madhyāt pūrvārdhāt_ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.4) Having spread the <s>ājya</s> (ghee), with the two joined fingers he cuts off twice from the oblation — from the middle and from the front part.
(KauśS 1.4.5) Having cut [the portion], he sprinkles [it with ghee]; he sprinkles the oblation twice in return.
(KauśS 1.4.6) From wherever he cuts off, [he does so] in that order.
(KauśS 1.4.7) Thus [are performed] all the cuttings (<s>avadāna</s>).
(KauśS 1.4.8) Except for the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s> who makes the sacrifice well-offered).

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.9) <ud enam uttaraṃ naya [6.5.1]> iti purastāddhomasaṃhatāṃ pūrvām
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.9) With [the verse] 'Lead him upward' [AV 6.5.1], [he offers] the first joined [portion] of the front-offering.
(KauśS 1.4.10) Thus he offers each successive joined [portion].
(KauśS 1.4.11) The oblations [are made] verse by verse, each ending with '<s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.12) yām uttarām agner ājyabhāgasya juhoti rakṣodevatyā sā yāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ somasya pitṛdevatyā sā
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.12) The [oblation] which he offers to the north of <s>Agni</s>'s <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portion) — that has <s>Rakṣas</s>-deities. The one [offered] to the south of <s>Soma</s>'s [portion] — that has <s>Pitṛ</s>-deities (ancestor-deities).

body.text:
(KauśS_1,4.13) tasmād antarā hotavyā devaloke_eva hūyante
(KauśS_1,4.14) yāṃ hutvā pūrvām aparāṃ juhoti sāpakramantī sa pāpīyān yajamāno bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.13-14) Therefore [the oblation] should be offered in between — [for then] they are offered in the world of the gods indeed. If, having offered the first [portion], one offers the latter — [that oblation] is retreating, and the sacrificer (<s>yajamāna</s>) becomes worse off.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.15) yāṃ parāṃparāṃ saṃhatāṃ juhoti sābhikramantī sa vasīyān yajamāno bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.15) If he offers each successive joined [portion] — [that oblation] is advancing, and the sacrificer becomes more prosperous.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.16) yām anagnau juhoti sāndhā tayā cakṣur yajamānasya mīyate so_andhaṃbhāvuko yajamāno bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.16) If he offers [the oblation] not in the fire — that [oblation] is blind; by it the eye of the sacrificer is impaired, and the sacrificer becomes prone to blindness.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.17) yāṃ dhūme juhoti sā tamasi hūyate so_arocako yajamāno bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.17) If he offers [the oblation] in the smoke — that is offered in darkness, and the sacrificer becomes ill.

body.text: (KauśS_1,4.18) yāṃ jyotiṣmati juhoti tayā brahmavarcasī bhavati tasmāt_jyotiṣmati hotavyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.4.18) If he offers in the flame — by that he becomes possessed of <s>brahmavarcas</s> (brahmanical splendor). Therefore one should offer in the flame.
(KauśS 1.4.19) Likewise [the verse] 'May <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s> [grant] sovereignty to this one' [AV 6.54.2] — for the <s>Agniṣomīya</s> [offering].

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.1) <agnīṣomā savedasā sahūtī vanataṃ giraḥ | sa devatrā babhūvathuḥ || yuvam etāni divi rocanāny agniś ca soma sakratū adhattam | yuvaṃ sindhū;mr abhiśaster avadyād agnīṣomāv amuñcataṃ gṛbhītān || agnīśomā ya āhutiṃ yo vāṃ dāśād dhaviśkṛtim | sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvam āyur vyaśnavat || [RV 1.93.9,5,3 etc.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.1) '<s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, of common treasure, of common invocation, receive [our] songs! You two have become [present] among the gods. You two established these luminous [realms] in heaven, O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, of common purpose. You two freed the rivers from reproach and blame, O <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, [you freed] those seized. <s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>, whoever shall offer you an oblation, whoever shall prepare an offering for you — he, with progeny and heroic sons, shall enjoy a full lifespan.' [RV 1.93.9,5,3 etc.]

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.2) <indrāgnī rocanā divaḥ pari vājeṣu bhūṣathaḥ | tad vāṃ ceti pra vīryam || [RV 3.12.9]> <śnathad vṛtram uta sanoti vājam indrā yo agnī sahurī saparyāt | irajyantā vasavyasya bhūreḥ sahastamā sahasā vājayantā || [RV 6.60.1]> <indrāgnī asmān rakṣatāṃ yau prajānāṃ prajāvatī | sa prajayā suvīryaṃ viśvam āyur vyaśnavat || [10.1.21cd + RV 1.93.3cd]> <gomad dhiraṇyavad vasu yad vām aśvāvad īmahe | indrāgnī vanemahi || [RV 7.94.9]> <svāhā> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.2) '<s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, you adorn yourselves with the luminous [realms] of heaven among the prizes. That heroic power of yours goes forth.' [RV 3.12.9] 'He smites <s>Vṛtra</s> and wins the prize — whoever worships <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, the mighty pair, ruling over abundant wealth, conquering by force, striving for the prize.' [RV 6.60.1] 'May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> protect us, who [protect] the progeny of beings. He, with progeny and heroic sons, shall enjoy a full lifespan.' [AV 10.1.21cd + RV 1.93.3cd] 'The wealth consisting of cattle, gold, and riches, together with horses — that which we beg from you, O <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, may we obtain.' [RV 7.94.9] '<s>Svāhā</s>!' — thus.
(KauśS 1.5.3) Of the <s>Aindrāgna</s> oblation, on the new-moon day.

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.4) prāk sviṣṭakṛtaḥ pārvaṇahomau samṛddhihomāḥ kāmyahomāś ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.4) Before the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>, [are performed] the <s>pārvaṇa</s> (seasonal) oblations, the completion-oblations, and the oblations for [specific] desires.
(KauśS 1.5.5) 'Full behind' [AV 7.80(=85).1] — on the full-moon day.

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.6) <yat te devā akṛṇvan bhāgadheyam [7.79.1]> ity amāvāsyāyām
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.6) 'What the gods have made your share' [AV 7.79.1] — on the new-moon day.

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.7) <ākūtyai tvā svāhā | kāmāya tvā svāhā | samṛdhe tvā svāhā | ākūtyai tvā kāmāya tvā samṛdhe tvā svāhā | [cf. TS 3.4.2.1 etc.]> <ṛcā stomaṃ samardhaya gāyatreṇa rathantaraṃ | bṛhad gāyatravartani || [TS 3.1.10.1 etc.]> <svāhā>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.7) 'To intention (<s>ākūti</s>), you, <s>svāhā</s>! To desire (<s>kāma</s>), you, <s>svāhā</s>! To prosperity (<s>samṛddhi</s>), you, <s>svāhā</s>! To intention, you; to desire, you; to prosperity, you — <s>svāhā</s>!' [cf. TS 3.4.2.1 etc.] 'Complete the hymn of praise with the <s>Ṛc</s> (verse), the <s>Rathantara</s> with the <s>Gāyatra</s> [sāman]; the <s>Bṛhat</s> moves in the path of the <s>Gāyatra</s>.' [TS 3.1.10.1 etc.] '<s>Svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.8) <pṛthivyām agnaye samanaman [4.39.1-8]> iti saṃnatibhiś ca <prajāpate na tvad etāny anyaḥ [7.80(=85).3]> iti ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.8) 'On the earth, to <s>Agni</s>, salutation' [AV 4.39.1-8] — with the salutation [verses]; and 'O <s>Prajāpati</s>, no other than you [comprehends] these' [AV 7.80(=85).3] — and [with this verse].

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.9) upastīryājyaṃ sarveṣām uttarataḥ sakṛtsakṛd avadāya dvir avattam abhighārayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.9) Having spread the <s>ājya</s> (ghee), from the north of all [offerings], he cuts off once from each [portion], and sprinkles the cut [portion] twice.
(KauśS 1.5.10) Not the oblations [themselves].

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.11) <ā devānām api panthām aganma yac chaknavāma tad anupravoḍhum | agnir vidvān sa yajāt sa id dhotā so 'dhvarān sa ṛtūn kalpayāti || [sakala PS 19.47.6 = ;SS 19.59.3, RV 10.2.3 etc.]> <agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā> ity uttarapūrvārdhe_avayutaṃ hutvā sarvaprāyaścittīyān homān_juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.11) 'We have reached the path of the gods, so that we may carry [the offerings] forward as best we can. <s>Agni</s>, the knower, shall sacrifice; he is the <s>hotṛ</s> (invoker); he arranges the <s>adhvaras</s> (sacrifices) and the seasons.' [PS 19.47.6 = SS 19.59.3, RV 10.2.3 etc.] 'To <s>Agni Sviṣṭakṛt</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — Thus, in the north-eastern quarter, having offered the separated [portion], he offers all the expiatory oblations.

body.text: (KauśS_1,5.12) <svāheṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā | vaṣaḍ aniṣṭebhyaḥ svāhā | bheṣajaṃ sviṣṭyai svāhā | niṣkṛtir duriṣṭyai svāhā | daivībhyas tanūbhyaḥ svāhā | [-, cf. Baudh;SS 1.21:32.10, Hir;SS 2.6.1]> <ayāś cāgne 'sy anabhiśastiś ca satyam it tvam ayā asi | ayāsā manasā kṛto 'yās +san [ed. 'yāsya] havyam ūhiṣe | ā [+ayā?] no dhehi bheṣajam || [MS 1.4.3:51.10, KS 5.4:57.1-4, KauśS 97.4, Hir;SS 2.6.2 etc.]> <svāhā> iti | <oṃ svāhā bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥ svāhā svaḥ svāhoṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.5.12) '<s>Svāhā</s> to those [offerings] well-offered! <s>Vaṣaṭ</s>! <s>Svāhā</s> to those ill-offered! Healing for the well-offered, <s>svāhā</s>! Remedy for the ill-offered, <s>svāhā</s>! To the divine selves, <s>svāhā</s>!' 'O <s>Agni</s>, you are <s>Ayā</s> (the uninjured) and without reproach; truly you are <s>Ayā</s>. Made by the mind that is <s>Ayā</s>, being <s>Ayā</s>, you carry the oblation. Place healing upon us.' '<s>Svāhā</s>!' — thus. 'Oṃ, <s>svāhā</s>! <s>Bhūḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! <s>Bhuvaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! <s>Svaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! Oṃ, <s>bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.1) <yan me skannaṃ manaso jātavedo yad vāskandad dhaviṣo yatrayatra | utpruṣo vipruṣaḥ saṃ juhomi satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ || [ab: -, cd: VSK 2.5.3]> <svāhā> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.1) 'Whatever of mine has been spilled, O <s>Jātavedas</s> (knower of beings), or whatever has spilled from the oblation here and there — the drops, the sprinkled drops, I offer together. May the desires of the sacrificer be fulfilled!' [cf. VSK 2.5.3] '<s>Svāhā</s>!' — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.2) <yan me skannaṃ [ab: -, cd: VSK 2.38(=2.5.2)]> <yad asmṛti [7.106(=111).1]> iti ca skannāsmṛtihomau
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.2) 'Whatever of mine has been spilled' [cf. VSK 2.38(=2.5.2)], 'What [was done] with lapse of memory' [AV 7.106(=111).1] — thus [are] the oblations for what was spilled and for lapse of memory.
(KauśS 1.6.3) 'What today you, the liberal one' [AV 7.97(=102).1-8] — thus [are] the oblations with the concluding [verse].
(KauśS 1.6.4) 'O lord of mind' [AV 7.97(=102).8] — the last [oblation] with the fourfold grasping (<s>caturgṛhīta</s>).
(KauśS 1.6.5) He anoints the sacrificial grass (<s>barhis</s>) with the remainder of the <s>ājya</s> (ghee).

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.6) <pṛthivyai tvā [-]> iti mūlam <antarikṣāya tvā [-]> iti madhyaṃ <dive tvā [-]> iti agram evaṃ triḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.6) 'For the earth, you' — the base; 'For the atmosphere, you' — the middle; 'For heaven, you' — the tip. Thus three times.
(KauśS 1.6.7) 'The anointed sacrificial grass' [AV 7.98(=103).1] — thus he casts [it] forward, according to the deity.
(KauśS 1.6.8) He holds the ladle (<s>sruva</s>) in the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.9) yad ājyadhānyāṃ tat saṃsrāvayati <saṃsrāvabhāgās taviṣā bṛhantaḥ prastareṣṭhā barhiṣadaś ca devāḥ | imaṃ yajñam abhi viśve gṛṇantaḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām || [PS 20.35.2, TS 1.1.13.2-3]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.9) Whatever [remains] in the ghee-vessel, that he pours together [with the verse]: 'The gods who share the remainders, mighty, radiant — those seated on the strew, seated on the sacrificial grass — all celebrating this sacrifice, <s>svāhā</s>, may the gods, the immortals, delight!' [PS 20.35.2, TS 1.1.13.2-3] — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.10) <sruvo 'si ghṛtād aniśitaḥ sapatnakṣayaṇo divi ṣīda | antarikṣe sīda pṛthivyāṃ sīdottaro 'haṃ bhūyāsam adhare matsapatnāḥ [KS 31.14:15.20, cf. Bhār;SS 4.11.1, Aap;SS 2.4.2 etc.]> iti sruvaṃ prāgdaṇḍaṃ nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.10) 'You are the ladle, unblunted from the ghee, destroying enemies; be seated in heaven, be seated in the atmosphere, be seated on earth. May I be superior; may my rivals be below.' — Thus he places the ladle down with the handle facing east.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.11) <vi muñcāmi brahmaṇā jātavedasam agniṃ hotāram ajaraṃ rathaspṛtam | sarvā devānāṃ janimāni vidvān yathābhāgaṃ vahatu havyam agniḥ || [PS 12.19.9]> <agnaye svāhā> iti samidham ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.11) 'I release with the sacred formula <s>Jātavedas</s>, <s>Agni</s> the invoker, the ageless, who touches the chariot. Knowing all the births of the gods, may <s>Agni</s> carry the oblation according to each [deity's] share.' [PS 12.19.9] 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — thus he places the firewood.
(KauśS 1.6.12) 'You are the fuel' [AV 7.89(=94).4a] — the second [piece]; 'You are the kindling' [AV 7.89(=94).4b] — the third.
(KauśS 1.6.13) 'You are the brilliance' [AV 7.89(=94).4c] — thus he wipes the face.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.14) dakṣiṇenāgniṃ trīn viṣṇukramān kramate <viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si [10.5.25-27]> iti dakṣiṇena pādenānusaṃharati savyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.14) South of the fire he takes three strides of <s>Viṣṇu</s> — 'This is the stride of <s>Viṣṇu</s>' [AV 10.5.25-27] — with the right foot he draws the left [foot] alongside.
(KauśS 1.6.15) 'The turning of the sun' [AV 10.5.37] — thus he turns to the right (<s>pradakṣiṇa</s>).
(KauśS 1.6.16) 'We have reached heaven' [AV 16.9.3-4] — thus he looks at the sun (<s>Āditya</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.17) <indrasya vacasā vayaṃ mitrasya varuṇasya ca | brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ pātraṃ punar utthāpayāmasi || [-, cf. 6.85.2ab, PS 19.6.2ab, AVPariś 37.19.2]> ity apareṇāgnim udapātraṃ parihṛtyottareṇāgnim <āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ [1.5.1-5?]> iti mārjayitvā barhiṣi patnyāñjalau ninayati <samudraṃ vaḥ pra hiṇomi [10.5.23-24]> iti <idaṃ janāsaḥ [1.32.1-4]?> iti vā
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.17) 'By the word of <s>Indra</s>, of <s>Mitra</s>, and of <s>Varuṇa</s>, we raise up again the vessel established by <s>Brahman</s>.' [cf. AV 6.85.2ab, PS 19.6.2ab, AVPariś 37.19.2] — Thus, passing the water-vessel behind the fire [to the] north of the fire, having sipped water [with the verse] 'O waters, you are indeed bliss-bestowing' [AV 1.5.1-5?], he pours [the water] into the wife's cupped hands upon the sacrificial grass [with the verse] 'I send you forth to the ocean' [AV 10.5.23-24], or [with] 'This, O people' [AV 1.32.1-4?].
(KauśS 1.6.18) 'May I become the wife of a hero' — thus she wipes her face.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.19) <vratāni vratapataye [cf. KauśS 5.6.16(=42.17): PS 19.51.4]> iti samidham ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.19) 'The vows to the lord of vows' [cf. KauśS 5.6.16(=42.17): PS 19.51.4] — thus he places the firewood.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.20) <satyaṃ tvartena [cf. TB 2.1.11.1]> iti pariṣicya_udañci havirucchiṣṭāny udvāsayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.20) 'With truth by the cosmic order (<s>ṛta</s>)' [cf. TB 2.1.11.1] — having sprinkled [water] around, he removes the remnants of the oblation northward.
(KauśS 1.6.21) A full vessel [is] the sacrificial fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.22) <nādakṣiṇaṃ haviḥ kurvīta yaḥ kurute kṛtyām ātmanaḥ kurute [cf. KS 37.12:93.3f.]> iti brāhmaṇam
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.22) 'One should not make an oblation without a sacrificial fee; whoever does so performs sorcery upon himself' [cf. KS 37.12:93.3f.] — thus [says] the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [text].
(KauśS 1.6.23) He feeds the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> as the <s>anvāhārya</s> (supplementary meal).

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.24) yad vai yajñasyānanvitaṃ bhavati tad anvāhāryeṇānvāhriyate
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.24) Whatever of the sacrifice has not been properly completed — that is supplemented by the <s>anvāhārya</s>.
(KauśS 1.6.25) This is the supplementary nature of the <s>anvāhārya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.26) <īḍyā vā anye devāḥ saparyeṇyā anye | devā īḍyā devā brāhmaṇāḥ saparyeṇyāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.26) 'Some gods are to be praised, others are to be honored. The gods are to be praised; the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> are to be honored.
(KauśS 1.6.27) By the sacrifice itself he gratifies those to be praised; by the <s>anvāhārya</s>, those to be honored.
(KauśS 1.6.28) Thus both [groups] are gratified at his sacrifice.'
(KauśS 1.6.29) These two — the new-moon and full-moon [sacrifices] — have been explained.
(KauśS 1.6.30) The <s>pākayajñas</s> (simple domestic sacrifices) [are modeled] on the new-moon and full-moon [sacrifices].
(KauśS 1.6.32) One should offer from the pot-cooking (<s>kumbhīpāka</s>) itself as the extracted [portion].

(KauśS 1.6.33) Having consecrated [the offering] with the [procedures of] placing on the fire (<s>adhiśrayaṇa</s>), carrying fire around (<s>paryagnikaraṇa</s>), sprinkling with ghee (<s>abhighāraṇa</s>), removing (<s>udvāsana</s>), adorning (<s>alaṃkaraṇa</s>), and winnowing (<s>utpavana</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.34) athāpi ślokau bhavataḥ <ājyabhāgāntaṃ prāktantram ūrdhvaṃ sviṣṭakṛtā saha | havīṃṣi yajña āvāpo yathā tantrasya tantavaḥ [-, attributed to GB by Sāyaṇa I, p. 349] ||> <pākayajñān samāsādya_ekājyān ekabarhiṣaḥ | ekasviṣṭakṛtaḥ kuryāt_nānāpi sati daivate_iti || [AaśvGS 1.3.10]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.34) And now there are two verses: 'The entire procedure up to the <s>ājyabhāga</s> [constitutes] the framework (<s>tantra</s>); above [that], together with the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>, the oblations in the sacrifice are the warp, like the threads of a woven fabric.' 'Having assembled the <s>pākayajñas</s> (simple domestic sacrifices), with one [portion of] ghee, one [spread of] sacrificial grass, one <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s>, one should perform [them] — even when the deities are different.' [AāśvGS 1.3.10]
(KauśS 1.6.35) By this same [procedure], the new-moon [sacrifice] has been explained.
(KauśS 1.6.36) The <s>Aindrāgna</s> (offering to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>) is the second [offering] on that [occasion].

body.text: (KauśS_1,6.37) tayor vyatikrame <tvam agne vratapā asi [19.59]> <kāmas tad agre [19.52]> iti śāntāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.6.37) In case of a transgression of those two, [the expiation is performed with the verses] 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are the guardian of vows' [AV 19.59] and 'Desire, that in the beginning' [AV 19.52] — as pacificatory [rites].
(KauśS 1.7.1) He eats; when there is no [specific] instruction, [the offering is] a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked oblation).
(KauśS 1.7.2) In rites for prosperity (<s>puṣṭikarma</s>), [one uses a cow] with a calf of the same color.
(KauśS 1.7.3) He offers clarified butter (<s>ājya</s>).
(KauśS 1.7.4) He places a fuel-stick (<s>samidh</s>).
(KauśS 1.7.5) He scatters rice, barley, and sesame.
(KauśS 1.7.6) He eats the flavors of milk-rice and cake (<s>puroḍāśa</s>).
(KauśS 1.7.7) He offers gruel (<s>mantha</s>) and rice (<s>odana</s>).
(KauśS 1.7.8) First [comes] the <s>Triṣaptīya</s> [rite].
(KauśS 1.7.9) At a direction involving water, one should approach with a water-vessel.
(KauśS 1.7.10) From the east and north, he gathers the materials.
(KauśS 1.7.11) [Materials taken] from trees, [but] not from within the reach of cattle.
(KauśS 1.7.12) [Materials taken] from the east of sunrise.
(KauśS 1.7.13) The performance of rites [takes place] in the wilderness, to the east and north.

body.text: (KauśS_1,7.14) uttarata udakānte prayujya karmāṇy apāṃ sūktair āplutya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya apa upaspṛśyānavekṣamāṇā grāmam udāvrajanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.7.14) Having performed the rites to the north at the water's edge, having bathed with the water-hymns, having turned around clockwise (<s>pradakṣiṇa</s>), having touched water, they return to the village without looking back.
(KauśS 1.7.15) Tying, binding, bathing, riding, and eating — [these rites] involve remnants (<s>saṃpāta</s>).
(KauśS 1.7.16) All [materials and procedures] are to be consecrated with <s>mantras</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,7.17) strīvyādhitāv āplutāvasiktau śirastaḥ prakramyā prapadāt pramārṣṭi
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.7.17) In [rites for] women and the sick, having bathed and sprinkled [them], proceeding from the head, he wipes from head to toe.
(KauśS 1.7.18) Having first washed the feet, he gives [the offering].
(KauśS 1.7.19) [He takes] the thirteenth and following three [herbs], soaks them in curds and honey, and ties them on.
(KauśS 1.7.20) He makes [the patient] eat.
(KauśS 1.7.21) For one who has grasped [the sacrificial animal], [there follow] consecrations and oblations.
(KauśS 1.7.22) Behind the fire, the preparation of the offerings [is done] on a hide.
(KauśS 1.7.23) A lump of ox-dung.
(KauśS 1.7.24) A hide [from an animal] killed while alive.
(KauśS 1.7.25) A stone without edges.
(KauśS 1.7.26) For bathings and sprinklings, he also makes [the patient] sip water.
(KauśS 1.7.27) Of those [rites] involving remnants, he eats or anoints.
(KauśS 1.7.28) For those involving fuel laid on [the fire], he draws in the smoke.
(KauśS 1.7.29) The performance of rites [is done] in a state of purity.

body.text: (KauśS_1,8.1) purastāddhomavatsu niśākarmasu pūrvāhṇe yajñopavītī śālāniveśamaṃ samūhayaty upavatsyadbhaktam aśitvā snāto_ahatavasanaḥ prayuṅkte
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.8.1) For rites that include an oblation beforehand and night-rites, in the forenoon, wearing the sacred thread (<s>yajñopavīta</s>), he sweeps the hall, fasts until the offering meal, and after bathing, wearing fresh garments, he performs [the rite].
(KauśS 1.8.2) And in <s>svastyayana</s> (benedictory) rites.
(KauśS 1.8.3) For those who have performed sacrifices, he carries the directional offerings (<s>bali</s>).
(KauśS 1.8.4) He worships in each direction.
(KauśS 1.8.5) In all cases, the fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>) is the prerogative of the officiating priest.
(KauśS 1.8.6) The water-rite [is performed] three times.
(KauśS 1.8.7) Successive [rites] are equal and connected.
(KauśS 1.8.8) The materials [should be] purified.
(KauśS 1.8.9) Everything [belongs] to the one who is authorized [to perform the rite].

body.text: (KauśS_1,8.10) viṣaye [ed. viśaye; see Caland, AZ, aḷ.; Speijer Museum 9 249 disagrees] yathāntaram
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.8.10) In the domain [of application], according to the interval [between rites].
(KauśS 1.8.11) With [the verse] '<s>pra yacha parśum</s>' [AV 12.3.31], he gives <s>darbha</s>-grass and salt.
(KauśS 1.8.12) With [the verse] '<s>arātīyoḥ</s>' [AV 10.6.1], he carves.
(KauśS 1.8.13) With [the verse] '<s>yat tvā śikvaḥ</s>' [AV 10.6.3], he washes.
(KauśS 1.8.14) With [the verse] '<s>yat yat kṛṣṇaḥ</s>' [AV 12.3.13], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.

(KauśS 1.8.15) <s>Palāśa</s>, <s>udumbara</s>, <s>jambu</s>, <s>kāmpīla</s>, garland[-tree], <s>vaṅgha</s>, <s>śirīṣa</s>, <s>sraktya</s>, <s>varaṇa</s>, <s>bilva</s>, <s>jaṅgiḍa</s>, <s>kuṭaka</s>, <s>garhya</s>, <s>galāvala</s>, <s>vetasa</s>, <s>śimbala</s>, <s>sipuna</s>, <s>syandana</s>, fire-drill (<s>araṇikā</s>), stone-yoke, <s>tunyu</s>, and <s>pūtudāru</s> — [these are] pacificatory [woods].

(KauśS 1.8.16) Funeral-pyre [wood], expiatory [wood], <s>śamī</s>, <s>śamakā</s>, [with] bamboo, <s>śāmyavākā</s>, <s>talāśa</s>, <s>palāśa</s>, <s>vāśā</s>, <s>śiṃśapā</s>, <s>śimbala</s>, <s>sipuna</s>, <s>darbha</s>-grass, <s>apāmārga</s>, a lump in the [proper] shape, termite-mound fat, tips of <s>dūrvā</s>-grass, rice, and barley — [these are] pacificatory [materials].
(KauśS 1.8.17) <s>Pramanda</s>, <s>uśīra</s>, <s>śalalī</s>, <s>upadhāna</s>, and <s>śakadhūma</s> — [these are] aging [substances].
(KauśS 1.8.18) Lead, river-lead, iron-dust, a chameleon's head — [these are] binding [agents].
(KauśS 1.8.19) Curds, clarified butter, honey-water — these are the liquids.
(KauśS 1.8.20) Rice, barley, wheat, <s>upavāka</s>, sesame, <s>priyaṅgu</s> (millet), and <s>śyāmāka</s> (barnyard millet) — these are the mixed grains.
(KauśS 1.8.21) [Each hymn is used] from one reference up to [the next] reference.
(KauśS 1.8.22) One should employ [the hymns] according to their meaning and future effect.

body.text: (KauśS_1,8.23) <ihaiva dhruvām [3.12]> <eha yātu [6.73]> <yamo mṛtyuḥ [6.93]> <satyaṃ bṛhat [12.1]> ity anuvāko vāstoṣpatīyāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.8.23) '<s>ihaiva dhruvām</s>' [AV 3.12], '<s>eha yātu</s>' [AV 6.73], '<s>yamo mṛtyuḥ</s>' [AV 6.93], '<s>satyaṃ bṛhat</s>' [AV 12.1] — this section [comprises] the <s>Vāstoṣpatīya</s> (house-lord) hymns.

body.text: (KauśS_1,8.24) <divyo gandharvaḥ [2.2]> <imaṃ me agne [6.111]> <yau te mātā [8.6]> iti mātṛnāmāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.8.24) '<s>divyo gandharvaḥ</s>' [AV 2.2], '<s>imaṃ me agne</s>' [AV 6.111], '<s>yau te mātā</s>' [AV 8.6] — these are the <s>Mātṛnāman</s> (mother-name) hymns.

body.text: (KauśS_1,8.25) <stuvānam [1.7]> <idaṃ haviḥ [1.8]> <nissālām [2.14]> <arāyakṣayaṇam [2.18.3]> <śaṃ no devī pṛśniparṇī [2.25]> <ā paśyati [4.20]> <tānt satyaujāḥ [4.36]> <tvayā pūrvam [4.37]> <purastād yuktaḥ [5.29]> <rakṣohaṇam [8.3-4]> iti anuvākaś cātanāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.8.25) '<s>stuvānam</s>' [AV 1.7], '<s>idaṃ haviḥ</s>' [AV 1.8], '<s>nissālām</s>' [AV 2.14], '<s>arāyakṣayaṇam</s>' [AV 2.18.3], '<s>śaṃ no devī pṛśniparṇī</s>' [AV 2.25], '<s>ā paśyati</s>' [AV 4.20], '<s>tānt satyaujāḥ</s>' [AV 4.36], '<s>tvayā pūrvam</s>' [AV 4.37], '<s>purastād yuktaḥ</s>' [AV 5.29], '<s>rakṣohaṇam</s>' [AV 8.3-4] — this section [comprises] the <s>cātana</s> (expelling) hymns.

body.text: (KauśS_1,9.1) <ambayo yanti [1.4]> <śaṃbhumayobhū [1.5-6]> <hiraṇyavarṇāḥ [1.33]> <nissālām [2.14]> <ye agnayaḥ [3.21.1-7]> <brahma jajñānam [4.1.1]> ity ekā <uta devāḥ [4.13]> mṛgārasūktāny uttamaṃ varjayitvā [4.23-29] <apa naḥ śośucad agham [4.33]> <punantu mā [6.19]> <sasruṣīḥ [6.23]> <himavataḥ prasravanti [6.24]> <vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa [6.51]> <śaṃ ca no mayaś ca naḥ [6.57.3]> <anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ prathamaṃ [6.59]> <mahyam āpaḥ [6.61]> <vaiśvānaro raśmibhiḥ [6.62]> <yamo mṛtyuḥ [6.93]> <viśvajit [6.107]> <saṃjñānam naḥ [7.52]> <yady antarikṣe [7.66]> <punar maitv indriyam [7.67]> <śivā naḥ [7.68.3]> <śaṃ no vāto vātu [7.69]> <agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn [11.6]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.9.1) '<s>ambayo yanti</s>' [AV 1.4], '<s>śaṃbhumayobhū</s>' [AV 1.5-6], '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33], '<s>nissālām</s>' [AV 2.14], '<s>ye agnayaḥ</s>' [AV 3.21.1-7], '<s>brahma jajñānam</s>' [AV 4.1.1] — [this is] one [group]; '<s>uta devāḥ</s>' [AV 4.13], the <s>Mṛgāra</s>-hymns omitting the last [AV 4.23-29], '<s>apa naḥ śośucad agham</s>' [AV 4.33], '<s>punantu mā</s>' [AV 6.19], '<s>sasruṣīḥ</s>' [AV 6.23], '<s>himavataḥ prasravanti</s>' [AV 6.24], '<s>vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa</s>' [AV 6.51], '<s>śaṃ ca no mayaś ca naḥ</s>' [AV 6.57.3], '<s>anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ prathamaṃ</s>' [AV 6.59], '<s>mahyam āpaḥ</s>' [AV 6.61], '<s>vaiśvānaro raśmibhiḥ</s>' [AV 6.62], '<s>yamo mṛtyuḥ</s>' [AV 6.93], '<s>viśvajit</s>' [AV 6.107], '<s>saṃjñānaṃ naḥ</s>' [AV 7.52], '<s>yady antarikṣe</s>' [AV 7.66], '<s>punar maitv indriyam</s>' [AV 7.67], '<s>śivā naḥ</s>' [AV 7.68.3], '<s>śaṃ no vāto vātu</s>' [AV 7.69], '<s>agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn</s>' [AV 11.6].
(KauśS 1.9.2) With '<s>pṛthivyai śrotrāya</s>' [AV 6.10], he sprinkles three times.

body.text: (KauśS_1,9.3) <ambayo yanti [1.4]> <śaṃbhumayobhū [1.5-6]> <hiraṇyavarṇāḥ [1.33]> śaṃtatīyaṃ ca [4.13] <yady antarikṣe [7.66]> <punar maitv indriyam [7.67]> <śivā naḥ [7.68.3]> <śaṃ no vāto vātu [7.69]> <agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn [11.6]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.9.3) '<s>ambayo yanti</s>' [AV 1.4], '<s>śaṃbhumayobhū</s>' [AV 1.5-6], '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33], and the <s>Śaṃtatīya</s> [section] [AV 4.13], '<s>yady antarikṣe</s>' [AV 7.66], '<s>punar maitv indriyam</s>' [AV 7.67], '<s>śivā naḥ</s>' [AV 7.68.3], '<s>śaṃ no vāto vātu</s>' [AV 7.69], '<s>agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīn</s>' [AV 11.6].
(KauśS 1.9.4) With '<s>pṛthivyai śrotrāya</s>' [AV 6.10], he sprinkles three times.
(KauśS 1.9.5) These are the [hymns] employed with pacificatory [rites].
(KauśS 1.9.6) The <s>Sāvitrī</s> [verse is recited] on both sides; '<s>śaṃ no devī</s>' [AV 1.6] on both sides.
(KauśS 1.9.7) Wearing a fresh garment, he prepares the pacificatory water in a bronze vessel.

body.text: (KauśS_1,9.8) <atisṛṣṭo apāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ [16.1.1]> ity apo_atisṛjya sarvā imā āpa oṣadhaya iti pṛṣṭvā sarvā ity ākhyāta oṃ bṛhaspatiprasūtaḥ karavāṇīty anujñāpya_oṃ savitṛprasūtaḥ kurutāṃ bhavān ity anujñātaḥ kurvīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.9.8) With '<s>atisṛṣṭo apāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ</s>' [AV 16.1.1], having released the waters, and having asked 'Are all these waters [and] herbs [present]?', and being told 'All,' having requested permission with 'Oṃ, impelled by <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, may I perform [it],' and being permitted with 'Oṃ, impelled by <s>Savitṛ</s>, may you perform [it],' he should perform [the rite].

(KauśS 1.9.9) 'He should perform with the former [formula]' — thus [say the teachers] <s>Gārgya</s>, <s>Pārthaśravasa</s>, <s>Bhāgali</s>, <s>Kāṅkāyana</s>, <s>Uparibabhrava</s>, <s>Kauśika</s>, <s>Jāṭikāyana</s>, and <s>Kaurupatha</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_1,9.10) anyatarayā kurvīteti yuvā kauśiko yuvā kauśikaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1.9.10) 'He should perform with either one' — thus [says] the young <s>Kauśika</s>.

body.text: (KauśS 1 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 1, Colophon) Thus ends the first chapter in the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> of the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS 2.1[10].1) [Hymns] of the preceding [section are used for rites] generating intelligence (<s>medhājanana</s>).
(KauśS 2.1[10].2) He ties on the tongues of a parrot, <s>sārikā</s> [bird], and an emaciated [creature].
(KauśS 2.1[10].3) He makes [the person] eat [them].
(KauśS 2.1[10].4) He places [fuel-sticks] of <s>udumbara</s>, <s>palāśa</s>, and <s>karkandhū</s>.
(KauśS 2.1[10].5) He scatters [offerings into the fire].
(KauśS 2.1[10].6) He eats [the remainder].
(KauśS 2.1[10].7) He gives alms-food to the teacher (<s>upādhyāya</s>).
(KauśS 2.1[10].8) He recites the <s>mantra</s> into the ear of one who is asleep.
(KauśS 2.1[10].9) While approaching, he mutters [the <s>mantra</s>].
(KauśS 2.1[10].10) Parched grains mixed with clarified butter, [offered as] a complete oblation (<s>sarvahuta</s>).
(KauśS 2.1[10].11) Having offered [grains] mixed with sesame, he partakes [of the remainder].

body.text: (KauśS_2,1[10].12) purastād agneḥ kalmāṣam daṇḍaṃ nihatya paścād agneḥ kṛṣṇājine dhānā anumantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.1[10].12) Having planted a spotted staff in front of the fire, behind the fire on a black antelope skin, he recites <s>mantras</s> over the parched grains.
(KauśS 2.1[10].13) Having reached the end of the hymn, he gives [them].
(KauśS 2.1[10].14) He offers once [into the fire].
(KauśS 2.1[10].15) He gives the staff, parched grains, and the skin [as a gift].

body.text: (KauśS_2,1[10].16) <ahaṃ rudrebhir [4.30]> iti śuklapuṣpaharitapuṣpe kiṃstyanābhipippalyau jātarūpaśakalena prāk stanagrahāt prāśayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.1[10].16) With '<s>ahaṃ rudrebhir</s>' [AV 4.30], with a white flower and a green flower, <s>kiṃstyāna</s> and long pepper, together with a piece of gold — before [the child begins] grasping the breast, he feeds [it].

body.text: (KauśS_2,1[10].17) prathamapravadasya mātur upasthe tālūni saṃpātān ānayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.1[10].17) Of a child speaking for the first time, on the mother's lap, he brings the remnants to the palate.
(KauśS 2.1[10].18) He feeds [the child] curds and honey.
(KauśS 2.1[10].19) He makes the initiated student recite — a rite [to be performed] annually.

body.text: (KauśS_2,1[10].20) <tvaṃ no medhe [6.108]> <dyauś ca ma [12.1.35]> iti bhakṣayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.1[10].20) With '<s>tvaṃ no medhe</s>' [AV 6.108] and '<s>dyauś ca ma</s>' [AV 12.1.35], he eats.
(KauśS 2.1[10].21) He worships the sun (<s>Āditya</s>).
(KauśS 2.1[10].22) With '<s>yad agne tapasā</s>' [AV 7.61], on the full-moon day of <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s> (Mārgaśīrṣa), he eats.
(KauśS 2.1[10].23) He worships the fire (<s>Agni</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_2,1[10].24) <prātar agniṃ [3.16]> <girāv aragarāṭeṣu [6.69]> <divaspṛthivyāḥ [6.125.2]> iti saṃhāya mukhaṃ vimārṣṭi
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.1[10].24) With '<s>prātar agniṃ</s>' [AV 3.16], '<s>girāv aragarāṭeṣu</s>' [AV 6.69], and '<s>divaspṛthivyāḥ</s>' [AV 6.125.2], having gathered [water], he wipes the face.
(KauśS 2.2[11].1) [Hymns] of the preceding [section are used for] rites of acquiring the qualities of a <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student).
(KauśS 2.2[11].2) Beginning with [fuel-sticks of] <s>udumbara</s>.
(KauśS 2.2[11].3) The <s>brahmacārin</s> takes bedding-materials from his dwelling.
(KauśS 2.2[11].4) On an ant-hill, [he offers] fat, honey, <s>śyāmāka</s> [millet], <s>īṣīka</s>-grass, and cotton, [and] offers clarified butter.

body.text: (KauśS_2,2[11].5) ājyaśeṣe pipīlikodvāpān opya grāmam etya sarvahutān
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.2[11].5) Having poured the ant-hill [earth] into the remaining clarified butter, going to the village, [he offers them as] a complete oblation.
(KauśS 2.2[11].6) He gives food, parched grains mixed with sesame, to <s>brahmacārins</s> (celibate students).
(KauśS 2.2[11].7) These are the rites of acquiring [qualities] in the village.
(KauśS 2.2[11].8) Carvings at the base of posts [in the shape of] modifications — these are the beddings for assembly halls.
(KauśS 2.2[11].9) Food [is given] to the villagers.
(KauśS 2.2[11].10) Liquor to the liquor-drinkers.
(KauśS 2.2[11].11) The <s>udumbara</s> [wood] and the rest, up to the eating — [these are] all the acquiring-rites.
(KauśS 2.2[11].12) He makes the light three times.
(KauśS 2.2[11].13) He worships.
(KauśS 2.2[11].14) From the left palm [held at] the heart, he eats blood mixed with liquid.
(KauśS 2.2[11].15) A drink churned with <s>pṛśni</s> [herb].

body.text: (KauśS_2,2[11].16) jihvāyā utsādyam akṣyoḥ +paristaraṇaṃ mastṛhaṇaṃ [ed. paristaraṇamastṛhaṇaṃ; see MSS 34 (1976), p. 23f.] hṛdayaṃ dūrśa upanahya tisro rātrīḥ palpūlane vāsayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.2[11].16) [He takes] what is to be scraped from the tongue, an application for the eyes, [something for] rubbing the head, the heart, and <s>dūrśa</s> [grass] — having wrapped [them together], he soaks them for three nights in a <s>palpūlana</s> (straining vessel).
(KauśS 2.2[11].17) He makes [them into] powder.
(KauśS 2.2[11].18) Having stirred [the powder] into a gruel of mixed grains, mixed with curds and honey, he eats.

body.text: (KauśS_2,2[11].19) <asmin vasu [1.9]> <yad ābadhnan [1.35]> <nava prāṇān [5.28]> iti yugmakṛṣṇalaṃ vāsitaṃ badhnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.2[11].19) With '<s>asmin vasu</s>' [AV 1.9], '<s>yad ābadhnan</s>' [AV 1.35], and '<s>nava prāṇān</s>' [AV 5.28], he ties on a pair of black [berries/beads] that have been soaked.

body.text: (KauśS_2,2[11].20) sārūpavatsaṃ puruṣagātraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ saṃpātavantaṃ kṛtvānabhimukhan aśnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.2[11].20) Having made [the offering] with a calf of the same color, [using] a human body-part, for twelve nights, with remnants, he eats [it] without facing [the fire].
(KauśS 2.3[12].1) With '<s>kathaṃ mahe</s>' [AV 5.11], he eats milk-rice cooked with <s>mādānaka</s> [plant].

body.text: (KauśS_2,3[12].2) camase sarūpavatsāyā dugdhe vrīhiyavāvavadhāya mūrchayitvā madhv āsicyāśyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.3[12].2) In a cup, having poured rice and barley into [milk] drawn from a cow with a calf of the same color, having curdled [it], and having poured honey [in], he feeds [the person].
(KauśS 2.3[12].3) With '<s>pṛthivyai śrotrāya</s>' [AV 6.10], he offers.
(KauśS 2.3[12].4) With '<s>vatso virājo</s>' [AV 13.1.33], up to the gruel-[rites].

body.text: (KauśS_2,3[12].5) <sahṛdayaṃ [3.30]> <tad ū ṣu [5.1.5]> <saṃ jānīdhvam [6.64]> <eha yātu [6.73]> <saṃ vaḥ pṛcyantāṃ [6.74]> <saṃ vo manāṃsi [6.94]> <saṃjñānaṃ naḥ [7.52]> iti sāṃmanasyāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.3[12].5) '<s>sahṛdayaṃ</s>' [AV 3.30], '<s>tad ū ṣu</s>' [AV 5.1.5], '<s>saṃ jānīdhvam</s>' [AV 6.64], '<s>eha yātu</s>' [AV 6.73], '<s>saṃ vaḥ pṛcyantām</s>' [AV 6.74], '<s>saṃ vo manāṃsi</s>' [AV 6.94], '<s>saṃjñānaṃ naḥ</s>' [AV 7.52] — these are the <s>sāṃmanasya</s> (concord-producing) hymns.

body.text: (KauśS_2,3[12].6) udakūlijaṃ saṃpātavantaṃ grāmaṃ parihṛtya madhye ninayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2.3[12].6) Having carried a pot-remnant with remnants around the village, he brings it to the center.
(KauśS 2,3[12].7) Likewise [is the rite] using <s>surā</s> (liquor) dregs.

body.text: (KauśS_2,3[12].8) trihāyaṇyā vatsataryāḥ śuktyāni [see Caland, ZR] piśitāny āśayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,3[12].8) He feeds [the patient] pieces of flesh cut from the oyster-shells [i.e., hooves] of a three-year-old heifer.
(KauśS 2,3[12].9) He prepares cooked rice, <s>surā</s>, and a drink, with the remainder [of the offering].
(KauśS 2,3[12].10) Of the preceding [rite], with [the hymn] '<s>mamāgne varco</s>' [AV 5.3], [are the rites] for splendor (<s>varcasya</s>).
(KauśS 2,3[12].11) Three [offerings] beginning with <s>audumbara</s> (fig-wood) [materials].
(KauśS 2,3[12].12) He consecrates the right thigh of a maiden.
(KauśS 2,3[12].13) He offers the omentum (<s>vapā</s>) [into the fire].
(KauśS 2,3[12].14) He attends to the fire.
(KauśS 2,3[12].15) With [the hymns] '<s>prātar agnim</s>' [AV 3.16], '<s>girāv aragarāṭeṣu</s>' [AV 6.69], '<s>divaspṛthivyāḥ</s>' [AV 6.125.2], he feeds [the patient] curds and honey.
(KauśS 2,3[12].16) [He feeds] a <s>kṣatriya</s> [curds and honey] mixed with <s>kīlāla</s> (a sweet drink); to others, [plain] <s>kīlāla</s>.
(KauśS 2,4[13].1) With [the hymn] '<s>hastivarcasam</s>' [AV 3.22], [he performs the rite using] an elephant.
(KauśS 2,4[13].2) He ties on [an amulet] of elephant ivory.
(KauśS 2,4[13].3) Having smeared hairs with lac and covered [them] with gold,

(KauśS 2,4[13].4) with [the hymns] '<s>siṃhe vyāghre</s>' [AV 6.38], '<s>yaśo haviḥ</s>' [AV 6.39], [he uses] the navel-hairs of a <s>snātaka</s> (graduate), a lion, a tiger, a he-goat, a black bull, and a king.
(KauśS 2,4[13].5) Chips of ten pacifying trees.

body.text: (KauśS_2,4[13].6) etayoḥ <prātar agniṃ [3.16]> <girāv aragarāṭeṣu [6.69]> <divaspṛthivyāḥ [6.125.2]> iti sapta marmāṇi sthālīpāke pṛktāny aśnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,4[13].6) Of these two [rites], with [the hymns] '<s>prātar agnim</s>' [AV 3.16], '<s>girāv aragarāṭeṣu</s>' [AV 6.69], '<s>divaspṛthivyāḥ</s>' [AV 6.125.2], he eats seven vital points [i.e., seven portions], mixed in the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked oblation).

body.text: (KauśS_2,4[13].7) akuśalaṃ yo brāhmaṇo lohitam aśnīyād iti gārgyaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,4[13].7) <s>Gārgya</s> [says]: 'It is inauspicious for a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> to eat blood.'
(KauśS 2,4[13].8) The hair-amulet (<s>lomamaṇi</s>) has been described.
(KauśS 2,4[13].9) He bathes [the patient] with all [the materials].
(KauśS 2,4[13].10) He pours over [the patient].
(KauśS 2,4[13].11) Having sprinkled a four-finger[-long] blade of grass with a drop of the dust-remover and having churned [it],

body.text: (KauśS_2,4[13].12) śuni kilāsam aje palitaṃ tṛṇe jvaro yo_asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas tasmin rājayakṣma iti dakṣiṇā tṛṇaṃ nirasyati gandhapravādābhir alaṃ kurute
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,4[13].12) [saying:] 'In the dog, the skin-disease; in the goat, grey hair; in the grass, fever; whoever hates us and whomever we hate — in him, consumption' — he casts the grass to the south, and adorns [the patient] with fragrances and garlands.
(KauśS 2,5[14].1) Of the preceding [rite, he uses] elephant leather straps.
(KauśS 2,5[14].2) He rolls back with a chariot wheel that has the remainder [of the offering].
(KauśS 2,5[14].3) He advances with a vehicle.
(KauśS 2,5[14].4) With musical instruments.
(KauśS 2,5[14].5) Having put pebbles into a leather bag and cloth,
(KauśS 2,5[14].6) with a goad, concealed naked,

body.text: (KauśS_2,5[14].7) <vidmā śarasya [1.2]> <mā no vidan [1.19]> <adārasṛd [1.20]> <svastidā [1.21]> <ava manyur [6.65]> <nirhastaḥ [6.66]> <pari vartmāny [6.67]> <abhibhūr [6.97]> <indro jayāti [6.98]> <abhi tvendra [6.99]> iti sāṃgrāmikāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,5[14].7) with [the hymns] '<s>vidmā śarasya</s>' [AV 1.2], '<s>mā no vidan</s>' [AV 1.19], '<s>adārasṛd</s>' [AV 1.20], '<s>svastidā</s>' [AV 1.21], '<s>ava manyuḥ</s>' [AV 6.65], '<s>nirhastaḥ</s>' [AV 6.66], '<s>pari vartmāni</s>' [AV 6.67], '<s>abhibhūḥ</s>' [AV 6.97], '<s>Indro jayāti</s>' [AV 6.98], '<s>abhi tvā Indra</s>' [AV 6.99] — these are the battle rites (<s>sāṃgrāmika</s>).
(KauśS 2,5[14].8) He offers ghee mixed with barley-meal.
(KauśS 2,5[14].9) On a fuel-pile [shaped like] a bow, he places a bow as the fuel-stick.
(KauśS 2,5[14].10) Likewise on an arrow fuel-pile.
(KauśS 2,5[14].11) Having wiped the bow with the remainder [of the offering], he presents it.
(KauśS 2,5[14].12) Of the first [rite], the arrow-ceremonies.
(KauśS 2,5[14].13) He ties [together] the roots of <s>drughna</s>, <s>ārtnī</s>, bowstring, noose, and grass.
(KauśS 2,5[14].14) With [the hymn] '<s>āre asāv</s>' [AV 1.26], the repelling rites.
(KauśS 2,5[14].15) He scatters husked grain, chaff, and sawdust.
(KauśS 2,5[14].16) He recites after [the offering].

body.text: (KauśS_2,5[14].17) <agnir naḥ śatrūn [3.1]> agnir no dūtaḥ [3.2]> iti mohanāni
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,5[14].17) With [the hymns] '<s>agnir naḥ śatrūn</s>' [AV 3.1], '<s>agnir no dūtaḥ</s>' [AV 3.2], the bewildering rites (<s>mohana</s>).
(KauśS 2,5[14].18) Having taken up with cooked rice, he offers husked grains with a mortar.
(KauśS 2,5[14].19) Likewise fine [grains].
(KauśS 2,5[14].20) He winnows with twenty-one pebbles.
(KauśS 2,5[14].21) He worships the waters.
(KauśS 2,5[14].22) With [the hymn] '<s>saṃśitam</s>' [AV 3.19], he releases a black-footed [cow] with the remainder [of the offering].
(KauśS 2,5[14].23) When [the enemies] swell up, he should yoke [the forces].
(KauśS 2,5[14].24) With [the hymns] '<s>imam Indra</s>' [AV 4.22 & 4.23], the rites ending with gift-giving for the two yoked [horses].
(KauśS 2,5[14].25) With the two direction-yoking [hymns, AV 3.26 & 3.27] and '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13], he attends [to the fire].
(KauśS 2,5[14].26) With [the hymns] '<s>tvayā Manyo</s>' [AV 4.31], '<s>yas te Manyo</s>' [AV 4.32], the rousing rites.
(KauśS 2,5[14].27) Looking toward the army, he murmurs [the hymns].

body.text: (KauśS_2,5[14].28) bhāṅgamauñjān pāśan iṅgiḍālaṃkṛtān saṃpātavato_anūktān senākrameṣu vapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,5[14].28) He scatters nooses of hemp and <s>muñja</s> grass, adorned with <s>iṅgiḍa</s> (a substance), with the remainder [of the offering], after reciting, at the passages of the army.
(KauśS 2,5[14].29) Likewise unbaked vessels.
(KauśS 2,5[14].30) Having sprinkled with <s>iṅgiḍa</s>, he kindles grasses with the <s>Āṅgirasa</s> fire.
(KauśS 2,5[14].31) Whichever [direction] the smoke pervades, that one they conquer.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].1) <ṛdhaṅ mantras [5.1]> <tad id āsa [5.2]> ity āśvatthyāṃ pātryāṃ trivṛti gomayaparicaye hastipṛṣṭhe puruṣaśirasi vāmitrāñ juhvad abhiprakramya nivapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].1) With [the hymns] '<s>ṛdhaṅ mantraḥ</s>' [AV 5.1], '<s>tad id āsa</s>' [AV 5.2], in an <s>aśvattha</s> (fig-wood) vessel, in a triple [wrapping] of cow-dung, on an elephant's back or a man's head, having stepped forward while offering the <s>ātmitrā</s> [oblations], he scatters.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].2) +varāhavihatād [ed. varāhavihitād; Caland, Kl.Schr. p. 70] rājāno vediṃ kurvanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].2) Kings make a ritual altar from [ground] dug up by a boar.
(KauśS 2,6[15].3) On it, [they perform] the rites ending with gift-giving.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].4) ekeṣvā hatasyādahane_upasamādhāya dīrghadaṇḍeṇa sruveṇa rathcakrasya khena samayā juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].4) In some [rites], having placed [the fire] upon the spot where one has been slain and not cremated, he offers with a long-handled ladle through the hole of a chariot wheel, while aligning [it].
(KauśS 2,6[15].5) Having heard [the signal for] yoking, he should yoke [the forces].

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].6) <yadi cin nu tvā [5.2.4]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13]> ity anvāha
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].6) With [the hymns] '<s>yadi cin nu tvā</s>' [AV 5.2.4], '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13], he recites after [the offering].
(KauśS 2,6[15].7) For a <s>vaiśya</s>, the rites ending with gift-giving.
(KauśS 2,6[15].8) With [the hymn] '<s>tvayā vayam</s>' [AV 5.2.5], for a weapon-bearer or village-chief.
(KauśS 2,6[15].9) With [the hymn] '<s>ni tad dadhiṣe</s>' [AV 5.2.6], the king should inspect the water-vessel, two by two.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].10) +yaṃ [ed.: yan; Caland, Kl.Schr. p. 57] na paśyed na yudhyeta
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].10) Whoever he does not see, that one should not fight.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].11) <ni tad dadhiṣe [5.2.6]> <vanaspate [12.3.33]> <ayā viṣṭhā [7.3]> <agna indraś [7.110]> <diśas catasro [8.8.22]> iti navaṃ rathaṃ rājānaṃ sasārathim āsthāpayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].11) With [the hymns] '<s>ni tad dadhiṣe</s>' [AV 5.2.6], '<s>vanaspate</s>' [AV 12.3.33], '<s>ayā viṣṭhā</s>' [AV 7.3], '<s>agna Indraḥ</s>' [AV 7.110], '<s>diśaś catasraḥ</s>' [AV 8.8.22], he mounts the king together with his charioteer on a new chariot.
(KauśS 2,6[15].12) With [the hymn] '<s>brahma jajñānam</s>' [AV 5.6], the knowledge of life-span.
(KauśS 2,6[15].13) Having placed three sinew-ropes upon the embers,
(KauśS 2,6[15].14) when they curl up, [it is] auspicious.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].15) sāṃgrāmikam etā vyādiśati madhye mṛtyur itare sene
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].15) He declares this battle rite: death in the middle [means the enemies]; the other two [the two armies].

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].16) parājeṣyamāṇān mṛtyur ativartate jyeṣyanto mṛtyum [note conj. Speijer Museum 9 249]
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].16) Death passes over those who are about to be defeated; those about to conquer [pass over] death.

body.text: (KauśS_2,6[15].17) agreṣūtkucatsu mukhyā hanyante madhyeṣu madhyā anteṣu_avare
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,6[15].17) When the front [ropes] curl up, the leaders are slain; in the middle [ropes], the middle [ranks]; at the ends, the inferior [ranks].
(KauśS 2,6[15].18) Likewise [with] reed-stalks.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].1) <uccair ghoṣo [5.20]> <upa śvāsaya [6.126]> iti sarvavāditrāṇi prakṣālya tagara_uśīreṇa saṃdhāvya saṃpātavanti trir āhatya prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].1) With [the hymns] '<s>uccair ghoṣaḥ</s>' [AV 5.20], '<s>upa śvāsaya</s>' [AV 6.126], having washed all musical instruments, having rubbed [them] with <s>tagara</s> (fragrant powder) and <s>uśīra</s> (vetiver), with the remainder [of the offering], having struck [them] three times, he presents [them].
(KauśS 2,7[16].2) With [the hymn] '<s>vihṛdayam</s>' [AV 5.21], having offered in a loud voice, [he goes about] turning the ladle upward.
(KauśS 2,7[16].3) Having sewn a <s>Soma</s> shoot onto a deer skin, he ties [it] to a <s>kṣatriya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].4) <pari vartmāni [6.67]> <indro jayāti [6.98]> iti rājā triḥ senāṃ pariyāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].4) With [the hymns] '<s>pari vartmāni</s>' [AV 6.67], '<s>Indro jayāti</s>' [AV 6.98], the king circumambulates the army three times.
(KauśS 2,7[16].5) The <s>Soma</s> shoot of the preceding [rite] has been described.
(KauśS 2,7[16].6) With [the hymns] '<s>saṃdānaṃ vaḥ</s>' [AV 6.103], '<s>ādānena</s>' [AV 6.104], the binding and seizing rites with nooses.
(KauśS 2,7[16].7) With [the hymn] '<s>marmāṇi te</s>' [AV 7.118], he arms the <s>kṣatriya</s> [in armor].
(KauśS 2,7[16].8) The conclusion of the fearlessness [rites].
(KauśS 2,7[16].9) With [the hymn] '<s>Indro manthatu</s>' [AV 8.8],
(KauśS 2,7[16].10) with [the verse] '<s>pūtirajjuḥ</s>' [AV 8.8.2ab], having placed a rotten rope,
(KauśS 2,7[16].11) he churns fire between <s>aśvattha</s> (fig) and <s>badhaka</s> (binding) woods.
(KauśS 2,7[16].12) With [the verse] '<s>dhūmam</s>' [AV 8.8.2cd], he consecrates the smoke.
(KauśS 2,7[16].13) With [the verse] '<s>agnim</s>' [AV 8.8.2cd], the fire.
(KauśS 2,7[16].14) On that fire in the forest, he places [fuel-sticks for] the destruction of enemies — of <s>aśvattha</s>, <s>badhaka</s>, <s>tājadbhaṅga</s>, <s>āhva</s>, <s>khadira</s>, and reeds.
(KauśS 2,7[16].15) The nooses have been described.
(KauśS 2,7[16].16) Clubs of <s>aśvattha</s> [wood], traps, nets of hemp.
(KauśS 2,7[16].17) Staves of <s>badhaka</s> [wood].
(KauśS 2,7[16].18) With [the formula] '<s>svāhaibhyaḥ</s>' [AV 8.8.24cd], he offers to allies.
(KauśS 2,7[16].19) With [the formula] '<s>durāhāmībhyaḥ</s>' [AV 8.8.24cd], [he offers] <s>iṅgiḍa</s> with the left hand to enemies, upon <s>badhaka</s> [wood].

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].20) uttarato_agner lohitāśvatthasya śākhāṃ nihatya nīlalohitābhyāṃ sūtrābhyāṃ paritatya <nīlalohitenāmūn [8.8.24e]> iti dakṣiṇā prahāpayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].20) To the north of the fire, having driven in a branch of a red <s>aśvattha</s> tree and having wound it with blue and red threads, with [the formula] '<s>nīlalohitenāmūn</s>' [AV 8.8.24e], he makes [it] fall to the south.
(KauśS 2,7[16].21) With [the hymns] '<s>ye bāhavaḥ</s>' [AV 11.9], '<s>ut tiṣṭhata</s>' [AV 11.10], he dispatches [warriors] according to their insignia.
(KauśS 2,7[16].22) For the oblation, ghee mixed with curds (<s>pṛṣadājya</s>).
(KauśS 2,7[16].23) The scattering rites ending with gift-giving.
(KauśS 2,7[16].24) With the scatterings, [rites are performed] at the three junctures [of the day], in the form of thunderbolts, in the form of <s>Arbuda</s>.
(KauśS 2,7[16].25) He ties a black-footed [cow] with the remainder [of the offering] to the <s>kṣatriya</s>'s armrest with a <s>darbha</s>-grass rope.
(KauśS 2,7[16].26) He casts the second one.
(KauśS 2,7[16].27) With [the hymn] '<s>asmin vasu</s>' [AV 1.9], the rite for gaining a kingdom.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].28) ānuśūkānāṃ vrīhīṇām āvraskajaiḥ kāmpīlaiḥ śṛtaṃ sārūpavatsam āśayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].28) He feeds [the king] rice that has been husked [in a specific way], cooked with <s>kāmpīla</s> [herbs], with a calf of the same color.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].29) <abhīvartena [1.29]> iti rathanemimaṇim ayaḥsīsaloharajatatāmraveṣṭitaṃ hemanābhiṃ vāsitaṃ baddhvā sūtrotaṃ barhiṣi kṛtvā saṃpātavantaṃ pratyṛcaṃ bhṛṣṭīr abhīvarttottamābhyām ācṛtati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].29) With [the hymn] '<s>abhīvartena</s>' [AV 1.29], having made a chariot-rim amulet — wrapped with iron, lead, tin, silver, and copper, with a golden hub, perfumed, tied, strung on a thread, placed on sacred grass, with the remainder [of the offering] — he anoints verse by verse with the last two verses of the <s>Abhīvarta</s> [hymn] the roasting spits.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].30) <acikradat [3.3]> <ā tvā gan [3.4]> iti yasmād rāṣṭrād avaruddhas tasyāśāyāṃ śayanavidhaṃ puroḍāśaṃ darbheṣūdake ninayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].30) With [the hymns] '<s>acikradat</s>' [AV 3.3], '<s>ā tvā gan</s>' [AV 3.4], in the direction from which kingdom he has been expelled, he lowers a sacrificial cake prepared on <s>darbha</s> grass, lying down, into the water.

body.text: (KauśS_2,7[16].31) tato loṣṭena jyotir āyatanaṃ saṃstīrya kṣīraudanam aśnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,7[16].31) Then, having spread a clod of earth as a fire-seat, he eats milk-rice.
(KauśS 2,7[16].32) From wherever the clod [comes], from there [come] the ritual materials.
(KauśS 2,7[16].33) For the three [rites], at the morning meal, they call upon [the deities] at the sacrificial cake.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].1) <bhūto bhūteṣu [4.8]> iti rājānam abhiṣekṣyan mahānade śāntyudakaṃ karoty ādiṣṭānām
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,8[17].1) With [the hymn] '<s>bhūto bhūteṣu</s>' [AV 4.8], about to consecrate a king, he prepares pacificatory water at a great river, of the prescribed [materials].

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].2) sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā dakṣiṇataḥ parigṛhyāyā darbheṣu tiṣṭhantam abhiṣiñcati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,8[17].2) Having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-oblation), having enclosed [the king] from the south, he consecrates [him] standing on <s>darbha</s> grass.
(KauśS 2,8[17].3) He makes [the king] mount a bull's hide on a couch.
(KauśS 2,8[17].4) They pour water-vessels together.
(KauśS 2,8[17].5) They exchange garments.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].6) sahaiva nau sukṛtaṃ saha duṣkṛtam iti brahmā brūyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,8[17].6) The <s>brahman</s> priest should say: 'Shared between us is the merit, shared is the sin.'

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].7) yo duṣkṛtaṃ karavat tasya duṣkṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ nau saheti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,8[17].7) 'Whoever commits sin — his is the sin; the merit is shared between us.'
(KauśS 2,8[17].8) He feeds [the king].
(KauśS 2,8[17].9) Having mounted a horse, he grants [the king] invincibility.
(KauśS 2,8[17].10) A thousand [cows] with the choice of a village is the ritual fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>).
(KauśS 2,8[17].11) [The rite] up to the exchange of garments has been explained in connection with a single king.
(KauśS 2,8[17].12) He consecrates [the king] on a couch upon <s>darbha</s> grass.
(KauśS 2,8[17].13) Over a greater [king], he makes [him] mount a tiger skin.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].14) catvāro rājaputrās tālpāḥ pṛthakpādeṣu śayanaṃ parāmṛśya sabhāṃ prāpayanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2,8[17].14) Four princes, seated on the couch, touching the bed at each of its feet, convey [the king] to the assembly hall.
(KauśS 2,8[17].15) A servant washes [his] feet.
(KauśS 2,8[17].16) A chief <s>śūdra</s> pours water.
(KauśS_2,8[17].17) He selects the completed and prepared dice up to the third time.
(KauśS_2,8[17].18) The <s>Vaiśya</s> approaches the one born of all his possessions, [saying] 'Release, O long-lived one.'

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].19) utsṛjāmi brāhmaṇāya_utsṛjāmi kṣatriyāya_utsṛjāmi vaiśyāya dharmo me janapade caryatām iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].19) 'I release for the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, I release for the <s>Kṣatriya</s>, I release for the <s>Vaiśya</s> — let <s>dharma</s> be practiced in my domain,' thus.
(KauśS_2,8[17].20) He accepts.
(KauśS_2,8[17].21) He causes [him] to eat.
(KauśS_2,8[17].22) Having mounted a horse, he leads [him] to <s>Aparājitā</s> (the unconquered [place]).
(KauśS_2,8[17].23) He goes up to the assembly hall.
(KauśS_2,8[17].24) He feeds the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> with honey-mixed [food].
(KauśS_2,8[17].25) He causes [them] to taste the juices.
(KauśS_2,8[17].26) He approaches the buffalo products.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].27) kuryur gām iti gārgyapārthaśravasau neti bhāgaliḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].27) 'One should offer a cow' — thus [say] <s>Gārgya</s> and <s>Pārthaśravas</s>; 'No' — thus <s>Bhāgali</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].28) <imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ me [4.22]> iti kṣatriyaṃ prātaḥ_prātar abhimantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].28) With '<s>imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ me</s>' [AV 4.22], he addresses the <s>Kṣatriya</s> every morning.
(KauśS_2,8[17].29) The sprinkling and the wrapping around have been stated.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].30) <savitā prasavānām [5.24]> iti paurohitye vatsyan vaiśvalopīḥ samidha ādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].30) With '<s>savitā prasavānām</s>' [AV 5.24], when about to take up the office of <s>purohita</s>, having placed fuel-sticks of the <s>Vaiśvalopa</s> [type],
(KauśS_2,8[17].31) with '<s>indra kṣatram</s>' [RV 7.84.2], he should initiate the <s>Kṣatriya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].32) tad āhur na kṣatriyaṃ sāvitrīṃ vācayed iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].32) Regarding that, they say: one should not cause a <s>Kṣatriya</s> to recite the <s>Sāvitrī</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_2,8[17].33) kathaṃ nu tam upanayīta yan na vācayed
body.translated_text: (KauśS_2,8[17].33) How then should one initiate him if one does not cause him to recite?
(KauśS_2,8[17].34) He should indeed cause him to recite, he should indeed cause him to recite.

body.text: (KauśS 2 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 2 Colophon) Thus ends the second chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_3,1[18].1) pūrvasya pūrvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyām astamita udakānte kṛṣṇacailaparihito nirṛtikarmāṇi prayuṅkte
body.translated_text: (KauśS_3,1[18].1) On the full moon of the first [fortnight], after sunset, at the water's edge, clad in a black garment, he performs the rites of <s>Nirṛti</s> (destruction).
(KauśS_3,1[18].2) He should bury a potsherd at the southward-turning [bend] of a navigable [river].
(KauśS_3,1[18].3) He sprinkles with the water hymns.
(KauśS_3,1[18].4) He casts a black [object] into the waters.
(KauśS_3,1[18].5) Putting on an unworn garment and sandals, he goes out to the <s>jīvaghātyā</s> (life-destroying [ritual ground]).
(KauśS_3,1[18].6) Having gone away, on the next [full moon] he performs the concluding rite.

body.text: (KauśS_3,1[18].7) śāpeṭam ālipyāpsu nibadhya tasminn upasamādhāya saṃpātavantaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_3,1[18].7) Having smeared the potsherd and bound it in water, having placed [offerings] upon it, he performs the rite with remainders.
(KauśS_3,1[18].8) He eats.
(KauśS_3,1[18].9) Having placed [fire], he sets afloat a black [object].

body.text: (KauśS_3,1[18].10) upamucya jaradupānahau savyena jarat_chattraṃ dakṣiṇena śālātṛṇāṇy ādīpya jīrṇaṃ vīriṇam abhinyasyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_3,1[18].10) Putting on old sandals, [holding] with the left hand an old umbrella, with the right hand having kindled hall-grasses, he places [them] on old <s>vīriṇa</s> grass.
(KauśS_3,1[18].11) Having covered what was uncovered, he offers into the fire once.
(KauśS_3,1[18].12) He casts the left [sandal] and the sandals.

body.text: (KauśS_3,1[18].13) jīrṇe vīriṇa upasamādhāya <ayaṃ te yonir [3.20]> iti jaratkoṣṭhād vrīhīñ śarkarāmiśrān āvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_3,1[18].13) Having placed [offerings] on the old <s>vīriṇa</s> grass, with '<s>ayaṃ te yonir</s>' [AV 3.20], he pours rice mixed with gravel from an old granary.
(KauśS_3,1[18].14) With '<s>ā no bhara</s>' [AV 5.7], parched grains.
(KauśS_3,1[18].15) A third [offering] together with the two granary [offerings].

body.text: (KauśS_3,1[18].16) kṛṣṇaśakuneḥ savyajaṅghāyām aṅkam anubadhyāṅke puroḍāśaṃ <pra patetaḥ [7.115]> iti anāvṛtaṃ prapādayati
