body.text: (KauśS_5,2[38].8) <namas te astu [1.13.1]> <yas te pṛthu stanayitnur [7.11.1]> ity aśaniyuktam apādāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 5.2[38].8) With '<s>namas te astu</s>' [AV 1.13.1], '<s>yas te pṛthu stanayitnur</s>' [AV 7.11.1] — having removed one struck by lightning,

(KauśS 5.2[38].9) Of the first [hymn] — <s>soma</s>, <s>darbha</s>-grass, hair, <s>anīka</s>, <s>kuṣṭha</s>, lac, <s>mañjiṣṭhī</s>, <s>badara</s>, and turmeric — having wrapped [them] with a birch-bark piece, he buries [them] in the center of a field with gruel on the head.
(KauśS 5.2[38].10) He eats curds with a new [vessel], until harvest time.
(KauśS 5.2[38].11) The <s>Āśāpālīya</s> [section], omitting the third [verse] — these are the strengthening [rites].
(KauśS 5.2[38].12) Of the earthly [section] — these are the leather-bag rites.
(KauśS 5.2[38].13) He places cakes on stones at the inner door-posts.
(KauśS 5.2[38].14) Both [sets of] remnants.
(KauśS 5.2[38].15) And at the assembly [hall], in the share-holders' [places].
(KauśS 5.2[38].16) Without heat, lying on one side of the fire-sanctuary, he mutters the earthly [hymn].

body.text: (KauśS_5,2[38].17) <iyaṃ vīrun [1.34.1]>_iti madughaṃ khādann aparājitāt pariṣadam āvrajati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 5.2[38].17) With '<s>iyaṃ vīrun</s>' [AV 1.34.1], eating <s>madugha</s> [honey-plant], he walks from the unconquered [place] to the assembly.
(KauśS 5.2[38].18) With '<s>nec chatruḥ</s>' [AV 2.27.1] — <s>pāṭā</s>-root eaten beforehand.
(KauśS 5.2[38].19) He recites.
(KauśS 5.2[38].20) He ties [it] on.
(KauśS 5.2[38].21) He wears a garland of seven <s>palāśa</s> [leaves].
(KauśS 5.2[38].22) With '<s>ye bhakṣayanto</s>' [AV 2.35.1], in the assembly, eating one meal, gazing [at the others], he eats.
(KauśS_5,2[38].23) With '<s>brahma jajñānam</s>' [AV 4.1.1], when about to begin the course of study, he utters [the verse].
(KauśS_5,2[38].24) When about to narrate a tale,
(KauśS_5,2[38].25) when about to speak a theological riddle (<s>brahmodya</s>),
(KauśS_5,2[38].26) with '<s>mamāgne varco</s>' [AV 5.3.1], when about to partake, he ties the negligence-cord.
(KauśS_5,2[38].27) With '<s>sabhā ca mā</s>' [AV 7.12.1], he partakes.
(KauśS_5,2[38].28) He grasps the pillars [and] stands near.
(KauśS_5,2[38].29) With '<s>yad vadāmi</s>' [AV 12.1.58], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_5,2[38].30) With '<s>aham asmi</s>' [AV 12.1.54], from the unconquered [place] (<s>Aparājita</s>) he enters the assembly.
(KauśS_5,3[39].1) With '<s>dūṣyā dūṣir asi</s>' [AV 2.11.1], he ties on the <s>srāktya</s> amulet.
(KauśS_5,3[39].2) In front of the fire, he has a tawny cow brought.
(KauśS_5,3[39].3) Behind the fire, a red she-goat.
(KauśS_5,3[39].4) For the purpose of broth and meat.
(KauśS_5,3[39].5) As stated in the <s>mantras</s>.
(KauśS_5,3[39].6) Having placed <s>vāśā</s>, <s>kāmpīla</s>, <s>sitīvāra</s>, and <s>sadaṃpuṣpā</s> [herbs],

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].7) <dūṣyā duṣir asi [2.11.1]> <ye purastāj [4.40.1]>_<īśānāṃ tvā [4.17.1]> <samaṃ jyotiḥ [4.18.1]>_<uto asy abandhukṛd [4.19.1]>_<suparṇas tvā [5.14.1]>_<yāṃ te cakrur [5.31.1]> <ayaṃ pratisaro [8.5.1]> <yāṃ kalpayanti [10.1.1]>_iti mahāśāntim āvapate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].7) with '<s>dūṣyā dūṣir asi</s>' [AV 2.11.1], '<s>ye purastāt</s>' [AV 4.40.1], '<s>īśānāṃ tvā</s>' [AV 4.17.1], '<s>samaṃ jyotiḥ</s>' [AV 4.18.1], '<s>uto asy abandhukṛt</s>' [AV 4.19.1], '<s>suparṇas tvā</s>' [AV 5.14.1], '<s>yāṃ te cakrur</s>' [AV 5.31.1], '<s>ayaṃ pratisaro</s>' [AV 8.5.1], '<s>yāṃ kalpayanti</s>' [AV 10.1.1], he performs the great pacificatory rite (<s>mahāśānti</s>).
(KauśS_5,3[39].8) At night, having removed [the amulet], wearing a turban, sprinkling in front, he goes.

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].9) yatāyai yatāyai śāntāyai śāntivāyai bhadrāyai bhadrāvati syonāyai śagmāyai śivāyai sumaṅgali prajāvati suśīme [ed.: +susīme]_ahaṃ vāmābhūr iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].9) [Saying:] 'To the controlled one, to the controlled one, to the pacified one, to the one with peace, to the auspicious one, to the one with auspiciousness, to the comfortable one, to the gentle one, to the benign one — O auspicious lady, rich in offspring, O fair one, I have become yours.'
(KauśS_5,3[39].10) From non-existence he casts away.

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].11) kṛtyayāmitracakṣuṣā samīkṣan [note Speijer Museum 9 251: conj. samakṣaṃ] <kṛtavyadhani [5.14.9]>_ity avaliptaṃ kṛtyayā vidhyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].11) Looking at [the enemy] with the eye of sorcery, with '<s>kṛtavyadhani</s>' [AV 5.14.9], he pierces the one smeared [with the substance] with the sorcery.
(KauśS_5,3[39].12) The scraping-instrument as stated.

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].13) <dūṣyā duṣir asi [2.11.1]>_iti darvyā triḥ sārūpavatsenāpodakena mathitena gulphān pariṣiñcati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].13) With '<s>dūṣyā dūṣir asi</s>' [AV 2.11.1], with a ladle, three times, with [urine of] a cow with a same-colored calf, waterless, churned, he sprinkles around the ankles.
(KauśS_5,3[39].14) Having poured with a potsherd, he causes [the patient] to eat the broth and meat.

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].15) yaṣṭibhis_carma pinahya praiṣakṛt parikramya bandhān muñcati saṃdaṃśena
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].15) Having fastened the hide with sticks, the <s>praiṣakṛt</s> (commander), having gone around, loosens the bonds with tongs.
(KauśS_5,3[39].16) He lays [the patient] down on the other side.
(KauśS_5,3[39].17) With a potsherd, as stated.
(KauśS_5,3[39].18) With '<s>abhyaktā</s>' [AV 10.1.25], with fresh butter, as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_5,3[39].19) Having bound with a <s>darbha</s>-grass rope, with '<s>uttiṣṭhaiva</s>' [AV 10.1.20c], he raises [the patient] up.
(KauśS_5,3[39].20) Holding a lamp with the left hand and a water-gourd with the right, observing silence,
(KauśS_5,3[39].21) the <s>praiṣakṛt</s> (commander) goes in front.
(KauśS_5,3[39].22) Uncovered.
(KauśS_5,3[39].23) Where there is no cow's footprint.
(KauśS_5,3[39].24) Where no water-channel has been dug.

body.text: (KauśS_5,3[39].25) dakṣiṇāpravaṇe vā svayaṃdīrṇe vā svakṛte vā_iriṇe_anyāśāyāṃ vā nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,3[39].25) On a slope inclined to the south, or on naturally split ground, or on self-made [ground], or on barren ground, or in another direction, he places [the offering].
(KauśS_5,3[39].26) Having extinguished the lamp with the gourd, with '<s>yathā sūryo</s>' [AV 10.1.32], having turned around, he returns.
(KauśS_5,3[39].27) Standing, he loudly recites the great pacificatory [formula] to the standing [patient].
(KauśS_5,3[39].28) They sprinkle the vital points.
(KauśS_5,3[39].29) He ploughs with a black ploughshare.
(KauśS_5,3[39].30) Over the ploughshares, ten gifts (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>).
(KauśS_5,3[39].31) The places for sorcery are known in the <s>mantras</s> — those are the vital points.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].1) <yad adaḥ saṃprayatīr [3.13.1]> iti yena_ichet_nadī pratipadyeta_iti prasiñcan vrajati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].1) With '<s>yad adaḥ saṃprayatīr</s>' [AV 3.13.1], when one wishes a river to turn — sprinkling, he goes.
(KauśS_5,4[40].2) He presses down <s>kāśa</s> grass, <s>divi</s> grass, <s>dhuvaka</s>, and <s>vetasa</s> (cane).
(KauśS_5,4[40].3) With '<s>idaṃ va āpo</s>' [AV 3.13.7a], he places gold upon [them].
(KauśS_5,4[40].4) With '<s>ayaṃ vatsa</s>' [AV 3.13.7b], having tied a reed-frog with blue and red [threads] together with a tuft,
(KauśS_5,4[40].5) with '<s>ihettham</s>' [AV 3.13.7c], he covers it with <s>avakā</s> (aquatic plant).
(KauśS_5,4[40].6) With '<s>yatredaṃ</s>' [AV 3.13.7d], he carries [it] down.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].7) mārutaṃ kṣīraudanaṃ mārutaśṛtaṃ mārutaiḥ paristīrya mārutena sruveṇa mārutenājyena varuṇāya trir juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].7) Having prepared rice-milk for <s>Maruts</s>, cooked with wind-[hymns], having spread around with wind-[hymns], with a wind-[hymn] ladle and wind-[hymn] ghee, he offers three times to <s>Varuṇa</s>.
(KauśS_5,4[40].8) The churning has been stated.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].9) dadhimanthaṃ baliṃ hṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇībhyāṃ prasiñcan vrajati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].9) Having offered a <s>bali</s> (offering) of curd-<s>mantha</s> (stirred drink), sprinkling with the two sprinkling vessels, he goes.
(KauśS_5,4[40].10) Having struck back with the hand or with a cane, he lies down upon it.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].11) <ayaṃ te yonir [3.20.1]> ity araṇyor agniṃ samāropayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].11) With '<s>ayaṃ te yonir</s>' [AV 3.20.1], he places fire upon the fire-sticks (<s>araṇi</s>).
(KauśS_5,4[40].12) Or upon himself.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].13) <upāvaroha jātavedaḥ punar devo devebhyo havyaṃ vaha prajānan | ānandino modamānāḥ suvīrā indhīmahi tvā śaradāṃ śatāni [cf. TB 2.5.8.8, ;Sāṅkh;SS 2.17.1, ;SāṅhGS 5.1.7]>_ity upāvarohayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].13) With 'Descend, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, carry the oblation again to the gods, being wise. May we, joyful, delighting, having good heroes, kindle you for a hundred autumns' [cf. TB 2.5.8.8], he brings [the fire] down.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].14) <yāṃ tvā gandharvo akhanad [4.4.1 (= PS 4.5.1)]> <vṛṣaṇas te khanitāro vṛṣā tvam asy oṣadhe | vṛṣāsi vṛṣṇyāvati vṛṣaṇe tvā khanāmasi [PS 4.5.2]>_ity ucchuṣmāparivyādhāv āyasena khanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].14) With '<s>yāṃ tvā gandharvo akhanat</s>' [AV 4.4.1 (= PS 4.5.1)], 'Your diggers are vigorous, you are vigorous, O herb; you are vigorous and possessed of vigor — we dig you up for the vigorous one' [PS 4.5.2], for [the cure of] <s>ucchuṣma</s> (burning) and <s>parivyādha</s> (piercing pain), he digs with an iron [instrument].

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].15) dugdhe phāṇṭau_+adhijyam upastha+ (ed.: adijyopastha; cf. Bloomfield, SBE 42, p. 369, n. 2) ādhāya pibati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].15) Having placed [the herb] in milk, in the two <s>phāṇṭa</s> (straining) [vessels], upon the lap, he drinks.

body.text: (KauśS_5,4[40].16) mayūkhe musale vāsīno <yathāsitaḥ [6.72.1]>_ity ekārkasūtram ārkaṃ badhnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,4[40].16) On a beam or pestle, sitting, with '<s>yathāsitaḥ</s>' [AV 6.72.1], he ties an <s>arka</s>-thread amulet made from a single <s>arka</s> plant.
(KauśS_5,4[40].17) With '<s>yāvad aṅgīnaṃ</s>' [AV 6.72.3], [he ties] a black-stemmed [plant] with a black tail-hair.
(KauśS_5,4[40].18) With '<s>ā vṛṣāyasva</s>' [AV 6.101.1], he approaches both.
(KauśS_5,5[41].1) With '<s>samutpatantu</s>' [AV 4.15.1], '<s>pra nabhasva</s>' [AV 7.18.1], one desiring rain should fast for twelve nights.
(KauśS_5,5[41].2) He rests from all observances.
(KauśS_5,5[41].3) He worships the <s>Maruts</s>, as he makes offerings to <s>Varuṇa</s>.
(KauśS_5,5[41].4) Having brought in herbs with remainders, he turns [them] upside down.
(KauśS_5,5[41].5) He should flood [them].
(KauśS_5,5[41].6) Having tied a dog's head, a ram's head, hair, and old sandals to the tip of a bamboo, he makes [them] fight.

body.text: (KauśS_5,5[41].7) udapātreṇa saṃpātavatā saṃprokṣyāmapātraṃ tripāde_aśmānam avadhāyāpsu nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,5[41].7) Having sprinkled with a water vessel containing remainders, having placed a stone in a water vessel on a three-legged [stand], he places [it] in the waters.

body.text: (KauśS_5,5[41].8) <ayaṃ te yonir [3.20.1]> <ā no bhara [5.7.1]> <dhītī vā [7.1.1]>_ity artham utthāsyann upadadhīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,5[41].8) With '<s>ayaṃ te yonir</s>' [AV 3.20.1], '<s>ā no bhara</s>' [AV 5.7.1], '<s>dhītī vā</s>' [AV 7.1.1], when about to rise for the purpose, he should make an offering.
(KauśS_5,5[41].9) He recites.
(KauśS_5,5[41].10) On the former <s>Āṣāḍhā</s> [asterism], he digs a pit.
(KauśS_5,5[41].11) On the latter [<s>Āṣāḍhā</s>], he fills [it] up.
(KauśS_5,5[41].12) Having spread [a surface] for the dice-play,

body.text: (KauśS_5,5[41].13) <udbhindatīṃ saṃjayantīm [4.38.1]>_<yathā vṛkṣam aśanir [7.50.1]> <idam ugrāya [7.109.1]>_iti vāsitān akṣān nivapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,5[41].13) with '<s>udbhindatīṃ saṃjayantīm</s>' [AV 4.38.1], '<s>yathā vṛkṣam aśanir</s>' [AV 7.50.1], '<s>idam ugrāya</s>' [AV 7.109.1], he casts fumigated dice.

body.text: (KauśS_5,5[41].14) <ambayo yanty [1.4.1]>_śaṃbhumayobhū [1.5, 1.6] <hiraṇyavarṇāḥ [1.33.1]>_<yad adaḥ [3.13.1]> <punantu mā [6.19.1]> <sasruṣīs [6.23.1]>_<himavataḥ pra sravanti [6.24.1]> <vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa [6.51.1]> <śaṃ ca no mayaś ca no [6.57.3]>_<anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ prathamaṃ [6.59.1]> <mahyam āpo [6.61.1]> <vaiśvānaro raśmibhir [6.62.1]> ity abhivarṣaṇāvasecanānām
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,5[41].14) With '<s>ambayo yanty</s>' [AV 1.4.1], '<s>śaṃbhu-mayobhu</s>' [AV 1.5, 1.6], '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33.1], '<s>yad adaḥ</s>' [AV 3.13.1], '<s>punantu mā</s>' [AV 6.19.1], '<s>sasruṣīs</s>' [AV 6.23.1], '<s>himavataḥ pra sravanti</s>' [AV 6.24.1], '<s>vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa</s>' [AV 6.51.1], '<s>śaṃ ca no mayaś ca no</s>' [AV 6.57.3], '<s>anaḍudbhyas tvaṃ prathamaṃ</s>' [AV 6.59.1], '<s>mahyam āpo</s>' [AV 6.61.1], '<s>vaiśvānaro raśmibhir</s>' [AV 6.62.1] — for the rain-making and sprinkling [rites].
(KauśS_5,5[41].15) With the last [hymn], using the <s>Vācaspati</s>-marked [verses], he worships the rising [sun].
(KauśS_5,5[41].16) Having bathed, wearing an unworn garment, having washed, he covers [himself] with an unworn [garment].
(KauśS_5,5[41].17) He gives [a gift].
(KauśS_5,5[41].18) With '<s>yathā māṃsam</s>' [AV 6.70.1], the utterance.
(KauśS_5,5[41].19) Having washed the calf with cow-urine, having sprinkled [it], having led [it] around three times, he trims.
(KauśS_5,5[41].20) He consecrates with <s>mantras</s> the head and ears.
(KauśS_5,5[41].21) With '<s>vātaraṃhā</s>' [AV 6.92.1], when the horse has been bathed, he carries the remainders over [it].
(KauśS_5,5[41].22) The northern [remainders] on a <s>palāśa</s> leaf among powders.
(KauśS_5,5[41].23) He causes [the horse] to sip.
(KauśS_5,5[41].24) He bathes [it].
(KauśS_5,5[41].25) He scatters powders [upon it].
(KauśS_5,5[41].26) Three times, with '<s>ekayā ca</s>' [AV 7.4.1].
(KauśS_5,6[42].1) With '<s>bhadrād adhi</s>' [AV 7.8.1], when about to set out on a journey, he should make an offering.
(KauśS_5,6[42].2) He recites.
(KauśS_5,6[42].3) Having sprinkled the vehicle, he unyokes [it].
(KauśS_5,6[42].4) He raises the goods with remainders.
(KauśS_5,6[42].5) Having wiped, he distributes.
(KauśS_5,6[42].6) With '<s>ubhā jigyathur</s>' [AV 7.44.1], with wet feet of both, the rite of mutual goodwill (<s>sāṃmanasya</s>).
(KauśS_5,6[42].7) Having conveyed the two back to the villages by vehicle, he distributes.

body.text: (KauśS_5,6[42].8) āyātaḥ samidha ādāya_<ūrjaṃ bibhrad [7.60.1]> ity asaṃkalpayann etya sakṛd ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,6[42].8) Having arrived, taking a fuel-stick, with '<s>ūrjaṃ bibhrat</s>' [AV 7.60.1], approaching without deliberation, he places [it] on [the fire] once.
(KauśS_5,6[42].9) With '<s>ṛcaṃ sāma</s>' [AV 7.54.1], he offers for the <s>anupravacanīya</s> (post-recitation rite).
(KauśS_5,6[42].10) A third with the two yoked [offerings].
(KauśS_5,6[42].11) A fourth for <s>Anumati</s>.
(KauśS_5,6[42].12) And this same offering [applies] for the return and the completion [rites].

body.text: (KauśS_5,6[42].13) <āpo divyā [7.89.1/10.5.46]> iti paryavetavrata udakānte śāntyudakam abhimantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,6[42].13) With '<s>āpo divyā</s>' [AV 7.89.1/10.5.46], one observing the ritual vow, at the water's edge, he consecrates the pacificatory water with <s>mantras</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_5,6[42].14) astamite samitpāṇir etya tṛtīyavarjaṃ samidha ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,6[42].14) After sunset, approaching with fuel-stick in hand, he places fuel-sticks, omitting the third.
(KauśS_5,6[42].15) With '<s>idāvatsarāya</s>' [PS 19.51.1-4], for the release of the vow, he should offer ghee.
(KauśS_5,6[42].16) He should add fuel-sticks.

body.text: (KauśS_5,6[42].17) <idāvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya prati vedayāma enat | yad vrateṣu duritaṃ nijagmimo durhārdaṃ tena śamalenāñjmaḥ || yan me vrataṃ vratapate lulobhāhorātre sam adhātāṃ ma enat | udyan purastād bhiṣag astu candramāḥ sūryo raśmibhir abhi gṛṇātv enat || yad vratam atipede cittyā manasā hṛdā | ādityā rudrās tan mayi vasavaś ca sam indhatām || vratāni vratapataya upā karomy agnaye | sa me dyumnaṃ bṛhad yaśo dīrgham āyuḥ kṛṇotu me || [PS 19.51.1-4]>_iti vratasamāpanīr ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,6[42].17) With [the verses]: 'To <s>Idāvatsara</s>, to <s>Parivatsara</s>, to <s>Saṃvatsara</s>, we declare this: whatever wrong we committed in our vows, with that stain of ill-will we anoint ourselves. || Whatever vow of mine, O lord of vows, I transgressed — may day and night set that right for me; may the rising moon be a healer from the east, may the sun with its rays take it up. || Whatever vow I overstepped through thought, mind, or heart — may the <s>Ādityas</s>, <s>Rudras</s>, and <s>Vasus</s> kindle that in me. || I perform the vows, O lord of vows, for <s>Agni</s>; may he grant me splendor, great fame, and long life.' [PS 19.51.1-4] — he places the vow-completing [fuel-sticks].
(KauśS_5,6[42].18) For three nights, eating tasteless food, he observes the bathed-vow.

body.text: (KauśS_5,6[42].19) <nir lakṣmyaṃ [1.18.1]>_iti pāpalakṣaṇāyā mukham ukṣati_anvṛcaṃ dakṣiṇāt keśastukāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,6[42].19) With '<s>nir lakṣmyaṃ</s>' [AV 1.18.1], he sprinkles the face of a woman with inauspicious marks, verse by verse, from the right lock of hair.
(KauśS_5,6[42].20) Having offered rice-cakes on a <s>palāśa</s> leaf, he brings back the remainder.
(KauśS_5,6[42].21) He places the rice-cake husks, chaff, and shavings on the heel of the left foot.
(KauśS_5,6[42].22) With the <s>apanodana</s> (removal) and <s>apāghā</s> (driving away) [hymns], he mutters while looking on.
(KauśS_5,6[42].23) With '<s>dīrghāyutvāya</s>' [AV 2.4.1], he ties on [the amulet] as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_5,7[43].1) With '<s>karśaphasya</s>' [AV 3.9.1], a tawny thread, an <s>aralu</s>-wood staff — that is the weapon.
(KauśS_5,7[43].2) He fumigates with rice-cakes.

body.text: (KauśS_5,7[43].3) <ati dhanvāny [7.41.1]>_ity avasānaniveśanānucaraṇātinayana+_ijyā [ed.: caraṇāni ninayannejyā; cf. Caland, AZ, p. 147, n. 2; but Bloomfield GGA 1902 512!]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,7[43].3) With <ati dhanvāny [7.41.1]>, the ritual procedure (<s>ijyā</s>) for following along, leading out, and settling at a resting place [ed.: caraṇāni ninayannejyā; cf. Caland, AZ, p. 147, n. 2; but Bloomfield GGA 1902 512!]
(KauśS_5,7[43].4) With the <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> (lord of the dwelling) hymns, he brings the materials to the south of the fire, on ground ploughed with a ploughshare (<s>kulija</s>)
(KauśS_5,7[43].5) Beginning with the <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> (lord of the dwelling) hymns, he performs the <s>mahāśānti</s> (great pacification rite)
(KauśS_5,7[43].6) In the middle pit, he deposits rice and barley on <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass)
(KauśS_5,7[43].7) In the other pits, pacification water (<s>śāntyudaka</s>), fresh grass (<s>śaṣpa</s>), and gravel (<s>śarkara</s>)
(KauśS_5,7[43].8) With <ihaiva dhruvāṃ [3.12.1]>, he consecrates the house being measured out and being raised up
(KauśS_5,7[43].9) Having anointed it, with <ṛtena [3.12.6]>, as stated in the mantra (<s>mantrokta</s>)
(KauśS_5,7[43].10) With <pūrṇaṃ nāri [3.12.8]>, taking a water pot and fire, they enter
(KauśS_5,7[43].11) With the two <s>dhruvā</s> (stability) verses, he makes it firm
(KauśS_5,7[43].12) With the two <s>śaṃbhu</s>-<s>mayobhu</s> (auspicious and blissful) verses, he makes it flow

body.text: (KauśS_5,7[43].13) <vāstoṣ pate prati jānīhy asmān svāveśo anamīvo na edhi | yat tvemahe prati nas taj juṣasva catuṣpado dvipada ā veśayeha || [PS 7.6.10]> <anamīvo vāstoṣ pate viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ || [PS 20.23.2]>_iti vāstoṣpataye kṣīraudanasya juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,7[43].13) With <vāstoṣ pate prati jānīhy asmān svāveśo anamīvo na edhi | yat tvemahe prati nas taj juṣasva catuṣpado dvipada ā veśayeha || [PS 7.6.10]> <anamīvo vāstoṣ pate viśvā rūpāṇy āviśan | sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ || [PS 20.23.2]>, he offers a milk-rice oblation (<s>kṣīraudana</s>) to <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> (lord of the dwelling)
(KauśS_5,7[43].14) He feeds the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> with all kinds of food
(KauśS_5,7[43].15) Auspicious things
(KauśS_5,7[43].16) With <ye agnayo [3.21.1-7]>, saying 'unaffected by the corpse-eating fire,' he ties a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) branch
(KauśS_5,7[43].17) He offers an oblation
(KauśS_5,7[43].18) He establishes the fire
(KauśS_5,7[43].19) With a ladle (<s>udañcana</s>), having brought barley with water into the water vessel (<s>udapātrī</s>), a handful of grain (<s>ullopa</s>)

body.text: (KauśS_5,7[43].20) <ye agnayo [3.21.1]>_iti pālāśyā darvyā mantham upamathya kāmpīlībhyām upamanthanībhyām
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,7[43].20) With <ye agnayo [3.21.1]>, he stirs the mixture (<s>mantha</s>) with a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) ladle (<s>darvī</s>), using two churning sticks (<s>upamanthanī</s>) made of <s>kāmpīla</s> wood
(KauśS_5,7[43].21) And the pacification rite (<s>śamana</s>)
(KauśS_5,8[44].1) With <ya ātmadā [4.2.1]>, the pacification of the <s>vaśā</s> (barren cow)
(KauśS_5,8[44].2) He holds it facing west, in front of the fire

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].3) paścād agneḥ prāṅmukha upaviśyānvārabdhāyai śāntyudakaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].3) Sitting behind the fire facing east, having taken hold of her, he performs the pacification water rite (<s>śāntyudaka</s>)
(KauśS_5,8[44].4) There he recites this <s>sūkta</s> (hymn) in sequence
(KauśS_5,8[44].5) With it he makes her sip and sprinkles her
(KauśS_5,8[44].6) Standing, he loudly recites the <s>mahāśānti</s> (great pacification rite) over her as she stands

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].7) <ya īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnām [2.34.1]> iti hutvā vaśām anakti śirasi kakude jaghanadeśe
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].7) With <ya īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnām [2.34.1]>, having offered an oblation, he anoints the <s>vaśā</s> (barren cow) on the head, on the hump, and in the hip region
(KauśS_5,8[44].8) He anoints one edge of the <s>svadhiti</s> (sacrificial knife)
(KauśS_5,8[44].9) With the anointed knife, he extracts the <s>vapā</s> (omentum)

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].10) dakṣiṇe pārśve darbhābhyām adhikṣipati_amuṣmai tvā juṣṭam iti yathādevatam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].10) On the right side, he places it on two <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) blades, saying 'For such-and-such deity, this is pleasing to you,' according to the deity (<s>yathādevatam</s>)

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].11) <nissālām [2.14.1]> ity ulmukena triḥ prasavyaṃ pariharati_anabhipariharan ātmānam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].11) With <nissālām [2.14.1]>, with a firebrand (<s>ulmuka</s>), he circumambulates three times in the reverse direction (<s>prasavya</s>), not encircling himself
(KauśS_5,8[44].12) He takes hold with two <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) blades
(KauśS_5,8[44].13) Behind and to the north of the fire, he lays it down with the head facing west and the feet facing north

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].14) <sam asyai tanvā bhava [- (note asyai = Genitive?)]>_ity anyataraṃ darbham avāsyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].14) With <sam asyai tanvā bhava [- (note asyai = Genitive?)]>, he places one <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) blade down
(KauśS_5,8[44].15) Then he restores the vital breaths (<s>prāṇa</s>) with <prajānantaḥ [2.34.5]>
(KauśS_5,8[44].16) Standing on the south side, he mutters the <s>rakṣohaṇa</s> (demon-destroying) formula

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].17) saṃjñaptāyāṃ juhoti <yad vaśā māyum akratoro vā paḍbhir āhata | agnir mā tasmād enaso viśvān muñcatv aṃhasaḥ [-, cf. TS 3.1.4.3, ManB 2.2.8 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].17) When it has been suffocated, he offers an oblation with <yad vaśā māyum akratoro vā paḍbhir āhata | agnir mā tasmād enaso viśvān muñcatv aṃhasaḥ [-, cf. TS 3.1.4.3, ManB 2.2.8 etc.]>
(KauśS_5,8[44].18) The wife, approaching with a water vessel (<s>udapātra</s>), washes the face and other limbs
(KauśS_5,8[44].19) 'Purify the face, for the sake of the divine sacrifice,' saying thus
(KauśS_5,8[44].20) 'The vital breaths (<s>prāṇa</s>)' — thus for the nostrils
(KauśS_5,8[44].21) 'The eye (<s>cakṣus</s>)' — thus for the two eyes
(KauśS_5,8[44].22) 'The ear (<s>śrotra</s>)' — thus for the two ears

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].23) <yat te krūraṃ yad āsthitaṃ [VSM 6.15]>_iti samantaṃ rajjudhānam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].23) With <yat te krūraṃ yad āsthitaṃ [VSM 6.15]>, the entire area of the rope-binding
(KauśS_5,8[44].24) 'The tracks (<s>caritrāṇi</s>)' — thus, gathering from the feet
(KauśS_5,8[44].25) 'The navel (<s>nābhi</s>)' — thus for the navel
(KauśS_5,8[44].26) 'The generative organ (<s>meḍhra</s>)' — thus for the generative organ
(KauśS_5,8[44].27) 'The anus (<s>pāyu</s>)' — thus for the anus

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].28) <yat te krūraṃ yad āsthitaṃ tac chundhasva [-, cf. VSM 6.14-15, TS 1.3.9.1, Baudh;SS 4.6:118.15 etc.]>_iti avaśiṣṭāḥ pārśvadeśe_avasicya yathārthaṃ vrajati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].28) With <yat te krūraṃ yad āsthitaṃ tac chundhasva [-, cf. VSM 6.14-15, TS 1.3.9.1, Baudh;SS 4.6:118.15 etc.]>, having poured the remaining water on the side area, one proceeds as appropriate

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].29) vapāśrapaṇyau_ājyaṃ sruvaṃ svadhitiṃ darbham ādāyābhivrajya_uttānāṃ +parivartyānulomaṃ (ed.: parivartmā-; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61) nābhideśe darbham āstṛṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].29) Taking the two omentum-roasting spits (<s>vapāśrapaṇī</s>), ghee (<s>ājya</s>), the offering spoon (<s>sruva</s>), the sacrificial knife (<s>svadhiti</s>), and <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass), having approached, turning her face-up, he strews <s>darbha</s> grass on the navel area following the natural direction of the hair (ed.: parivartmā-; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61)

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].30) <oṣadhe trāyasvainaṃ svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ [VSM 6.15]>_iti śastraṃ prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].30) With <oṣadhe trāyasvainaṃ svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ [VSM 6.15]>, he hands over the knife

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].31) idam aham āmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya prāṇāpānāv apakṛntāmīty apakṛtya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].31) Saying 'I cut away the <s>prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>apāna</s> (outbreath) of so-and-so, son of so-and-so,' he cuts them away
(KauśS_5,8[44].32) With a downward cut (<s>adharapravraskena</s>), having struck away the blood

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].33) idam aham āmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya prāṇāpānau nikhanāmīty āsye nikhanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].33) Saying 'I bury the <s>prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>apāna</s> (outbreath) of so-and-so, son of so-and-so,' he buries them in the mouth

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].34) <vapayā dyāvāpṛthivī prorṇuvāthām [-, cf. VSM 6.16]> iti vapāśrapaṇyau vapayā prachādya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].34) With <vapayā dyāvāpṛthivī prorṇuvāthām [-, cf. VSM 6.16]>, having covered the two omentum-roasting spits (<s>vapāśrapaṇī</s>) with the <s>vapā</s> (omentum)
(KauśS_5,8[44].35) Having pierced and cut with the sacrificial knife (<s>svadhiti</s>)
(KauśS_5,8[44].36) Having basted the cut portion (<s>āvraska</s>) with ghee

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].37) <vāyo ve [ed. vāyave, see Bloomfield AJPh 27 (1906), p.416] stokānām [VSM 6.16]> iti darbhāgraṃ prāsyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].37) With <vāyo ve [ed. vāyave, see Bloomfield AJPh 27 (1906), p.416] stokānām [VSM 6.16]>, he throws the tips of the <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass)

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].38) <pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ [TS 1.1.2.1, KauśS 1.3.9 etc.]>_iti carum aṅgāre nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].38) With <pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ [TS 1.1.2.1, KauśS 1.3.9 etc.]>, he places the pot on the coals

body.text: (KauśS_5,8[44].39) <devas tvā savitā śrapayatu [cf. VSM 1.22, TB 3.2.8.6]>_iti śrapayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,8[44].39) With <devas tvā savitā śrapayatu [cf. VSM 1.22, TB 3.2.8.6]>, he cooks it
(KauśS_5,8[44].40) He makes it well-cooked

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].1) yadi_aṣṭāpadī syād garbhamañjalau sahiraṇyaṃ sayavaṃ vā <ya ātmadā [4.2.1]> iti khadāyāṃ tryaratnau_agnau sakṛt_juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].1) If it should be an eight-legged one (a pregnant cow), in the hollow of the womb, with gold or with barley, with <ya ātmadā [4.2.1]>, he offers once into a fire in a pit three forearms deep
(KauśS_5,9[45].2) Having butchered, he should cut equal portions (<s>samavatta</s>)

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].3) <hṛdayaṃ jihvā śyenaś ca doṣī pārśve ca tāni ṣaṭ | yakṛdvṛkkau gudaśroṇī tāny ekādaśa daivatāni | [-, cf. Aap;SS 7.22.6, Kāty;SS 6.7.6 etc.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].3) <hṛdayaṃ jihvā śyenaś ca doṣī pārśve ca tāni ṣaṭ | yakṛdvṛkkau gudaśroṇī tāny ekādaśa daivatāni | [-, cf. Aap;SS 7.22.6, Kāty;SS 6.7.6 etc.]>

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].4) <dakṣiṇaḥ kapilalāṭaḥ savyā śroṇir gudaś ca yaḥ | etāni trīṇi tryaṅgāni sviṣṭakṛdbhāga eva | [-, cf. Aap;SS 7.22.6, Kāty;SS 6.7.7 etc.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].4) <dakṣiṇaḥ kapilalāṭaḥ savyā śroṇir gudaś ca yaḥ | etāni trīṇi tryaṅgāni sviṣṭakṛdbhāga eva | [-, cf. Aap;SS 7.22.6, Kāty;SS 6.7.7 etc.]>
(KauśS_5,9[45].5) Having cut those well-known portions, he should cook them
(KauśS_5,9[45].6) When about to offer, he should cut twice for each of the deities' portions
(KauśS_5,9[45].7) Once each for the <s>Sviṣṭakṛt</s> (fire that makes the offering successful) portions
(KauśS_5,9[45].8) Of the <s>vapā</s> (omentum), he offers with <samiddho [5.12.1]> and <ūrdhvā asya [5.27.1]>
(KauśS_5,9[45].9) The third with both combined
(KauśS_5,9[45].10) The fourth to <s>Ānumatī</s> (goddess of consent)

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].11) <jātavedo vapayā gacha devāṃs tvaṃ hi hotā prathamo babhūtha | ghṛtasyāgne tanvā saṃ bhava satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ svāhā | [cf. TS 3.1.4.4]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].11) <jātavedo vapayā gacha devāṃs tvaṃ hi hotā prathamo babhūtha | ghṛtasyāgne tanvā saṃ bhava satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ svāhā | [cf. TS 3.1.4.4]>

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].12) ūrdhvanabhasaṃ [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. ūrdhvaṃ nabhasaṃ] gachatam iti vapāśrapaṇyau_anupraharati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].12) With 'Go upward to the sky,' he sends the two omentum-roasting spits (<s>vapāśrapaṇī</s>) after [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. ūrdhvaṃ nabhasaṃ]
(KauśS_5,9[45].13) The one pointing east with one prong, the one pointing west with two prongs

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].14) <vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitān vettha nihitān parāke | medasaḥ kulyā upa tān sravantu satyā eṣām āśiṣaḥ santu kāmāḥ svāhā svadhā [see 84.1, cf. ManB 2.3.18, VSM 35.20]>_iti vapāyās trir juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].14) With <vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitān vettha nihitān parāke | medasaḥ kulyā upa tān sravantu satyā eṣām āśiṣaḥ santu kāmāḥ svāhā svadhā [see 84.1, cf. ManB 2.3.18, VSM 35.20]>, he offers from the <s>vapā</s> (omentum) three times
(KauśS_5,9[45].15) Of the equal portions (<s>samavatta</s>)

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].16) sthālīpākasya <samrāḍ asy adhiśrayaṇaṃ nāma sakhīnām abhy ahaṃ viśvā āśāḥ sākṣīya | kāmo 'si kāmāya tvā sarvavīrāya sarvapuruṣāya sarvagaṇāya sarvakāmāya juhomi | anv adya no 'numatiḥ pūṣā sarasvatī mahī | yat karomi tad ṛdhyatām anumataye svāhā [-]>_iti juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].16) Of the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (cooked grain offering), he offers with <samrāḍ asy adhiśrayaṇaṃ nāma sakhīnām abhy ahaṃ viśvā āśāḥ sākṣīya | kāmo 'si kāmāya tvā sarvavīrāya sarvapuruṣāya sarvagaṇāya sarvakāmāya juhomi | anv adya no 'numatiḥ pūṣā sarasvatī mahī | yat karomi tad ṛdhyatām anumataye svāhā [-]>

body.text: (KauśS_5,9[45].17) <ka idaṃ kasmā adāt [3.29.7-8]> <kāmas tad agre [19.52.1]> <yad annam [6.71.1]>_<punar maitv indriyaṃ [7.67.1]>_iti pratigṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,9[45].17) With <ka idaṃ kasmā adāt [3.29.7-8]> <kāmas tad agre [19.52.1]> <yad annam [6.71.1]> <punar maitv indriyaṃ [7.67.1]>, he accepts the gift
(KauśS_5,9[45].18) The last is for all desires (<s>sarvakāma</s>)
(KauśS_5,9[45].19) The <s>pākayajña</s> (simple cooked-food sacrifices) have been explained by means of the <s>vaśā</s> (barren cow) rite
(KauśS_5,10[46].1) With <utāmṛtāsur [5.1.7]> and <śivās ta [7.43.1]>, he gives to one who has been accused
(KauśS_5,10[46].2) He ties a rope around a <s>drughaṇa</s> (mallet)-shaped head
(KauśS_5,10[46].3) A suitable substitute from among <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa), red metal, or gold
(KauśS_5,10[46].4) With <yena soma [6.7.1]>, when about to sacrifice, he eats one having a calf of the same color
(KauśS_5,10[46].5) He sacrifices at the conclusion
(KauśS_5,10[46].6) With <yaṃ yācāmy [5.7.5]> and <yad āśasā [7.57.1]>, when about to make a request

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].7) mantroktāni patitebhyo <devāḥ kapota [6.27.1]> <ṛcā kapotaṃ [6.28.1]>_<amūn hetiḥ [6.29.1]>_iti mahāśāntim āvapate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].7) With the things stated in the mantra (<s>mantrokta</s>), for the fallen ones, with <devāḥ kapota [6.27.1]> <ṛcā kapotaṃ [6.28.1]> <amūn hetiḥ [6.29.1]>, he performs the <s>mahāśānti</s> (great pacification rite)

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].8) <parīme 'gnim [6.28.2]> ity agniṃ gām ādāya niśi kārayamāṇas triḥ śālāṃ pariṇayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].8) With <parīme 'gnim [6.28.2]>, taking fire and a cow, having it done at night, he leads them around the house three times

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].9) <paro 'pehi [6.45.1]> <yo na jīvo [6.46.1]>_iti svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhaṃ vimārṣṭi
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].9) With <paro 'pehi [6.45.1]> and <yo na jīvo [6.46.1]>, having seen a bad dream, he wipes his face

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].10) atighoraṃ dṛṣṭvā maiśradhānyaṃ puroḍāśam anyāśāyāṃ vā nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].10) Having seen an extremely terrible dream, he offers a <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake) of mixed grains in another direction
(KauśS_5,10[46].11) With <paryāvarte [7.100.1]>, he turns around
(KauśS_5,10[46].12) With <yat svapne [7.101.1]>, having eaten, he looks around

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].13) <vidma [ed. misprint: vidmā] te svapna [6.46.2]>_iti sarveṣām apyayaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].13) With <vidma [ed. misprint: vidmā] te svapna [6.46.2]>, this is the remedy for all dreams

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].14) <nahi te agne tanvaḥ [6.49.1]>_iti brahmacārī_ācāryasyādahana upasamādhāya triḥ parikramya puroḍāśaṃ juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].14) With <nahi te agne tanvaḥ [6.49.1]>, when a <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student)'s teacher has died, having built up the fire and circumambulated three times, he offers a <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake)
(KauśS_5,10[46].15) He should sleep for three nights without turning over
(KauśS_5,10[46].16) He should not sleep with another — thus says <s>Kauśika</s>
(KauśS_5,10[46].17) He should bathe with the bathing hymns
(KauśS_5,10[46].18) He should return having completed the vow without interruption

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].19) avakīrṇine darbhaśulbam āsajya <yat te devī [6.63.1]>_iti āvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].19) For the <s>avakīrṇin</s> (one who has broken the vow of celibacy), having attached a <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) rope, with <yat te devī [6.63.1]>, he performs the rite
(KauśS_5,10[46].20) In this manner, having poured with a water vessel containing the remnants (<s>saṃpāta</s>)
(KauśS_5,10[46].21) Having sprinkled with pacification water (<s>śāntyudaka</s>) as stated in the mantra (<s>mantrokta</s>)
(KauśS_5,10[46].22) With <saṃsam id [6.63.4]>, in a self-kindled fire
(KauśS_5,10[46].23) With <agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati [8.3.26]>, driving away the <s>rakṣas</s> (demons)
(KauśS_5,10[46].24) With <yad asmṛti [7.106.1]>, completing the message without interruption
(KauśS_5,10[46].25) With <pratno hi [6.110.1]>, [this rite is performed] for one born under an inauspicious <s>nakṣatra</s> (asterism), using the root.

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].26) <mā jyeṣṭhaṃ [6.112.1]> <tṛte [read: trite] devā [6.113.1]> iti parivittiparivividānau_udakānte mauñjaiḥ parvasu baddhvā piñjūlībhir āplāvayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].26) With <mā jyeṣṭhaṃ [6.112.1]> and <trite devā [6.113.1]>, the <s>parivitti</s> (one whose younger brother has married first) and the <s>parivividāna</s> (the younger brother who married before the elder) — having bound them at the water's edge with <s>mauñja</s> (muñja-grass) cords at the joints, he sprinkles them with tufts of grass.
(KauśS_5,10[46].27) He pours water over them.

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].28) pheneṣūttarān pāśān ādhāya <nadīnāṃ phenān [6.113.2c]> iti praplāvayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].28) Having placed the upper nooses upon the foam, with <nadīnāṃ phenān [6.113.2c]>, he sets them afloat.
(KauśS_5,10[46].29) And entering [the water] with all the <s>sūktas</s> (hymns) addressed to the Waters.
(KauśS_5,10[46].30) With the <s>devaheḍana</s> (hymn of divine appeasement), what is prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_5,10[46].31) To the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher),
(KauśS_5,10[46].32) he should offer.
(KauśS_5,10[46].33) He sows [seeds] in a pit dug with a <s>khadā</s> (mattock).
(KauśS_5,10[46].34) He worships <s>Vaivasvata</s> (Yama, son of Vivasvat).
(KauśS_5,10[46].35) He gives [an offering in] four bowls.
(KauśS_5,10[46].36) When the creditor dies, he gives [the debt-offering] to his offspring.
(KauśS_5,10[46].37) [Or] to one of the same <s>gotra</s> (lineage).
(KauśS_5,10[46].38) He makes an offering at the cremation ground.
(KauśS_5,10[46].39) And at the crossroads.
(KauśS_5,10[46].40) He sets fire to the thicket.
(KauśS_5,10[46].41) With <divo nu mām [6.124.1]>, he washes off the drops [that fall] from a clear sky.
(KauśS_5,10[46].42) He touches [the person] with [substances] prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].43) yasya_uttamadantau pūrvau jāyete <yau vyāghrāv [6.140.1]> ity āvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].43) For one whose upper teeth appear first, with <yau vyāghrāv [6.140.1]>, he extracts [them].
(KauśS_5,10[46].44) He causes [the child] to bite the [objects] prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_5,10[46].45) He feeds those designated [for the rite] with [food] cooked in <s>śāntyudaka</s> (peace-water).
(KauśS_5,10[46].46) And [also feeds] both parents.
(KauśS_5,10[46].47) With <idaṃ yat kṛṣṇaḥ [7.64.1]>, he washes off what has been defiled by a black bird.
(KauśS_5,10[46].48) He performs the <s>paryagni</s> (fire-circling) rite on what has been wiped.
(KauśS_5,10[46].49) With <pratīcīnaphalo [7.65.1]>, at the <s>apāmārga</s> (Achyranthes aspera) plant oblation, he places <s>apāmārgī</s> (apāmārga) branches.
(KauśS_5,10[46].50) With <yad arvācīnaṃ [10.5.22]>, he sips water ritually (<s>ācamana</s>).
(KauśS_5,10[46].51) With <yat te bhūme [12.1.35]>, he digs up [the earth].
(KauśS_5,10[46].52) With <yat ta ūnaṃ [12.1.61c]>, he sows [to restore the earth].

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].53) <prehi pra hara [PS 20.50.5-7, .RVKh 2.2.2, .RV 2.43.3, PS 20.50.8]>_iti kāpiñjalāni svastyayanāni bhavanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].53) With <prehi pra hara [PS 20.50.5-7, RVKh 2.2.2, RV 2.43.3, PS 20.50.8]>, the <s>kāpiñjala</s> (partridge) auspicious rites (<s>svastyayana</s>) are performed.

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].54) <prehi pra hara vā dāvān gṛhebhyaḥ svastaye | kapiñjala pradakṣiṇaṃ śatapattrābhi no vada || bhadraṃ vada dakṣiṇato bhadram uttarato vada | bhadraṃ purastān no vada bhadraṃ paścāt kapiñjala || śunaṃ vada dakṣiṇataḥ śunam uttarato vada | śunaṃ purastān no vada śunaṃ paścāt kapiñjala || [PS 20.50.5-7]> <bhadraṃ vada putrair bhadraṃ vada gṛheṣu ca | bhadram asmākaṃ vada bhadraṃ no abhayaṃ vada || [.RVKh 2.2.2]> <āvadaṃs tvaṃ śakune bhadram ā vada tūṣṇīm āsīnaḥ sumatiṃ cikiddhi naḥ | yad utpatan vadasi karkarir yathā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ || [.RV 2.43.3]> <yauvanāni mahayasi jigyuṣām iva dundubhiḥ | kapiñjala pradakṣiṇaṃ śatapattrābhi no vada || [PS 20.50.8, cf. .RVKh 2.2.5]>_iti kāpiñjalāni svastyayanāni bhavanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].54) "Go forth, bring blessings from the forests to the houses, for well-being! O <s>Kapiñjala</s> (partridge), with your hundred-feathered [voice], speak to us auspiciously, turning to the right! || Speak what is auspicious from the south, speak what is auspicious from the north; speak what is auspicious before us, speak what is auspicious behind, O <s>Kapiñjala</s>! || Speak what is fortunate from the south, speak what is fortunate from the north; speak what is fortunate before us, speak what is fortunate behind, O <s>Kapiñjala</s>! || [PS 20.50.5-7]" "Speak what is auspicious for [our] sons, speak what is auspicious in [our] houses; speak what is auspicious for us, speak safety for us! || [RVKh 2.2.2]" "Speaking auspiciously, O bird, speak what is auspicious; sitting silent, grant us good understanding; when you call out flying upward, like a <s>karkarī</s> (water-jar), may we speak greatly at the assembly, rich in heroes! || [RV 2.43.3]" "You magnify the youthful [warriors], like a <s>dundubhi</s> (war-drum) of conquerors; O <s>Kapiñjala</s>, with your hundred-feathered [voice], speak to us auspiciously, turning to the right! || [PS 20.50.8, cf. RVKh 2.2.5]" — thus the <s>kāpiñjala</s> (partridge) auspicious rites (<s>svastyayana</s>) are performed.

body.text: (KauśS_5,10[46].55) <yo abhy u babhruṇāyasi svapantam atsi puruṣaṃ śayānam agatsvalam | ayasmayena brahmaṇāśmamayena varmaṇā pary asmān varuṇo dadhat [PS 20.9.4]>_ity abhyavakāśe saṃviśati_abhyavakāśe saṃviśati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_5,10[46].55) "O you who with tawny [radiance] come upon a man sleeping, lying down, unwary — may <s>Varuṇa</s>, enclosing us with an iron prayer and a stone armor, protect us! [PS 20.9.4]" — with this, one lies down in the open, one lies down in the open.

body.text: (KauśS 5 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 5 Colophon) Thus ends the fifth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_6,1[47].1) In the <s>ābhicārika</s> (sorcery) rites, the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass) is made of reeds, cut at both ends.
(KauśS_6,1[47].2) He brings the ritual materials from the south — the <s>āṅgirasa</s> (Aṅgiras-related) [rite].
(KauśS_6,1[47].3) <s>Iṅgiḍa</s> (a type of mineral salt) serves as the <s>ājya</s> (clarified butter).
(KauśS_6,1[47].4) [Actions are performed] with the left [hand].
(KauśS_6,1[47].5) [Ritual actions conclude] turning to the south (<s>dakṣiṇāpavarga</s>).
(KauśS_6,1[47].6) On a southward-sloping barren ground, facing south, he performs [the rites].
(KauśS_6,1[47].7) [These rites are performed] with fire.
(KauśS_6,1[47].8) With <agne yat te tapas [2.19.1]>, the preliminary oblations (<s>purastādhoma</s>) [are made].
(KauśS_6,1[47].9) With <tathā tad agne kṛṇu jātavedo [5.29.2]>, the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> (shares of clarified butter) [oblations are made].
(KauśS_6,1[47].10) With <nir amuṃ nuda [6.75.1]>, the concluding oblations (<s>saṃsthitahoma</s>) [are made].
(KauśS_6,1[47].11) [This applies] to the <s>kṛttikā</s> (Pleiades) rite, the <s>roka</s> (light) rite, the <s>rodhā</s> (obstruction) rite, and the <s>āpya</s> (water) rites.
(KauśS_6,1[47].12) With the <s>Bharadvāja</s> hymn of banishment, he cuts a staff belonging to the <s>Āṅgirasa</s> (Aṅgiras tradition).
(KauśS_6,1[47].13) With <mṛtyor ahaṃ [6.133.3]>, he places the <s>bādhakī</s> (repelling amulet).

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].14) <ya imāṃ [6.133.1]>_<ayaṃ vajras [6.134.1]>_iti dviguṇām ekavīrān saṃnahya (saṃvyūhya? See Caland, AZ, aḷ.) pāśān nimuṣṭitṛtīyaṃ daṇḍaṃ saṃpātavat
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].14) With <ya imāṃ [6.133.1]> and <ayaṃ vajras [6.134.1]>, having doubled [the cord] and tied together the warriors one by one, [he prepares] nooses, a staff with a fist-[knot] as the third [binding], fitted with a knot.
(KauśS_6,1[47].15) He binds with the first [verses].

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].16) <vajro 'si sapatnahā tvayādya vṛtraṃ sākṣīya | tvām adya vanaspate vṛkṣāṇām ud ayuṣmahi || sa na indrapurohito [see Bloomfield, AJPh 27 (1906), 416] viśvataḥ pāhi rakṣasaḥ | abhi gāvo anūṣatābhi dyumnaṃ bṛhaspate || prāṇa prāṇaṃ trayasvāso asave mṛ;la | nirṛte nirṛtyā naḥ pāśebhyo muñca || [PS 19.42.4-6 (also at AVPariś 37.1.8) - cf. 19.44.4]> iti daṇḍam ādatte
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].16) "You are the <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), the slayer of rivals; with you may I today overcome <s>Vṛtra</s>! You, O lord of trees, today we have raised among the trees, life-giving! || May he, with <s>Indra</s> as our priest, protect us from <s>rakṣas</s> (demons) on all sides! The cows have lowed towards [him]; O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, [grant us] splendor! || O <s>Prāṇa</s> (breath), protect our <s>prāṇa</s> (life-breath); be gracious for our sustenance! O <s>Nirṛti</s> (goddess of dissolution), release us from the bonds of <s>nirṛti</s> (destruction)! || [PS 19.42.4-6]" — with this, he takes up the staff.
(KauśS_6,1[47].17) With a portion of the food-offering, he anoints the knot of the girdle.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].18) <ayaṃ vajras [6.134.1]>_iti bāhyato daṇḍam ūrdhvam avāgagraṃ tisṛbhir anvṛcaṃ nihanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].18) With <ayaṃ vajras [6.134.1]>, he strikes [the target] from outside with the staff held upward, point downward, three times, verse by verse.
(KauśS_6,1[47].19) He should touch [the target] in between.
(KauśS_6,1[47].20) With <yad aśnāmi [6.135.1]>, what is prescribed by the <s>mantra</s> [is done].

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].21) yat pātram āhanti <phaḍ ḍhato 'sau [cf. KauśS 116.7, and VSM 7.3 = ;SBM 4.1.1.26 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].21) When he strikes the vessel, [he says] "<s>phaḍ</s>! Let that one [be destroyed]!"

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].22) idam aham āmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya prāṇāpānāv apy āyachāmīty āyachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].22) Saying "I hereby seize the <s>prāṇa</s> (inbreath) and <s>apāna</s> (outbreath) of so-and-so, son of so-and-so, descendant of so-and-so," he seizes [them].
(KauśS_6,1[47].23) With <ye 'māvāsyāṃ [1.16.1]>, having bound [an effigy], [he places] lead filings in the food-offering as adornment.
(KauśS_6,1[47].24) With a staff made from a ruined bamboo, arm's length, adorned, he strikes.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].25) <dyāvāpṛthivī urv [2.12.1]> iti paraśupalāśena dakṣiṇā dhāvataḥ padaṃ vṛścati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].25) With <dyāvāpṛthivī urv [2.12.1]>, using a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) leaf [shaped like] an axe, he cuts the footprint of one running to the south.
(KauśS_6,1[47].26) Lengthwise three times, crosswise three times.
(KauśS_6,1[47].27) Having placed [the pieces] diagonally,

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].28) +āvraskāt pāṃsūn+ (ed.: āvraskānyāṃśūn; see Caland, AZ, aḷ.) palāśam upanahya bhraṣṭre_abhyasyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].28) tying dust from the cuttings [together] with a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) leaf, he throws [it] into the roasting pan.
(KauśS_6,1[47].29) He is covered [with ashes] when [the mixture] crackles.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].30) paścād agneḥ karṣvāṃ kūdyupastīrṇāyāṃ dvādaśarātram aparyāvartamānaḥ śayīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].30) Behind the fire, in a furrow lined with <s>kūdya</s> (a type of mat), he should lie for twelve nights without turning over.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].31) tata utthāya trir ahna udavajrān praharati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].31) Rising from there, three times a day he hurls water-thunderbolts (<s>udavajra</s>).
(KauśS_6,1[47].32) He casts a stone into a river whose name has not been ascertained.
(KauśS_6,1[47].33) In hot [water], he drinks barley flour mixed with crushed grains, without drawing breath.
(KauśS_6,1[47].34) How [does he observe the vow]: three by three <s>kāśa</s> (grass stalks) for three nights;
(KauśS_6,1[47].35) two by two for three nights;
(KauśS_6,1[47].36) one by one for six nights.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].37) dvādaśyāḥ prātaḥ kṣīraudanaṃ bhojayitvā_ucchiṣṭān ucchiṣṭaṃ bahumatsye prakirati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].37) On the morning of the twelfth [day], having fed [the officiants] rice cooked in milk, [the performer] scatters the leavings and leftover food where there are many fish.
(KauśS_6,1[47].38) He is covered [with ashes] when [the fish] swarm together.

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].39) lohitaśirasaṃ kṛkalāsam amūn hanmīti hatvā sadyaḥ kāryo bhāṅge śayane
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].39) Having killed a red-headed lizard saying "I slay that one," it should be done immediately — [the performer then lies] on a bed made of hemp.
(KauśS_6,1[47].40) He burns an unrecited [effigy] adorned with red [ornaments], clad in black garments.
(KauśS_6,1[47].41) With single-footed [verses], another [ritualist] follows along.
(KauśS_6,1[47].42) Another [enemy-effigy is offered] limb by limb as a complete burnt offering (<s>sarvahuta</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].43) paścād agneḥ śarabhṛṣṭīr nidhāya_udag vrajati_ā svedajananāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].43) Having placed reed-spits behind the fire, he goes northward until perspiration is produced.
(KauśS_6,1[47].44) Returning, adorned with perspiration, he makes the oblation.
(KauśS_6,1[47].45) Having placed [the effigy's] chest and head in a sheath, [he collects] dust from the foot[print].

body.text: (KauśS_6,1[47].46) paścād agner lavaṇamṛḍīcīs tisro_aśītīr vikarṇīḥ śarkarāṇām
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,1[47].46) Behind the fire, [he prepares] eighty-three <s>vikarṇī</s> (ear-shaped) pebbles of salt and soft earth (<s>lavaṇamṛḍīcī</s>).
(KauśS_6,1[47].47) Poison [is placed] on the head.
(KauśS_6,1[47].48) Guiding [the substance] with the <s>bādhaka</s> (repelling instrument) held point downward, he recites the accompanying verses.
(KauśS_6,1[47].49) With <pāśe sa [2.12.2c]>, he ties knots in the sheath.
(KauśS_6,1[47].50) With <āmuṃ [2.12.4d]>, he takes it up.
(KauśS_6,1[47].51) At a vulnerable point (<s>marman</s>), he digs a pit with a ladle made of <s>khadira</s> (Acacia catechu) wood.
(KauśS_6,1[47].52) [The pit is] arm's length. With <atīva yo [2.12.6]>, he sets fire [to it] with reed arrows.
(KauśS_6,1[47].53) Having placed [the effigy] and heaped [earth over it], he levels [the ground] with the ladle.
(KauśS_6,1[47].54) Saying "I have led that one up [to destruction]," [he uses] the scraping implement as instructed.
(KauśS_6,1[47].55) Or [he targets] the shadow.
(KauśS_6,1[47].56) He brings [the implement] near.
(KauśS_6,1[47].57) He recites the accompanying verses.
(KauśS_6,2[48].1) With <bhrātṛvyakṣayaṇaṃ [2.18.1]>, in the forest he places the rival-destroying [substances] (<s>sapatnakṣayaṇī</s>).
(KauśS_6,2[48].2) Having come to the village, he sows [them].
(KauśS_6,2[48].3) With <pumān puṃsaḥ [3.6.1]>, as prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>, he binds [an effigy] that has been offered into and adorned.

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].4) yāvantaḥ sapatnās tāvataḥ pāśān iṅgiḍālaṃkṛtān saṃpātavato_anūktān sasūtrān_camvā marmaṇi nikhanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].4) As many as the rivals, that many nooses — adorned with <s>iṅgiḍa</s> (mineral salt), fitted with knots, accompanied by the recitation, with threads — he buries in a bowl at a vulnerable point (<s>marman</s>).
(KauśS_6,2[48].5) In a boat, with <praiṇān [3.6.8]> and <nudasva kāma [9.2.4]>, as prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>, he pushes [the rival's effigy] away with a branch.
(KauśS_6,2[48].6) With <te 'dharāñcaḥ [3.6.7]>, he sets them afloat.
(KauśS_6,2[48].7) With <bṛhann eṣām [4.16.1]>, he recites the accompanying verses as the one being cursed approaches.
(KauśS_6,2[48].8) With <vaikaṅkatena [5.8.1]>, as prescribed by the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_6,2[48].9) With <dadir hi [5.13.1]>, [these are performed] with fire.
(KauśS_6,2[48].10) He scatters [the substance] in a conspicuous place with a sharp [instrument].
(KauśS_6,2[48].11) With <te 'vadan [5.17.1]>, he cuts the footprint of the leaders.
(KauśS_6,2[48].12) He recites the accompanying verses.
(KauśS_6,2[48].13) He recites the accompanying verses with [hymns addressed to] the <s>Brahman</s>-cow pair.
(KauśS_6,2[48].14) [He performs] the ritual movement (<s>ceṣṭā</s>),
(KauśS_6,2[48].15) he spreads out.
(KauśS_6,2[48].16) At the place of binding (<s>ūbadhya</s>),
(KauśS_6,2[48].17) at the cremation ground,
(KauśS_6,2[48].18) he says "Take them away three times!"

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].19) dvitīyayāśmānam ūbadhyagūhe [em. Caland, AZ p. 168 n. 9 -- ed.: ūbadhye gūhayati]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].19) With the second [verse], [he places] a stone in the hollow of the <s>ūbadhya</s> (binding-post).
(KauśS_6,2[48].20) For twelve nights, observing all the vows, he rests (<s>upaśrāmyati</s>).
(KauśS_6,2[48].21) He is covered [with ashes] when [the sun] has risen twice.
(KauśS_6,2[48].22) He turns back [the implement] with the point downward.
(KauśS_6,2[48].23) With <upa prāgāt [6.37.1]>, he offers a white ball of food (<s>piṇḍa</s>) to a dog.
(KauśS_6,2[48].24) He ties an <s>tārcha</s> (protective amulet).
(KauśS_6,2[48].25) He makes an oblation.
(KauśS_6,2[48].26) He places [the fire].

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].27) <idaṃ tad yuja [6.54.1]>_<yat kiṃ cāsau manasā [7.70.1]>_ity āhitāgniṃ pratinirvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].27) With <idaṃ tad yuja [6.54.1]> and <yat kiṃ cāsau manasā [7.70.1]>, he makes a counter-offering to one who maintains the sacred fires (<s>āhitāgni</s>).
(KauśS_6,2[48].28) With the middle <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) leaf, he makes oblations of rice grains (<s>phalīkaraṇa</s>).
(KauśS_6,2[48].29) With '<s>nir amuṃ</s>' [AV 6.75.1], he strews three times with the thumb.
(KauśS_6,2[48].30) He offers an arrow with <s>kadvindu</s> granary [offerings].
(KauśS_6,2[48].31) With a red <s>aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) leaf, he offers what has been crushed against poison.

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].32) <tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ [6.138.1]>_iti mūtrapurīṣaṃ vatsaśepyāyāṃ kakucair apidhāpya saṃpiṣya nikhanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].32) With '<s>tvaṃ vīrudhāṃ</s>' [AV 6.138.1], having covered urine and excrement with hump-pieces in a <s>vatsaśepyā</s> (calf-pen), having crushed [them], he buries [them].
(KauśS_6,2[48].33) The penis of a bull.
(KauśS_6,2[48].34) In the [calf-]pen.
(KauśS_6,2[48].35) With '<s>yathā sūryo</s>' [AV 7.13.1], he recites along.
(KauśS_6,2[48].36) With the latter [verse], those whom he sees going.

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].37) <indrotibhir [7.31.1]> <agne jātān [7.34.1]> <yo na stāyad dipsati [7.108.1]> <yo naḥ śapād [7.59.1/6.37.3]> iti vaidyuddhatīḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].37) With '<s>indrotibhir</s>' [AV 7.31.1], '<s>agne jātān</s>' [AV 7.34.1], '<s>yo na stāyad dipsati</s>' [AV 7.108.1], '<s>yo naḥ śapād</s>' [AV 7.59.1/6.37.3] — the lightning-struck [rites].
(KauśS_6,2[48].38) With '<s>sāṃtapanā</s>' [AV 7.77.1], the upward-dried [rites].
(KauśS_6,2[48].39) A sacrificial cake cooked in the sun's heat, a whole-offering melted in the sun's heat.

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].40) <ud asya śyāvau [7.95.1]>_itīṣīkāñjimaṇḍūkaṃ nīlalohitābhyāṃ sūtrābhyāṃ sakakṣaṃ baddhvā_uṣṇodake vyādāya pratyāhuti maṇḍūkam apanudati_abhinyubjati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].40) With '<s>ud asya śyāvau</s>' [AV 7.95.1], having tied a reed-frog with blue and red threads together with a tuft, having placed [it] in warm water, at each offering he pushes the frog away and turns [it] upside down.

body.text: (KauśS_6,2[48].41) upadhāvantam <asadan gāvaḥ [7.96.1]>_iti kāmpīlaṃ saṃnahya kṣīrotsikte pāyayati lohitānāṃ caikkaśam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,2[48].41) To the one approaching, with '<s>asadan gāvaḥ</s>' [AV 7.96.1], having bound <s>kāmpīla</s> [herb], he gives [it] to drink in milk-sprinkled [water], and one by one of the red [cows].
(KauśS_6,2[48].42) For one desiring to eat, rice-milk.
(KauśS_6,2[48].43) He washes out a raw vessel.
(KauśS_6,3[49].1) With '<s>sapatnahanam</s>' [AV 9.2.1], he releases a bull with remainders.
(KauśS_6,3[49].2) <s>Aśvattha</s> (sacred fig) [offerings] that have fallen.
(KauśS_6,3[49].3) He himself washes with '<s>indrasyaujaḥ</s>' [AV 10.5.1a].
(KauśS_6,3[49].4) With '<s>jiṣṇave yogāya</s>' [AV 10.5.1b], he yokes the waters.
(KauśS_6,3[49].5) 'The womb of the wind's swiftness and of immortality' — thus he accepts.

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].6) uttamāḥ pratāpyādharāḥ pradāya_enam enān adharācaḥ parāco_avācas tamasas [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. tapasas] tam unnayata devāḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ prajāpatiḥ prathamo devatānām ity atisṛjati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].6) Having heated the upper [offerings], having given the lower ones, [saying:] 'These, downward, away, and below — from darkness lift him up, O gods; <s>Prajāpati</s>, the first of deities, being in accord with the ancestors' — thus he releases [them].

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].7) idam ahaṃ <yo mā prācyā diśo_aghāyur abhidāsād apavādīd iṣugūhaḥ [cf. 5.10, 4.40]> tasya_imau prāṇāpānau_apakrāmāmi brahmaṇā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].7) 'This I [do]: whoever from the eastern direction, being hostile, would attack me, slander me, [being] an arrow-concealer [cf. AV 5.10, 4.40] — from his in-breath and out-breath I depart by means of <s>Brahman</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].8) dakṣiṇāyāḥ pratīcyā udīcyā dhruvāyā vyadhvāya ūrdhvāyāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].8) From the southern, western, northern, fixed, intermediate, and upper [directions].

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].9) idam aham <yo mā diśām antardeśebhya [-]> ity <apakrāmāmi [-]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].9) 'This I [do]: whoever [attacks me] from the intermediate regions between the directions' — thus 'I depart.'

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].10) evam abhiṣṭhānāpohananiveṣṭanāni (see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 50, on the reading and sūtra division)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].10) Thus the treading upon, the driving away, and the binding [rites].
(KauśS_6,3[49].11) Indeed, all beings [are subject to this] continually.

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].12) brāhmaṇād vajram udyachamānāt_śaṅkante māṃ haniṣyasi māṃ haniṣyasīti tebhyo_abhayaṃ vadet_śam agnaye śaṃ pṛthivyai śam antarikṣāya śaṃ vāyave śaṃ dive śaṃ sūryāya śaṃ candrāya śaṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ śaṃ gandharvāpsarobhyaḥ śaṃ sarpetarajanebhyaḥ śivam mahyam iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].12) From a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> raising the thunderbolt [of curse], they fear, [thinking] 'He will strike me, he will strike me.' To them he should speak fearlessness: 'Peace to <s>Agni</s>, peace to the earth, peace to the atmosphere, peace to <s>Vāyu</s>, peace to the sky, peace to <s>Sūrya</s>, peace to the moon, peace to the constellations, peace to <s>Gandharvas</s> and <s>Apsarases</s>, peace to serpents and other creatures — may there be well-being for me.'

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].13) <yo va āpo 'pāṃ [10.5.15]> <yaṃ vayaṃ [10.5.42]>_<apām asmai vajraṃ [10.5.50]>_ity anvṛcam udavajrān
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].13) With '<s>yo va āpo 'pāṃ</s>' [AV 10.5.15], '<s>yaṃ vayaṃ</s>' [AV 10.5.42], '<s>apām asmai vajraṃ</s>' [AV 10.5.50], verse by verse, the water-thunderbolts.
(KauśS_6,3[49].14) With '<s>viṣṇoḥ kramo 'si</s>' [AV 10.5.25], the strides of <s>Viṣṇu</s>.

(KauśS_6,3[49].15) With '<s>mamāgne varco</s>' [AV 5.3.1], having sprinkled the <s>Bṛhaspatiśiras</s> (head of <s>Bṛhaspati</s> [hymn]) with drops, having consecrated with <s>mantras</s>, he places [it] nearby.
(KauśS_6,3[49].16) One who is affirming should not speak contrarily.
(KauśS_6,3[49].17) With the last [verse], the witness.
(KauśS_6,3[49].18) With '<s>udehi vājin</s>' [AV 13.1.1ab], with the half-verse, a sinking boat.
(KauśS_6,3[49].19) With '<s>samiddho 'gniḥ</s>' [AV 13.1.28], '<s>ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī</s>' [AV 13.3.1], '<s>ajaiṣma</s>' [AV 16.6.1], he places the over-bonds.
(KauśS_6,3[49].20) At every step he cuts the bonds.
(KauśS_6,3[49].21) Having crushed and bound together the over-bonds, restraints, and pegs, he places [them] on a frying pan.
(KauśS_6,3[49].22) For one desiring to eat, rice-milk and the other two [foods].

body.text: (KauśS_6,3[49].23) gartedhmau_antareṇāvalekhanīṃ sthāṇau nibadhya dvādaśarātraṃ saṃpātān abhyatininayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_6,3[49].23) Having tied the scraping-instrument to a post between the pit and the fuel, for twelve nights he carries the remainders over [it].
(KauśS_6,3[49].24) On the sixth [day], he strikes with water-thunderbolts.
(KauśS_6,3[49].25) On the seventh, he sips water.
(KauśS_6,3[49].26) With '<s>yaś ca gāṃ</s>' [AV 13.1.56], he recites along.
(KauśS_6,3[49].27) With '<s>nir durarmaṇya</s>' [AV 16.2.1], having washed, he touches.

body.text: (KauśS 6 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 6 Colophon) Thus ends the sixth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_7,1[50].1) With '<s>svastidā</s>' [AV 1.21.1], '<s>ye te panthāno</s>' [AV 7.55.1/12.1.47], he sets out on a journey to the right.
(KauśS_7,1[50].2) He scatters uncounted pebbles.
(KauśS_7,1[50].3) Having cut grasses, he stands near.

body.text: (KauśS_7,1[50].4) <āre [1.26.1]>_<amūḥ pāre [1.27.1]> <pātaṃ na [6.3.1]>_<ya enaṃ pariṣīdanti [6.76.1]> yad āyudhaṃ daṇḍena vyākhyātam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,1[50].4) With '<s>āre</s>' [AV 1.26.1], '<s>amūḥ pāre</s>' [AV 1.27.1], '<s>pātaṃ na</s>' [AV 6.3.1], '<s>ya enaṃ pariṣīdanti</s>' [AV 6.76.1] — whatever weapon [is used], it has been explained with the staff.
(KauśS_7,1[50].5) Having opened his mouth with a [fortunate] direction, he lies down.
(KauśS_7,1[50].6) Having measured out three steps, he rises.
(KauśS_7,1[50].7) Three [fortunate] directions.

body.text: (KauśS_7,1[50].8) <pretaṃ pādau [1.27.4]>_ity +avasasya (ed.: avaśasya; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,1[50].8) With '<s>pretaṃ pādau</s>' [AV 1.27.4], of the one who has died,
(KauśS_7,1[50].9) he gives [water] to drink.
(KauśS_7,1[50].10) With '<s>upasthās te</s>' [AV 12.1.62], he steps over three [times].
(KauśS_7,1[50].11) With '<s>svasti mātra</s>' [AV 1.31.4], at night he stands near.
(KauśS_7,1[50].12) With '<s>indram ahaṃ</s>' [AV 3.15.1], he raises the merchandise with remainders.

body.text: (KauśS_7,1[50].13) nimṛjya digyuktābhyāṃ <doṣo gāya [6.1.1]> <pātaṃ na [6.3-6.7]> iti pañca_<anaḍudbhyas [6.59.1]>_<yamo mṛtyur [6.93.1]> <viśvajit [6.107.1]>_<śakadhūmaṃ [6.128.1]> <bhavāśarvau [4.28.1/11.2.1/11.6.9]>_ity upadadhīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,1[50].13) Having wiped, with the two [offerings] yoked to the directions, with '<s>doṣo gāya</s>' [AV 6.1.1], '<s>pātaṃ na</s>' [AV 6.3-6.7] — the five — '<s>anaḍudbhyas</s>' [AV 6.59.1], '<s>yamo mṛtyur</s>' [AV 6.93.1], '<s>viśvajit</s>' [AV 6.107.1], '<s>śakadhūmaṃ</s>' [AV 6.128.1], '<s>bhavāśarvau</s>' [AV 4.28.1/11.2.1/11.6.9], he should make the offering.
(KauśS_7,1[50].14) With the last [verse], for [a cow] with a same-colored calf, he offers three times to <s>Rudra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,1[50].15) upa_uttamena suhṛdo brāhmaṇasya śakṛtpiṇḍān parvasu_ādhāya śakadhūmaṃ kim adyāhar iti pṛchati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,1[50].15) With the penultimate, having placed dung-balls of a friendly <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>'s [cow] with a same-colored calf on the <s>parvan</s> days, he asks '<s>śakadhūma</s>, what [happened] today?'
(KauśS_7,1[50].16) He responds: 'Auspicious, of good omen.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,1[50].17) yuktayor <mā no devā [6.56.1]> <yas te sarpo [12.1.46]>_iti śayanaśālā_urvarāḥ parilikhati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,1[50].17) Of the two yoked [offerings], with '<s>mā no devā</s>' [AV 6.56.1], '<s>yas te sarpo</s>' [AV 12.1.46], he traces [lines around] the sleeping hall and the fields.
(KauśS_7,1[50].18) He scatters grasses with yoke-trappings, containing remainders, at the door.
(KauśS_7,1[50].19) He splits the udder-band.
(KauśS_7,1[50].20) He buries [it].
(KauśS_7,1[50].21) He places [an offering].
(KauśS_7,1[50].22) <s>Apāmārga</s> flowers, cow-hoof [shaped objects], with roots [placed] in reverse direction.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].1) <ud itas [4.3.1]>_iti khādiraṃ śaṅkuṃ saṃpātavantam udgṛhṇan nikhanan gā anuvrajati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].1) With '<s>ud itas</s>' [AV 4.3.1], raising a <s>khadira</s> (Acacia catechu) peg with remainders, burying [it], he follows the cows.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].2) ninayanaṃ samuhya cāre sārūpavatsasya_indrāya trir juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].2) Having swept up the place of carrying down, at a distance, for [a cow] with a same-colored calf, he offers three times to <s>Indra</s>.
(KauśS_7,2[51].3) He carries <s>bali</s> (offerings) to the directions.
(KauśS_7,2[51].4) He worships in each direction.
(KauśS_7,2[51].5) In the middle, a fifth [offering], unspecified.
(KauśS_7,2[51].6) He carries down the remainder.
(KauśS_7,2[51].7) With '<s>brahma jajñānaṃ</s>' [AV 4.1.1/5.6.1], '<s>bhavāśarvau</s>' [AV 4.28.1/11.2.1/11.6.9], he worships a mountain nearby in the forest.
(KauśS_7,2[51].8) In another [mountain], separate offerings for <s>Bhava</s>, <s>Śarva</s>, <s>Paśupati</s>, <s>Ugra</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Mahādeva</s>, and <s>Īśāna</s>.
(KauśS_7,2[51].9) And in the cattle-pen, he eats the second [meal].
(KauśS_7,2[51].10) Having placed <s>darbha</s> grasses, he fumigates.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].11) bhūtyai vaḥ puṣṭyai va iti prathamajayor mithunayor mukham anakti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].11) 'For your prosperity, for your nourishment' — he anoints the faces of the firstborn pair.
(KauśS_7,2[51].12) He gives the calves to drink from three <s>nalada</s> (spikenard) branches.
(KauśS_7,2[51].13) With a branch and a stream of water, he walks around the cows.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].14) <aśmavarma me [5.10.1]>_iti ṣaḍ aśmanaḥ saṃpātavataḥ +sraktiṣūpari_(ed.: sraktiṣu pary; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61)_adhastān nikhanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].14) With '<s>aśmavarma me</s>' [AV 5.10.1], he buries six stones with remainders above at the corners and below.
(KauśS_7,2[51].15) With '<s>alasālā</s>' [AV 6.16.4], the remedy for sluggishness.
(KauśS_7,2[51].16) He buries three tips of <s>silāñjāla</s> (a plant) in the middle of the field.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].17) <hataṃ tardaṃ [6.50.1]>_iti ayasā sīsaṃ karṣann urvarāṃ parikrāmati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].17) With '<s>hataṃ tardaṃ</s>' [AV 6.50.1], dragging lead with iron, he walks around the field.
(KauśS_7,2[51].18) He scatters stones.

body.text: (KauśS_7,2[51].19) tardam avaśirasaṃ vadanāt keśena samuhya_urvarāmadhye nikhanati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,2[51].19) Having swept up the borer (<s>tarda</s>) head-downward from the mouth by the hair, he buries [it] in the middle of the field.
(KauśS_7,2[51].20) As stated, at a distance.
(KauśS_7,2[51].21) He carries <s>bali</s> offerings — to the direction, to the lord of the direction, to the <s>Aśvins</s>, to the lord of the field.
(KauśS_7,2[51].22) When he performs [rites] for these, he should stand observing silence until sunset.
(KauśS_7,3[52].1) With '<s>ye panthāno</s>' [AV 6.55.1], having gone around, he should make an offering.
(KauśS_7,3[52].2) He distributes.

body.text: (KauśS_7,3[52].3) <yasyās te [6.84.1]> <yat te devī [6.63.1]> <viṣāṇā pāśān [6.121.1]> ity unmocanapratirūpaṃ saṃpātavantaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,3[52].3) With '<s>yasyās te</s>' [AV 6.84.1], '<s>yat te devī</s>' [AV 6.63.1], '<s>viṣāṇā pāśān</s>' [AV 6.121.1], he performs [the rite] like an unbinding, with remainders.
(KauśS_7,3[52].4) For one bound by speech, a tracing on the ground.
(KauśS_7,3[52].5) With '<s>āyane</s>' [AV 6.106.1], he performs the pacification between a pool.
(KauśS_7,3[52].6) And in a hall.
(KauśS_7,3[52].7) With <s>avakā</s> (aquatic plant) he encloses the hall.
(KauśS_7,3[52].8) For one being cursed, he distributes.
(KauśS_7,3[52].9) What has been burned, he washes.
(KauśS_7,3[52].10) With '<s>mahīm ū ṣu</s>' [AV 7.6.2], he causes [the patient] to touch the crossing-places.
(KauśS_7,3[52].11) From afar, he ties a gem-amulet to a boat containing remainders.
(KauśS_7,3[52].12) With '<s>prapathe</s>' [AV 7.9.1], for those seeking what is lost, having washed and anointed their hands and feet, having wiped their right hands, he raises [them] up.
(KauśS_7,3[52].13) Likewise, with remainders.
(KauśS_7,3[52].14) Having wiped, he throws twenty-one pebbles at a crossroads and scatters [them].
(KauśS_7,3[52].15) With '<s>namaskṛtya</s>' [AV 7.102.1], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_7,3[52].16) For those with signs of distress: water, food-offerings, touching, and worship of <s>Āditya</s> (the sun).
(KauśS_7,3[52].17) He himself eats the offerings.
(KauśS_7,3[52].18) With '<s>viśve devā</s>' [AV 1.30.1], the longevity [rites].
(KauśS_7,3[52].19) In a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (cooked offering), having mixed ghee-balls, he eats.

body.text: (KauśS_7,3[52].20) <asmin vasu [1.9.1]> <yad ābadhnan [1.35.1]> <nava prāṇān [5.28.1> iti yugmakṛṣṇalam ādiṣṭānāṃ sthālīpāke_ādhāya badhnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_7,3[52].20) With '<s>asmin vasu</s>' [AV 1.9.1], '<s>yad ābadhnan</s>' [AV 1.35.1], '<s>nava prāṇān</s>' [AV 5.28.1], having placed paired black <s>kṛṣṇala</s> (guñjā berries) of the designated [type] in a <s>sthālīpāka</s>, he ties [them on].
(KauśS_7,3[52].21) He causes [the patient] to eat.
(KauśS_7,4[53].1) With '<s>āyurdā</s>' [AV 2.13.1], when about to perform the <s>godāna</s> (hair-cutting ceremony), he gathers the requisites.

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].2) amamrim ojomānīṃ dūrvām akarṇam aśmamaṇḍalam ānaḍuhaśakṛtpiṇḍaṃ ṣaḍ darbhaprāntāni kaṃsam ahate vasane śuddham ājyam śāntā oṣadhīr navam udakumbham
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].2) [He gathers:] <s>amamri</s> [plant], vigor-giving (<s>ojomānī</s>) <s>dūrvā</s>-grass, an edgeless stone disc, an ox-dung lump, six tips of <s>darbha</s>-grass, a bronze [vessel], [garments of] fresh cloth, pure clarified butter, pacificatory herbs, and a new water-jar.
(KauśS 7.4[53].3) Outside, having placed the fuel-sticks of a pacificatory tree facing east,

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].4) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya paricaraṇenājyaṃ paricarya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].4) having swept around, having sprinkled around, having strewn the sacred grass (<s>barhis</s>), having placed the water-vessel nearby, and having attended to the clarified butter with the attending-ladle,
(KauśS 7.4[53].5) having offered the regular oblations beforehand and the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portions),

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].6) paścād agneḥ prāṅmukha upaviśyānvārabdhāya śāntyudakaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].6) having sat down behind the fire, facing east, he prepares the pacificatory water for one who has grasped [the sacrificial post].
(KauśS 7.4[53].7) There he employs this hymn.
(KauśS 7.4[53].8) He sprinkles the fire three times; he sprinkles around three times.

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].9) triḥ kārayamāṇam ācāmayati ca saṃprokṣati ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].9) Three times, while performing [the rite], he makes [the person] sip water and sprinkles.

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].10) śakṛtpiṇḍasya sthālarūpaṃ kṛtvā suhṛde brāhmaṇāya prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].10) Having made a plate-form from the dung-lump, he gives [it] to a friendly <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].11) tat suhṛd dakṣiṇato_agner udaṅmukha āsīno dhārayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].11) That friend, sitting to the south of the fire, facing north, holds [it].
(KauśS 7.4[53].12) Then he performs [the rite] for the one who has grasped [the post].

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].13) <āyurdā [2.13.1]> ity anena sūktenājyaṃ juhvan mūrdhni saṃpātān ānayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].13) With '<s>āyurdā</s>' [AV 2.13.1] — offering clarified butter with this hymn, he brings the remnants to the top of the head.
(KauśS 7.4[53].14) In the right hand, on the stone disc, in the water-vessel — he brings the northern remnants to the plate-form.
(KauśS 7.4[53].15) Having placed the <s>amamri</s> and the vigor-giving [<s>dūrvā</s>-grass] in the water-vessel,
(KauśS 7.4[53].16) on the plate-form, having placed the <s>dūrvā</s>-grass, pacificatory water, and warm water — pouring [them] together as one,
(KauśS 7.4[53].17) with '<s>āyam agan savitā kṣureṇa</s>' [AV 6.68.1], he consecrates the water-vessel with <s>mantras</s>.
(KauśS 7.4[53].18) With '<s>aditiḥ śmaśru</s>' [AV 6.68.2], he wets [the hair].

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].19) <yat kṣureṇa [8.2.17]>_ity udakpattraṃ kṣuram adbhi ścotya triḥ pramārṣṭi
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].19) With '<s>yat kṣureṇa</s>' [AV 8.2.17], having dripped water on the razor [from] the water-leaf, he wipes [the razor] three times.

body.text: (KauśS_7,4[53].20) <yenāvapat [6.68.3]>_iti dakṣiṇasya keśapakṣasya darbhapiñjulyā keśān abhinidhāya prachidya sthālarūpe karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.4[53].20) With '<s>yenāvapat</s>' [AV 6.68.3], having pressed the hairs of the right lock with a tuft of <s>darbha</s>-grass, having cut [them], he places [them] in the plate-form.
(KauśS 7.4[53].21) Likewise, he does the same a second time.
(KauśS 7.4[53].22) Likewise, a third time.
(KauśS 7.4[53].23) Likewise, he does the same for the left lock.

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].1) atha nāpitaṃ samādiśati_akṣaṇvan vapa keśaśmaśrur oma parivapa nakhāni kuru_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].1) Then he instructs the barber: 'Shave the head-hair and beard without cutting [the skin], shave the body-hair, trim the nails.'
(KauśS 7.5[54].2) With '<s>punaḥ prāṇaḥ</s>' [AV 6.53.2], '<s>punar maitv indriyaṃ</s>' [AV 7.67.1], having wiped three times,
(KauśS 7.5[54].3) he should conclude with 'In you I establish greatness.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].4) atha_enam uptakeśaśmaśruṃ kṛtanakham (ed.: kṛttanakhaṃ; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61) āplāvayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].4) Then, having shaved the head-hair and beard and trimmed the nails, he bathes [the person].
(KauśS 7.5[54].5) With '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33.1] — with this hymn, having adorned [the person] with fragrant ointments,

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].6) <svāktaṃ (ed.: svaktaṃ; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 78) me [7.30.1]>_ity ānakti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].6) with '<s>svāktaṃ me</s>' [AV 7.30.1], he anoints [the person].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].7) atha_enam ahatena vasanena paridhāpayati <pari dhatta [2.13.2]>_iti dvābhyām
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].7) Then he clothes [the person] with a fresh garment — with '<s>pari dhatta</s>' [AV 2.13.2], with two [verses].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].8) <ehy aśmānam ā tiṣṭha [2.13.4]>_iti dakṣiṇena pādenāśmamaṇḍalam āsthāpya pradakṣiṇam agnim anupariṇīya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].8) With '<s>ehy aśmānam ā tiṣṭha</s>' [AV 2.13.4], having made [the person] step on the stone disc with the right foot, he leads [the person] clockwise around the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].9) athāsya vāso nirmuṣṇāti <yasya te vāsaḥ [2.13.5]>_ity anayā
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].9) Then he removes his garment — with '<s>yasya te vāsaḥ</s>' [AV 2.13.5].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].10) atha_enam apareṇāhatena vasanenāchādayati_<ayaṃ vaste garbhaṃ pṛthivyā [13.1.16]> iti pañcabhiḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].10) Then he covers [the person] with a different fresh garment — with '<s>ayaṃ vaste garbhaṃ pṛthivyā</s>' [AV 13.1.16], with five [verses].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].11) <yathā dyauḥ [2.15.1]>_<manase cetase dhiya [6.41.1]> iti mahāvrīhīṇāṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā śāntyudakena_upasicyābhimantrya prāśayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].11) With '<s>yathā dyauḥ</s>' [AV 2.15.1], '<s>manase cetase dhiya</s>' [AV 6.41.1] — having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked oblation) of large rice, having sprinkled with pacificatory water, having consecrated with <s>mantras</s>, he feeds [the person].
(KauśS 7.5[54].12) With '<s>prāṇāpānau</s>' [AV 2.16.1], '<s>ojo 'si</s>' [AV 2.17.1], he should place [fuel-sticks].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].13) <tubhyam eva jariman [2.28.1]>_iti kumāraṃ mātāpitarau triḥ saṃprayachete
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].13) With '<s>tubhyam eva jariman</s>' [AV 2.28.1], the parents hand the child over three times [to each other].
(KauśS 7.5[54].14) They feed [the child] lumps of clarified butter.
(KauśS 7.5[54].15) And the tonsure ceremony (<s>cūḍākaraṇa</s>) is explained by the cow-gift (<s>godāna</s>) [rite].
(KauśS 7.5[54].16) Except for the clothing and the stone disc.
(KauśS 7.5[54].17) With '<s>śive te stāṃ</s>' [AV 8.2.14], up to the giving away.
(KauśS 7.5[54].18) With '<s>pārthivasya</s>' [AV 2.29.1], '<s>mā pra gāma</s>' [AV 13.1.59] — these four [verses] accompany all [rites].

body.text: (KauśS_7,5[54].19) amamrim ojomānīṃ ca dūrvāṃ ca keśān_ca śakṛtpiṇḍaṃ ca_ekadhābdisamāhṛtya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.5[54].19) Having gathered together the <s>amamri</s>, the vigor-giving [<s>dūrvā</s>-grass], the <s>dūrvā</s>-grass, the [cut] hairs, and the dung-lump —
(KauśS 7.5[54].20) he places [them] on top of [the stump of] a pacificatory tree.
(KauśS 7.5[54].21) The fee (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>) [for the priest] of <s>Brahman</s> is the bronze vessel, the garments, and a cow as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
(KauśS 7.5[54].22) They serve the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> with food.
(KauśS 7.6[55].1) The initiation (<s>upanayana</s>).
(KauśS 7.6[55].2) With '<s>āyam agan</s>' [AV 6.68.1], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS 7.6[55].3) With '<s>yat kṣureṇa</s>' [AV 8.2.17] — as stated.
(KauśS 7.6[55].4) With '<s>yenāvapat</s>' [AV 6.68.3], with the dung, without the <s>darbha</s>-tuft.
(KauśS 7.6[55].5) And the worldly [procedures are] the same, up to the clothing.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].6) upetapūrvasya niyataṃ savān dāsyato_agnīn ādhāsyamānaparyavetavratadīkṣiṣyamāṇānām (ed.: ādhāsyamānaḥ pary-; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 61)
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].6) For one who has been previously initiated, or one who is about to regularly offer the <s>savana</s> (libations), or one about to establish the sacred fires, or one about to undergo the <s>paryavetavrata</s> (observance), or one about to be consecrated (<s>dīkṣā</s>) —

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].7) soṣṇodakaṃ śāntyudakaṃ pradakṣiṇam anupariṇīya purastād agneḥ pratyaṅmukham avasthāpya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].7) with warm pacificatory water, having led [the student] clockwise, he stations [the student] in front of the fire, facing west.
(KauśS 7.6[55].8) He says: 'Speak.'
(KauśS 7.6[55].9) [The student says:] 'I have come for <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibate studentship); initiate me.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].10) ko nāmāsi kiṃgotra ity asau_iti yathā nāmagotre bhavatas tathā prabrūhi
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].10) 'What is your name? What is your <s>gotra</s> (lineage)?' — 'I am such-and-such' — state your name and <s>gotra</s> as they are.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].11) ārṣeyaṃ mā kṛtvā bandhum antam upanaya
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].11) 'Having made you [a member of] the <s>ṛṣi</s>-lineage (<s>ārṣeya</s>), I shall initiate you to the end of the bond [of studentship].'

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].12) ārṣeyaṃ tvā kṛtvā bandhum antam upanayāmīti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].12) 'Having made you [a member of] the <s>ṛṣi</s>-lineage, I initiate you to the end of the bond.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].13) oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om ity añjalau_udakam āsiñcati
