body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].13) [Reciting] '<s>Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad oṃ</s>,' he pours water into [the student's] joined palms.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].14) uttaro 'asāni brahmacāribhya ity uttamaṃ pāṇim anvādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].14) 'May I be superior among celibate students' — he places the uppermost palm [of the student in his own].

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].15) eṣa ma ādityaputras tan me gopāyasva_ity ādityena samīkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].15) 'This [student] of mine is a child of the Sun (<s>Āditya</s>); protect him for me' — he gazes at the sun together [with the student].

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].16) <apakrāman pauruṣeyād vṛṇāno [7.105.1]> ity enaṃ bāhugṛhītaṃ prāñcam avasthāpya dakṣiṇena pāṇinā nābhideśe_abhisaṃstabhya japati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].16) With '<s>apakrāman pauruṣeyād vṛṇāno</s>' [AV 7.105.1], having grasped him by the arm, having stationed him facing east, pressing the navel-region with the right hand, he mutters.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].17) <asmin vasu vasavo dhārayantu [1.9.1]>_<viśve devā vasavo [1.30.1]>_<ā yatu mitra [3.8.1]>_<amutrabhūyād [7.53.1]> <antakāya mṛtyave [8.1.1]>_<ā rabhasva [8.2.1]>_<prāṇāya namo [11.4.1]> <viṣāsahim [17.1.5]> ity abhimantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].17) With '<s>asmin vasu vasavo dhārayantu</s>' [AV 1.9.1], '<s>viśve devā vasavo</s>' [AV 1.30.1], '<s>ā yatu mitra</s>' [AV 3.8.1], '<s>amutrabhūyād</s>' [AV 7.53.1], '<s>antakāya mṛtyave</s>' [AV 8.1.1], '<s>ā rabhasva</s>' [AV 8.2.1], '<s>prāṇāya namo</s>' [AV 11.4.1], '<s>viṣāsahim</s>' [AV 17.1.5] — he consecrates [the student].

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].18) athāpi paritvaramāṇa <ā yātu mitra [3.8.1]>_ity api khalu_etavatā_eva_upanīto bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].18) Or even in haste, with '<s>ā yātu mitra</s>' [AV 3.8.1] — indeed, even with this much alone he becomes initiated.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].19) prachādya trīn prāṇāyāmān kṛtvāvachādya vatsatarīm udapātre samavekṣayet
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].19) Having covered [the student], having performed three breath-controls (<s>prāṇāyāma</s>), having uncovered [him], he should make [the student] gaze at a heifer in a water-vessel.

body.text: (KauśS_7,6[55].20) <sam indra no [7.97.2]>_<saṃ varcasā [6.53.3]>_iti dvābhyām utsṛjanti gām
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.6[55].20) With '<s>sam indra no</s>' [AV 7.97.2], '<s>saṃ varcasā</s>' [AV 6.53.3] — with these two [verses], they release the cow.
(KauśS 7.7[56].1) With '<s>śraddhāyā duhitā</s>' [AV 6.133.4], with two [verses], he ties on a <s>mauñjī mekhalā</s> (girdle of <s>muñja</s>-grass from the <s>Bhadra</s> variety).

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].2) mitrāvaruṇayos tvā hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā prayachāmīti pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].2) 'Impelled by the hands of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by authority I give you [this]' — he gives a <s>palāśa</s> (butea) staff.

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].3) mitrāvaruṇayos tvā hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā pratigṛhṇāmi | suśravaḥ suśravasaṃ mā kurv avakro 'vithuro 'haṃ bhūyāsam iti pratigṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].3) 'Impelled by the hands of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by authority I receive [this]. Of good fame, make me of good fame. May I become unbent and unshaken' — he receives [the staff].
(KauśS 7.7[56].4) And with '<s>śyeno 'si</s>' [AV 6.48.1].
(KauśS 7.7[56].5) Then he has [the student] place fuel-sticks for the vow-undertaking.

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].6) <agne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmi tac chakeyaṃ tat samāpeyaṃ tan me rādhyatāṃ tan me samṛdhyatāṃ tan me mā vyanaśat tena rādhyāsaṃ tat te prabravīmi tad upākaromi agnaye vratapataye svāhā [cf. TS 1.5.10.3 etc.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].6) [The student recites:] 'O <s>Agni</s>, lord of vows, I shall perform the vow; may I be able to do it; may I complete it; may it succeed for me; may it prosper for me; may it not be ruined; through it may I prosper. This I declare to you; this I undertake. To <s>Agni</s>, lord of vows — <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].7) <vāyo vratapate | sūrya vratapate | candra vratapate | āpo vratapatnyo | devā vratapatayo | vratānāṃ vratapatayo vratam acāriṣaṃ tad aśakaṃ tat samāptaṃ tan me rāddhaṃ tan me samṛddhaṃ tan me mā vyanaśat tena rādho 'smi tad vaḥ prabravīmi tad upākaromi vratebhyo vratapatibhyaḥ svāha [cf. TS 1.6.6.3 etc.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].7) [At completion:] 'O <s>Vāyu</s>, lord of vows! O <s>Sūrya</s>, lord of vows! O <s>Candra</s>, lord of vows! O Waters, ladies of vows! O gods, lords of vows! O lords of vows among vows — I have performed the vow; I was able; it is completed; it has succeeded for me; it has prospered for me; it is not ruined; through it I have prospered. This I declare to you; this I undertake. To the vows and to the lords of vows — <s>svāhā</s>!'
(KauśS 7.7[56].8) Then, having tied the girdle, having placed the fuel-stick, he makes [the student] recite the <s>Sāvitrī</s> [verse].
(KauśS 7.7[56].9) [He teaches it] syllable by syllable first.
(KauśS 7.7[56].10) Then half-verse by half-verse.
(KauśS 7.7[56].11) Then the complete [verse].

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].12) atha_enaṃ saṃśāsti_<agneś cāsi brahmacārin mama cāpo 'śāna karma kurūrdhvas tiṣṭhan mā divā svāpsīḥ samidha ādhehi [cf. ManB 1.6.23]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].12) Then he instructs [the student]: 'You are a celibate student of <s>Agni</s> and of me. Sip water, perform your duties, stand upright, do not sleep during the day, place fuel-sticks.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].13) atha_enaṃ bhūtebhyaḥ paridadāti_<agnaye tvā paridadāmi brahmaṇe tvā paridadāmy udaṅkyāya tvā śūlvāṇāya paridadāmi śatruṃjayāya tvā kṣātrāṇāya paridadāmi mārtyuṃjayāya tvā mārtyavāya paridadāmy aghorāya tvā paridadāmi takṣakāya tvā vaiśāleyāya paridadāmi hāhāhūhūbhyāṃ tvā gandharvābhyāṃ paridadāmi yogakṣemābhyāṃ tvā paridadāmi bhayāya ca tvābhayāya ca paridadāmi viśvebhyas tvā devebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvebhyas tvā devebhyaḥ paridadāmi viśvebhyas tvā bhūtebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvebhyas tvā bhūtebhyaḥ paridadāmi saprajāpatikebhyaḥ [cf. BhārGS 1.8:8.1ff.]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].13) Then he entrusts [the student] to the beings: 'I entrust you to <s>Agni</s>; I entrust you to <s>Brahman</s>; I entrust you to <s>Udaṅkya Śūlvāṇa</s>; I entrust you to <s>Śatrujaya Kṣātrāṇa</s>; I entrust you to <s>Mārtyujaya Mārtyava</s>; I entrust you to <s>Aghora</s>; I entrust you to <s>Takṣaka Vaiśāleya</s>; I entrust you to <s>Hāhā</s> and <s>Hūhū</s>, the two <s>Gandharvas</s>; I entrust you to <s>Yogakṣema</s> (safety and prosperity); I entrust you to Fear and Fearlessness; I entrust you to all the gods (<s>Viśvedevāḥ</s>); I entrust you to all the gods; I entrust you to all beings; I entrust you to all beings, together with <s>Prajāpati</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].14) <svasti caratād iha [cf. PS 20.53.2, HirGS 1.5.1]>_iti <mayi ramantāṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ [-]>_ity anugṛhṇīyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].14) With '<s>svasti caratād iha</s>' (May he fare well here) — 'May the celibate students delight in me' — he should bless [the student].
(KauśS 7.7[56].15) He should not send [the student] away.
(KauśS 7.7[56].16) With '<s>praṇītīr abhyāvartasva</s>' [AV 7.105.1], he turns [the student] toward himself.

body.text: (KauśS_7,7[56].17) <yathāpaḥ pravatā yanti yathā māsā aharjaram | evā mā brahmacāriṇo dhātar ā yantu sarvadā || [PS 20.52.9]> svāhā_ity ācāryaḥ samidham ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.7[56].17) [Reciting:] 'Just as waters flow downhill, just as months [flow] toward the year — so may celibate students come to me, O <s>Dhātṛ</s>, always!' [PS 20.52.9] — with '<s>svāhā</s>,' the teacher places the fuel-stick.

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].1) <śraddhāyā [ed. misprint: śrādhayā; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 51, Bloomfield GGA 1902 514] duhitā [6.133.4]>_iti dvābhyāṃ bhādramauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ brāhmaṇāya badhnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.8[57].1) With '<s>śraddhāyā duhitā</s>' [AV 6.133.4], with two [verses], he ties a <s>mauñjī mekhalā</s> (girdle of <s>muñja</s>-grass from the <s>Bhadra</s> variety) for a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.
(KauśS 7.8[57].2) One of <s>mūrvā</s>-fiber for a <s>kṣatriya</s>, or of bowstring.
(KauśS 7.8[57].3) One of linen for a <s>vaiśya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].4) mitrāvaruṇayos tvā hastābhyāṃ prasūtaḥ praśiṣā prayachāmīti pālāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayachati
body.translated_text: (KauśS 7.8[57].4) 'Impelled by the hands of <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>, by authority I give you [this]' — he gives a <s>palāśa</s> (butea) staff to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.
(KauśS 7.8[57].5) An <s>aśvattha</s> (fig-tree) [staff] to a <s>kṣatriya</s>.
(KauśS 7.8[57].6) A hanging <s>nyagrodha</s> (banyan) [root-staff] to a <s>vaiśya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].7) yadi_asya daṇḍo bhajyeta <ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ [14.2.47]>_ity etayālabhyābhimantrayate
body.translated_text: If his staff breaks, with '<s>ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ</s>' [AV 14.2.47], having touched [the staff], he consecrates it with <s>mantras</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].8) sarvatra śīrṇe bhinne naṣṭe_anyaṃ kṛtvā <punar maitv indriyaṃ [7.67.1]>_ity ādadhīta
body.translated_text: In all cases when [something is] shattered, split, or lost, having made another, with '<s>punar maitv indriyam</s>' [AV 7.67.1], he should place [it on the fire].
Now, garments.
Of antelope and deer [skin] for a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.
Of <s>ruru</s>-deer and spotted-deer [skin] for a <s>kṣatriya</s>.
Of goat and sheep [skin] for a <s>vaiśya</s>.
Linen, hemp, woolen, and cloth garments for all.
Saffron-dyed [garments].
And also a garment that is not saffron-dyed.
A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should go about [saying]: 'Lady, give alms.'
A <s>kṣatriya</s> [says]: 'Lady, please give alms.'
A <s>vaiśya</s> [says]: 'Give alms, lady.'

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].19) sapta kulāni brāhmaṇaś caret trīṇi kṣatriyo dve vaiśyaḥ
body.translated_text: A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should visit seven families, a <s>kṣatriya</s> three, a <s>vaiśya</s> two.
He should go for alms through the whole village, avoiding thieves and outcasts.
With '<s>mayy agre</s>' [AV 7.82.2], he offers with the five-question [formula].
With '<s>saṃ mā siñcantu</s>' [AV 7.33.1], he sprinkles around three times.

body.text: (KauśS_7,8[57].23) <yad agne tapasā tapa [7.61.1]>_<agne tapas tapyāmaha [7.62.2]> iti dvābhyāṃ parisamūhayati
body.translated_text: With '<s>yad agne tapasā tapa</s>' [AV 7.61.1] and '<s>agne tapas tapyāmaha</s>' [AV 7.62.2], with these two, he sweeps around.
With '<s>idam āpaḥ pravahata</s>' [AV 7.89.3], he washes the hands.
With '<s>saṃ mā siñcantu</s>' [AV 7.33.1], he sprinkles around three times.
With '<s>agne samidham āhārṣam</s>' [AV 19.64.1], he places four fuel-sticks.
With '<s>edho 'si</s>' [AV 7.89.4], he partakes of the steam-offering (<s>ūṣmabhakṣa</s>) until the conclusion.
With '<s>tvaṃ no medhe</s>' [AV 6.108.1], he worships.
With '<s>yad annam</s>' [AV 6.71.1], with three [verses], he offers from the alms-food.
Day after day, having brought fuel-sticks, thus he should add fuel morning and evening.
He should offer with the intelligence-generating (<s>medhājanana</s>) and life-giving (<s>āyuṣya</s>) [hymns].
At will, for twelve nights he subsists on tasteless food.

body.text: (KauśS_7,9[58].1) <bhadrāya karṇaḥ krośatu bhadrāyākṣi vi vepatām | parā duḥṣvapnyaṃ suva yad bhadraṃ tan na ā suva || akṣivepaṃ duḥṣvapnyam ārtiṃ puruṣareṣiṇīm | tad asmad aśvinā yuvam apriye prati muñcatam || yat pārśvād uraso me aṅgādaṅgād avavepate | aśvinā puṣkarasrajā tasmān naḥ pātam aṃhasaḥ [PS 20.54.6-8]>_iti karṇaṃ krośantam anumantrayate
body.translated_text: 'May the ear hear what is auspicious, may the eye flutter for what is auspicious; send away bad dreams, bring to us what is auspicious. || Eye-fluttering, bad dreams, pain, and the man-harming [omen] — from these, O <s>Aśvins</s>, you two release us onto the unpleasant one. || What flutters from my side, chest, or limb by limb — from that distress, O <s>Aśvins</s> wearing lotus-garlands, protect us.' [PS 20.54.6-8] — with this, he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the person whose] ear rings.
Or [whose] eye flutters.

body.text: (KauśS_7,9[58].3) <vi devā jarasā [3.31.1]>_<uta devā [4.13.1]> <āvatas ta [5.30.1]> <upa priyaṃ [7.32.1]>_<antakāya mṛtyave [8.1.1]>_<ā rabhasva [8.2.1]> <prāṇāya namo [11.4.1]> <viṣāsahiṃ [17.1.1]>_ity abhimantrayate
body.translated_text: With '<s>vi devā jarasā</s>' [AV 3.31.1], '<s>uta devā</s>' [AV 4.13.1], '<s>āvatas ta</s>' [AV 5.30.1], '<s>upa priyam</s>' [AV 7.32.1], '<s>antakāya mṛtyave</s>' [AV 8.1.1], '<s>ā rabhasva</s>' [AV 8.2.1], '<s>prāṇāya namo</s>' [AV 11.4.1], '<s>viṣāsahim</s>' [AV 17.1.1] — he consecrates with <s>mantras</s>.
As stated by the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, and the <s>ṛṣihasta</s> [procedure].

body.text: (KauśS_7,9[58].5) <karmaṇe vāṃ veṣāya vāṃ sukṛtāya vām [cf. TS 1.1.4.1 etc., KauśS 1.1.40]> iti pāṇī prakṣālya
body.translated_text: With '<s>karmaṇe vāṃ veṣāya vāṃ sukṛtāya vām</s>' [cf. TS 1.1.4.1, KauśS 1.1.40], having washed the hands,
with '<s>nir durarmaṇya</s>' [AV 16.2.1], having bathed,
with '<s>śuddhā na āpas</s>' [AV 12.1.30], having spat out, he sips with life-giving [waters].
With '<s>ehi jīvam</s>' [AV 4.9.1], he ties on the <s>āñjanamaṇi</s> (collyrium-jewel amulet).
With '<s>vātāj jāto</s>' [AV 4.10.1], [he ties on] a <s>kṛśana</s> [bead].
With '<s>nava prāṇān</s>' [AV 5.28.1], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,9[58].11) <ghṛtād ulluptam [5.28.14]> <ā tvā cṛtatv [5.28.12]> <ṛtubhiṣ ṭvā [5.28.13]> [cf. PS 2.59.10-12] <muñcāmi tvā [3.11.1]>_<uta devā [4.13.1]> <āvatas ta [5.30.1]> <upa priyaṃ [7.32.1]>_<antakāya mṛtyave [8.1.1]>_<ā rabhasva [8.2.1]> <prāṇāya namo [11.4.1]> <viṣāsahiṃ [17.1.1]>_ity abhimantrayate
body.translated_text: With '<s>ghṛtād ulluptam</s>' [AV 5.28.14], '<s>ā tvā cṛtatv</s>' [AV 5.28.12], '<s>ṛtubhiṣ ṭvā</s>' [AV 5.28.13] [cf. PS 2.59.10-12], '<s>muñcāmi tvā</s>' [AV 3.11.1], '<s>uta devā</s>' [AV 4.13.1], '<s>āvatas ta</s>' [AV 5.30.1], '<s>upa priyam</s>' [AV 7.32.1], '<s>antakāya mṛtyave</s>' [AV 8.1.1], '<s>ā rabhasva</s>' [AV 8.2.1], '<s>prāṇāya namo</s>' [AV 11.4.1], '<s>viṣāsahim</s>' [AV 17.1.1] — he consecrates with <s>mantras</s>.
With '<s>nir durarmaṇya</s>' [AV 16.2.1], with all fragrant powders, in the forest without opposition, he anoints.
Now, the naming ceremony (<s>nāmakaraṇa</s>).
With '<s>ā rabhasvemām</s>' [AV 8.2.1], he causes [the child] to touch an unbroken stream of water.
He ties on <s>pūtudāru</s> [wood].
He gives [it] to drink.
With '<s>yat te vāsaḥ</s>' [AV 8.2.16], he covers [the child] with an unworn garment as an upper cloth.
With '<s>śive te stām</s>' [AV 8.2.14], he brings out the boy for the first time.
With '<s>śivau te stām</s>' [AV 8.2.18], he feeds [the child] rice and barley.
With '<s>ahne ca tvā</s>' [AV 8.2.20], he entrusts [the child] to day and night.
With '<s>śarade tvā</s>' [AV 8.2.22], to the seasons.
With '<s>ud asya ketavo</s>' [AV 13.2.1], '<s>mūrdhāham</s>' [AV 16.3.1], '<s>viṣāsahim</s>' [AV 17.1.1], he worships [the sun] as it rises.
At midday, and as it sets — once with each of the two sets [of verses].
For those with inauspicious signs (<s>aṃholiṅga</s>), water is the offering — as stated.

body.text: (KauśS_7,9[58].25) uttamāsu <yan mātalī rathakrītam [11.6.23]> iti sarvāsāṃ dvitīyā
body.translated_text: In the last [verses], with '<s>yan mātalī rathakrītam</s>' [AV 11.6.23], the second [verse applies] for all of them.
With '<s>viśve devā</s>' [AV 1.30.1], one desiring long life worships the <s>Viśvedevas</s>.
He worships.
With '<s>idaṃ janāsa</s>' [AV 1.32.1], one desiring prosperity [worships] <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth).
One desiring success.
With '<s>indra juṣasva</s>' [AV 2.5.1], one desiring strength [worships] <s>Indra</s>.
With '<s>indram aham</s>' [AV 3.15.1], one desiring trade.
With '<s>ud enam uttaraṃ naya</s>' [AV 6.5.1], '<s>yo 'smān</s>' [AV 6.6.1], '<s>indraḥ sutrāmā</s>' [AV 7.91.1], one desiring a village.
For village-prosperity [rites], the conclusion.
With '<s>yaśasaṃ mendro</s>' [AV 6.58.1], one desiring fame.
With '<s>mahyam āpo</s>' [AV 6.61.1], one desiring spaciousness.
With '<s>āgachata</s>' [AV 6.82.1], one desiring a wife.
With '<s>vṛṣendrasya</s>' [AV 6.86.1], one desiring a bull.
With '<s>ā tvāhārṣam</s>' [AV 6.87.1], '<s>dhruvā dyaur</s>' [AV 6.88.1], one desiring stability.
With '<s>tyam ū ṣu</s>' [AV 7.85.1], '<s>trātāram</s>' [AV 7.86.1], '<s>ā mandrair</s>' [AV 7.117.1], one desiring safe passage.
With '<s>samās tvāgne</s>' [AV 2.6.1], '<s>abhy arcata</s>' [AV 7.82.1], one desiring success [worships] <s>Agni</s>.
With '<s>pṛthivyām</s>' [AV 4.39.1], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
With '<s>tad id āsa</s>' [AV 5.2.1], '<s>dhītī vā</s>' [AV 7.1.1], [one worships] <s>Indrāgnī</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_7,10[59].18) <yasyedam ā rajo [6.33.1]>_<atharvāṇaṃ [7.2.1]>_<aditir dyaur [7.6.1]> <diteḥ putrāṇām [7.7.1]>_<bṛhaspate savitar [7.16.1]> ity abhyuditaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ bodhayati
body.translated_text: With '<s>yasyedam ā rajo</s>' [AV 6.33.1], '<s>atharvāṇam</s>' [AV 7.2.1], '<s>aditir dyaur</s>' [AV 7.6.1], '<s>diteḥ putrāṇām</s>' [AV 7.7.1], '<s>bṛhaspate savitar</s>' [AV 7.16.1], he wakes a <s>brahmacārin</s> who has slept past sunrise.

body.text: (KauśS_7,10[59].19) <dhātā dadhātu [7.17.1]> <prajāpatir janayati [7.19.1]>_<anv adya no [7.20.1]> <yan na indro [7.24.1]> <yayor ojasā [7.25.1]> <viṣṇor nu kaṃ [7.26.1]>_<agnāviṣṇū [7.29.1]> <somārudrā [7.42.1]> <sinīvāli [7.46.1]> <bṛhaspatir naḥ [7.51.1]>_<yat te devā akṛṇvan [7.79.1]> <pūrṇā paścād [7.80.1]>_<prajāpate [7.80.3]>_<abhy arcata [7.82.1]> <ko asyā no [7.103.1]>_iti prajāpatim
body.translated_text: With '<s>dhātā dadhātu</s>' [AV 7.17.1], '<s>prajāpatir janayati</s>' [AV 7.19.1], '<s>anv adya no</s>' [AV 7.20.1], '<s>yan na indro</s>' [AV 7.24.1], '<s>yayor ojasā</s>' [AV 7.25.1], '<s>viṣṇor nu kam</s>' [AV 7.26.1], '<s>agnāviṣṇū</s>' [AV 7.29.1], '<s>somārudrā</s>' [AV 7.42.1], '<s>sinīvāli</s>' [AV 7.46.1], '<s>bṛhaspatir naḥ</s>' [AV 7.51.1], '<s>yat te devā akṛṇvan</s>' [AV 7.79.1], '<s>pūrṇā paścād</s>' [AV 7.80.1], '<s>prajāpate</s>' [AV 7.80.3], '<s>abhy arcata</s>' [AV 7.82.1], '<s>ko asyā no</s>' [AV 7.103.1] — [one worships] <s>Prajāpati</s>.
With '<s>agna indraś ca</s>' [AV 7.110.1], one desiring all [goals worships] the deities stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
With '<s>ya īśe</s>' [AV 2.34.1], '<s>ye bhakṣayanto</s>' [AV 2.35.1], one desiring a [heavenly] world [worships] <s>Indrāgnī</s>.
He gives food first.
The animal-offering is the last.
Offerings preceded by the <s>Sava</s> [pressing] are employed.
With '<s>doṣo gāya</s>' [AV 6.1.1], having completed the <s>Atharvan</s> [rites], he eats.
With '<s>abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī</s>' [AV 6.40.1], '<s>śyeno 'si</s>' [AV 6.48.1], in each direction, one desiring fearlessness [worships] the Seven Sages.

body.text: (KauśS_7,10[59].27) uttareṇa dīkṣitasya vā brahmacāriṇo vā daṇḍapradānaṃ
body.translated_text: The giving of the staff is to the north of one who is initiated or a <s>brahmacārin</s>.
With '<s>dyauś ca ma</s>' [AV 6.53.1], he will exert himself [in worship] to <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth).
With '<s>yo agnau</s>' [AV 7.87.1], one desiring safe passage [worships] the <s>Rudras</s>. One desiring safe passage.

body.text: (KauśS 7 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the seventh chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,1[60].1) agnīn ādhāsyamānaḥ savān vā dāsyan saṃvatsaraṃ brahmaudanikam agniṃ dīpayati
body.translated_text: One about to establish the [sacred] fires, or one about to give the <s>Sava</s> [pressings], kindles the <s>brahmaudanika</s> (brāhmaṇa's rice-gruel) fire for a year.
Or for a day and a night.
Or at will.
But a year is recommended.
The <s>sava</s>-fire and the <s>senāgni</s> (army-fire) — both being for that purpose — are to be produced by churning.
And both the <s>aupāsana</s> (domestic) [fires], for both are known [from tradition].
On that [fire], with the <s>devaheḍana</s> (divine-wrath appeasement [hymn]), he should offer ghee.
He should add fuel-sticks.
Or wood-chips.

body.text: (KauśS_8,1[60].10) tasmin yathākāmaṃ savān dadāti_ekaṃ dvau sarvān vā
body.translated_text: On that [fire], at will, he gives the <s>Sava</s> pressings — one, two, or all.
Or he causes the giver to recite self-blessings, one by one.
The recitation accompanies blessings directed at others and those with unspecified blessings.
The two givers perform the rites.
He consecrates them with <s>mantras</s> according to their characteristic marks.

body.text: (KauśS_8,1[60].15) ubhayaliṅgair ubhau puṃliṅgair dātāraṃ strīliṅgaiḥ patnīm
body.translated_text: With verses of both genders [he addresses] both; with masculine [verses] the giver; with feminine [verses] the wife.
Except for the water-carrying and the directing command.
Now, the place of worship (<s>devayajana</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_8,1[60].18) tad yat samaṃ samūlam avidagdhaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ prāgudakpravaṇam ākṛtiloṣṭavalmīkenāstīrya darbhaiś ca lomabhiḥ paśūnām
body.translated_text: That [ground] which is level, firm-rooted, unburnt, stable, and sloping to the north and east — having spread [it] with shaped clay bricks and an anthill, and with <s>darbha</s> grasses and the hairs of animals,
with '<s>agne jāyasva</s>' [AV 11.1.1], he consecrates the two who are churning with <s>mantras</s>.
The wife bows down to the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,1[60].21) yajamānaś ca [em. Caland, Kl. Schr. p. 89, Bloomfield GGA 1902 514]
body.translated_text: And the sacrificer [does likewise].
With '<s>kṛṇuta dhūmam</s>' [AV 11.1.2], [he addresses] the smoke.
With '<s>agne 'janiṣṭhā</s>' [AV 11.1.3], [he addresses the fire] when born.
With '<s>samiddho agne</s>' [AV 11.1.4], [he addresses the fire] as it is being kindled.
With '<s>parehi nāri</s>' [AV 11.1.13], he directs the woman who has fetched water — [she being] guarded and adorned.
With '<s>emā agur</s>' [AV 11.1.14a], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the woman] as she approaches.
With '<s>ut tiṣṭha nāri</s>' [AV 11.1.14b], he directs the wife.
(KauśS_8,1[60].28) With <prati kumbhaṃ gṛbhāya [11.1.14d]> he receives [the pot].
(KauśS_8,1[60].29) With <ūrjo bhāgo [11.1.15]> he places it down.
(KauśS_8,1[60].30) With <iyaṃ mahī [11.1.8]> he spreads the <s>carma</s> (hide) with its neck facing east and its hair upward.
(KauśS_8,1[60].31) With <pumān puṃso [12.3.1]> he makes [the sacrificer] mount the <s>carma</s> (hide).
(KauśS_8,1[60].32) [He does this] while the wife is calling.
(KauśS_8,1[60].33) On the third [verse], he calls the offspring to come after.
(KauśS_8,1[60].34) With <ṛṣipraśiṣṭā [11.1.15b]> he places the water vessel on the <s>carma</s> (hide).
(KauśS_8,1[60].35) Then with <āpas putrāso [12.3.4]> the couple together with their offspring sit down.
(KauśS_8,2[61].1) With <prācīṃprācīṃ [12.3.7]> [they do] as stated in the mantra.
(KauśS_8,2[61].2) With four [verses] they circumambulate the water vessel.
(KauśS_8,2[61].3) In each direction, with <dhruveyaṃ virāṇ [12.3.11]> they stand in attendance.

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].4) <piteva putrān [12.3.12]> ity avarohya bhūmiṃ tena_udakārthān kurvanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].4) With <piteva putrān [12.3.12]>, having descended, they perform the water-related acts on the ground with that [water].
(KauśS_8,2[61].5) They sprinkle themselves with the <s>pavitre</s> (purifying strainers).
(KauśS_8,2[61].6) With the tips of two <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) blades, he sprinkles the <s>carma</s> (hide) and the offering.
(KauśS_8,2[61].7) He gives the designated [items] to the wife of [the one] not of the same lineage.
(KauśS_8,2[61].8) Those, with <tredhā bhāgo [11.1.5]>, he places rice grains in the blessing portions.

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].9) teṣāṃ yaḥ pitṝṇāṃ taṃ śrāddhaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].9) Of those [portions], the one that belongs to the <s>pitṛs</s> (ancestors) — with that he performs the <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestral offering).
(KauśS_8,2[61].10) The one that belongs to humans — with that he feeds <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].11) yo devānāṃ tam <agne sahasvān [11.1.6]> iti dakṣiṇaṃ jānu_ācyāparājitābhimukhaḥ prahvo vā muṣṭiprasṛtāñjalibhiḥ kumbhyāṃ nirvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].11) The one that belongs to the gods — with <agne sahasvān [11.1.6]>, bending his right knee, facing the invincible [direction], or bowing, he offers it into the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot) with fist-fulls and open-palmed handfuls.
(KauśS_8,2[61].12) Or four [handfuls] from the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot).
(KauśS_8,2[61].13) Those, with <sapta medhān [12.3.16]>, the couple together with offspring touch.
(KauśS_8,2[61].14) With <gṛhṇāmi hastam [12.3.17c]>, [they do] as stated in the mantra.
(KauśS_8,2[61].15) With <trayo varā [11.1.10c]>, 'Choose three boons,' [he says].

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].16) anena karmaṇā dhruvān iti prathamaṃ vṛṇīte
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].16) By this rite, 'May [our possessions] be firm' — thus he chooses the first [boon].
(KauśS_8,2[61].17) The other two — those the wife [chooses].

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].18) <etau grāvāṇau [11.1.9]>_<ayaṃ grāvā [12.3.14]>_ity ulūkhalamusalaṃ śūrpaṃ prakṣālitaṃ carmaṇi_ādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].18) With <etau grāvāṇau [11.1.9]> and <ayaṃ grāvā [12.3.14]>, having washed the <s>ulūkhala</s> (mortar), <s>musala</s> (pestle), and <s>śūrpa</s> (winnowing basket), he places them on the <s>carma</s> (hide).
(KauśS_8,2[61].19) With <gṛhāṇa grāvāṇau [11.1.10]> he grasps both [implements].
(KauśS_8,2[61].20) With <sākaṃ sajātaiḥ [11.1.7]> he pours the rice grains into the <s>ulūkhala</s> (mortar).
(KauśS_8,2[61].21) With <vanaspatiḥ [12.3.15]> he raises the <s>musala</s> (pestle).
(KauśS_8,2[61].22) With <nirbindhy aṃśūn [11.1.9b]> and <grāhiṃ pāpmānam [12.3.18]> they pound.
(KauśS_8,2[61].23) With <iyaṃ te dhītir [11.1.11]> and <varṣavṛddham [12.3.19c]> he takes up the <s>śūrpa</s> (winnowing basket).
(KauśS_8,2[61].24) With <ūrdhvaṃ prajām [11.1.9d]> and <viśvavyacā [12.3.19]> [he recites] while she winnows upward.
(KauśS_8,2[61].25) With <parā punīhi [11.1.11c]> and <tuṣaṃ palāvān [12.3.19d]> [he recites] while she sifts and cleans.
(KauśS_8,2[61].26) With <pṛthag rūpāṇi [12.3.21]> [he recites] while she separates [the grains].
(KauśS_8,2[61].27) With <trayo lokāḥ [12.3.20]> the couple touches the separated [grains].
(KauśS_8,2[61].28) With <punar ā yantu śūrpam [12.3.20d]> he pours them back [into the winnowing basket].
(KauśS_8,2[61].29) With <upaśvase [11.1.12]> he blows away [the chaff].
(KauśS_8,2[61].30) With <pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyām [12.3.22]> he smears the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot).
(KauśS_8,2[61].31) With <agne carur [11.1.16]> he places it on the fire.
(KauśS_8,2[61].32) With <agniḥ pacan [12.3.24]> he adds fuel around it.
(KauśS_8,2[61].33) With <ṛṣipraśiṣṭā [11.1.15b]> he draws out the water.
(KauśS_8,2[61].34) With <śuddhāḥ pūtāḥ [11.1.17]> and <pūtāḥ pavitraiḥ [12.3.25]>, having placed [the water] between the <s>pavitre</s> (purifying strainers),
(KauśS_8,2[61].35) he pours in the water.

body.text: (KauśS_8,2[61].36) <brahmaṇā śuddhāḥ [11.1.18]> <saṃkhyātā stokāḥ [12.3.28]>_ity āpas tāsu niktvā taṇḍulān āvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,2[61].36) With <brahmaṇā śuddhāḥ [11.1.18]> and <saṃkhyātā stokāḥ [12.3.28]>, having washed the rice grains in those waters, he pours [them] in.
(KauśS_8,2[61].37) With <uruḥ prathasva [11.1.19]> and <ud yodhanti [12.3.29]> he cooks [the rice].
(KauśS_8,2[61].38) With <pra yacha parśuṃ [12.3.31]> he hands over the sickle for gathering <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass).
(KauśS_8,2[61].39) With <oṣadhīr dāntu parvan [12.3.31b]> he cuts above the joints.
(KauśS_8,2[61].40) With <navaṃ barhir [12.3.32]> he strews the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).
(KauśS_8,2[61].41) With <udehi vediṃ [11.1.21]> and <dhartā dhriyasva [12.3.35]> he removes [the pot from the fire].
(KauśS_8,2[61].42) With <abhyāvartasva [11.1.22]> he turns the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot) clockwise.
(KauśS_8,2[61].43) With <vanaspate stīrṇam [12.3.33]> he places the <s>pātrī</s> (dish) on the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).
(KauśS_8,2[61].44) With <aṃsadhrīṃ [11.1.23c]> he places [it] near.
(KauśS_8,2[61].45) With <upa stṛṇīhi [12.3.27]> he under-layers with ghee.
(KauśS_8,2[61].46) With <upastarīr [12.3.28]> he consecrates the under-layered [offering] with a mantra.
(KauśS_8,3[62].1) With <aditer hastāṃ [11.1.24]> and <sarvān samāgā [12.3.36]>, [they do] as stated in the mantra.
(KauśS_8,3[62].2) Then, having taken water, he brings it to the <s>pātrī</s> (dish).
(KauśS_8,3[62].3) With a ladle, into the <s>kumbhī</s> (pot).
(KauśS_8,3[62].4) What was done with the ladle, he brings back to that same [place].

body.text: (KauśS_8,3[62].5) darvyā_uttamam apādāya tatsuhṛd dakṣiṇato_agner udaṅmukha āsīno dhārayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,3[62].5) Having taken the topmost portion with the ladle, his friend, seated to the south of the fire facing north, holds it.
(KauśS_8,3[62].6) Then he lifts out [the offering].

body.text: (KauśS_8,3[62].7) uddhṛte yad apādāya dhārayati tat uttarārdha ādadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,3[62].7) When it is lifted out, what he had taken and held, that he places on the upper half.

body.text: (KauśS_8,3[62].8) anuttarādharatāyā odanasya yad uttaraṃ tad uttaram odana eva_odanaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,3[62].8) Regarding the non-distinction of upper and lower of the <s>odana</s> (cooked rice): what is upper is [simply] upper — <s>odana</s> (cooked rice) is just <s>odana</s> (cooked rice).
(KauśS_8,3[62].9) With <ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaratsu [12.3.34]> he places [the offering] to the west of the fire.
(KauśS_8,3[62].10) With <nidhiṃ nidhipā [12.3.42]> he makes three sections.
(KauśS_8,3[62].11) With <yadyaj jāyā [12.3.39]>, [they do] as stated in the mantra.
(KauśS_8,3[62].12) She holds onto her husband.
(KauśS_8,3[62].13) While they are holding on, from this point onward he performs [the rites].
(KauśS_8,3[62].14) With <agnī rakṣas [12.3.43]> he performs the <s>paryagni</s> (fire-circumambulation rite).
(KauśS_8,3[62].15) With <babhrer adhvaryo [11.1.31]> and <idam prāpam [12.3.45]> he makes the <s>āpāna</s> (drinking vessel) on top.
(KauśS_8,3[62].16) With <babhrer brahmann [cf. 11.1.31]> he should address one who is not the <s>Adhvaryu</s> (officiating priest).

body.text: (KauśS_8,3[62].17) <ghṛtena gātrā [11.1.31c]>_<ā siñca sarpir [12.3.45c]> iti sarpiṣā viṣyandayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,3[62].17) With <ghṛtena gātrā [11.1.31c]> and <ā siñca sarpir [12.3.45c]> he makes [the offering] drip with ghee.
(KauśS_8,3[62].18) With <vasor yā dhārā [12.3.41]> and <ādityebhyo aṅgirobhyo [12.3.44]> he pours juices over [the offering].
(KauśS_8,3[62].19) With <priyaṃ priyāṇāṃ [12.3.49]>, to the north of the fire, he consecrates with mantras the cow and other [gifts].
(KauśS_8,3[62].20) Having had it milked as prescribed with <atyāsarat prathamā [PS 5.31.1]>, he pours [the milk] over [the offering].

body.text: (KauśS_8,3[62].21) <atyāsarat prathamā dhokṣyamāṇā sarvān yajñān bibhratī vaiśvadevī | upa vatsaṃ sṛjata vāśyate gaur vy asṛṣṭa sumanā hiṃ kṛṇoti || badhāna vatsam abhi dhehi bhuñjatī nijya godhug upa sīda dugdhi | irām asmā odanaṃ pinvamānā kīlālaṃ ghṛtaṃ madam annabhāgam || sā dhāvatu yamarājñaḥ savatsā sudughāṃ pathā prathameha dattā | atūrṇadattā prathamedam āgan vatsena gāṃ saṃ sṛja viśvarūpām [PS 5.31.1-3]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,3[62].21) <atyāsarat prathamā dhokṣyamāṇā sarvān yajñān bibhratī vaiśvadevī | upa vatsaṃ sṛjata vāśyate gaur vy asṛṣṭa sumanā hiṃ kṛṇoti || badhāna vatsam abhi dhehi bhuñjatī nijya godhug upa sīda dugdhi | irām asmā odanaṃ pinvamānā kīlālaṃ ghṛtaṃ madam annabhāgam || sā dhāvatu yamarājñaḥ savatsā sudughāṃ pathā prathameha dattā | atūrṇadattā prathamedam āgan vatsena gāṃ saṃ sṛja viśvarūpām [PS 5.31.1-3]> — thus.
(KauśS_8,3[62].22) With <idaṃ me jyotir [11.1.28]> and <sam agnayaḥ [12.3.50]> he places gold on top [of the offering].
(KauśS_8,3[62].23) With <eṣā tvacāṃ [12.3.51]> he places a home-woven garment in front, together with gold.
(KauśS_8,4[63].1) With <yad akṣeṣu [12.3.52]> the couple wears matching garments.

body.text: (KauśS_8,4[63].2) dvitīyaṃ tat pāpacailaṃ bhavati tan manuṣyāndhamāya dadyād ity eke
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,4[63].2) The second garment becomes the soiled one; some say one should give that to a blind person.

body.text: (KauśS_8,4[63].3) <śṛtaṃ tvā havyam [11.1.25]> iti vatura ārṣeyān bhṛgvaṅgirovid upasādayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,4[63].3) With <śṛtaṃ tvā havyam [11.1.25]>, at the <s>Vātura</s> [fire], he seats the <s>ārṣeya</s> (lineage-descended) priests who know the <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s> [traditions].
(KauśS_8,4[63].4) With <śuddhāḥ pūtā [11.1.27]>, [they do] as stated in the mantra.
(KauśS_8,4[63].5) With <pakvaṃ kṣetrāt [11.1.28b]> and <varṣaṃ vanuṣva [12.3.53]> he removes [the offering from the fire].
(KauśS_8,4[63].6) With <agnau tuṣān [11.1.29]> he throws the husks into the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_8,4[63].7) <paraḥ kambūkān [11.1.29b]> iti savyena pādena phalīkaraṇān apohati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,4[63].7) With <paraḥ kambūkān [11.1.29b]> he pushes away the broken grains with his left foot.
(KauśS_8,4[63].8) With <tanvaṃ svargo [12.3.54]> he throws the other [husks] in.
(KauśS_8,4[63].9) With <agne prehi [4.14.5]> and <samācinuṣva [11.1.36]> he should offer ghee.
(KauśS_8,4[63].10) This is the <s>saṃskāra</s> (consecration procedure) of the <s>savanas</s> (pressings/extractions).
(KauśS_8,4[63].11) Those [elements] whose purpose is lost revert [to the basic form].
(KauśS_8,4[63].12) He adapts the mantra according to the [particular] <s>savana</s> (pressing).

body.text: (KauśS_8,4[63].13) liṅgaṃ parihitasya liṅgasyānantaraṃ karmakarmānupūrveṇa liṅgaṃ parīkṣeta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,4[63].13) One should examine the characteristic mark of the [ritual] that has been performed: in the order of ritual acts, [examine] the mark immediately following the mark that was assigned.
(KauśS_8,4[63].14) Or by the characteristic mark [alone].
(KauśS_8,4[63].15) The order following the origin of the ritual act is recommended.
(KauśS_8,4[63].16) When the origin is otherwise, [one proceeds] according to the characteristic mark.
(KauśS_8,4[63].17) [When there are] equal meanings, there is combination (<s>samuccaya</s>); or alternatively, option (<s>vikalpa</s>).
(KauśS_8,4[63].18) Now, the distinction between these two [is as follows].
(KauśS_8,4[63].19) With the <s>sūkta</s> (hymn), he first makes [the offering] <s>saṃpātavant</s> (with remainders).

(KauśS_8,4[63].20) With <śrāmyataḥ [11.1.30]> and the following [verses], or with the <s>sūkta</s> (hymn), having consecrated with mantras and having recited aloud, the giver, being addressed, should give.
(KauśS_8,4[63].21) With the <s>anuvāka</s> (section of verses), he makes the second [offering] <s>saṃpātavant</s> (with remainders).

body.text: (KauśS_8,4[63].22) <prācyai tvā diśe [12.3.55]>_itiprabhṛtibhir vānuvākenābhimantryābhinigadya dadyād dātā vācyamānaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,4[63].22) With <prācyai tvā diśe [12.3.55]> and the following [verses], or with the <s>anuvāka</s> (section of verses), having consecrated with mantras and having recited aloud, the giver, being addressed, should give.
(KauśS_8,4[63].23) According to the [particular] <s>savana</s> (pressing), the others separately — thus is the basic procedure.
(KauśS_8,4[63].24) All [are performed] according to their origin [as taught by] the <s>Ācāryas</s> (teachers), except the <s>pañcaudana</s> (five-rice offering).
(KauśS_8,4[63].25) Those that have been employed are not to be employed again.
(KauśS_8,4[63].26) Some [prescribe] a cow together with gold as the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
(KauśS_8,4[63].27) Or <s>Kaurupathi</s> [prescribes] a cow as the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
(KauśS_8,4[63].28) Of the <s>saṃpātavant</s> (with-remainders offering), having consecrated with mantras and having recited aloud, the giver, being addressed, should give.
(KauśS_8,4[63].29) <etaṃ bhāgaṃ [6.122.1]>, <etaṃ sadhasthāḥ [6.123.1]>, <ulūkhale [10.9.26]> — these are the concluding oblations.
(KauśS_8,4[63].30) He offers into [the fire].
(KauśS_8,4[63].31) And the consecrating recitation [follows].
(KauśS_8,5[64].1) With <āśānām [1.31.1]>, [he prepares] the four-dish offering.
(KauśS_8,5[64].2) With <yad rājāno [3.29.1]> he looks upon [the offering].
(KauśS_8,5[64].3) On the footprints of one who has bathed his feet, he places cakes separately at each foot.
(KauśS_8,5[64].4) A fifth [cake] at the navel.
(KauśS_8,5[64].5) While wrapping with a garment, [he makes it] <s>saṃpātavant</s> (with remainders), together with gold.
(KauśS_8,5[64].6) With '<s>ā nayaitam</s>' [AV 9.5.1], from the unconquered [place], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> the goat being led.
(KauśS_8,5[64].7) With '<s>indrāya bhāgaṃ</s>' [AV 9.5.2], [he consecrates] [the goat] being led around the fire.
(KauśS_8,5[64].8) With '<s>ye no dviṣanti</s>' [AV 9.5.2c], [he consecrates the goat] being killed.
(KauśS_8,5[64].9) With '<s>pra pado</s>' [AV 9.5.3], [he consecrates] the one washing the feet.
(KauśS_8,5[64].10) With '<s>anuchya śyāmena</s>' [AV 9.5.4], [he consecrates the goat] entering limb by limb.
(KauśS_8,5[64].11) With '<s>ṛcā kumbhīm</s>' [AV 9.5.5], [he consecrates] the one placing [it] on the fire.
(KauśS_8,5[64].12) With '<s>ā siñca</s>' [AV 9.5.5b], [he consecrates] the one pouring in.
(KauśS_8,5[64].13) With '<s>ava dhehi</s>' [AV 9.5.5b-Part], [he consecrates] the one placing down.
(KauśS_8,5[64].14) With '<s>paryādhatta</s>' [AV 9.5.5c], [he consecrates] the one placing around.
(KauśS_8,5[64].15) With '<s>śṛto gachatu</s>' [AV 9.5.5d], [he consecrates] the one removing [it from the fire].
(KauśS_8,5[64].16) With '<s>ut krāmātaḥ</s>' [AV 9.5.6], [he consecrates] the one lifting [it] out behind the fire onto <s>darbha</s> grasses.
(KauśS_8,5[64].17) When it is lifted out, with '<s>ajam anajmi</s>' [AV 4.14.6], he anoints [it] with ghee.
(KauśS_8,5[64].18) With '<s>pañcaudanaṃ</s>' [AV 4.14.7], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.
(KauśS_8,5[64].19) He places the rice-offerings on separate pedestals.
(KauśS_8,5[64].20) The fifth in the middle.
(KauśS_8,5[64].21) The southern rear half, having sprinkled with the sacrificial post,
(KauśS_8,5[64].22) with '<s>śṛtam ajaṃ</s>' [AV 4.14.9], the hide of this [goat] with head and feet still attached.
(KauśS_8,5[64].23) With '<s>ajo hi</s>' [AV 4.14.1], with the entire hymn, [he performs] with remainders, as stated.
(KauśS_8,5[64].24) The upper unwoven [cloth] — in front of it he places [an offering] together with gold.
(KauśS_8,5[64].25) With '<s>pañca rukmā</s>' [AV 9.5.25(26)], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,5[64].26) dhenvādīni_uttarataḥ sopadhānam āstaraṇam vāso hiraṇyaṃ ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,5[64].26) A milch cow and so forth to the north, along with a cushion, a coverlet, a garment, and gold.
(KauśS_8,5[64].27) With '<s>ā nayaitam</s>' [AV 9.5.1], with the entire hymn, with remainders.
(KauśS_8,5[64].28) Up to the anointing — [the rite] of the <s>śataudanā</s> (hundred-rice offering) is explained by the <s>pañcaudana</s> (five-rice offering).
(KauśS_8,6[65].1) With '<s>aghāyatām</s>' [AV 10.9.1], here he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the offering] whose mouth is being covered.
(KauśS_8,6[65].2) With '<s>sapatneṣu vajram</s>' [AV 10.9.1b], '<s>grāvā tvaiṣo</s>' [AV 10.9.2d], [he consecrates the offering] falling down.
(KauśS_8,6[65].3) With '<s>vediṣ ṭe</s>' [AV 10.9.2], he spreads [the altar] as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,6[65].4) viṃśatyodanāsu śrayaṇīṣu śatam avadānāni vadhrīsaṃnaddhāni pṛthagodaneṣūpary ādadhati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,6[65].4) Among twenty rice-cooking vessels, he places on top a hundred cut portions bound with leather strips, on separate rice-offerings.

body.text: (KauśS_8,6[65].5) madhyamāyāḥ prathame randhriṇyāmikṣāṃ daśame_abhitaḥ saptasaptāpūpān pariśrayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,6[65].5) Of the middle one, in the first perforated [vessel] he [places] curds, around the tenth he arranges seven and seven cakes.
(KauśS_8,6[65].6) On the fifteenth, two sacrificial cakes.
(KauśS_8,6[65].7) At the front, gold.
(KauśS_8,6[65].8) With '<s>apo devīr</s>' [AV 10.9.27], water pots in front.
(KauśS_8,6[65].9) With '<s>bālās te</s>' [AV 10.9.3], with the entire hymn, with remainders.
(KauśS_8,6[65].10) Having led [the offering] around the fire to the right, the seating, washing, and sipping have been stated.
(KauśS_8,6[65].11) Having brought water to the hand,

body.text: (KauśS_8,6[65].12) athāmuṣya_odanasyāvadānānāṃ ca madhyāt pūrvārdhāt_ca dvir avadāya_upariṣṭād udakenābhighārya juhoti <somena pūto jaṭhare sīda brahmaṇām [11.1.25c]> <ārṣeyeṣu ni dadha odana tvā [11.1.33a]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,6[65].12) then, having cut twice from the middle and the front half of that rice-offering and its cut portions, having sprinkled with water from above, he offers [with the verses]: '<s>soma</s>-purified, settle in the belly of the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>' [AV 11.1.25c], 'Among those of the seer-lineage I place you, O rice-offering' [AV 11.1.33a].
(KauśS_8,6[65].13) Then he partakes.

body.text: (KauśS_8,6[65].14) <agneṣ ṭvāsyena prāśnāmi bṛhaspater mukhena | indrasya tvā jaṭhare sādayāmi varuṇasyodare | tad yathā hutam iṣṭaṃ prāśnīyād devātmā tvā prāśnāmy ātmāsy ātmann ātmānaṃ me mā hiṃsīr [PS 20.57.14; cf. PS 9.21.1ff., VSK 2.3.5+7, VaitS 3.11]> iti prāśitam anumantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,6[65].14) 'With the mouth of <s>Agni</s> I partake of you, with the mouth of <s>Bṛhaspati</s>; I seat you in the belly of <s>Indra</s>, in the stomach of <s>Varuṇa</s>. Just as one would eat what has been offered and sacrificed — being one with the deity, I partake of you; you are the self, do not harm the self in my self' [PS 20.57.14; cf. PS 9.21.1ff.] — thus he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> what has been eaten.

body.text: (KauśS_8,6[65].15) <yo 'gnir nṛmaṇā nāma brāhmaṇeṣu praviṣṭaḥ | tasmin ma eṣa suhuto 'stv odanaḥ sa mā mā hiṃsīt parame vyoman || so asmabhyam astu parame vyomann [cf. PS 20.57.15, PS 16.72.9]> iti dātāraṃ vācayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,6[65].15) 'That <s>Agni</s> called <s>Nṛmaṇas</s> who has entered among the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> — in him may this rice-offering be well-offered for me; may he not harm me in the highest heaven; may he be for us in the highest heaven' [cf. PS 20.57.15, PS 16.72.9] — thus he causes the giver to recite.
(KauśS_8,6[65].16) Up to the viewing — [the rite] of the <s>śataudanā</s> (hundred-rice offering) is explained by the morning recitation.
(KauśS_8,7[66].1) With '<s>vāṅ ma āsan</s>' [AV 19.60.1], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> as stated in the <s>mantra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].2) <bṛhatā mano [5.10.8]> <dyauś ca me [6.53.1]> <punar maitv indriyaṃ [7.67.1]>_iti pratimantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].2) With '<s>bṛhatā mano</s>' [AV 5.10.8], '<s>dyauś ca me</s>' [AV 6.53.1], '<s>punar maitv indriyaṃ</s>' [AV 7.67.1], he recites counter-<s>mantras</s>.
(KauśS_8,7[66].3) When the counter-<s>mantras</s> have been recited, having divided [the food], they eat.
(KauśS_8,7[66].4) For the <s>śataudanā</s> (hundred-rice offering), twelve hundred [are the] gifts (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>).
(KauśS_8,7[66].5) For one giving more, the fulfillment of desire is attained.
(KauśS_8,7[66].6) With '<s>brahmāsya</s>' [AV 4.34.1], in the rice-offering he makes pools in each direction.
(KauśS_8,7[66].7) On top, a drinking place.
(KauśS_8,7[66].8) Around that, four directional channels.
(KauśS_8,7[66].9) He fills them with juices.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].10) pṛthivyāṃ surayādbhir āṇḍīkādivanti mantroktāni pratidiśaṃ nidhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].10) On the ground, having placed [vessels] containing liquor, water, and <s>āṇḍīka</s> (a plant) and so forth as stated in the <s>mantra</s> in each direction,
(KauśS_8,7[66].11) with '<s>yam odanaṃ</s>' [AV 4.35.1], the death-transcending [rite].
(KauśS_8,7[66].12) With '<s>anaḍvān</s>' [AV 4.11.1], [the offering of] a draft-ox.
(KauśS_8,7[66].13) With '<s>sūryasya raśmīn</s>' [AV 4.38.5], he gives a <s>karkī</s> (white cow) together with a barren cow.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].14) <āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir [6.31.1]> <ayaṃ sahasram [7.22.1]> iti pṛśnim gām
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].14) With '<s>āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnir</s>' [AV 6.31.1], '<s>ayaṃ sahasram</s>' [AV 7.22.1], a speckled cow.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].15) <devā imaṃ madunā saṃyutaṃ yavaṃ [6.30.1]> iti paunaḥśilaṃ madhumantaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ saṃpātavantam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].15) With '<s>devā imaṃ madunā saṃyutaṃ yavaṃ</s>' [AV 6.30.1], a <s>Punaḥśila</s> [stone] with honey and gold, with remainders.
(KauśS_8,7[66].16) With '<s>punantu mā devajanāḥ</s>' [AV 6.19.1], a purificatory <s>kṛśara</s> (rice and sesame dish).
(KauśS_8,7[66].17) With '<s>kaḥ pṛśniṃ</s>' [AV 7.104.1], a field.
(KauśS_8,7[66].18) With '<s>sāhasras</s>' [AV 9.4.1], a bull.
(KauśS_8,7[66].19) With '<s>prajāpatiś ca</s>' [AV 9.7.1], a draft-ox.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].20) <namas te jāyamānāyai [10.10.1]> <dadāmi [12.4.1]>_iti vaśām udapātreṇa saṃpātavatā saṃprokṣyābhimantryābhinigadya dadyād dātā vācyamānaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].20) With '<s>namas te jāyamānāyai</s>' [AV 10.10.1], '<s>dadāmi</s>' [AV 12.4.1], having sprinkled a barren cow with a water vessel containing remainders, having consecrated with <s>mantras</s>, having recited aloud — the giver, being instructed, should give.
(KauśS_8,7[66].21) With '<s>bhūmiṣ ṭvā</s>' [AV 3.29.8], he accepts her.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].22) <upamitāṃ [9.3.1 (5.28.5)]>_iti yat_śālayā saha dāsyan bhavati tad antar bhavati_apihitam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].22) With '<s>upamitāṃ</s>' [AV 9.3.1 (5.28.5)], whatever he is going to give together with a hall — that is placed inside, concealed.
(KauśS_8,7[66].23) But what is stated in the <s>mantra</s> is commended.
(KauśS_8,7[66].24) With '<s>iṭasya te vi cṛtāmi</s>' [AV 9.3.18], he opens the door.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].25) <pratīcīṃ tvā pratīcīnaḥ [9.3.22]>_ity udapātram agnim ādāya prapadyante
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].25) With '<s>pratīcīṃ tvā pratīcīnaḥ</s>' [AV 9.3.22], taking a water vessel and fire, they enter.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].26) tad antar eva sūktena saṃpātavat karoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].26) Inside that very [hall], he performs with the hymn, with remainders.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].27) udapātreṇa saṃpātavatā śālāṃ saṃprokṣyābhimantryābhinigadya dadyād dātā vācyamānaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].27) Having sprinkled the hall with a water vessel containing remainders, having consecrated with <s>mantras</s>, having recited aloud — the giver, being instructed, should give.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].28) <antarā dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca [9.3.15]>_ity enāṃ pratigṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].28) With '<s>antarā dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca</s>' [AV 9.3.15], he accepts her.
(KauśS_8,7[66].29) With '<s>upamitāṃ</s>' [AV 9.3.1], he distributes as stated in the <s>mantras</s>.
(KauśS_8,7[66].30) With '<s>mā naḥ pāśaṃ</s>' [AV 9.3.24], having consecrated with <s>mantras</s>, he holds [the offering].
(KauśS_8,7[66].31) With '<s>nāsyāsthīni</s>' [AV 9.5.23], as stated.

body.text: (KauśS_8,7[66].32) <sarvam enaṃ samādaya [9.5.23c]>_ity adbhiḥ pūrṇe garte pravidhya saṃvapati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,7[66].32) With '<s>sarvam enaṃ samādaya</s>' [AV 9.5.23c], having thrown [it] into a pit filled with water, he buries [it].
(KauśS_8,7[66].33) And the <s>śataudanā</s> (hundred-rice offering) [likewise].

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].1) saṃbhṛteṣu sāvikeṣu saṃbhāreṣu brāhmaṇam ṛtvijaṃ vṛṇīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].1) When the <s>sāvika</s> (Soma-related) requisites have been assembled, he should choose a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> as the officiating priest.
(KauśS_8,8[67].2) A seer, of seer-lineage, of good disposition regarding gifts, without ulterior motive.

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].3) eṣa ha vā ṛṣir ārṣeyaḥ sudhātudakṣiṇo yasya tryavarārdhyāḥ pūrvapuruṣā vidyācaraṇavṛttaśīlasaṃpannāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].3) He indeed is a seer, of seer-lineage, of good disposition regarding gifts, whose ancestors for three and a half generations were endowed with learning, conduct, livelihood, and character.
(KauśS_8,8[67].4) [He should do this] during the northern course [of the sun], say some.
(KauśS_8,8[67].5) Now we shall explain the rules of procedure for the rice-offering pressings (<s>odanasava</s>).
(KauśS_8,8[67].6) Having given the pressings, he should establish the fires.
(KauśS_8,8[67].7) [It should be] according to all Vedas, say some.
(KauśS_8,8[67].8) All Vedas have a twofold arrangement.
(KauśS_8,8[67].9) The <s>dīkṣā</s> (consecration) lasts half a month, or twelve nights.
(KauśS_8,8[67].10) Three nights, say some.
(KauśS_8,8[67].11) They should be celibate (<s>brahmacārin</s>), eating only <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial) food.
(KauśS_8,8[67].12) They should sleep on the ground.

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].13) kartṛdātārau_ā samāpanāt kāmaṃ na bhuñjīran saṃtatāś cet syuḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].13) The performer and the givers should not eat at will until the completion, if they are continuous [in their observance].
(KauśS_8,8[67].14) It is completed in one day, say some.

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].15) yātrārthaṃ dātārau vā dātā keśaśmaśruromanakhāni vāpayīta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].15) For the sake of the ritual journey, the giver or givers should have the hair, beard, body-hair, and nails shaved.
(KauśS_8,8[67].16) The wife [also], except for the [head] hair.
(KauśS_8,8[67].17) Having bathed, wearing unworn garments, fragrant, observing the vow, being fit for the ritual, they stay overnight.

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].18) śvo bhūte yajñopavītī śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā yajñavāstu ca saṃprokṣya brahmaudanikam agniṃ mathitvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].18) On the next day, wearing the sacred thread, having prepared the pacificatory water, having sprinkled the sacrificial ground, having churned the fire for the <s>brahmaudana</s> (priestly rice-offering),

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].19) <yad devā devaheḍanaṃ [6.114.1]> <yad vidvāṃso yad avidvāṃso [6.115.1]> <'pamityam apratīttaṃ [6.117.1]>_ity etais tribhiḥ sūktair anvārabdhe dātari pūrṇahomaṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].19) with '<s>yad devā devaheḍanaṃ</s>' [AV 6.114.1], '<s>yad vidvāṃso yad avidvāṃso</s>' [AV 6.115.1], '<s>apamityam apratīttaṃ</s>' [AV 6.117.1] — with these three hymns, while the giver holds on, he should offer a full oblation.
(KauśS_8,8[67].20) In the forenoon, outside, by a peaceful tree, having placed fuel facing east,

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].21) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya paricaraṇenājyaṃ paricarya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].21) having swept around, sprinkled around, spread the <s>barhis</s> grass, placed a water vessel nearby, and having attended to the ghee with the ladle,
(KauśS_8,8[67].22) having offered the regular preliminary oblations and the two ghee portions,

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].23) paścād agneḥ palpūlitavihitam aukṣaṃ vānaḍuham vā rohitaṃ carma prāggrīvam uttaraloma paristīrya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].23) behind the fire, having spread a properly prepared ox-hide or bull-hide, red, with neck facing east and hair upward,
(KauśS_8,8[67].24) he makes the purificatory [arrangement].
(KauśS_8,8[67].25) Having washed two <s>darbha</s> grasses with uncut tips, he wipes [the hide] in the direction of the hair.

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].26) dakṣiṇaṃ jānu_ācyāparājitābhimukhaḥ prahvo vā muṣṭinā prasṛtināñjalinā yasyāṃ śrapayiṣyan syāt tayā caturtham
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].26) Bending the right knee, facing <s>Aparājitā</s> (the unconquered direction), bent forward, with a fist, with an outstretched hand, with a cupped hand — with whichever [vessel] he is about to cook, a fourth [portion with that].

body.text: (KauśS_8,8[67].27) śarāveṇa catuḥśarāvaṃ <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave [PS 16.70.1, TS 2.4.6.1 etc.]>_<ṛṣibhyas tvārṣeyebhyas tvaikarṣaye tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi [cf. PS 16.70.2]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,8[67].27) With a dish, a four-dish [measure]: '<s>devasya tvā savituḥ prasave</s>' [PS 16.70.1], '<s>ṛṣibhyas tvārṣeyebhyas tvaikarṣaye tvā juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi</s>' [cf. PS 16.70.2] — 'For the seers, for those of seer-lineage, for one seer I offer you with pleasure.'

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].1) <vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā nir vapantu | ūrjam akṣitam akṣīyamāṇam upajīvyāsam [cf. PS 16.70.2+3]> iti dātāraṃ vācayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,9[68].1) 'May the <s>Vasus</s> with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> meter winnow you forth; may I live on imperishable, undecaying nourishment' [cf. PS 16.70.2+3] — thus he causes the giver to recite.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].2) <rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā | ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā | viśve tvā devā ānuṣṭubhena chandasā nir vapantu | ūrjam akṣitam akṣīyamāṇam upa jīvyāsam [cf. PS 16.70.2+4+5, AitB 8.12]> iti dātāraṃ vācayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,9[68].2) 'May the <s>Rudras</s> with the <s>Triṣṭubh</s> meter, the <s>Ādityas</s> with the <s>Jagatī</s> meter, the <s>Viśve Devas</s> with the <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> meter winnow you forth; may I live on imperishable, undecaying nourishment' [cf. PS 16.70.2+4+5, AitB 8.12] — thus he causes the giver to recite.
(KauśS_8,9[68].3) What has been winnowed, he touches with the hymn.
(KauśS_8,9[68].4) The heavenly and the priestly rice-offerings form the basic framework.
(KauśS_8,9[68].5) At the confluence, he should pour water measured for the priestly rice-offering, a double portion.
(KauśS_8,9[68].6) As many rice-grains as there are, he should not pour off or pour back.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].7) yadi_avasiñcet_<mayi varco atho yaśo [6.69.3]>_iti brahmā yajamānaṃ vācayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_8,9[68].7) If he should pour off, with '<s>mayi varco atho yaśo</s>' [AV 6.69.3], the <s>Brahman</s> priest causes the sacrificer to recite.
Now he should pour back.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].9) <ā pyāyasva [PS 20.55.4, .RV 1.19.16 etc.]> <saṃ te payāṃsi [PS 20.55.6, .RV 1.91.18 etc.]>_iti dvābhyāṃ pratiṣiñcet
body.translated_text: With '<s>ā pyāyasva</s>' [PS 20.55.4, RV 1.19.16 etc.] and '<s>saṃ te payāṃsi</s>' [PS 20.55.6, RV 1.91.18 etc.], with these two [verses], he should pour back.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].10) <ā pyāyasva sam etu te visvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṃgathe || saṃ te payāṃsi sam u yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyāny abhimātiṣāhaḥ | āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsy uttamāni dhiṣva || [PS 20.55.4+6, .RV 1.91.16+18]>_iti
body.translated_text: 'Fill yourself up, let [nourishment] come to you from all sides, O <s>Soma</s>, with virile power; be at the gathering of strength. || Let your streams of milk and prizes come together, [let] your virile powers [come together], O conqueror of rivals; swelling for immortality, O <s>Soma</s>, bestow the highest glories in heaven.' [PS 20.55.4+6, RV 1.91.16+18] — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].11) tatra ced upādhimātrāyāṃ nakhena na lavaṇasya kuryāt tena_evāsya tad vṛthānnaṃ saṃpadyate
body.translated_text: If therein, at the measure of [one] addition, he does not make [the mark] with the fingernail of salt — by that very [omission], his food becomes wasted.
An unworn garment lies to the south.
That [garment is] with gold.
There two water vessels are placed.
One to the south, the other to the inner [side].
The inner one is the one from which he will perform the secondary offering.
The outer one is the <s>jāṅmāyana</s> (knee-[water]).
From that, taking water, he brings [it] to the pan.
With a ladle into the pot.
What was made with the ladle, he brings back to that very [place].

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].21) darvyā_uttamam apādāya tatsuhṛd dakṣiṇato_agner udaṅmukha āsīno dhārayati
body.translated_text: With the ladle, having removed the top [portion], his friend, seated to the south of the fire facing north, holds [it].
Now he lifts out [the rice-cake].

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].23) uddhṛte yad apādāya dhārayati tad uttarārdha ādhāya rasair upasicya pratigrahītre dātā_upavahati
body.translated_text: When [the rice-cake] has been lifted out, what he had removed and held — that he places on the upper half, sprinkles with juices, and the giver serves [it] to the recipient.
On that [occasion], having touched [the recipient], he causes the giver to recite.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].25) tantraṃ sūktaṃ pacchaḥ snātena <yau te pakṣau [PS 3.38.6]> <yad atiṣṭhaḥ [PS 3.38.7]>
body.translated_text: The principal hymn [is recited] in sections; by one who has bathed, [with] '<s>yau te pakṣau</s>' [PS 3.38.6] and '<s>yad atiṣṭhaḥ</s>' [PS 3.38.7].

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].26) <yau te pakṣāv ajarau patatriṇau yābhyāṃ rakṣāṃsy apahaṃsy odana | tābhyāṃ pathyāsma sukṛtasya lokaṃ yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ || yad atiṣṭho divas pṛṣṭhe vyomann adhy odana | anvāyan satyadharmāṇo brāhmaṇā rādhasā saha || [PS 3.38.6-7, cf. TS 4.7.13.1, VSM 18.52]>
body.translated_text: 'Your two wings, ageless, feathered, by which you drive away evil spirits, O rice-cake — by those two [wings], may we [go] the path to the world of the meritorious, where the sages are, first-born, ancient. || When you stood upon the ridge of heaven, in the firmament, O rice-cake — the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> of truthful conduct followed along, together with the gift.' [PS 3.38.6-7, cf. TS 4.7.13.1, VSM 18.52]

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].27) <kramadhvam agninā nākam [4.14.2]>_<pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā aham antarikṣam āruham [4.14.3]>_<svar yanto nāpekṣanta [4.14.4]> <uruḥ prathasva mahatā mahimnā [11.1.19]>_<idaṃ me jyotir [11.1.28]>_<satyāya ca [12.3.46]>_iti tisraḥ <sam agnayaḥ [12.3.50]>_iti sārdham etayā
body.translated_text: With '<s>kramadhvam agninā nākam</s>' [AV 4.14.2], '<s>pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā aham antarikṣam āruham</s>' [AV 4.14.3], '<s>svar yanto nāpekṣanta</s>' [AV 4.14.4], '<s>uruḥ prathasva mahatā mahimnā</s>' [AV 11.1.19], '<s>idaṃ me jyotir</s>' [AV 11.1.28], '<s>satyāya ca</s>' [AV 12.3.46] — three [verses]; '<s>sam agnayaḥ</s>' [AV 12.3.50] — together with this one.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].28) ata ūrdhvaṃ vācite hute saṃsthite_amūṃ te dadāmīti nāmagrāham upaspṛśet
body.translated_text: After this, when [the hymn] has been recited, the oblation offered, and [the rite] concluded — saying 'I give this to you,' he should touch [the recipient], calling [him] by name.
With the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee), '<s>kāmas tad</s>' [AV 19.52.1] — as stated.
With '<s>ye bhakṣayanto</s>' [AV 2.35.1], the preliminary offerings.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].31) <agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhavā varūthyaḥ | taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnam īmahe sakhibhyaḥ || [.RV 5.24.1ab+2cd etc.]> <gayasphāno amīvahā vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ | sumitraḥ sumano bhava [cf. .RV 1.91.12 etc.]>_ity ājyabhāgau
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, you are our closest [friend] and also protector; be gracious, be our shield. || You who shine most brightly, blazing — we now entreat you for your favor, for our companions.' [RV 5.24.1ab+2cd etc.] 'Increasing prosperity, dispeller of disease, finder of wealth, increaser of nourishment — be a good friend, be of good mind.' [cf. RV 1.91.12 etc.] — these are the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> (ghee-portion) [offerings].
Having brought water to the hand — as stated.
[The rite continues] until the concluding consecration (<s>pratimantraṇa</s>).
When the concluding consecration is done, having distributed [the food], they eat.
With '<s>idāvatsarāya</s>' [PS 19.51.1-4], for the release of the vow, he should offer ghee.
He should add fuel-sticks.

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].37) tatra ślokau | yajuṣā mathite agnau yajuṣopasamāhite | savān dattvā savāgnes tu katham utsarjanaṃ bhavet || vācayitvā savān sarvān pratigṛhya yathāvidhi | hutvā saṃnatibhis tatrotsargaṃ kauśiko 'bravīt
body.translated_text: Thereon [are] two verses: 'When the fire has been churned with <s>yajus</s> [formulas] and established with <s>yajus</s> [formulas], having given the <s>Sava</s> pressings, how should the dismissal of the <s>Sava</s>-fire take place? || Having caused the recitation of all the <s>Sava</s> [pressings], having received [them] according to rule, having offered with salutations therein — <s>Kauśika</s> declared the dismissal.'
They go eastward, or toward the unconquered direction, for the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath).

body.text: (KauśS_8,9[68].39) apāṃ sūktair āplutya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyāpa upaspṛśyānavekṣamāṇāḥ pratyudāvrajanti
body.translated_text: Having bathed with the water hymns, having turned to the right, having touched the waters, without looking back, they return.
They honor the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> with cooked food.
The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) is as stated. The <s>dakṣiṇā</s> is as stated.
Thus ends the eighth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].1) pitryam agniṃ śamayiṣyañ jyeṣṭhasya cāvibhaktina ekāgnim ādhāsyan
body.translated_text: One about to pacify the funeral fire (<s>pitryāgni</s>), and the eldest of those who have not yet divided [the property], about to establish a single fire —

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].2) amāvāsyāyaṃ pūrvasminn upaśāle gāṃ dvihāyanīṃ rohiṇīm ekarūpāṃ bandhayati
body.translated_text: On the new-moon day, in the front hall, he ties a two-year-old, reddish, single-colored cow.
At night, the eldest, girded with <s>śāmūla</s> [roots], touches [the cow].
The wife, wearing an unworn garment, [touches] the eldest.
The others [touch] the wife in succession.

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].6) atha_enān abhivyāhārayati_<adhrigo śamīdhvam | suśami śamīdhvam | śamīdhvam adhrigā o u [cf. TB 3.6.6.4 etc.]> iti triḥ
body.translated_text: Then he causes them to utter: '<s>Adhrigo śamīdhvam</s>, <s>Suśami śamīdhvam</s>, <s>Śamīdhvam adhrigā o u</s>' [cf. TB 3.6.6.4 etc.] — three times.

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].7) <ayam agniḥ satpatir [7.62.1]> <naḍam ā roha [12.2.1]>_ity anuvākaṃ mahāśāntiṃ ca śāntyudaka āvapate
body.translated_text: With '<s>ayam agniḥ satpatir</s>' [AV 7.62.1] and '<s>naḍam ā roha</s>' [AV 12.2.1], the [whole] <s>anuvāka</s> (section) and the great pacification — he pours [them] into the pacificatory water.
With '<s>agne akravyād</s>' [AV 12.2.42], from the fallen [embers] he holds a lamp.
And having dug up what was scorched from the ground,
having spread [the area] with shaped clay bricks and an anthill,
having smeared [it] with a lump of cow-dung,
having scattered sand, he sprinkles.
Having made a mark,
he sprinkles again.
Having placed the fire-churning [apparatus] to the west of the mark,

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].16) go'śvājāvīnāṃ puṃsāṃ lomabhir āstīrya vrīhiyavaiś ca śakṛtpiṇḍam abhivimṛjya prāñcau darbhau nidadhāti
body.translated_text: having spread [the area] with hairs of male cattle, horses, goats, and sheep, and having wiped the cow-dung lump with rice and barley, he places two <s>darbha</s> [grasses] pointing eastward.
With '<s>vṛṣaṇau sthaḥ</s>' [TS 1.3.7.1 etc.], [he addresses] the two <s>araṇi</s> (fire-churning) [sticks] taken in the hands.
On top of those, the lower <s>araṇi</s>.
With the roots to the south.

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].20) paścāt prajananām <urvaśy asi [TS 1.3.7.1 etc.]>_ity <āyur asi [TS 1.3.7.1 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: Behind [he places] the generative [piece], with '<s>urvaśy asi</s>' [TS 1.3.7.1 etc.] and '<s>āyur asi</s>' [TS 1.3.7.1 etc.].
Having joined the upper <s>araṇi</s> at the base,
with '<s>pṛtanājitam</s>' [AV 7.63.1], having invoked,

body.text: (KauśS_9,1[69].23) abhidakṣiṇaṃ jyeṣṭhas trir abhimanthati_<oṃ bhūr gāyatraṃ chando 'nuprajāyasva traiṣṭhubhaṃ jāgatam ānuṣṭhubam oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om [cf. TS 1.3.7.1 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: the eldest churns three times in the right-hand direction, [reciting]: '<s>Oṃ bhūr</s>, <s>Gāyatra</s> is the meter, be born; <s>Traiṣṭubha</s>, <s>Jāgata</s>, <s>Ānuṣṭhubha</s> — <s>Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om</s>' [cf. TS 1.3.7.1 etc.].
After that, at will.

body.text: (KauśS_9,2[70].1) <manthāmi tvā jātavedaḥ sujātaṃ jātavedasam | sa no jīveṣv ā bhaja dīrgham āyuś ca dhehi naḥ || [-]> <jāto 'janiṣṭhā yaśasā sahāgre prajāṃ paśūṃs tejo rayim asmāsu dhehi | ānandino modamānāḥ suvīrā anāmayāḥ sarvam āyur gamema || [-, cf. ;Sāṅkh;SS 2.17.8> <ud dīpyasva jātavedo 'va sediṃ tṛṇāṃ kṣudhaṃ jahi | apāsmat tama uchatv apa hrītamukho jahy apa durhārddiśo jahi ||> <ihaivaidhi dhanasanir iha tvā sam idhīmahi | ihaidhi puṣṭivardhana iha tvā sam idhīmahi [-, cf. 18.4.38a]>_iti
body.translated_text: 'I churn you, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, well-born <s>Jātavedas</s>; grant us a share among the living, and bestow upon us long life. || Born, you were born with glory at the forefront; bestow upon us offspring, cattle, splendor, and wealth. May we, joyful, rejoicing, with fine heroes, free from disease, complete our full life-span. || Blaze forth, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, drive away affliction, grass-devouring hunger; drive away darkness from us, drive away the shame-faced one, drive away the ill-intentioned ones. || Right here be the winner of wealth, right here we kindle you; right here be the increaser of prosperity, right here we kindle you.' — thus.
With the first [verse], he churns.
With the second, he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the fire] when born.
With the third, he fans [it] into flame.
With the fourth, he establishes [it].

body.text: (KauśS_9,2[70].6) <yat tvā kruddhāḥ [12.2.5, cf. MS 1.7.1 etc.]>_iti ca_<oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om> ity <aṅgirasāṃ tvā devānām ādityānāṃ vratenā dadhe [cf. KS 7.13:76.15ff. etc.]> | <dyaur mahnāsi bhūmir bhūmnā tasyās te devy aditir upasthe 'nnādāyānnapatyāyā dadhat [cf. KS 7.13:76.17f. etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: With '<s>yat tvā kruddhāḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.5, cf. MS 1.7.1 etc.], and '<s>Oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om</s>', [reciting] '<s>Aṅgirasām tvā devānām ādityānāṃ vratenā dadhe</s>' [cf. KS 7.13:76.15ff. etc.] | '<s>Dyaur mahnāsi bhūmir bhūmnā tasyās te devy aditir upasthe 'nnādāyānnapatyāyā dadhat</s>' [cf. KS 7.13:76.17f. etc.] — thus.
Having established [the fire] on the mark, he rises.
Then he worships.

body.text: (KauśS_9,2[70].9) <agne gṛhapate sugṛhapatir ahaṃ tvayāgne gṛhapatinā bhūyāsam | sugṛhapatis tvaṃ mayāgne gṛhapatinā bhūyāḥ | asthūri ṇau gārhapatyāni dīdihi śataṃ samāḥ [cf. VSM 2.27 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Agni</s>, lord of the household, may I with you, <s>Agni</s>, lord of the household, become a good lord of the household. May you with me, <s>Agni</s>, lord of the household, become a good lord of the household. May our domestic [fires] not fail — shine for a hundred years.' [cf. VSM 2.27 etc.] — thus.
With '<s>vyākaromi</s>' [AV 12.2.32], he looks upon the <s>gārhapatya</s> (domestic fire) and the <s>kravyāda</s> (corpse-devouring fire).
He places the pacified ghee beside the <s>gārhapatya</s>.
The <s>māṣamantha</s> (bean-gruel) [he places beside] the <s>kravyāda</s>.
With '<s>upa tvā namasā</s>' [AV 3.15.7], [he recites] the invitatory verse (<s>puro'nuvākyā</s>).
With '<s>viśvahā te</s>' [AV 3.15.8], he offers the full oblation (<s>pūrṇāhuti</s>).
With '<s>yo no agniḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.33], together with the performer, they touch [their] hearts.

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].1) <aṃśo rājā vibhajatīmāv agnī vidhārayan | kravyādaṃ nir ṇudāmasi havyavāḍ iha tiṣṭhatu [-]>_iti vibhāgaṃ japati
body.translated_text: 'King <s>Aṃśa</s> distributes, maintaining these two fires; let us drive out the corpse-devouring [fire]; let the oblation-carrying [fire] remain here.' — with this, he mutters the separation [formula].
With '<s>sugārhapatyo</s>' [AV 12.2.45c], with the right [hand] he places a fuel-stick on the <s>gārhapatya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].3) <yaḥ kravyāt tam aśīśamam [cf. 3.21.9]> iti savyena naḍamayīṃ kravyādi
body.translated_text: With '<s>yaḥ kravyāt tam aśīśamam</s>' [cf. AV 3.21.9], with the left [hand], a reed [fuel-stick] on the <s>kravyāda</s>.
With '<s>apāvṛtya</s>' [AV 12.2.34], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>, having placed [the kravyāda fire] outside,

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].5) <naḍam ā roha [12.2.1]> <sam indhate [12.1.11]>_<iṣīkāṃ jaratīm [12.1.54]>_<pratyañcam arkaṃ [12.1.55]>_ity upasamādadhāti
body.translated_text: with '<s>naḍam ā roha</s>' [AV 12.2.1], '<s>sam indhate</s>' [AV 12.1.11], '<s>iṣīkāṃ jaratīm</s>' [AV 12.1.54], '<s>pratyañcam arkam</s>' [AV 12.1.55], he establishes [the fire].

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].6) <yady agniḥ [12.2.4]>_<yo agniḥ [12.2.7]>_<aviḥ kṛṣṇā [12.2.53]> <mā no ruroḥ śucadvidaḥ śivo no astu bharato rarāṇaḥ | ativyādhī vyādho agrabhīṣṭa kravyādo agnīñ śamayāmi sarvān [-]> iti śuktyā māṣapiṣṭāni juhoti
body.translated_text: With '<s>yady agniḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.4], '<s>yo agniḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.7], '<s>aviḥ kṛṣṇā</s>' [AV 12.2.53], 'May the piercer not pierce us, the pain-knower; may <s>Bharata</s> be gracious to us, the giver. The piercer has pierced the enemy beyond; I pacify all corpse-devouring fires' — with a shell, he offers bean-paste.
Having placed lead in the ladle, having tied [it] up, he should pacify [the fire] while offering the gruel.

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].8) <naḍam ā roha [12.2.1]>_iti catasro_<agne akravyād [12.2.42]> <imaṃ kravyād [12.2.43]> <yo no aśveṣu [12.2.15]>_<anyebhyas tvā [12.2.16]> <hiraṇyapāṇiṃ [3.21.8]>_iti śamayati
body.translated_text: With '<s>naḍam ā roha</s>' [AV 12.2.1], four [verses]; '<s>agne akravyād</s>' [AV 12.2.42], '<s>imaṃ kravyād</s>' [AV 12.2.43], '<s>yo no aśveṣu</s>' [AV 12.2.15], '<s>anyebhyas tvā</s>' [AV 12.2.16], '<s>hiraṇyapāṇim</s>' [AV 3.21.8] — with these he pacifies [the fire].
To the south, in an old granary, he spreads cold ashes.
Having made [it] well-pacified with pacificatory water, having dug up what was scorched,
with '<s>paraṃ mṛtyo</s>' [AV 12.2.21], he raises [them] up.
With '<s>kravyādam</s>' [AV 12.2.8], with three [verses], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the fire] as it is being carried away.
From the lamp onward, until the recitation [of formulas], [the procedure] is explained by the reverse order.
With '<s>aviḥ kṛṣṇā</s>' [AV 12.2.53], he places [it].
Except for the last [portion], the lead [pieces go] into the eldest's joined palms.
With '<s>asmin vayam</s>' [AV 12.2.13], '<s>yad ripram</s>' [AV 12.2.40], '<s>sīse mṛḍḍhvam</s>' [AV 12.2.19], he causes [them] to wash off.
Having wiped the hands and feet with black wool,

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].18) <ime [ed.: imā; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 78] jīvā [12.2.22]> <udīcīnaiḥ [12.2.29]>_iti mantroktam
body.translated_text: '<s>ime jīvā</s>' [AV 12.2.22], '<s>udīcīnaiḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.29] — as stated in the <s>mantra</s>,

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].19) <triḥ sapta [12.2.29c]>_iti kūdyā padāni lopayitvā [ed. yopayitvā -- corrigenda ed. p. 424] nadībhyaḥ
body.translated_text: with '<s>triḥ sapta</s>' [AV 12.2.29c], having erased the footprints from the wall, [he takes them] to the rivers,
with '<s>mṛtyoḥ padaṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.30], with the second [verse he prepares] the boats,
with '<s>paraṃ mṛtyo</s>' [AV 12.2.21], having thrust a wall-peg eastward and to the right,
having made seven river-forms and filled them with water,

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].23) <ā rohata savitur nāvam etāṃ [12.2.48c]> <sutrāmāṇaṃ [7.6.3]> <mahīm ū ṣu [7.6.2]>_iti sahiraṇyāṃ sayavāṃ nāvam ārohayati
body.translated_text: with '<s>ā rohata savitur nāvam etāṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.48c], '<s>sutrāmāṇaṃ</s>' [AV 7.6.3], '<s>mahīm ū ṣu</s>' [AV 7.6.2], he makes [the person] board a boat containing gold and barley,

body.text: (KauśS_9,3[71].24) <aśmanvatī rīyate [12.2.26]>_<ut tiṣṭhatā pra taratā sakhāyo [12.2.27]>_ity udīcas tārayati
body.translated_text: with '<s>aśmanvatī rīyate</s>' [AV 12.2.26], '<s>ut tiṣṭhatā pra taratā sakhāyo</s>' [AV 12.2.27], he ferries [them] northward,
To the north [he digs] a pit with water flowing northward, and places stones [in it] with a gap between them,
with '<s>tiro mṛtyuṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.23d], he steps over the stone,
with '<s>tā adharād udīcīr</s>' [AV 12.2.41], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s>,
with '<s>nissālām</s>' [AV 2.14.1], having sprinkled the house-settlement,
with '<s>ūrjaṃ bibhrad</s>' [AV 7.60.1], he causes [the person] to enter,
with '<s>vaiśvadevīṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.28], he sacrifices a heifer,
with '<s>imam indraṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.47], a bull,
with '<s>anaḍvāhaṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.48], '<s>ahorātre</s>' [AV 12.2.49], he sacrifices [for] the bed,
with '<s>ā rohatāyur</s>' [AV 12.2.24], he mounts [the bed],
with '<s>āsīnā</s>' [AV 12.2.30c], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> [the woman] as she is seated,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].11) piñjūlīr āñjanaṃ sarpiṣi paryasya_<imā nārīr [12.2.31]> iti strībhyaḥ prayachati
body.translated_text: Having mixed broom-sticks and ointment with ghee, with '<s>imā nārīr</s>' [AV 12.2.31], he gives [them] to the women,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].12) <ime jīvā avidhavāḥ sujāmaya [cf. 12.2.22,31a and PS 17.33.2]> iti puṃbhya eka_ekasmai tisrastisras tā adhyadhy udadhānaṃ paricṛtya prayachati
body.translated_text: with '<s>ime jīvā avidhavāḥ sujāmaya</s>' [cf. AV 12.2.22, 31a and PS 17.33.2], to the men — to each one, three by three, having poured them over the water-vessel, he gives [them],

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].13) <paraṃ mṛtyo [12.2.21]> <vyākaromi [12.2.32]>_<ā rohata [12.2.24(48)]>_<antardhir [12.2.44]>_<pratyañcam arkaṃ [12.2.55]> <ye agnayo [3.21.1]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13.1]>_<agne 'bhyāvartinn [PS 1.41.1]> <agne jātavedaḥ [PS 1.41.2]> <saha rayyā [PS 1.41.3]> <punar ūrjā [PS 1.41.4]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>paraṃ mṛtyo</s>' [AV 12.2.21], '<s>vyākaromi</s>' [AV 12.2.32], '<s>ā rohata</s>' [AV 12.2.24(48)], '<s>antardhir</s>' [AV 12.2.44], '<s>pratyañcam arkaṃ</s>' [AV 12.2.55], '<s>ye agnayo</s>' [AV 3.21.1], '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13.1], '<s>agne 'bhyāvartinn</s>' [PS 1.41.1], '<s>agne jātavedaḥ</s>' [PS 1.41.2], '<s>saha rayyā</s>' [PS 1.41.3], '<s>punar ūrjā</s>' [PS 1.41.4] —

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].14) <agne 'bhyāvartinn abhi na ā vavṛtsva | āyuṣā varcasā sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena || agne jātavedaḥ śataṃ te sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ | adhā puṣṭasyeśānaḥ punar no rayim ā kṛdhi || saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvatas pari || punar ūrjā vavṛtsva punar agna iṣāyuṣā | punar naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ || [PS 1.41.1-4]>
body.translated_text: '<s>agne 'bhyāvartinn abhi na ā vavṛtsva | āyuṣā varcasā sanyā medhayā prajayā dhanena</s>' || '<s>agne jātavedaḥ śataṃ te sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ | adhā puṣṭasyeśānaḥ punar no rayim ā kṛdhi</s>' || '<s>saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvatas pari</s>' || '<s>punar ūrjā vavṛtsva punar agna iṣāyuṣā | punar naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ</s>' || [PS 1.41.1-4]
Having bound pebbles and self-grown [grasses] with two hemp ropes, he holds [them],
He offers with a level [spoon] through the opening,
with '<s>imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.23], he places [it] at the door,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].18) juhoti_etayā_ṛcā | <āyurdāvā dhanadhāvā baladāvā paśudāvā puṣṭidāvā prajāpataye svāhā []>_iti
body.translated_text: He offers with this verse: '<s>āyurdāvā dhanadhāvā baladāvā paśudāvā puṣṭidāvā prajāpataye svāhā</s>' — 'O giver of life, giver of wealth, giver of strength, giver of cattle, giver of nourishment — to <s>Prajāpati svāhā</s>',
The mother feeds the sons with a six-fold mixture,
The leftover [she feeds to] the wife,
For one year, one should not blow upon the fire, nor carry it away, nor let others carry it away,
For twelve nights, say some,
The fees (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>) are ten,
He lies down behind the fire, observing silence,
And on the following day, he should worship <s>Indrāgnī</s>,
With two <s>sthālīpākas</s> (pot-cooked oblations) [he worships] <s>Agni</s> and <s>Agniṣomau</s> on the full-moon day,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].27) sāyaṃprātar vrīhīn āvaped yavān vā_<agnaye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā>_iti sāyam [sūtra-division with Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 30]
body.translated_text: In the evening and morning, he should offer rice or barley — '<s>agnaye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā</s>' — in the evening,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].28) <sūryāya svāhā prajāpataye svāha>_iti prātaḥ [sūtra-division with Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 30]
body.translated_text: '<s>sūryāya svāhā prajāpataye svāhā</s>' — in the morning,
On the twelfth night, he should worship <s>Agni</s> with an animal sacrifice,
Or with a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked oblation); he will prosper in both [cases],
On the anniversary, having prepared <s>śāntyudaka</s> (pacificatory water),

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].32) <ghṛtāhutir no bhavāgne akravyāhutir ghṛtāhutiṃ tvā vayam akravyāhutim upa ni ṣadema jātavedaḥ [-]>_iti catura udapātre saṃpātān ānīya
body.translated_text: '<s>ghṛtāhutir no bhavāgne akravyāhutir ghṛtāhutiṃ tvā vayam akravyāhutim upa ni ṣadema jātavedaḥ</s>' — having brought the remainders into four water-pots,
Having mixed them together,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].34) purastād agneḥ pratyaṅ āsīno juhoti | <hute rabhasva hutabhāga edhi mṛḍāsmabhyaṃ mota hiṃsīḥ paśūn naḥ [-]>_iti
body.translated_text: Seated facing west in front of the fire, he offers: '<s>hute rabhasva hutabhāga edhi mṛḍāsmabhyaṃ mota hiṃsīḥ paśūn naḥ</s>' — 'Being offered, be vigorous; be the enjoyer of oblations; be gracious to us, and do not harm our cattle',

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].35) yady udvāyād bhasmanāraṇiṃ saṃspṛśya tūṣṇīṃ mathitvā_uddīpya
body.translated_text: If he should blow upon [the fire], having touched the fire-churning stick with ashes, having silently churned and kindled [it],
having offered the <s>pūrṇahoma</s> (full oblation),
he should offer ghee with the <s>saṃnati</s> (submission) [verses] or with the <s>vyāhṛtis</s> (sacred utterances),
And when [fires] are combined, he should offer thus,
When the fire is gone out [and] being reborn,
Having smeared the fire-hearths with a lump of bull's dung,
Having placed the oblation material nearby,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].42) <prāṇāpānābhyāṃ svahā samānavyānābhyāṃ svāhā_udānarūpābhyāṃ svāhā>_ity ātmani_eva juhuyāt
body.translated_text: '<s>prāṇāpānābhyāṃ svāhā samānavyānābhyāṃ svāhā udānarūpābhyāṃ svāhā</s>' — he should offer into himself alone,

body.text: (KauśS_9,4[72].43) atha prātar utthāyāgniṃ nirmathya yathāsthānaṃ praṇīya yathāpuram agnihotraṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Then, having risen in the morning, having churned fire, having carried it to its [proper] place, he should offer the <s>agnihotra</s> (fire-oblation) as before,
The evening meal and the morning meal are the two sacrifices; the two officiants,

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].1) <purodayād astamayāc ca pāvakaṃ prabodhayed gṛhiṇī śuddhahastā | samatīte saṃdhivarṇe 'tha hāvayet susamiddhe pāvaka āhutīṣahiḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Before sunrise and after sunset, the housewife with clean hands should awaken the sacred fire; and when the twilight hour has passed, she should offer oblations in the well-kindled fire, O <s>Pāvaka</s>',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].2) <agnaye ca prajāpataye ca rātrāv ādityaś ca divā prajāpatiś ca | udakaṃ ca samidhaś ca homehome puro varam [-]>
body.translated_text: 'To <s>Agni</s> and <s>Prajāpati</s> at night; to <s>Āditya</s> and <s>Prajāpati</s> by day; water and fuel-sticks, the best offering at every oblation',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].3) <homyaiḥ samidbhiḥ payasā sthālīpākena sarpiṣā | sāyaṃprātar homa eteṣām ekenāpi sidhyati [-]>
body.translated_text: 'With oblation materials, fuel-sticks, milk, pot-cooked oblation, and ghee — the evening and morning oblation is accomplished with even one of these',
