body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].4) <abhyuddhṛto huto 'gniḥ pramādād upaśāmyati | mathite vyāhṛtīr juhuyāt pūrṇahomau yathaṛtvijau [-]>
body.translated_text: 'If the fire, having been raised up and offered into, is extinguished through negligence — having churned [a new fire], one should offer the <s>vyāhṛtis</s>; the two <s>pūrṇahomas</s> [serve as] the two officiants',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].5) <vanaspatibhyo vānaspatebhya oṣadhibhyo vīrudbhyaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyo devajanebhyaḥ puṇyajanebhyaḥ [-, cf. 11.6.24]>_iti prācīnaṃ tad udakaṃ ninīyate
body.translated_text: 'To the trees, to the forest trees, to the plants, to the herbs, to all the gods, to the divine beings, to the auspicious beings' — that water is carried eastward,

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].6) <svadhā prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ [-]>_iti dakṣiṇataḥ
body.translated_text: '<s>Svadhā</s> to the great-grandfathers, <s>svadhā</s> to the grandfathers, <s>svadhā</s> to the fathers' — to the south,
'To <s>Tārkṣya Ariṣṭanemi</s>, immortality for me' — to the west,
'To <s>Soma</s>, to the Seven Sages' — to the north,

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].9) <parimṛṣṭe parilipte ca parvaṇi vrātapataṃ hāvayed annam agnau | bhūyo dattvā svayam alpaṃ ca bhuktvāparāhṇe vratam upaiti yājñikam [-]>
body.translated_text: 'When [the altar] has been wiped and smeared, on the <s>parvan</s> (juncture) day, one should offer food of the <s>vrātapati</s> (lord of the assembly) into the fire; having given more [to others] and eaten little himself, in the afternoon he undertakes the ritual observance',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].10) <anaśanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca bhūmau śucir agnim upaśete sugandhiḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Fasting, <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy), and [sleeping] on the ground — pure and fragrant, one lies near the fire',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].11) <agnīṣomābhyāṃ darśana indrāgnibhyām adarśane | āgneyaṃ tu pūrvaṃ nityam anvāhāryaṃ prajāpateḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'To <s>Agniṣomau</s> at the new-moon; to <s>Indrāgnī</s> at the [day of] non-appearance; the <s>āgneya</s> (offering to <s>Agni</s>) is always first; the <s>anvāhārya</s> (supplementary offering) belongs to <s>Prajāpati</s>',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].12) <ardhāhutis tu sauviṣṭakṛtī sarveṣāṃ haviṣāṃ smṛtā | ānumatī vā bhavati sthālīpākeṣv atharvaṇām [-]>
body.translated_text: 'A half-oblation is the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> (making well-offered) for all oblations, so it is remembered; or [it may be] the <s>ānumatī</s> (offering to <s>Anumati</s>) in the <s>sthālīpākas</s> of the <s>Atharvans</s>',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].13) <ubhau ca saṃdhijau yau vaiśvadevau yathaṛtvijau | varjayitvā sabarhiṣaḥ sājyā yajñāḥ sadakṣiṇāḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'And both the <s>vaiśvadeva</s> (all-gods) [offerings] born at the two twilights, as the two officiants — excepting those with <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass); the sacrifices should be with ghee and with fees (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>)',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].14) yathāśakti yathābalaṃ <hutādo 'nye ahutādo 'nye | vaiśvadevaṃ havir ubhaye saṃ caranti | te samyañca iha mādayantām iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānā yam ichata [PS 5.15.2]> [sūtra division emended!]
body.translated_text: According to one's ability, according to one's strength — 'Some are enjoyers of what is offered, others are enjoyers of what is not offered; both partake of the <s>vaiśvadeva</s> oblation; may they together rejoice here; the sacrificers desire nourishment and sustenance' [PS 5.15.2],

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].15) <viśve devā idaṃ havir ādityāsaḥ saparyata | asmin yajñe mā vyathiṣy amṛtāya haviṣkṛtam [PS 19.35.1]>
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> (All Gods), O <s>Ādityas</s>, attend to this oblation; may I not waver in this sacrifice, [this oblation] prepared for immortality' [PS 19.35.1],

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].16) <vaiśvadevasya haviṣaḥ sāyaṃprātar juhoti | sāyamāśaprātarāśau yajñāv etau smṛtāv ubhau [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Of the <s>vaiśvadeva</s> oblation, one offers in the evening and morning; the evening meal and the morning meal — both these are declared to be the two sacrifices',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].17) <apratibhuktau śucikāryau ca nityaṃ vaiśvadevau jānatā yajñaśreṣṭhau | nāśrotriyo nānavaniktapāṇir nāmantravij juhuyān nāvipaścit [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Without eating beforehand, and always performing the rites in purity — the two <s>vaiśvadeva</s> [offerings] are the foremost of sacrifices for the knower; one who is not learned, who has not washed his hands, who does not know the <s>mantras</s>, who is not wise, should not offer',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].18) <bībhatsavaḥ śucikāmā hi devā nāśraddadhānasya havir juṣante | brāhmaṇena brahmavidā tu hāvayen na strīhutaṃ śūdrahutaṃ ca devagam [-]>
body.translated_text: 'For the gods are disgusted [by impurity] and desiring purity, and they do not enjoy the oblation of one without faith; one should have a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who knows <s>Brahman</s> perform the offering — an offering made by a woman or a <s>śūdra</s> does not reach the gods',

body.text: (KauśS_9,5[73].19) <yas tu vidyād ājyabhāgau yajñān mantraparikramān | devatājñānam āvṛta āśiṣaś ca karma striyā apratiṣiddham āhuḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'But one who knows the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (ghee-portions), the sacrifices, the <s>mantra</s>-procedures, knowledge of the deities, the <s>āvṛts</s> (repetitions), and the blessings — they say that the rite is not prohibited for a woman',
For those two [offerings], the <s>baliharaṇa</s> (carrying of the <s>bali</s>-offering),
Having offered '<s>agnaye indrāgnibhyāṃ vāstoṣpataye prajāpataye 'numataye</s>' — 'To <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Indrāgnī</s>, to <s>Vāstoṣpati</s>, to <s>Prajāpati</s>, to <s>Anumati</s>',

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].3) niṣkramya bahiḥ pracīnaṃ <brahmaṇe vaiśravaṇāya viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyo viśvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ>_iti bahuśo baliṃ haret
body.translated_text: Going outside, to the east: '<s>brahmaṇe vaiśravaṇāya viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sarvebhyo devebhyo viśvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ</s>' — 'To <s>Brahman</s>, to <s>Vaiśravaṇa</s>, to all the gods, to all the gods, to all beings, to all beings' — he should carry the <s>bali</s>-offering abundantly,
Sprinkling twice, circumambulating clockwise, passing inside at the door,
At the two door-posts: 'To <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death), to <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Adharma</s>',
At the water-vessel: 'To <s>Dhanvantari</s>, to the ocean, to plants and forest trees, to <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth)',
At the pillar and cross-beam: 'To the directions, to the intermediate quarters',
At the corners: 'To <s>Vāsuki</s>, to <s>Cittasenā</s>, to <s>Cittaratha</s>, to <s>Takṣa</s> and <s>Upatakṣa</s>',

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].9) samantam agner <āśāyai śraddhāyai medhāyai śriyai hriyai vidyāyai>_iti
body.translated_text: All around the fire: 'To <s>Āśā</s> (Hope), to <s>Śraddhā</s> (Faith), to <s>Medhā</s> (Wisdom), to <s>Śrī</s> (Prosperity), to <s>Hrī</s> (Modesty), to <s>Vidyā</s> (Knowledge)',
To the east of the fire: 'To the domestic [deities], to the divine consorts',
Having taken out more [food], he should feed the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>,

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].12) tad api śloko vadati | <mābrāhmaṇa agrataḥ [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. mābrāhmaṇāgrataḥ] kṛtam aśnīyād viṣavad annam annakāmyā | devānāṃ devo brāhmaṇo bhḥvo nāmaiṣa devatā>_iti
body.translated_text: On this, a verse is recited: 'A <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should not eat food served first without [giving to brāhmaṇas] — [such food is] like poison, even out of desire for food; the god of gods is the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> named <s>Bhū</s> — this is the deity',

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].13) āgrayaṇe śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā yathartu taṇḍulān upasādya
body.translated_text: At the <s>āgrayaṇa</s> (first-fruits offering), having prepared <s>śāntyudaka</s> (pacificatory water), having placed grain-husks according to the season,
Having cooked the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked oblation) in water, or in milk

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].15) <sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūr agnaye svāhā | sajūr indrāgnibhyāṃ sajūr dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ sajūr viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūḥ somāya svāhā>_ity ekahavir vā syāt_nānāhavīṃṣi vā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_9,6[74].15) <sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūr agnaye svāhā | sajūr indrāgnibhyāṃ sajūr dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ sajūr viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ sajūr ṛtubhiḥ sajūr vidhābhiḥ sajūḥ somāya svāhā> — it may be a single oblation or separate oblations.
(KauśS_9,6[74].16) He should perform the <s>saumya</s> (Soma-related) rite, weaving it with <s>śyāmāka</s> (millet) grain in autumn.
(KauśS_9,6[74].17) Then the <s>yajamāna</s> (sacrificer) takes up the <s>prāśitra</s> (first portion).

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].18) <prajāpateṣ ṭvā grahaṃ gṛhṇāmi | mahyaṃ bhūtyai mahyaṃ puṣṭyai mahyaṃ śriyai mahyaṃ hriyai mahyaṃ yaśase mahyam āyuṣe mahyam annāya mahyam annādyāya mahyaṃ sahasrapoṣāya mahyam aparimitapoṣāya [cf. ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.2]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_9,6[74].18) <prajāpateṣ ṭvā grahaṃ gṛhṇāmi | mahyaṃ bhūtyai mahyaṃ puṣṭyai mahyaṃ śriyai mahyaṃ hriyai mahyaṃ yaśase mahyam āyuṣe mahyam annāya mahyam annādyāya mahyaṃ sahasrapoṣāya mahyam aparimitapoṣāya [cf. ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.2]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].19) atha prāśnāti | <bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ sam anaiṣṭa devās tvayāvasena sam aśīmahi tvā | sa naḥ pito madhumā;m ā viveśa śivas tokāya tanvo na ehi [cf. TS 5.7.2.4, ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.3 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_9,6[74].19) Then he eats. <bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ sam anaiṣṭa devās tvayāvasena sam aśīmahi tvā | sa naḥ pito madhumām ā viveśa śivas tokāya tanvo na ehi [cf. TS 5.7.2.4, ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.3 etc.]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].20) prāśitam anumantrayate | <amo 'si prāṇa tad ṛtaṃ bravīmy amāsi sarvāṅ asi praviṣṭa | sa me jarāṃ rogam apanudya śarīrādanāmayaidhi mā riṣāma indo [cf. ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.4 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_9,6[74].20) He recites a mantra over the eaten <s>prāśitra</s> (first portion): <amo 'si prāṇa tad ṛtaṃ bravīmy amāsi sarvāṅ asi praviṣṭa | sa me jarāṃ rogam apanudya śarīrādanāmayaidhi mā riṣāma indo [cf. ;SāṅkhGS 3.8.4 etc.]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_9,6[74].21) vatsaḥ prathamajo grīṣme vāsaḥ śaradi dakṣiṇā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_9,6[74].21) A calf, the firstborn, in summer; a garment in autumn is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee).
(KauśS_9,6[74].22) Or one may give the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) according to one's ability.
(KauśS_9,6[74].23) What is beyond one's ability is not prescribed; what is beyond one's ability is not prescribed.

body.text: (KauśS 9 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre navamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 9 Colophon) Thus ends the ninth <s>adhyāya</s> (chapter) of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_10,1[75].1) Now the <s>vivāha</s> (marriage ceremony).
(KauśS_10,1[75].2) After <s>Kārttikī</s> (the full moon of Kārttika) up to <s>Vaiśākhī</s> (the full moon of Vaiśākha).
(KauśS_10,1[75].3) Or according to one's wish.
(KauśS_10,1[75].4) But one should avoid the bright half of <s>Citrā</s> (the <s>nakṣatra</s> Citrā fortnight).

body.text: (KauśS_10,1[75].5) <maghāsu hanyante gāvaḥ phalgunīṣu vyuhyate [14.1.13cd]>_iti vijñāyate maṅgalaṃ ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,1[75].5) <maghāsu hanyante gāvaḥ phalgunīṣu vyuhyate [14.1.13cd]> — thus it is known, and it is auspicious.
(KauśS_10,1[75].6) With <satyenottabhitā [14.1.1]> and <pūrvāparaṃ [14.1.23]> he should place the offerings.
(KauśS_10,1[75].7) And the announcement to the bridegroom.
(KauśS_10,1[75].8) With <yuvaṃ bhagaṃ [14.1.31a]> he sends the <s>saṃbhala</s> (bride-price) together with attendants.
(KauśS_10,1[75].9) With <brahmaṇas pate [14.1.31c]> — the <s>brahman</s> (priest).
(KauśS_10,1[75].10) If one apprehends danger from the bride's family, one should carry it out at night, having lit <s>valīka</s> (torches of bark).
(KauśS_10,1[75].11) With <devā agre [14.2.32]> — with five verses at once, he makes her offer <s>pūlya</s> (rice balls).
(KauśS_10,1[75].12) With <anṛkṣarā [14.1.34a]> he sends the <s>kumārīpāla</s> (bride's guardian).
(KauśS_10,1[75].13) Of the one who fetches water, with arrows fitted, the <s>brahman</s> (priest) goes in front and behind.
(KauśS_10,1[75].14) With <yo anidhmo [14.1.37]> he throws a clod into the water.
(KauśS_10,1[75].15) With <idam ahaṃ [14.1.38a]> — having pushed it aside,
(KauśS_10,1[75].16) with <yo bhadro [14.1.38c]> — drawing water downstream,
(KauśS_10,1[75].17) with <āsyai brāhmaṇāḥ [14.1.39a]> he gives it to her.
(KauśS_10,1[75].18) As they come, the <s>brahman</s> (priest) goes in front, and an archer with strung bow behind.
(KauśS_10,1[75].19) On the outside, to the north of the fire, he fastens a branch of <s>plakṣa</s> (fig) or <s>udumbara</s> (cluster fig) tree.
(KauśS_10,1[75].20) With that they perform the water-related rites.
(KauśS_10,1[75].21) And from that, the sprinkling is done with another vessel.
(KauśS_10,1[75].22) Having passed within, with <aryamaṇaṃ [14.1.17]> he makes an oblation.
(KauśS_10,1[75].23) With <pra tvā muñcāmi [14.1.19]> he unties the wrapping.
(KauśS_10,1[75].24) With <uśatīḥ [14.2.52]> — with this verse he makes her bathe three times.
(KauśS_10,1[75].25) With seven hot pourings he makes them with remainder-water.

body.text: (KauśS_10,1[75].26) <yad āsandyām [14.2.65]> iti pūrvayor uttarasyāṃ sraktyāṃ tiṣṭhantīm āplāvayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,1[75].26) With <yad āsandyām [14.2.65]> he pours water over her as she stands at the northern corner of the first two (fires).

body.text: (KauśS_10,1[75].27) <yac ca varco [14.1.35]> <yathā sindhur [14.1.43]> ity utkrāntām anyenāvasiñcati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,1[75].27) With <yac ca varco [14.1.35]> and <yathā sindhur [14.1.43]> — when she has stepped out, he sprinkles her with another vessel.
(KauśS_10,2[76].1) With <yad duṣkṛtaṃ [14.2.66]> — having wiped the limbs with a garment, he gives it to the <s>kumārīpāla</s> (bride's guardian).
(KauśS_10,2[76].2) Having handed it over with a <s>tumbara</s>-wood staff, she should go out.
(KauśS_10,2[76].3) That he deposits in the forest.
(KauśS_10,2[76].4) With <yā akṛntaṃs [14.1.45]> and <tvaṣṭā vāso [14.1.53]> he covers her with an unworn garment.
(KauśS_10,2[76].5) With <kṛtrimaḥ [14.2.68]> — with a comb having a hundred teeth, made of <s>iṣīkā</s> (reed), he combs her once.
(KauśS_10,2[76].6) Saying 'the appointed time has been fulfilled,' he releases it.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].7) <āśāsānā [14.1.42]> <saṃ tvā nahyāmi [14.2.70]> ity ubhayataḥ pāśena yoktreṇa (ed. misprint: yoktrena; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 51) saṃnahyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].7) With <āśāsānā [14.1.42]> and <saṃ tvā nahyāmi [14.2.70]> he binds her on both sides with a <s>yoktra</s> (binding cord) having loops (ed. misprint: yoktrena; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 51).

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].8) <iyaṃ vīrud [1.34.1 (7.56.2)]> iti madughamaṇiṃ lākṣāraktena sūtreṇa vigrathyānāmikāyāṃ badhnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].8) With <iyaṃ vīrud [1.34.1 (7.56.2)]> — having strung a <s>madugha</s>-gem on a thread dyed with lac, he ties it on the ring finger.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].9) antato ha maṇir bhavati bāhyo granthiḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].9) The gem is on the inner side, the knot on the outer.
(KauśS_10,2[76].10) With <bhagas tveto [14.1.20]> — grasping her hand, he leads her forth.
(KauśS_10,2[76].11) Having placed a yoke on a branch, another person holds it from the south.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].12) dakṣiṇasyāṃ yugadhuri_uttarasmin yugatardmani darbheṇa vigrathya <śaṃ te [14.1.40]>_iti lalāṭe hiraṇyaṃ saṃstabhya japati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].12) On the southern yoke-hole, at the northern yoke-peg, having tied with a <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) blade, with <śaṃ te [14.1.40]> he presses gold on her forehead and recites.
(KauśS_10,2[76].13) He pours water evenly over the yoke-peg.
(KauśS_10,2[76].14) Having taken hold of her, to the north of the fire, with <aṅgādaṅgād [14.2.69]> he leads her.
(KauśS_10,2[76].15) With <syonaṃ [14.1.47a]> he places a stone on a lump of cow-dung.
(KauśS_10,2[76].16) With <tam ā tiṣṭha [14.1.47c]> he makes her step upon it.
(KauśS_10,2[76].17) With <iyaṃ nārī [14.2.63]> — as she stands firm, he makes her offer <s>pūlya</s> (rice balls).
(KauśS_10,2[76].18) Three times without interruption, and a fourth for the sake of desire.
(KauśS_10,2[76].19) With <yenāgnir [14.1.48]> he makes her grasp his hand (<s>pāṇigrahaṇa</s>).
(KauśS_10,2[76].20) With <aryamṇo [14.1.39c]> he leads her around the fire three times (<s>agni-pariṇayana</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].21) <sapta maryādāḥ [5.1.6]>_ity uttarato_agneḥ sapta lekhā likhati prācyaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].21) With <sapta maryādāḥ [5.1.6]> — to the north of the fire, he draws seven lines running eastward.
(KauśS_10,2[76].22) On those he makes her step forward.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].23) iṣe tvā sumaṅgali prajāvati suśīma [ed.: +susīma] iti prathamam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].23) 'For food I take you, O auspicious one, rich in offspring, of good disposition' — thus for the first step.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].24) ūrje tvā rāyaspoṣāya tvā saubhāgyāya tvā sāmrājyāya tvā saṃpade tvā jīvātave tvā sumaṅgali prajāvati suśīma [ed.: +susīma] iti saptamaṃ sakhā saptapadī bhava_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].24) 'For vigor I take you, for increase of wealth, for good fortune, for sovereignty, for prosperity, for long life — O auspicious one, rich in offspring, of good disposition' — thus for the seventh. 'Be my companion with the seventh step' — thus.
(KauśS_10,2[76].25) With <ā roha talpaṃ [14.2.31]> and <bhagas tatakṣa [14.1.60]> he seats her on the <s>talpa</s> (bridal bed).
(KauśS_10,2[76].26) When she is seated, a friend washes her feet.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].27) prakṣālyamānau_anumantrayate | <imau pādau subhagau suśevau saubhāgyāya kṛṇutāṃ no aghāya | prakṣālyamānau subhagau supatnyāḥ prajāṃ paśūn dīrgham āyuś ca dhattām [-]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].27) Over the feet being washed, he recites: <imau pādau subhagau suśevau saubhāgyāya kṛṇutāṃ no aghāya | prakṣālyamānau subhagau supatnyāḥ prajāṃ paśūn dīrgham āyuś ca dhattām [-]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].28) <ahaṃ vi ṣyāmi [14.1.57]> <pra tvā muñcāmi [14.1.58]>_iti yoktraṃ vicṛtati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].28) With <ahaṃ vi ṣyāmi [14.1.57]> and <pra tvā muñcāmi [14.1.58]> he unties the <s>yoktra</s> (binding cord).
(KauśS_10,2[76].29) Meanwhile the attendants engage in a contest.

body.text: (KauśS_10,2[76].30) ye jayanti te balīyāṃsa eva manyante
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,2[76].30) Those who win consider themselves the stronger.
(KauśS_10,2[76].31) With <bṛhaspatinā [14.2.53]> — verse by verse, with a <s>kāmpīla</s>-leaf (Mallotus philippensis), he sprinkles all-fragrant powder on her head.
(KauśS_10,2[76].32) With <ud yachadhvam [14.1.59]>, <bhagas tatakṣa [14.1.60]>, and <abhrātṛghnīṃ [14.1.62]> — with one verse each he raises her up.
(KauśS_10,2[76].33) With <prati tiṣṭha [14.2.15]> he establishes her firmly.
(KauśS_10,3[77].1) With <sukiṃśukaṃ [14.1.61]> and <rukmaprastaraṇaṃ [14.2.30]> he makes her mount the vehicle.
(KauśS_10,3[77].2) With <emamṃ panthām [14.2.8]> and <brahmāparaṃ [14.1.64]> the <s>brahman</s> (priest) goes ahead in front.
(KauśS_10,3[77].3) With <mā vidann [14.2.11]> and <anṛkṣarā [14.1.34]> — concerning the road, it has been stated.

body.text: (KauśS_10,3[77].4) <yedaṃ purvā [14.2.74]>_iti tenānyasyām ūḍhāyāṃ vādhūyasya daśāṃ catuṣpathe dakṣiṇair abhitiṣṭhati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,3[77].4) With <yedaṃ purvā [14.2.74]> — when another woman has been married by the same man, he treads upon the fringe of the bridal garment at a crossroads with his right foot.

body.text: (KauśS_10,3[77].5) sa ced ubhayoḥ śubhakāmo bhavati <sūryāyai devebhyo [14.2.46]>_ity etām ṛcaṃ japati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,3[77].5) If he wishes well for both, he recites the verse <sūryāyai devebhyo [14.2.46]>.

body.text: (KauśS_10,3[77].6) <sam ṛchata svapatho 'navayantaḥ suśīmakāmāv [ed.: +susīma-] ubhe virājāv ubhe suprajasau [-]>_ity atikramayato 'ntarā brahmāṇam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,3[77].6) <sam ṛchata svapatho 'navayantaḥ suśīmakāmāv [ed.: +susīma-] ubhe virājāv ubhe suprajasau [-]> — thus he makes the two pass between the <s>brahman</s> (priest).

body.text: (KauśS_10,3[77].7) <ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ [14.2.47]>_iti yānaṃ saṃprokṣya viniṣkārayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,3[77].7) With <ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ [14.2.47]> — having sprinkled the vehicle, he makes her descend.
(KauśS_10,3[77].8) With <sā mandasānā [14.2.6]> — at a ford, he throws a clod into the water.
(KauśS_10,3[77].9) With <idam su me [14.2.9]> he recites at large trees.
(KauśS_10,3[77].10) With <sumaṅgalīr [14.2.28]> he recites toward those who come to see the bride.
(KauśS_10,3[77].11) With <yā oṣadhayo [14.2.7]> — at the things mentioned in the mantra.
(KauśS_10,3[77].12) With <ye pitaro [14.2.73]> — at cremation grounds.
(KauśS_10,3[77].13) With <pra budhyasva [14.2.75]> he should wake her if she has fallen asleep.
(KauśS_10,3[77].14) With <saṃ kāśayāmi [14.2.12]> he recites when the house comes into view.
(KauśS_10,3[77].15) With <ud va ūrmiḥ [14.2.16]> — having sprinkled the vehicle, he unyokes it.
(KauśS_10,3[77].16) With <ut tiṣṭhetaḥ [14.2.19]> the wife sprinkles the hall.
(KauśS_10,3[77].17) With <syonaṃ [14.1.47]> — to the south of the <s>valīka</s> (torches of bark), he places a stone on a lump of cow-dung.
(KauśS_10,3[77].18) On top of that, on the middle leaf, four tips of <s>dūrvā</s> (couch grass) in ghee.
(KauśS_10,3[77].19) With <tam ā tiṣṭha [14.1.47c]> he makes her step upon it.
(KauśS_10,3[77].20) With <sumaṅgalī prataraṇī [14.2.26]>, <iha priyaṃ [14.1.21]>, <mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ [14.1.63]>, and <brahmāparaṃ [14.1.64]> — verse by verse he makes her step forward.
(KauśS_10,3[77].21) A friend presents her with a full vessel.
(KauśS_10,3[77].22) With <aghoracakṣur [14.2.17]> he leads her around the fire three times.
(KauśS_10,3[77].23) With <yadā gārhapatyam [14.2.20]> and <sūryāyai devebhyo [14.2.46]> he recites over her as she makes obeisance to those mentioned in the mantras.
(KauśS_10,4[78].1) With <śarma varma [14.2.21]> — over the one bringing a red hide.
(KauśS_10,4[78].2) With <carma copastṛṇīthana [14.2.22b]> — over the one spreading it.
(KauśS_10,4[78].3) With <yaṃ balbajaṃ [14.2.22]> — over the one placing <s>balbaja</s> (coarse grass).
(KauśS_10,4[78].4) With <upa stṛṇīhi [14.2.23]> — over the one spreading it.
(KauśS_10,4[78].5) With <tad ā rohatu [14.2.22c]> he makes her mount it.
(KauśS_10,4[78].6) With <tatropaviśya [14.2.23c]> he seats her.
(KauśS_10,4[78].7) He makes the lap [facing] south-north.
(KauśS_10,4[78].8) With '<s>sujyaiṣṭhyo</s>' [AV 14.2.24d], he seats a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>'s son with an auspicious name in the lap.
(KauśS_10,4[78].9) With '<s>vi tiṣṭhantāṃ</s>' [AV 14.2.25], having measured out a churning-stick, he raises [the bride] up.

body.text: (KauśS_10,4[78].10) <tena bhūtena [6.78.1]> <tubhyam agre [14.2.1]> <śumbhanī [14.2.45]> <agnir janavin mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt somo vasuvin mahyaṃ jāyām imām adāt pūṣā jñātivin [ed. misprint jātivin] mahyaṃ jāyām imām adād indraḥ sahīyān mahyaṃ jāyām adād agnaye janavide svāhā somāya vasuvide svāhā pūṣṇe jñātivide [ed. misprint jātivide] svāhendrāya sahīyase svāhā [PS 1.34+1.35>_iti [ed. ity āgachataḥ: āgachataḥ moved to next sūtra after Bloomfield GGA 1902 514]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,4[78].10) With '<s>tena bhūtena</s>' [AV 6.78.1], '<s>tubhyam agre</s>' [AV 14.2.1], '<s>śumbhanī</s>' [AV 14.2.45], '<s>Agni</s>, knower of people, gave this wife to me; <s>Soma</s>, knower of wealth, gave this wife to me; <s>Pūṣan</s>, knower of kin, gave this wife to me; <s>Indra</s>, the mightiest, gave [this] wife to me. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s> the knower of people, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Soma</s> the knower of wealth, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Pūṣan</s> the knower of kin, <s>svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s> the mightiest' [PS 1.34+1.35] — thus

body.text: (KauśS_10,4[78].11) <āgachataḥ [6.82.1]><savitā prasavānām [5.24.1]> iti mūrdhnoḥ saṃpātān ānayati [pratīka of 6.82.1 prefixed after Bloomfield GGA 1902 514]
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,4[78].11) with '<s>āgachataḥ</s>' [AV 6.82.1], '<s>savitā prasavānām</s>' [AV 5.24.1], he brings the remainders to their heads.
(KauśS_10,4[78].12) The northern [remainders] into a water vessel.
(KauśS_10,4[78].13) With the <s>śumbhanī</s> [verse] he carries [the remainders] into their cupped hands.
(KauśS_10,4[78].14) With '<s>tena bhūtena</s>' [AV 6.78.1], they eat together.
(KauśS_10,4[78].15) He causes [them] to taste juices and the <s>sthālīpāka</s> (cooked offering).
(KauśS_10,4[78].16) He offers a handful of barley mixed with ghee.
(KauśS_10,5[79].1) With '<s>sapta maryādāḥ</s>' [AV 5.1.6], on three mornings he performs the rite.
(KauśS_10,5[79].2) With '<s>akṣyau nau</s>' [AV 7.36.1], they anoint each other's eyes.
(KauśS_10,5[79].3) With '<s>mahīm u ṣu</s>' [AV 7.6.2], he causes [the bride] to touch the bed.
(KauśS_10,5[79].4) With '<s>ā roha talpaṃ</s>' [AV 14.2.31], he makes [her] ascend.
(KauśS_10,5[79].5) With '<s>tatropaviśya</s>' [AV 14.2.23c], he seats [her].
(KauśS_10,5[79].6) With '<s>devā agre</s>' [AV 14.2.32], he lays [them] down together.
(KauśS_10,5[79].7) With '<s>abhi tvā</s>' [AV 7.37.1], he covers [them].
(KauśS_10,5[79].8) With '<s>saṃ pitarāv</s>' [AV 14.2.37], he lays [both] parents down together.
(KauśS_10,5[79].9) With '<s>ihemāv</s>' [AV 14.2.64], he presses [them] together three times.
(KauśS_10,5[79].10) Having removed the honey-gem on the ox-[hide], with '<s>iyaṃ vīrut</s>' [AV 1.34.1], '<s>amo 'ham</s>' [AV 14.2.71], they touch each other.
(KauśS_10,5[79].11) With '<s>brahma jajñānaṃ</s>' [AV 4.1.1 (5.6.1)], with the thumb he separates [them].
(KauśS_10,5[79].12) With '<s>syonād yoner</s>' [AV 14.2.43], he raises [the bride] up.
(KauśS_10,5[79].13) With the two garment-covering [verses], he covers [her] with an unworn [garment].

body.text: (KauśS_10,5[79].14) <bṛhaspatiḥ [14.1.55]>_iti śaṣpeṇābhighārya vrīhiyavābhyām abhinidhāya darbhapiñjulyā sīmantaṃ vicṛtati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,5[79].14) With '<s>bṛhaspatiḥ</s>' [AV 14.1.55], having anointed with young grass, having placed rice and barley, he parts the hair-parting with a <s>darbha</s>-grass pin.

body.text: (KauśS_10,5[79].15) śaṇaśakalena pariveṣṭya tisro rātrīḥ prati suptāste
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,5[79].15) Having bound [her hair] with a hemp band, she sleeps facing [him] for three nights.
(KauśS_10,5[79].16) With the two <s>anuvāka</s> (recitation sections), while holding on to both, he should make the offering.
(KauśS_10,5[79].17) With '<s>ihed asātha</s>' [AV 14.1.32], with this [verse] having removed the bride-price,

body.text: (KauśS_10,5[79].18) dvābhyāṃ nivartayatīha mama rādhyatām atra tava_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_10,5[79].18) with two [verses] he turns [the bride] back: 'May it be fulfilled for me here, and for you there.'
(KauśS_10,5[79].19) Or as they think [appropriate].
(KauśS_10,5[79].20) With '<s>parā dehi</s>' [AV 14.1.25], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> the one giving the bridal [gifts].
(KauśS_10,5[79].21) With '<s>devair dattaṃ</s>' [AV 14.2.41], he accepts.
(KauśS_10,5[79].22) With '<s>apāsmat tama</s>' [AV 14.2.48], he fastens [it] on a post.
(KauśS_10,5[79].23) With '<s>yāvatīḥ kṛtyā</s>' [AV 14.2.49], he should go.
(KauśS_10,5[79].24) With '<s>yā me priyatamā</s>' [AV 14.2.50], he covers a tree.
(KauśS_10,5[79].25) Having bathed with the <s>śumbhanī</s> [verses],
(KauśS_10,5[79].26) with '<s>ye antā</s>' [AV 14.2.51], he covers [her].
(KauśS_10,5[79].27) With '<s>navaṃ vasānaḥ</s>' [AV 14.2.44], he enters [the house].
(KauśS_10,5[79].28) With '<s>pūrvāparaṃ</s>' [AV 14.1.23], where he does not obtain [the proper verse], with '<s>brahmāparaṃ</s>' [AV 14.1.64], he should perform.
(KauśS_10,5[79].29) A cow is the gift (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>), and a return-conveyance.
(KauśS_10,5[79].30) With '<s>jīvaṃ rudanti</s>' [AV 14.1.46], '<s>yadīme keśino</s>' [AV 14.2.59], he offers.
(KauśS_10,5[79].31) This is the <s>saurya</s> (solar) marriage.
(KauśS_10,5[79].32) With '<s>brahmāparaṃ</s>' [AV 14.1.64], the <s>brāhma</s> (priestly) [forms of marriage].
(KauśS_10,5[79].33) The reversed [form] is the <s>prājāpatya</s> (of <s>Prajāpati</s>) [marriage]. The <s>prājāpatya</s> [marriage].

body.text: (KauśS 10 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 10 Colophon) Thus ends the tenth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_11,1[80].1) Now we shall explain the <s>pitṛmedha</s> (funeral rites for ancestors).
(KauśS_11,1[80].2) The place for burning and depositing, the trees surrounding [it], the time for depositing — these are stated in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].3) durbalībhavantaṃ śālātṛṇeṣu darbhān āstīrya <syonāsmai bhava [18.2.19]>_ity avarohayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].3) When [the person] is becoming weak, having spread <s>darbha</s> grasses on hall-grasses, with '<s>syonāsmai bhava</s>' [AV 18.2.19], he lays [the dying person] down.
(KauśS_11,1[80].4) He consecrates with <s>mantras</s> as stated in the <s>mantras</s>.
(KauśS_11,1[80].5) With '<s>yat te kṛṣṇaḥ</s>' [AV 18.3.55], he kindles [the fire].
(KauśS_11,1[80].6) When the one who maintained the sacred fires has died, he gathers the requisites.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].7) ājyaṃ ca pṛṣadājyaṃ cājaṃ ca gāṃ ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].7) Ghee, curdled ghee, a goat, and a cow.
(KauśS_11,1[80].8) A garment as the fifth.
(KauśS_11,1[80].9) Gold as the sixth.
(KauśS_11,1[80].10) He does not touch the body.
(KauśS_11,1[80].11) He consecrates with <s>mantras</s> another who is handling [the body].
(KauśS_11,1[80].12) He prepares the pacificatory water and also performs the scattering rites, incomplete.
(KauśS_11,1[80].13) With the pacificatory water-water, they gather the hair, beard, body-hair, and nails.
(KauśS_11,1[80].14) They bathe [the body].
(KauśS_11,1[80].15) They anoint [it].
(KauśS_11,1[80].16) They bring garlands.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].17) evaṃsnātam alaṃkṛtam ahatenāvāgdaśena vasanena prachādayati_<etat te devaḥ [18.4.31]>_<etat tvā vāsaḥ prathamaṃ nv āgann [18.2.57a]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].17) Having thus bathed and adorned [the body], he covers [it] with an unworn garment with the fringe downward: '<s>etat te deva���</s>' [AV 18.4.31], '<s>etat tvā vāsaḥ prathamaṃ nv āgann</s>' [AV 18.2.57a].
(KauśS_11,1[80].18) With '<s>apemaṃ</s>' [AV 18.2.27], he offers into the fires.
(KauśS_11,1[80].19) They prepare the fire-pots.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].20) tāḥ śakṛdābhyantaraṃ limpanti śuṣkeṇa vā pūrayanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].20) Those they smear on the inside with dung, or fill with dry [dung].
(KauśS_11,1[80].21) Those they heat separately with fires, until the dung ignites.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].22) teṣāṃ haraṇānupūrvam āhavanīyaṃ prathamaṃ tato dakṣiṇāgniṃ tato gārhapatyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].22) The order of carrying them: the <s>āhavanīya</s> (offering fire) first, then the <s>dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire), then the <s>gārhapatya</s> (householder's fire).

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].23) atha videśe pretasya_<ā rohata janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ [18.4.1]>_iti pṛthag araṇīṣu_agnīn samāropayanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].23) Then, in a [suitable] place for the deceased, with '<s>ā rohata janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ</s>' [AV 18.4.1], they place the fires separately on the fire-sticks (<s>araṇi</s>).
(KauśS_11,1[80].24) On those, he performs as stated.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].25) apivānyavatsāyā vā saṃdhinīkṣīreṇa_ekaśalākena vā manthenāgnihotraṃ juhoti_ā dahanāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].25) Or with the milk of a cow that has lost her calf, or of a cow about to calve, or with <s>mantha</s> (stirred drink) [stirred] with a single stick, he offers the <s>agnihotra</s> until the burning.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].26) darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ kṛṣṇakataṇḍulānāṃ tasyā ājyena nāntaṃ na bahiḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].26) At the new and full moon [rites], rice husked by a black woman — with her ghee, neither inside nor outside [the altar].
(KauśS_11,1[80].27) Straw-stalks [serve as] the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).
(KauśS_11,1[80].28) Sesame-husks [serve as] the fuel-sticks.
(KauśS_11,1[80].29) Having taken out the cups, the two ghee portions, the preliminary oblations, and the concluding oblations,

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].30) prāṇāpānau_+avarudhyoṃnidhanābhir (ed.: avarudhyai nidhanābhir; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 45) juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].30) having restrained the in-breath and out-breath, he should offer with [verses] having <s>om</s> as their conclusion.
(KauśS_11,1[80].31) Then, of both [husband and wife], with '<s>ut tiṣṭha</s>' [AV 18.3.8], he raises [the body] up.
(KauśS_11,1[80].32) With '<s>pra cyavasva</s>' [AV 18.3.9], he causes [the body] to be carried three times, and however many times he raises [it].
(KauśS_11,1[80].33) In just this way, having tied a grain-basket at the rear,
(KauśS_11,1[80].34) with '<s>imau yunajmi</s>' [AV 18.2.56], he yokes two cows, or two men.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].35) <ut tiṣṭha prehi [18.3.8]> <pra cyavasva [18.3.9]>_<udanvatī [18.2.48]>_<ita ete [18.1.61]>_<agnīṣomā [18.2.53]>_<idaṃ pūrvam [18.4.44]> iti hariṇībhir hareyur <ati drava [18.2.11-18]>_ity aṣṭabhiḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].35) With '<s>ut tiṣṭha prehi</s>' [AV 18.3.8], '<s>pra cyavasva</s>' [AV 18.3.9], '<s>udanvatī</s>' [AV 18.2.48], '<s>ita ete</s>' [AV 18.1.61], '<s>agnīṣomā</s>' [AV 18.2.53], '<s>idaṃ pūrvam</s>' [AV 18.4.44], with the <s>hariṇī</s> (golden) [verses] they should carry — with '<s>ati drava</s>' [AV 18.2.11-18], with eight [verses].
(KauśS_11,1[80].36) With '<s>idaṃ ta</s>' [AV 18.3.7], fire in front.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].37) <prajānaty aghnye [18.3.4]>_ity +jaghanyāṃ (ed.: jaghanyaṃ; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 4) gām edham agniṃ pariṇīya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].37) With '<s>prajānaty aghnye</s>' [AV 18.3.4], having led the rear cow and the fuel-fire around,
(KauśS_11,1[80].38) with '<s>syonāsmai bhava</s>' [AV 18.2.19], to the north of the fire, he places the body.
(KauśS_11,1[80].39) The <s>adhvaryu</s> priests prepare the offering.
(KauśS_11,1[80].40) In that [offering], having taken out the preliminary oblations and the concluding oblations according to the deities,
(KauśS_11,1[80].41) having restrained the in-breath and out-breath, he should offer with [verses] having <s>om</s> as their conclusion.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].42) atha_ubhayor <apeta [18.1.55]> <dadāmi [18.2.37]>_ity śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇībhyāṃ kāmpīlaśākhāyā dahanaṃ saṃprokṣya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].42) Then, of both [husband and wife], with '<s>apeta</s>' [AV 18.1.55], '<s>dadāmi</s>' [AV 18.2.37], having prepared the pacificatory water, having sprinkled the burning-place with the two sprinkling vessels and a <s>kāmpīla</s> branch,

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].43) <ud īratām [18.1.44]> ity +uddhatya (ed.: uddhṛtya)_abhyukṣya lakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā punar abhyukṣya prāgdakṣiṇam edhaś cinvanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].43) with '<s>ud īratām</s>' [AV 18.1.44], having raised up, having sprinkled, having made a mark, having sprinkled again, they pile the fuel facing east and south.
(KauśS_11,1[80].44) With '<s>iyaṃ nārī</s>' [AV 18.3.1], he lays the wife down beside [the body].
(KauśS_11,1[80].45) With '<s>ud īrṣva</s>' [AV 18.3.2], he raises [her] up.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].46) yad ddhiraṇyaṃ bibharti tad dakṣiṇe pāṇau_+ādhāya (ed.: ādāya)_ājyenābhighārya jyeṣṭhena putreṇādāpayati_<idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ [18.4.56]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].46) Whatever gold [the deceased] bears, having placed it in the right hand, having sprinkled with ghee, the eldest son takes it: '<s>idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ</s>' [AV 18.4.56].
(KauśS_11,1[80].47) With '<s>svargaṃ yataḥ</s>' [AV 18.4.56c], he wipes the right hand.
(KauśS_11,1[80].48) With '<s>daṇḍaṃ hastād</s>' [AV 18.2.59], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>, he takes [the staff] from the hand of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.
(KauśS_11,1[80].49) With '<s>dhanur hastād</s>' [AV 18.2.60], of a <s>Kṣatriya</s>.
(KauśS_11,1[80].50) With '<s>aṣṭrām</s>' [cf. AV 18.2.59-60], of a <s>Vaiśya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].51) <idaṃ pitṛbhyo [18.4.51, see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 4]>_iti darbhān edhān stṛṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].51) With '<s>idaṃ pitṛbhyo</s>' [AV 18.4.51], he strews <s>darbha</s> grasses and fuel.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].52) tatra_enam uttānam ādadhīta_<ījānaś +citam (ed.: cittam; cf. vḷ. in ;SS-edition by ;SPP) ārukṣad agniṃ [18.4.14]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].52) There he should place [the body] face-up: '<s>ījānaś citam ārukṣad agniṃ</s>' [AV 18.4.14].
(KauśS_11,1[80].53) With '<s>prācyāṃ tvā diśi</s>' [AV 18.3.30], in each direction.
(KauśS_11,1[80].54) 'No' — [say] the <s>Uparibabhravas</s>.
(KauśS_11,1[80].55) He consecrates with <s>mantras</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_11,1[80].56) athāsya saptasu prāṇeṣu sapta hiraṇyaśakalāni_avāsyati_<amṛtam asy amṛtatvāyāmṛtam asmin dhehi>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,1[80].56) Then in his seven vital breaths he places seven pieces of gold: 'You are immortal, for the sake of immortality; place immortality in this one.'
(KauśS_11,2[81].1) Now, for the one who has not maintained sacred fires, having spread a black antelope skin with hair inward on <s>darbha</s> grasses,
(KauśS_11,2[81].2) there he places [the body] face-up.
(KauśS_11,2[81].3) Then, having filled his sacrificial vessels with curdled ghee, he places them in corresponding positions.
(KauśS_11,2[81].4) The <s>juhū</s> (offering ladle) in the right hand.
(KauśS_11,2[81].5) The <s>upabhṛt</s> (secondary ladle) in the left.
(KauśS_11,2[81].6) The <s>dhruvā</s> (fixed ladle) at the throat, the <s>agnihotrahavanī</s> (agnihotra offering vessel) at the mouth, the <s>sruva</s> (libation spoon) at the nostrils.
(KauśS_11,2[81].7) He consecrates those with <s>mantras</s>: '<s>juhūr dadhāra dyām</s>' [AV 18.4.5], '<s>dhruvā ā roha</s>' [AV 18.4.6].
(KauśS_11,2[81].8) The <s>prāśitraharaṇa</s> (first-portion vessel) on the forehead.
(KauśS_11,2[81].9) With '<s>imam agne camasaṃ</s>' [AV 18.3.53], [he places] an <s>iḍā</s>-ladle on the head.
(KauśS_11,2[81].10) With '<s>devā yajñam</s>' [AV 18.4.2], [he places] a sacrificial cake on the chest.
(KauśS_11,2[81].11) On the right side, [he places] a wooden sword; on the left, a winnowing basket.
(KauśS_11,2[81].12) On the belly, a dish.
(KauśS_11,2[81].13) At the knees, a mortar and pestle.
(KauśS_11,2[81].14) At the hips, a cart.
(KauśS_11,2[81].15) Between the thighs, the other sacrificial vessels.
(KauśS_11,2[81].16) At the feet, a winnowing fan.
(KauśS_11,2[81].17) They offer earthen [vessels] with water.
(KauśS_11,2[81].18) They deposit iron [implements].

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].19) amā +putrasya (ed.: putrā ca; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 4) dṛṣat
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].19) At home, the grinding stone of the son.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].20) atha_ubhayor <apaśyaṃ yuvatiṃ [18.3.3]> <prajānaty aghnye [18.3.4]>_iti jaghanyāṃ gāṃ prasavyaṃ pariṇīyamānām anumantrayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].20) Then, for both [man and wife], with '<s>apaśyaṃ yuvatiṃ</s>' [AV 18.3.3] and '<s>prajānaty aghnye</s>' [AV 18.3.4], he consecrates a barren cow being led around to the left,
(KauśS_11,2[81].21) They seat her behind [the corpse] in the southwest, striking her without killing.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].22) tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhato vṛkkau_uddhārya pāṇyor asyādadhati_<ati drava śvānau [18.2.11]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].22) Having extracted the kidneys from her back, he places them in [the deceased's] hands, with '<s>ati drava śvānau</s>' [AV 18.2.11].
(KauśS_11,2[81].23) The right [kidney] in the right [hand], the left in the left.
(KauśS_11,2[81].24) The heart [of the cow] upon [his] heart.
(KauśS_11,2[81].25) With '<s>agner varma</s>' [AV 18.2.58], they cover the face with the omentum having seven openings.
(KauśS_11,2[81].26) Limbs corresponding to limbs.
(KauśS_11,2[81].27) Right [limbs] with right [limbs], left with left.
(KauśS_11,2[81].28) Having covered the cow-shed with the hide, with the head and feet still attached,
(KauśS_11,2[81].29) with '<s>ajo bhāgas</s>' [AV 18.2.8] and '<s>ut tvā vahantu</s>' [AV 18.2.22], he ties a goat to the south.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].30) <asmād vai tvam ajāyathā ayaṃ tvad adhi jāyatām asau svāhā [cf. JB 1.2, 1.47, cf. TA 6.2.1, 6.4.2, AAśvGS 4.3.27]>_ity urasi gṛhe juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].30) With '<s>asmād vai tvam ajāyathā ayaṃ tvad adhi jāyatām asau svāhā</s>' [cf. JB 1.2, 1.47, cf. TA 6.2.1, 6.4.2, ĀśvGS 4.3.27] — 'From this one indeed you were born; may this one be born again from you; to him, <s>svāhā</s>' — he offers into the fire upon the chest.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].31) tathāgniṣu juhoti_<agnaye svāhā kāmāya svāhā lokāya svāhā [cf. AAśvGS 4.3.26]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].31) Likewise, he offers into the fires: '<s>Agnaye svāhā, Kāmāya svāhā, Lokāya svāhā</s>' [cf. ĀśvGS 4.3.26] — 'To <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Kāma</s> (Desire), <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Loka</s> (the World), <s>svāhā</s>!'
(KauśS_11,2[81].32) In the <s>dakṣiṇāgni</s> (southern fire), say some.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].33) <mainam agne vi dahaḥ [18.2.4]> <śaṃ tapa [18.2.36]> <ā rabhasva [18.3.71 e.a.]> <prajānantaḥ [2.34.5]>_iti kaniṣṭha ādīpayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].33) With '<s>mainam agne vi dahaḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.4], '<s>śaṃ tapa</s>' [AV 18.2.36], '<s>ā rabhasva</s>' [AV 18.3.71 etc.], and '<s>prajānantaḥ</s>' [AV 2.34.5], the youngest [son] sets fire [to the pyre].

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].34) ādīpte sruveṇa yāmān homān_juhoti <pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīr iti [18.1.49]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].34) When it is ablaze, with a sacrificial ladle he offers the <s>yāma</s> oblations: '<s>pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīr iti</s>' [AV 18.1.49].

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].35) <yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda [18.1.50]> iti dve prathame
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].35) '<s>Yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda</s>' [AV 18.1.50] — these two are first.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].36) <aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā [18.1.58]> iti saṃhitāḥ sapta
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].36) '<s>Aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro Navagvāḥ</s>' [AV 18.1.58] — seven [verses] in a group.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].37) <yo mamāra prathamo martyānāṃ [18.3.13]> <ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā [18.2.49]> ity ekādaśa
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].37) '<s>Yo mamāra prathamo martyānāṃ</s>' [AV 18.3.13], '<s>ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahāḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.49] — eleven [verses].
(KauśS_11,2[81].38) Then the <s>Sārasvatī</s> [oblations].

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].39) <sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante [18.1.41]> <sarasvatīṃ pitaro havante [18.1.42]> <sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha [18.1.43]> <sarasvati vrateṣu te [7.68.1]>_<idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat sarasvati [7.68.2]>_<indro mā marutvān [18.3.25]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].39) '<s>Sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante</s>' [AV 18.1.41], '<s>Sarasvatīṃ pitaro havante</s>' [AV 18.1.42], '<s>Sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayātha</s>' [AV 18.1.43], '<s>Sarasvati vrateṣu te</s>' [AV 7.68.1], '<s>idaṃ te havyaṃ ghṛtavat Sarasvati</s>' [AV 7.68.2], '<s>Indro mā marutvān</s>' [AV 18.3.25].
(KauśS_11,2[81].40) To the south, in another [fire], the officiating priest offers.
(KauśS_11,2[81].41) They attend with all [hymns], three being the minimum.
(KauśS_11,2[81].42) Or also with the attendant [hymns].
(KauśS_11,2[81].43) These are the attendant [hymns]:

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].44) <mainam agne vi daho [18.2.4]>_itiprabhṛti_<ava sṛja [18.2.10]>_iti varjayitvā <sahasranīthāḥ [18.2.18]>_ity ātaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].44) Beginning with '<s>mainam agne vi daho</s>' [AV 18.2.4], excluding '<s>ava sṛja</s>' [AV 18.2.10], up to '<s>sahasranīthāḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.18].
(KauśS_11,2[81].45) With '<s>ā roha janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ</s>' [AV 18.4.1], fifteen [verses] for one who has established the [sacred] fires.

body.text: (KauśS_11,2[81].46) <mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām [18.3.12]> iti pāṇī prakṣālayate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,2[81].46) With '<s>Mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām</s>' [AV 18.3.12], he washes his hands.
(KauśS_11,2[81].47) With '<s>varcasā māṃ</s>' [AV 18.3.10(11)], he sips water (<s>ācamana</s>).
(KauśS_11,2[81].48) With '<s>Vivasvān no</s>' [AV 18.3.61], to the north, in another [fire], the officiating priest offers.
(KauśS_11,3[82].1) The preliminary rites are for those who are younger first, facing east, wearing the sacred thread, with circumambulation to the right.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].2) atha_eṣāṃ saptasapta śarkarāḥ pāṇiṣu_+āvapati (ed.: āvapate; thus Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 47)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].2) Then he places seven pebbles each into their hands.
(KauśS_11,3[82].3) Of those, scattering one by one with the left hand turned downward, not looking back, they depart.
(KauśS_11,3[82].4) He consecrates [them] with the <s>apāgha</s> [formula].
(KauśS_11,3[82].5) All walk in front of the <s>Brahman</s> priest.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].6) <mā pra gāma [13.1.59]>_iti japanta udakānte +vyaghāpaghe japati+ (ed.: vyapādye japanti; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 71-72)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].6) Reciting '<s>mā pra gāma</s>' [AV 13.1.59], at the water's edge the <s>vyaghāpagha</s> [priest] recites.
(KauśS_11,3[82].7) He pours [water] from behind.
(KauśS_11,3[82].8) With '<s>ud uttamaṃ</s>' [AV 18.4.69], the eldest [son].
(KauśS_11,3[82].9) With '<s>payasvatīr</s>' [AV 18.3.56 etc.], the <s>Brahman</s> priest. || Having recited, he casts <s>piñjūlī</s> (cotton-tufts).
(KauśS_11,3[82].10) Having sipped pacificatory water and sprinkled [himself], with '<s>aśvāvatīṃ</s>' [AV 18.2.31], he crosses the river.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].11) nakṣatraṃ dṛṣṭvā_upatiṣṭhate <nakṣatrāṇāṃ mā saṃkāśaś ca pratīkāśaś cāvatām [cf. VaitS 11.13]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].11) Having seen a star, he worships: 'May the appearance and counter-appearance of the stars protect me' [cf. VaitS 11.13].

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].12) śāmyākīḥ samidha +ādāya (ed.: ādhāya; see Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 47)_agrato brahmā japati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].12) Taking <s>śamī</s>-wood fuel sticks, the <s>Brahman</s> priest recites in front.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].13) <yasya trayā gatam anuprayanti devā manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca sarve | taṃ no devaṃ mano adhi bravītu sunītir no nayatu dviṣate mā radhāma [PS 1.78.4]>_iti śāntyudakenācamyābhyukṣya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].13) '<s>yasya trayā gatam anuprayanti devā manuṣyāḥ paśavaś ca sarve | taṃ no devaṃ mano adhi bravītu sunītir no nayatu dviṣate mā radhāma</s>' [PS 1.78.4] — 'May gods, men, and all cattle follow him whose departure the three follow; may the god speak over our mind; may good guidance lead us; may we not be subject to the enemy' — having sipped pacificatory water and sprinkled,
(KauśS_11,3[82].14) with '<s>nissālām</s>' [AV 2.14.1], having sprinkled the house-site,
(KauśS_11,3[82].15) with '<s>ūrjaṃ bibhrad</s>' [AV 7.60.1], he serves [food].

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].16) nadīm ālambhayati gām agnim aśmānaṃ ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].16) He causes them to touch a river, a cow, fire, and a stone.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].17) <yavo 'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātim [cf. TS 1.3.1.1 etc.]> iti yavān
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].17) With '<s>yavo 'si yavayāsmad dveṣo yavayārātim</s>' [cf. TS 1.3.1.1 etc.] — 'You are barley; ward off hatred from us, ward off the enemy' — barley [is used].
(KauśS_11,3[82].18) With '<s>khalvakāsya</s>' [—], threshing floors and granaries.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].19) +vyaghāpaghābhyāṃ (ed.: vyapādyābhyāṃ; Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 71-72) śāmyākīr ādhāpayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].19) With the <s>vyaghāpagha</s> [formulas], he causes <s>śamī</s>-wood [sticks] to be kindled.
(KauśS_11,3[82].20) They inhale the smoke of those.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].21) yadyat kravyād gṛhyed yadi kravyādā nānte 'paredyuḥ | <divo nabhaḥ śukraṃ payo duhānā iṣam ūrjaṃ pinvamānāḥ || apāṃ yonim apādhvaṃ svadhā yāś cakṛṣe jīvaṃs tās te santu madhuścutaḥ [cf. PS 19.52.1-3]> ity agnau sthālīpākaṃ nipṛṇāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].21) Whatever the corpse-eating [fire] seizes, if the corpse-eating [fire] does not [consume it] by the end or the next day — '<s>divo nabhaḥ śukraṃ payo duhānā iṣam ūrjaṃ pinvamānāḥ || apāṃ yonim apādhvaṃ svadhā yāś cakṛṣe jīvaṃs tās te santu madhuścutaḥ</s>' [cf. PS 19.52.1-3] — 'Milking the bright milk of heaven's vault, swelling with food and nourishment; go to the womb of the waters; those oblations which you made while living, may they be honey-dripping for you' — with this he cooks a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering) in the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].22) ādahane cāpivānyavatsāṃ dohayitvā tasyāḥ pṛṣṭhe juhoti <vaiśvānare havir idaṃ juhomi [18.4.35 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].22) And at the cremation ground, having milked a cow whose calf has been removed, he offers on her back: '<s>vaiśvānare havir idaṃ juhomi</s>' [AV 18.4.35 etc.] — 'I offer this oblation to <s>Vaiśvānara</s>.'
(KauśS_11,3[82].23) In her milk,
(KauśS_11,3[82].24) a pot-cooked offering, say some.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].25) <ye agnayo [3.21.1]>_iti pālāśyā darvyā mantham upamathya kāmpīlībhyām upamanthanībhyāṃ tṛtīyasyām asthīni_abhijuhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].25) With '<s>ye agnayo</s>' [AV 3.21.1], having churned a <s>mantha</s> (stirred drink) with a <s>palāśa</s>-wood ladle and with <s>kāmpīla</s>-wood churning sticks, on the third [day] he offers over the bones.
(KauśS_11,3[82].26) With '<s>upa dyām</s>' [AV 18.3.5] and '<s>śaṃ te nīhāro</s>' [AV 18.3.60], having set aside what is mentioned in the <s>mantras</s>,
(KauśS_11,3[82].27) he pours over the bones of a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> with [a mixture] mixed with milk; for a <s>Kṣatriya</s>, with [one] mixed with honey; for a <s>Vaiśya</s>, with water.
(KauśS_11,3[82].28) With '<s>ava sṛja</s>' [AV 18.2.10], he consecrates.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].29) <mā te mano [18.2.24]> <yat te aṅgam [18.2.26]> iti saṃcinoti (emended text + sūtra-division [29-30-31] acc. to Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 47)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].29) With '<s>mā te mano</s>' [AV 18.2.24] and '<s>yat te aṅgam</s>' [AV 18.2.26], he gathers [the bones].

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].30) +pattaḥ (thus Caland; ed.: pacchaḥ) prathamaṃ śīrṣakapālāni paścāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].30) The flat bones first, the skull-bones last.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].31) kalaśe samopya sarvasurabhicūrṇair avakīrya_utthāpanībhir utthāpya hariṇībhir hareyuḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].31) Having collected [them] in a jar, having strewn with all fragrant powders, having raised [the jar] with raising-verses, they should carry it with the <s>hariṇī</s>-verses.
(KauśS_11,3[82].32) With '<s>mā tvā vṛkṣaḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.25], he deposits [the jar] at the root of a tree.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].33) <syonāsmai bhava [18.2.19]>_iti bhūmau trirātram arasāśinaḥ karmāṇi kurvate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].33) With '<s>syonāsmai bhava</s>' [AV 18.2.19], [he deposits it] on the ground. For three nights they eat flavorless food and perform the rites.
(KauśS_11,3[82].34) For ten nights, say some.
(KauśS_11,3[82].35) Or according to family custom.

body.text: (KauśS_11,3[82].36) ūrdhvaṃ tṛtīyasyā vaivasvataṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā <vivasvān no [18.3.61]>_iti juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,3[82].36) After the third [day], having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> for <s>Vivasvat</s>, with '<s>Vivasvān no</s>' [AV 18.3.61], he offers.
(KauśS_11,3[82].37) The third [night, the offering is] with yoked [animals].
(KauśS_11,3[82].38) The fourth [is the offering to] <s>Ānumatī</s>.
(KauśS_11,3[82].39) The remainder, having mixed with pacificatory water, having consecrated, he feeds [them].
(KauśS_11,3[82].40) With '<s>ā pra cyavethām</s>' [AV 18.4.49], he presents two cows.
(KauśS_11,3[82].41) With '<s>eyam agann</s>' [AV 18.4.50], the sacrificial fee is a half-share of ten cows.
(KauśS_11,3[82].42) For twelve nights, the performer should observe the <s>Yama</s>-vow.
(KauśS_11,3[82].43) [Wearing] a single garment or three garments.
(KauśS_11,3[82].44) Eating only <s>haviṣya</s> (sacrificial) food.
(KauśS_11,3[82].45) He should perform ablutions morning and evening.
(KauśS_11,3[82].46) [He should be] a celibate (<s>brahmacārin</s>), observing the vow, sleeping on the ground.
(KauśS_11,3[82].47) He should employ auspicious rites.
(KauśS_11,4[83].1) One who is going to deposit the ancestors gathers the requisites.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].2) ekādaśa +carūn acakrakṛtān+ (ed.: carūñ cakrakṛtān; see Caland, Gebraeuche, p. 134, n. 493) kārayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].2) He has eleven rice-cakes prepared, not made with a wheel.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].3) śatātṛṇṇasahasrātṛṇṇau ca pāśīm ūṣam sikatāḥ śaṅkhaṃ śālūkaṃ sarvasurabhiśamīcūrṇakṛtaṃ śāntavṛkṣasya nāvaṃ tripādakam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].3) [He gathers] a platter pierced with a hundred and a thousand [holes], a mat, sand, a conch shell, a lotus root, powder made of all fragrant substances and <s>śamī</s>-wood, a boat of peaceful tree-wood, a tripod,

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].4) dve niḥśīyamāne nīlalohite sūtre savyarajjuṃ śāntavṛkṣasya caturaḥ śaṅkūn_caturaḥ paridhīn vāraṇaṃ śāmīlam audumbaraṃ pālāśaṃ vṛkṣasya śāntauṣadhīḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].4) two cloths being torn apart — blue and red threads, a left-twisted rope, four pegs of peaceful tree-wood, four enclosing sticks, a <s>vāraṇa</s> [tree branch], <s>śamī</s>-wood, <s>udumbara</s>-wood, <s>palāśa</s>-wood, tree-wood, and peaceful herbs.
(KauśS_11,4[83].5) He should deposit in [the month of] <s>Māgha</s>, for 'may it be absorbed (<s>māgha</s>).'
(KauśS_11,4[83].6) He should deposit in autumn, for 'may the sin be pacified (<s>śāmyatu</s>).'
(KauśS_11,4[83].7) He should deposit in summer, for 'may the sin be burned up (<s>nidahyatām</s>).'

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].8) amāvāsyāyāṃ nidadhyād amā hi pitaro bhavanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].8) He should deposit on the new-moon day, for the ancestors are indeed at home [then].
(KauśS_11,4[83].9) Now, the [choice of burial] site.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].10) tad yat samaṃ samūlam avidagdhaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ prāgudakpravaṇam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].10) That which is level, undisturbed at the root, unburnt, firm, and sloping to the east and north.
(KauśS_11,4[83].11) Where the trees and herbs are thornless.
(KauśS_11,4[83].12) And [the site should be] elevated, if one desires heaven.
(KauśS_11,4[83].13) On the day before the new moon, he has a cow prepared.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].14) tasyāḥ savyaṃ cāpaghanaṃ prapākaṃ ca nidhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_11,4[83].14) Having set aside the left hoof and the cooking vessel of that [cow],
(KauśS_11,4[83].15) he has alms collected.
(KauśS_11,4[83].16) In the village, having offered the <s>Sārasvatī</s> oblations,
(KauśS_11,4[83].17) having circumambulated the dwelling with the two sprinkling [vessels] and a <s>kāmpīla</s>-branch,

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].18) prāgdakṣiṇaṃ śākhāṃ pravidhya sīreṇa karṣayitvā śākhābhiḥ parivārya
body.translated_text: Having thrust a branch to the northeast, having ploughed with a plough, and having enclosed [the area] with branches,
with '<s>punar dehi</s>' [AV 18.3.70], he takes [the bones] from the base of the tree.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].20) <yat te kṛṣṇaḥ [18.3.55]>_iti bhūmer vasane samopya sarvasurabhicūrṇair avakīrya_utthāpanībhir utthāpya hariṇībhir hareyuḥ
body.translated_text: With '<s>yat te kṛṣṇaḥ</s>' [AV 18.3.55], having gathered [the bones] from the ground into a garment, having scattered all fragrant powders [upon them], having raised [the bones] with the raising [verses], they should carry [them] with the carrying [verses].
[They take] dust from the uninhabited place.
Or at the water's edge, having spread a garment, one should call [the deceased] by name.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].23) tatra yo jantur nipatet tam utthāpanībhir utthāpya hariṇībhir hareyuḥ
body.translated_text: Whatever creature falls there — that they should raise with the raising [verses] and carry with the carrying [verses].
Or three hundred and sixty <s>palāśa</s> leaves for the <s>tsaru</s> [wrappings].
In the village, having measured out [a space] with a door to the south and north, he spreads [it] with <s>darbha</s> [grasses].
The northern [door] is the passage for the living; the southern is the passage for the ancestors.
Before sunset, with '<s>ā yāta</s>' [AV 18.4.62], he invites [the ancestors] to come.
With '<s>ācyā jānu</s>' [AV 18.1.52], he seats [them].
With '<s>saṃ viśantv</s>' [AV 18.2.29], he causes [them] to lie down.

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].30) <etad vaḥ pitaraḥ pātram [cf. VSM 2.32, ManB 2.3.14 etc.]> iti trīṇy udakaṃsān ninayati
body.translated_text: With '<s>etad vaḥ pitaraḥ pātram</s>' [cf. VSM 2.32, ManB 2.3.14 etc.], he pours down three water-vessels.
He gives three bathed and anointed <s>brāhmaṇas</s> honey-drink (<s>madhumantha</s>) to drink.
He brings the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) for the <s>brahman</s> [priest].
They announce the cow.
He says: 'Do it.'

body.text: (KauśS_11,4[83].35) tasyā dakṣiṇam ardhaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayati savyaṃ pitṝn
body.translated_text: The right half of that [cow] feeds the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>; the left half [is for] the ancestors.

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].1) <vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatraitān vettha nihitān parāke | medasaḥ kulyā upa tān sravantu satyā eṣām āśiṣaḥ santu kāmāḥ svāhā svadhā [see 45.14, cf. ManB 2.3.18, VSM 35.20]>_iti vapāyās trir juhoti
body.translated_text: 'Carry the <s>vapā</s> (omentum), O <s>Jātavedas</s>, to the ancestors, where you know them placed far away; may streams of fat flow to them; may their blessings and desires be true. <s>Svāhā</s>, <s>Svadhā</s>.' [see 45.14, cf. ManB 2.3.18, VSM 35.20] — from the <s>vapā</s>, he offers three times.
With '<s>imaṃ yama</s>' [AV 18.1.60], the fourth [oblation] to <s>Yama</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].3) ekaviṃśatyā yavaiḥ kṛśaraṃ randhayati yutam anyat prapākaṃ ca
body.translated_text: With twenty-one barley grains, he cooks <s>kṛśara</s> (rice-and-sesame gruel); another [dish] mixed [with it], and a <s>prapāka</s> (simple cooked [dish]).
The living eat [from the dish] with barley.
Then of the other [dish], he forms a rice-ball (<s>piṇḍa</s>).
With '<s>yaṃ te mantham</s>' [AV 18.4.42], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>, he places the rice-ball in the measured [space].

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].7) tad udgatoṣma hartāro [ed. -oṣmahart-, Caland Ahnencult p. 264] dāsā bhuñjate
body.translated_text: When the steam has risen from that, the servants who are the bearers eat.
He says: 'Let the <s>vīṇās</s> (lutes) sound.'

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].9) mahayata pitṝn iti riktakumbhaṃ vimitamadhye nidhāya taṃ jaradupānahāghnanti
body.translated_text: 'Honor the ancestors' — having placed an empty pot in the middle of the measured [space], they strike it with old sandals.

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].10) <kasye mṛjānā [18.3.17]> iti triḥ prasavyaṃ prakīrṇakeśyaḥ pariyanti dakṣiṇān ūrūn aghnānāḥ
body.translated_text: With '<s>kasye mṛjānā</s>' [AV 18.3.17], three times counter-clockwise, women with disheveled hair go around, striking [their] right thighs.
Likewise at midnight and in the latter part of the night.
Before [the deceased's] marriage, the <s>piṇḍapitṛyajña</s> (rice-ball ancestor sacrifice) [includes] meat.
Having raised [the bones] with the raising [verses], they should carry [them] with the carrying [verses].

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].14) atha_<avasāya [?, .RV 10.169.1d, PS 19.51.5d? Note Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 48)]>_iti paścāt pūrvakṛtebhyaḥ pūrvāṇi pūrvebhyo_aparāṇi yavīyasām
body.translated_text: Then with '<s>avasāya</s>' [cf. RV 10.169.1d, PS 19.51.5d?], from behind — the former [offerings go] to those made earlier, the earlier [portions] to the earlier [ancestors], the later ones to the younger [ancestors].

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].15) prāgdakṣiṇāṃ diśam abhy uttarām aparāṃ diśam abhitiṣṭhanti
body.translated_text: They stand facing the northeast direction and the northwest direction.

body.text: (KauśS_11,5[84].16) yathā citiṃ tathā śmaśānaṃ dakṣiṇāparāṃ diśam abhi pravaṇam
body.translated_text: As the funeral pyre (<s>citi</s>), so the cremation ground (<s>śmaśāna</s>) — [sloping] toward the southwest direction.
Now, the measurements.
The <s>diṣṭi</s>, <s>kudiṣṭi</s>, <s>vitasti</s>, <s>nimuṣṭi</s>, <s>aratni</s>, <s>pada</s>, and <s>prakrama</s> [are the units of measurement].
With a span (<s>prādeśa</s>) and a bow [length], with '<s>imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe</s>' [AV 18.2.38] — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].4) sapta dakṣiṇato mimīte sapta_uttarataḥ pañca purastāt trīṇi paścāt
body.translated_text: He measures seven to the south, seven to the north, five to the east, three to the west.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].5) nava dakṣiṇato mimīte nava_uttarataḥ sapta purastāt pañca paścāt
body.translated_text: He measures nine to the south, nine to the north, seven to the east, five to the west.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].6) ekādaśa dakṣiṇato mimīta ekādaśa_uttarato nava purastāt sapta paścāt
body.translated_text: He should measure eleven to the south, eleven to the north, nine to the east, seven to the west.
With eleven [measures] for those of the <s>Devadarśin</s> [school].
Odd-numbered measurements; circular or square — [according to] the <s>Śaunakins</s>.
For thus they are seen [in practice].

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].10) yāvān puruṣa ūrdhvanāhus tāvān agniś citaḥ
body.translated_text: As tall as a man with upraised arms, so high is the piled fire-altar.
Left-[handed arrangements], doors facing south, odd-numbered stones, and odd-numbered bricks.
With '<s>imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe</s>' [AV 18.2.38], having measured from the south with a left-hand cord,

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].13) vārayatām agham iti vāraṇaṃ paridhiṃ paridadhāti śaṅkuṃ ca nicṛtati
body.translated_text: 'May it ward off evil' — he places a warding (<s>vāraṇa</s>) enclosure-stick and drives in a peg.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].14) purastān mītvā śam ebhyo astv agham iti śāmīlaṃ paridhiṃ paridadhāti śaṅkuṃ ca nicṛtati
body.translated_text: Having measured to the east: 'May there be peace for these, [may] evil [be gone]' — he places a <s>śāmīla</s> (pacificatory) enclosure-stick and drives in a peg.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].15) uttarato mītvā śāmyatv agham ity audumbaraṃ paridhiṃ paridadhāti śaṅkuṃ ca nicṛtati
body.translated_text: Having measured to the north: 'May evil be pacified' — he places an <s>audumbara</s> (fig-wood) enclosure-stick and drives in a peg.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].16) paścān mītvā śāntam agham iti pālāśaṃ paridhiṃ paridadhāti śaṅkuṃ ca nicṛtati
body.translated_text: Having measured to the west: 'Evil is pacified' — he places a <s>pālāśa</s> (palāśa-wood) enclosure-stick and drives in a peg.
With '<s>amāsi</s>' [AV 18.2.45], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s>.
Having bound [the pegs] diagonally with a red thread,

with '<s>stuhi śrutam</s>' [AV 18.1.40], having dug a pit in the middle, he scatters [into it]: pebbles, sand, alkaline [earth], <s>udumbara</s> [fig-bark], conch-shell, lotus-root, and all fragrant <s>śamī</s> [tree] powders.
'May evil be destroyed' — he spreads [the covering] as it is being laid down.
'Evil is obstructed.'

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].22) vi lumpatām agham iti pari cailaṃ dūrśaṃ vilumpati
body.translated_text: 'May evil be torn apart' — he tears around the cloth covering and <s>dūrśa</s> [grass].
The oblation and the spreading to the south — as stated.
With '<s>etad ā roha</s>' [AV 18.3.73], '<s>dadāmi</s>' [AV 18.2.37], the youngest [son] places [the offerings].
With '<s>edaṃ barhir</s>' [AV 18.4.52], the son who is standing arranges [the bones] limb by limb.

body.text: (KauśS_11,6[85].26) <mā te mano [18.2.24]> <yat te aṅgam [18.2.26]> <indro mā [18.3.25]>_<udapūr [18.3.37]> ity āto_anumantrayate
body.translated_text: With '<s>mā te mano</s>' [AV 18.2.24], '<s>yat te aṅgam</s>' [AV 18.2.26], '<s>indro mā</s>' [AV 18.3.25], '<s>udapūr</s>' [AV 18.3.37], from this point he consecrates with <s>mantras</s>.
He scatters grains together with husks.
With '<s>idaṃ kasāmbu</s>' [AV 18.4.37], he shows [the site] to the kinsmen.

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].2) <ye ca jīvā [18.4.57]> <ye te pūrve parāgatā [18.3.72]> iti sarpirmadhubhyāṃ caruṃ pūrayitvā śīrṣadeśe nidadhāti
body.translated_text: With '<s>ye ca jīvā</s>' [AV 18.4.57] and '<s>ye te pūrve parāgatā</s>' [AV 18.3.72], having filled a dish with ghee and honey, he places [it] at the head-region.
With '<s>apūpavān</s>' [AV 18.4.16], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>, he places [offerings] in the directions at the eight designated spots.
The cooking [vessel is placed] in the middle.
With '<s>sahasradhāraṃ śatadhāram</s>' [AV 18.4.36], flooding with water,
with '<s>parṇo rājā</s>' [AV 18.4.53], he covers [the bones] with medium-sized <s>palāśa</s> leaves.
With '<s>ūrjo bhāgo</s>' [AV 18.4.54], with stones.
With '<s>ut te stabhnāmi</s>' [AV 18.3.52], [he places] logs limb by limb.

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].9) niḥśīyatām agham iti niḥśīyamānenāvachādya darbhair avastīrya
body.translated_text: 'May evil be destroyed' — having covered with the covering [material], having spread <s>darbha</s> [grasses],

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].10) <idam id vā u na [18.2.50]>_<upa sarpa [18.3.49]>_<asau hā [18.4.66]> iti cinvanti
body.translated_text: with '<s>idam id vā u na</s>' [AV 18.2.50], '<s>upa sarpa</s>' [AV 18.3.49], '<s>asau hā</s>' [AV 18.4.66], they pile up [the mound].
With '<s>yathā yamāya</s>' [AV 18.4.55], having joined together,

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].12) śṛṇātv agham ity upariśira stambam ādadhāti
body.translated_text: 'May evil be shattered' — on top, at the head, he places a post.
Some prohibit this.

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].14) akalmāṣāṇāṃ kāṇḍānām aṣṭāṅgulīṃ tejanīm antarhitam agham iti grāmadeśād ucchrayati
body.translated_text: Of unblemished stalks, an eight-finger-width torch — 'Evil is hidden' — he raises [it] from the village site.
Sprinkling counter-clockwise, they break the pots.
With '<s>sameta</s>' [AV 7.21.1], at the far corner of the cremation ground, they grasp the fixed [posts].
Behind, to the north of the fire, with '<s>varcasā mām</s>' [AV 18.3.10], '<s>vivasvān</s>' [AV 18.3.61], '<s>indra kratum</s>' [AV 18.3.67] — from this point [he recites].
With '<s>sam indhate</s>' [AV 18.4.41 etc.], behind [the fire], he fans the <s>saṃkasuka</s> (kindling-wood) into flame.
With '<s>asmin vayam</s>' [AV 12.2.13], '<s>yad ripram</s>' [AV 12.2.40], '<s>sīse mṛḍḍhvam</s>' [AV 12.2.19], he causes [them] to wash off.
Having wiped the hands and feet with black wool,
with '<s>ime jīvā</s>' [AV 12.2.22], '<s>udīcīnaiḥ</s>' [AV 12.2.29], as stated in the <s>mantra</s>,

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].22) <triḥ sapta [12.2.29c]>_iti kūdyā padāni lopayitvā [ed. yopayitvā -- corrigenda ed. p. 424] śmaśānāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>triḥ sapta</s>' [AV 12.2.29c], having obliterated the footprints with a <s>kūdī</s> (thorn-bush) from the cremation ground,
with '<s>mṛtyoḥ padam</s>' [AV 12.2.30], with the second [verse], [they board] the boats.
With '<s>paraṃ mṛtyo</s>' [AV 12.2.21], having thrust a <s>kūdī</s> (thorn-bush) to the northeast,
having made seven river-like [channels], having filled [them] with water,

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].26) <ā rohata savitur nāvam etāṃ [12.2.48c]> <sutrāmāṇaṃ [7.6.3]> <mahīm ū ṣu [7.6.2]>_iti sahiraṇyāṃ sayavāṃ nāvam ārohayati
body.translated_text: with '<s>ā rohata savitur nāvam etām</s>' [AV 12.2.48c], '<s>sutrāmāṇam</s>' [AV 7.6.3], '<s>mahīm ū ṣu</s>' [AV 7.6.2], he causes [them] to board a boat with gold and barley.

body.text: (KauśS_11,7[86].27) <aśmanvatī rīyate [12.2.26]>_<ut tiṣṭhatā pra taratā sakhāyo [12.2.27]>_ity udīcas tārayati
body.translated_text: With '<s>aśmanvatī rīyate</s>' [AV 12.2.26], '<s>ut tiṣṭhatā pra taratā sakhāyo</s>' [AV 12.2.27], he ferries [them] northward.
From the pebbles onward, up to the placing of fuel-sticks [the procedure continues].
From the <s>Vaivasvata</s> [section] onward, [the procedure is] the same.
Having reached home, the <s>piṇḍapitṛyajña</s> (rice-ball ancestor sacrifice) is the same.
Now, the <s>piṇḍapitṛyajña</s> (rice-ball ancestor sacrifice).
On the new-moon day, in the evening — 'at the junction of day [and night]' — it is known [from tradition].

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].3) <mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām [18.3.12]> iti pāṇī prakṣālayate
body.translated_text: With '<s>mitrāvaruṇā pari mām adhātām</s>' [AV 18.3.12], he washes the hands.
With '<s>varcasā mām</s>' [AV 18.3.10], he sips (<s>ācamati</s>).

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].5) punaḥ savyenācamanād apasavyaṃ kṛtvā praiṣakṛtaṃ samādiśati
body.translated_text: Again, having sipped with the left [hand], having performed the reversal (<s>apasavya</s>), he directs the preparatory command.

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].6) ulūkhalamusalaṃ śūrpaṃ caruṃ kaṃsaṃ prakṣālaya barhir udakumbham ā hara_iti
body.translated_text: 'Wash the mortar and pestle, the winnowing basket, the cooking vessel, and the bronze cup; bring the sacred grass and the water-pot' — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].7) yajñopavītī dakṣiṇapūrvam antardeśam abhimukhaḥ śūrpa ekapavitrāntarhitān haviṣyān nirvapati
body.translated_text: Wearing the sacred thread (<s>yajñopavīta</s>), facing the southeast direction, on the winnowing basket, he offers the sacrificial grains placed between a single purifier.

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].8) idam <agnaye kavyavāhanāya [18.4.71]> <svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthiviṣadbhyaḥ [18.4.78]>_itīdaṃ <somāya pitṛmate svadhā [18.4.72]> <pitṛbhyaḥ somavadbhyaḥ [18.4.73]> <pitṛbhyo vāntarikṣasadbhyaḥ [18.4.79]>_itīdaṃ <yamāya pitṛmate [18.4.74]> <svadhā pitṛbhyaś ca diviṣadbhyaḥ [18.4.80]>_iti trīn avācīnakāśīn nirvapati
body.translated_text: 'This [is] for <s>Agni</s> <s>Kavyavāhana</s> (carrier of offerings to ancestors)' [AV 18.4.71], '<s>Svadhā</s> to the ancestors who dwell on the earth' [AV 18.4.78] — this [is] for '<s>Soma</s> accompanied by the ancestors, <s>svadhā</s>' [AV 18.4.72], 'to the ancestors who are with <s>Soma</s>' [AV 18.4.73], 'to the ancestors who dwell in the atmosphere' [AV 18.4.79] — this [is] for '<s>Yama</s> accompanied by the ancestors' [AV 18.4.74], '<s>Svadhā</s> to the ancestors who dwell in heaven' [AV 18.4.80] — he offers three [portions] with [the grains spread] facing downward.

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].9) ulūkhala opya trir avahanti_<idaṃ vaḥ pitaro haviḥ>_iti
body.translated_text: Having placed [the grains] in the mortar, they pound three times — 'This is your offering, O ancestors' — thus.
As the oblation, so he performs the service.
For the ancestor sacrifice is indeed the oblation.

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].12) praiṣakṛtaṃ samādiśanti caruṃ prakṣālayādhiśrayāpa opya taṇḍulān āvapasva nekṣaṇena yodhayann āsva mā śiro grahīḥ
body.translated_text: They direct [him] with the command-formula: 'Wash the rice-gruel pot, set it on the fire, pour in water, put in the grain-husks, keep stirring with the ladle, do not take [it] by the head',
They call [this] the 'head-seizing' [prohibition],

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].14) bāhyena_upaniṣkramya yajñopavītī dakṣiṇapūrvam antardeśam abhimukha <ud īratām [18.1.44]> iti karṣūṃ khanati prādeśamātrīṃ tiryagaṅgurim
body.translated_text: Going outside through the outer [entrance], wearing the sacred thread, facing the southeast intermediate quarter, with '<s>ud īratām</s>' [AV 18.1.44], he digs a pit of one span's depth and a finger's breadth crosswise,
With downward-pointing finger, of one joint's depth — say some,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].16) <apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi ye pitṛṣadaḥ [cf. VSM 2.29, ManB 2.3.3]>_iti prāgdakṣiṇaṃ pāṃsūn udūhati
body.translated_text: With '<s>apahatā asurā rakṣāṃsi ye pitṛṣadaḥ</s>' [cf. VSM 2.29, ManB 2.3.3], he sweeps the dust to the east and south,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].17) karṣūṃ ca pāṇī ca prakṣālya_<etad vaḥ pitaraḥ pātram> iti karṣūm udakena pūrayitvā
body.translated_text: Having washed the pit and his hands — '<s>etad vaḥ pitaraḥ pātram</s>' ('This is your vessel, O Fathers') — having filled the pit with water,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].18) antarupātītya mastunā navanītena vā pratinīya dakṣiṇāñcam udvāsya
body.translated_text: Passing inside, having poured in whey or fresh butter, having placed [it] to the south,
Having taken two pieces of firewood, with '<s>uśantas</s>' [AV 18.1.56], he kindles [them],
When they are kindled, he places one back,
With '<s>ihaivaidhi dhanasanir</s>' [AV 18.4.38], having taken one [away],
Having placed [it] in the dust, he lays fuel upon it — '<s>ye nikhātāḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.34], '<s>sam indhate</s>' [AV 18.4.41], '<s>ye tātṛṣur</s>' [AV 18.3.47], '<s>ye satyāso</s>' [AV 18.3.48],
He places the ritual materials nearby,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].24) paryukṣaṇīṃ barhir udakumbhaṃ kaṃsaṃ darvim ājyam āyavanaṃ caruṃ vāsāṃsy āñjanam abhyañjanam iti
body.translated_text: The sprinkling vessel, <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), a water-pot, a bronze cup, a ladle, ghee, a strainer, the rice-gruel, garments, eye-ointment, and body-ointment,
Whatever additional material is to be brought there, having brought that,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].26) ato yajñopavītī pitryupavītī barhir gṛhītvā vicṛtya saṃnahanaṃ dakṣiṇāparam aṣṭamadeśam abhyavāsyet
body.translated_text: Then, [alternating between] wearing the sacred thread on the left (<s>yajñopavītin</s>) and on the right (<s>pitryopavītin</s>), having taken the <s>barhis</s> and spread it, he should place the binding at the southwest eighth-quarter,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].27) barhir udakena saṃprokṣya <barhiṣadaḥ pitara [18.1.51]> <upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ [18.3.45]>_<agniṣvāttāḥ pitaro [18.3.44]> <ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro [18.3.46]> <ye 'smākaṃ [18.4.68]>_iti prastṛṇāti
body.translated_text: Having sprinkled the <s>barhis</s> with water — '<s>barhiṣadaḥ pitara</s>' [AV 18.1.51], '<s>upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ</s>' [AV 18.3.45], '<s>agniṣvāttāḥ pitaro</s>' [AV 18.3.44], '<s>ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro</s>' [AV 18.3.46], '<s>ye 'smākaṃ</s>' [AV 18.4.68] — he strews [the sacred grass],
The three [verses] beginning with the invocation,
With '<s>ud īratām</s>' [AV 18.1.44], with three [verses] he should pour the water-vessels, one verse for each,

body.text: (KauśS_11,8[87].30) ataḥ pitryupavītī yajñopavītī <ye dasyavaḥ [18.2.28]>_ity ubhayata ādīptam ulmukaṃ triḥ prasavyaṃ parihṛtya nirasyati
body.translated_text: Then, [wearing the thread alternately] on the right and on the left — with '<s>ye dasyavaḥ</s>' [AV 18.2.28], having carried a firebrand lit at both ends three times counter-clockwise, he casts it away,
Having sprinkled around,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].1) <ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānā asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti | tvaṃ tān agne apa sedha dūrān satyāḥ naḥ pitṝṇāṃ santv āśiṣaḥ svahā svadhā [-, cf. VS 2.20, ManB 2.3.4]>_iti hutvā kumbhīpākam abhighārayati
body.translated_text: '<s>ye rūpāṇi pratimuñcamānā asurāḥ santaḥ svadhayā caranti | tvaṃ tān agne apa sedha dūrān satyāḥ naḥ pitṝṇāṃ santv āśiṣaḥ svāhā svadhā</s>' — 'Those who, assuming forms, though being <s>Asuras</s>, roam about with <s>svadhā</s> — O <s>Agni</s>, drive them far away; may the blessings of our Fathers be true, <s>svāhā</s>, <s>svadhā</s>' [cf. VS 2.20, ManB 2.3.4] — having offered, he pours ghee over the pot-cooked [offering],
With '<s>agnaye kavyavāhanāya</s>' [AV 18.4.71], he offers,
The second [offering] as prescribed,
With '<s>yamāya pitṛmate</s>' [AV 18.4.74], '<s>svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ</s>' [AV 18.4.78], the third [offering],
With '<s>yad vo agnir</s>' [AV 18.4.64], the grain-husks with the strainer,
With '<s>saṃ barhir</s>' [AV 7.98.1], having sprinkled the grain-husks together with <s>darbha</s> grass,
Then, [wearing the thread alternately] on the left and on the right, he lifts [the offering] with the ladle,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].8) dyaur darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā sā yathā dyaur darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā_evā [read _evaṃ? ;Srautakośa I Eng. I p. 488] pratatāmahasya_iyaṃ darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā
body.translated_text: Heaven is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden; just as heaven is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden — so is this ladle of the great-grandfather imperishable, unlimited, untrodden,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].9) antarikṣaṃ darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā sā yathāntarikṣam darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā_evā [read _evaṃ? ;Srautakośa I Eng. I p. 488] tatāmahasya_iyaṃ darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā
body.translated_text: The atmosphere is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden; just as the atmosphere is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden — so is this ladle of the grandfather imperishable, unlimited, untrodden,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].10) pṛthivī darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā sā yathā pṛthivī darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā_evā [read _evaṃ? ;Srautakośa I Eng. I p. 488] tatasya_iyaṃ darvir akṣitāparimitānupadastā_iti
body.translated_text: The earth is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden; just as the earth is the ladle — imperishable, unlimited, untrodden — so is this ladle of the father imperishable, unlimited, untrodden,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].11) uddhṛtyājyena saṃnīya trīn piṇḍān saṃhatān nidadhāti_<etat te pratatāmaha [18.4.75]>_iti
body.translated_text: Having lifted [the offering] and mixed it with ghee, he places three <s>piṇḍas</s> (rice-balls) joined together — '<s>etat te pratatāmaha</s>' [AV 18.4.75] ('This is for you, O great-grandfather'),
To the south, for the wives [of the ancestors] — '<s>idaṃ vaḥ patnyaḥ</s>' ('This is for you, O wives'),

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].13) idam āśaṃsūnām idam āśaṃsamānānāṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ prakīrṇāvaśīrṇānāṃ <yeṣāṃ vayaṃ dātāro ye cāsmākam upajīvanti | tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyaḥ svadhāvad akṣayyam astu [-]>_iti triḥ prasavyaṃ taṇḍulaiḥ parikirati
body.translated_text: 'This is for those who hope, this is for those hoping women and men who have scattered and fallen away — <s>yeṣāṃ vayaṃ dātāro ye cāsmākam upajīvanti | tebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ sapatnīkebhyaḥ svadhāvad akṣayyam astu</s>' — 'For all those whom we support and who depend on us, for all of them together with their wives, may it be imperishable, endowed with <s>svadhā</s>'' — three times counter-clockwise, he scatters grain-husks,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].14) piñjūlīr āñjanaṃ sarpiṣi paryasya_<addhvaṃ pitaraḥ>_iti nyasyati
body.translated_text: Having mixed broom-sticks and ointment with ghee — '<s>addhvaṃ pitaraḥ</s>' ('Eat, O Fathers') — he places [them],

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].15) <vaddhvaṃ pitaro mā vo 'to 'nyat pitaro yoyuvata [-]>_iti sūtrāṇi
body.translated_text: '<s>vaddhvaṃ pitaro mā vo 'to 'nyat pitaro yoyuvata</s>' — 'Clothe yourselves, O Fathers; may nothing else separate you, O Fathers, from this' — [he gives] threads,
With '<s>añjate vy añjate</s>' [AV 18.3.18], the body-ointment,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].17) ājyenāvichinnaṃ piṇḍān abhighārayati <ye ca jīvā [18.4.57]> <ye te pūrve parāgatā [18.3.72]> iti
body.translated_text: He pours ghee continuously over the <s>piṇḍas</s> — '<s>ye ca jīvā</s>' [AV 18.4.57], '<s>ye te pūrve parāgatā</s>' [AV 18.3.72],
