body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].18) <atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyadhvam [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.6 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: '<s>atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyadhvam</s>' — 'Here, O Fathers, rejoice; according to your share, according to your world, refresh yourselves' [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.6],

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].19) <atra patnyo mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyadhvam [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.6 etc.]> iti
body.translated_text: '<s>atra patnyo mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyadhvam</s>' — 'Here, O wives, rejoice; according to your share, according to your world, refresh yourselves' [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.6],

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].20) yo_asau_antaragnir bhavati taṃ pradakṣiṇam avekṣya tisras tāmīs tāmyati
body.translated_text: Looking clockwise at the fire that is between [the offerings], he holds his breath three times,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].21) pratiparyāvṛtya_<amīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyiṣata [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.7 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: Turning back again — '<s>amīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyiṣata</s>' — 'The Fathers have rejoiced; according to their share, according to their world, they have refreshed themselves' [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.7],

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].22) <amīmadanta patnyo yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyiṣata [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.7 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>amīmadanta patnyo yathābhāgaṃ yathālokam āvṛṣāyiṣata</s>' — 'The wives have rejoiced; according to their share, according to their world, they have refreshed themselves' [cf. VSM 2.31, ManB 2.3.7],
With '<s>āpo agniṃ</s>' [AV 18.4.40], he extinguishes the fire with water,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].24) <putraṃ pautram abhitarpayantīr [18.4.39]> ity <ācāmata mama pratatāmahās tatāmahās tatāḥ sapatnīkās tṛpyantv ācāmantu [-]>_iti prasavyaṃ pariṣicya
body.translated_text: With '<s>putraṃ pautram abhitarpayantīr</s>' [AV 18.4.39] — '<s>ācāmata mama pratatāmahās tatāmahās tatāḥ sapatnīkās tṛpyantv ācāmantu</s>' — 'Sip, [O waters]; may my great-grandfathers, grandfathers, fathers, together with their wives, be satisfied; may they sip' — he pours [water] counter-clockwise around,

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].25) <vīrān me pratatāmahā datta vīrān me tatāmahā datta vīrān me pitaro datta> pitṝn vīrān yācati
body.translated_text: '<s>vīrān me pratatāmahā datta vīrān me tatāmahā datta vīrān me pitaro datta</s>' — 'Give me heroes, O great-grandfathers; give me heroes, O grandfathers; give me heroes, O fathers' — he asks the Fathers for heroes,
With '<s>namo vaḥ pitara</s>' [AV 18.4.81ff.], he pays homage,
With '<s>akṣann</s>' [AV 18.4.61], having shaken off the leavings-vessel,
With '<s>parā yāta</s>' [AV 18.4.63], he dismisses [the Fathers],

body.text: (KauśS_11,9[88].29) ataḥ pitryupavītī yajñopavītī <yan na idaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha mano 'bhūt tad upāhvayāmi [-]>_iti mana upāhvayati
body.translated_text: Then, [wearing the thread alternately] on the right and on the left — '<s>yan na idaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha mano 'bhūt tad upāhvayāmi</s>' — 'That mind of ours which was with the Fathers, that I call back' — he calls back the mind,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].1) <mano nv ā hvāmahe nārāśaṃsena [corr. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. nāra-] stomena | pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ || ā na etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase | jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe || punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo [ed. daivyaḥ] janaḥ | jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi || vayaṃ soma vrate tava manas tanūṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi [PS 19.24.10-13, VaitS 20.9]> || <ye sajātāḥ sumanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣā;m śrīr mayi kalpatām asmin goṣṭhe śata;m samāḥ [VSM 19.46 etc.]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>mano nv ā hvāmahe nārāśaṃsena stomena | pitṝṇāṃ ca manmabhiḥ</s>' || '<s>ā na etu manaḥ punaḥ kratve dakṣāya jīvase | jyok ca sūryaṃ dṛśe</s>' || '<s>punar naḥ pitaro mano dadātu daivyo janaḥ | jīvaṃ vrātaṃ sacemahi</s>' || '<s>vayaṃ soma vrate tava manas tanūṣu bibhrataḥ prajāvantaḥ sacemahi</s>' [PS 19.24.10-13] || '<s>ye sajātāḥ sumanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣāṃ śrīr mayi kalpatām asmin goṣṭhe śataṃ samāḥ</s>' [VSM 19.46] — 'We call back the mind with the <s>Nārāśaṃsa</s> hymn and with the thoughts of the Fathers' || 'May our mind return to us for wisdom, for skill, for living, and for long seeing the sun' || 'May the Fathers and the divine folk give back our mind to us; may we join the company of the living' || 'O <s>Soma</s>, in your observance, bearing the mind in our bodies, may we, rich in offspring, be united' || 'Those kinsmen of mine who are well-minded, living among the living — may their prosperity be mine, in this homestead for a hundred years',

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].2) yat_carusthālyām odanāvaśiṣṭaṃ bhavati tasya_ūṣmabhakṣaṃ bhakṣayitvā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt
body.translated_text: Whatever rice remains in the gruel-pot — having eaten the steam-portion of it, he should give [the rest] to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s>,
If a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> is not obtainable, he should cast it into water,
To one's own servant — say some,
He gives the middle <s>piṇḍa</s> to a wife desiring a son,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].6) <ā dhatta pitaro garbhaṃ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam | yatheha puruṣo 'sat || [VSM 2.33 etc.]> <ā tvārukṣad vṛṣabhaḥ pṛśnir agriyo medhāvinaṃ pitaro garbham ā dadhuḥ | ā tvāyaṃ puruṣo gamet puruṣaḥ puruṣād adhi | sa te śraiṣṭhyāya jāyatāṃ sa some sāma gāyatu [-, cf. .RV 9.83.3]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>ā dhatta pitaro garbhaṃ kumāraṃ puṣkarasrajam | yatheha puruṣo 'sat</s>' [VSM 2.33] — 'Place in her, O Fathers, an embryo, a boy with a lotus-garland, so that here a man may be born' || '<s>ā tvārukṣad vṛṣabhaḥ pṛśnir agriyo medhāvinaṃ pitaro garbham ā dadhuḥ | ā tvāyaṃ puruṣo gamet puruṣaḥ puruṣād adhi | sa te śraiṣṭhyāya jāyatāṃ sa some sāma gāyatu</s>' [cf. RV 9.83.3] — 'The foremost dappled bull has mounted you; the Fathers have placed a wise embryo [in you]; may this man come to you, man from man; may he be born for your excellence, may he sing the <s>Sāman</s> at the <s>Soma</s>-pressing',
If there is another, a second [wife], [he gives] the other [piṇḍa] to her,
The foremost [piṇḍa goes] to a learned <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (<s>śrotriya</s>),

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].9) atha yasya bhāryā dāsī vā pradrāviṇī bhavati ye_amī taṇḍulāḥ prasavyaṃ parikīrṇā bhavanti tān_tasyai prayachati
body.translated_text: Now, for one whose wife or female servant is running away — those grain-husks which have been scattered counter-clockwise, those he gives to her,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].10) <arvācy +upasaṃkrāma [ed. upasaṃkrame] mā parācy apa vartathāḥ [ed. upa vastathā] | annaṃ prāṇasya bandhanaṃ tena badhnāmi tvā mayi [-, emendations Caland, Ahnencult p. 192, cf. ManB 1.3.10]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>arvācy upasaṃkrāma mā parācy apa vartathāḥ | annaṃ prāṇasya bandhanaṃ tena badhnāmi tvā mayi</s>' — 'Come hither, do not turn away; food is the bond of life — with that I bind you to me' [cf. ManB 1.3.10],

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].11) paryukṣaṇīṃ samidhaś cādāya <mā pra gāma [13.1.59]>_ity āvrajya_<ūrjaṃ bibhrad [7.60.1]> iti gṛhān upatiṣṭhate
body.translated_text: Having taken the sprinkling vessel and fuel-sticks, with '<s>mā pra gāma</s>' [AV 13.1.59], having returned — with '<s>ūrjaṃ bibhrad</s>' [AV 7.60.1], he pays homage to the house,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].12) <ramadhvaṃ mā bibhītanāsmin goṣṭhe karīṣiṇaḥ | ūrjaṃ duhānāḥ śucayaḥ śucivratā gṛhā jīvanta upa vaḥ sadema || ūrjaṃ me devā adadur ūrjaṃ manuṣyā uta | ūrjaṃ pitṛbhya āhārṣam ūrjasvanto gṛhā mama || payo me devā adaduḥ payo manuṣyā uta | payaḥ pitṛbhya āhārṣaṃ payasvanto gṛhā mama || [PS 18.82.3-5]> <vīryaṃ me devā adaduḥ vīryaṃ manuṣyā uta | vīryaṃ pitṛbhya āhārṣaṃ vīravanto gṛhā mama || [-, cf. PS 18.82.4-5]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>ramadhvaṃ mā bibhītanāsmin goṣṭhe karīṣiṇaḥ | ūrjaṃ duhānāḥ śucayaḥ śucivratā gṛhā jīvanta upa vaḥ sadema</s>' || '<s>ūrjaṃ me devā adadur ūrjaṃ manuṣyā uta | ūrjaṃ pitṛbhya āhārṣam ūrjasvanto gṛhā mama</s>' || '<s>payo me devā adaduḥ payo manuṣyā uta | payaḥ pitṛbhya āhārṣaṃ payasvanto gṛhā mama</s>' [PS 18.82.3-5] || '<s>vīryaṃ me devā adaduḥ vīryaṃ manuṣyā uta | vīryaṃ pitṛbhya āhārṣaṃ vīravanto gṛhā mama</s>' [cf. PS 18.82.4-5] — 'Be content, fear not, O dung-rich [cattle] in this homestead; yielding nourishment, pure, of pure observance — may we, living, sit near you, O houses' || 'The gods gave me nourishment, and humans too; nourishment I brought to the Fathers — full of nourishment is my house' || 'The gods gave me milk, and humans too; milk I brought to the Fathers — full of milk is my house' || 'The gods gave me valor, and humans too; valor I brought to the Fathers — full of heroes is my house',

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].13) antarupātītya samidho 'bhyādadhāti | <ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo 'yaṃ no vasuvittamaḥ | asyopasadye mā riṣāmāyaṃ rakṣatu naḥ prajām || asmin sahasraṃ puṣyāsmaidhamānāḥ sve gṛhe | imaṃ sam indhiṣīmahy āyuṣmantaḥ suvarcasaḥ || [PS 20.61.5-6]> <tvam agna īḍito [18.3.42]>_<ā tvāgna indhīmahi [18.4.88]>_iti
body.translated_text: Passing inside, he lays fuel-sticks [on the fire]: '<s>ayaṃ no agnir adhyakṣo 'yaṃ no vasuvittamaḥ | asyopasadye mā riṣāmāyaṃ rakṣatu naḥ prajām</s>' || '<s>asmin sahasraṃ puṣyāsmaidhamānāḥ sve gṛhe | imaṃ sam indhiṣīmahy āyuṣmantaḥ suvarcasaḥ</s>' [PS 20.61.5-6] — 'This <s>Agni</s> is our overseer, this one is the best finder of wealth; in his service may we not come to harm, may he protect our offspring' || 'In this [fire] may we prosper a thousandfold, kindling [it] in our own house; may we, long-lived and radiant, kindle this [fire]' — '<s>tvam agna īḍito</s>' [AV 18.3.42], '<s>ā tvāgna indhīmahi</s>' [AV 18.4.88],
With '<s>abhūd dūtaḥ</s>' [AV 18.4.65], he brings back the fire,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].15) yadi sarvaḥ praṇītaḥ syād dakṣiṇāgnau tu_etad āhitāgneḥ
body.translated_text: If [the fire] has been entirely carried forth, [this rite is performed] on the southern fire — this [applies] to one who has established the [three] fires,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].16) gṛhye +'pi_anāhitāgneḥ [ed. gṛhyeṣv, cf. Caland Ahnencult p. 15]
body.translated_text: On the domestic fire also, for one who has not established [the three] fires,

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].17) <idaṃ cin me kṛtam astīdaṃ cic chaknavāni | pitaraś cin mā vedan [-]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>idaṃ cin me kṛtam astīdaṃ cic chaknavāni | pitaraś cin mā vedan</s>' — 'This much I have accomplished, and this much I am able to do; may the Fathers acknowledge me',

body.text: (KauśS_11,10[89].18) yo ha yajate taṃ devā vidur yo dadāti taṃ manuṣyā yaḥ śrāddhāni kurute taṃ pitaras taṃ pitaraḥ
body.translated_text: He who sacrifices — the gods know him; he who gives — humans [know him]; he who performs <s>śrāddhas</s> (ancestral offerings) — the Fathers [know] him, the Fathers [know him],

body.text: (KauśS 11 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre ekādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the eleventh chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_12,1[90].1) When about to have the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) brought, he has <s>darbha</s> (sacred grass) brought.
(KauśS_12,1[90].2) Then he has <s>viṣṭaras</s> (grass seats) made.

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].3) sa khalu_ekaśākham eva prathamaṃ pādyaṃ dviśākham āsanaṃ triśākhaṃ madhuparkāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].3) He indeed [makes] first a single-branched one for the <s>pādya</s> (foot-washing water), a two-branched one for the <s>āsana</s> (seat), and a three-branched one for the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture).

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].4) sa yāvato manyeta tāvata upādāya vivicya saṃparyāpya mūlāni ca prāntāni ca yathāvistīrṇa iva syād ity upotkṛṣya madhyadeśe_abhisaṃnahyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].4) He, having taken up as many [grass blades] as he thinks [sufficient], separating them, arranging them fully, and trimming both roots and tips so that it would be as if spread out evenly, ties [them] together at the middle portion.

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].5) <ṛtena tvā satyena tvā tapasā tvā karmaṇā tvā>_iti saṃnahyati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].5) He ties [them] with <ṛtena tvā satyena tvā tapasā tvā karmaṇā tvā> ("With order you, with truth you, with austerity you, with ritual action you").

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].6) atha ha sṛjati_<atisṛṣṭo dveṣṭā yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].6) Then indeed he releases [the excess blades]: <atisṛṣṭo dveṣṭā yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ> ("Cast off is the hater — he who hates us and whom we hate").

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].7) asya ca dātur iti dātāram īkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].7) "And of this giver" — thus he looks at the giver.
(KauśS_12,1[90].8) Then he has water brought: "<s>pādya</s> (foot-washing water), sir!"

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].9) hiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pratimantrya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ prathamaṃ prakarṣati | mayi brahma ca tapaś ca dhārayāṇīti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].9) Having recited the counter-mantra with the <s>hiraṇyavarṇā</s> verses, he extends the right foot first: "May I bear <s>brahman</s> (sacred knowledge) and <s>tapas</s> (austerity) in myself."

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].10) dakṣiṇe prakṣālite savyaṃ prakarṣati | mayi kṣatraṃ ca viśas ca dhārayāṇīti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].10) When the right [foot] has been washed, he extends the left: "May I bear <s>kṣatra</s> (ruling power) and <s>viś</s> (the people) in myself."

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].11) prakṣālitau_anumantrayate | <imau pādāv avaniktau brāhmaṇaṃ yaśasāvatām | āpaḥ pādāvanejanīr dviṣantaṃ nir dahantu me [-, cf. AitB 8.27]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].11) When both have been washed, he recites the blessing: <imau pādāv avaniktau brāhmaṇaṃ yaśasāvatām | āpaḥ pādāvanejanīr dviṣantaṃ nir dahantu me [-, cf. AitB 8.27]>

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].12) asya ca dātur iti dātāram īkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].12) "And of this giver" — thus he looks at the giver.

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].13) athāsanam āhārayati | saviṣṭaram āsanam bho iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].13) Then he has a seat brought: "A seat with a <s>viṣṭara</s> (grass mat), sir!"
(KauśS_12,1[90].14) On that [seat] he sits down facing west.

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].15) <vimṛgvarīṃ pṛthivīm [12.1.29]> ity etayā viṣṭare pādau pratiṣṭhāpya_<adhiṣṭhito dveṣṭā yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].15) With <vimṛgvarīṃ pṛthivīm [12.1.29]>, having placed his feet on the <s>viṣṭara</s> (grass seat) with this [verse]: <adhiṣṭhito dveṣṭā yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ> ("Trampled upon is the hater — he who hates us and whom we hate").

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].16) asya ca dātur iti dātāram īkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].16) "And of this giver" — thus he looks at the giver.
(KauśS_12,1[90].17) Then he has water brought: "<s>arghya</s> (honorific water), sir!"

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].18) tat pratimantrayate | <annānāṃ mukham asi mukham ahaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhūyāsam | āpo 'mṛtaṃ sthāmṛtaṃ mā kṛṇuta dāsāsmākaṃ bahavo bhavanty aśvāvad goman mayy astu puṣṭoṃ (ed. puṣṭam oṃ; cf. Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 45, n. 1) bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].18) He recites the counter-mantra over it: <annānāṃ mukham asi mukham ahaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhūyāsam | āpo 'mṛtaṃ sthāmṛtaṃ mā kṛṇuta dāsāsmākaṃ bahavo bhavanty aśvāvad goman mayy astu puṣṭoṃ (ed. puṣṭam oṃ; cf. Caland, Kl. Schr., p. 45, n. 1) bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om> — thus.
(KauśS_12,1[90].19) Silently he directs [the water] inward toward himself.
(KauśS_12,1[90].20) With <tejo 'sy amṛtam asi> ("You are radiance, you are immortality") he touches his forehead.
(KauśS_12,1[90].21) Then he has water brought: "<s>ācamanīya</s> (sipping water), sir!"
(KauśS_12,1[90].22) He sips with the <s>jīvā</s> verses.

body.text: (KauśS_12,1[90].23) athāsmai madhuparkaṃ vedayante dvyanucaro madhuparko bho iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,1[90].23) Then they announce the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-mixture) to him, with two attendants: "The <s>madhuparka</s>, sir!"
(KauśS_12,1[90].24) With two branches [of grass] beneath, one on top, together with a lid.
(KauśS_12,1[90].25) With <madhu vātā ṛtāyate [PS 19.45.5]> — with these [verses] is the consecration.
(KauśS_12,1[90].26) Likewise the counter-recitation.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].1) <madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ || madhu naktam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ || madhumān no vanaspatir madhumā;m astu sūryaḥ | madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā || [PS 19.45.5-7]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].1) <madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ | mādhvīr gāvo bhavantu naḥ || madhu naktam utoṣaso madhumat pārthivaṃ rajaḥ | mādhvīr naḥ santv oṣadhīḥ || madhumān no vanaspatir madhumā;m astu sūryaḥ | madhu dyaur astu naḥ pitā || [PS 19.45.5-7]>

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].2) tat <sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣe [PS 20.57.11, VaitS 3.8, GB 2.1.2, etc.]> iti pratīkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].2) He looks at it with <sūryasya tvā cakṣuṣā pratīkṣe [PS 20.57.11, VaitS 3.8, GB 2.1.2, etc.]> ("I behold you with the eye of <s>Sūrya</s>").

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].3) <ayuto 'ham [19.51.1]> <devasya tvā savituḥ [19.51.2]>_iti pratigṛhya puromukhaṃ prāgdaṇḍaṃ nidadhāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].3) Having received it with <ayuto 'ham [19.51.1]> <devasya tvā savituḥ [19.51.2]>, he places [the vessel] eastward, with the handle pointing east.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].4) <pṛthivyās tvā nābhau sādayāmy adityā upasthe [VaitS 3.10, etc.]>_iti bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].4) Having set it on the ground with <pṛthivyās tvā nābhau sādayāmy adityā upasthe [VaitS 3.10, etc.]> ("I seat you at the navel of the earth, in the lap of <s>Aditi</s>"),

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].5) dvābhyām aṅgulibhyāṃ pradakṣiṇam ācālyānāmikayāṅgulyāṅguṣṭhena ca saṃgṛhya prāśnāti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].5) stirring clockwise with two fingers, grasping with the ring finger and thumb, he eats.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].6) <oṃ bhūs tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhūḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10a e.a.]>_iti prathamam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].6) The first [portion he eats] with <oṃ bhūs tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhūḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10a e.a.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].7) <bhargo devasya dhīmahi bhuvaḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10b e.a.]>_iti dvitīyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].7) The second with <bhargo devasya dhīmahi bhuvaḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10b e.a.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].8) <dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt svaḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10c e.a.]>_iti tṛtīyam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].8) The third with <dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt svaḥ svāhā [.RV 3.62.10c e.a.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].9) <vayaṃ devasya dhīmahi janat svāhā [.RV 3.62.10d e.a.]>_iti caturtham
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].9) The fourth with <vayaṃ devasya dhīmahi janat svāhā [.RV 3.62.10d e.a.]>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].10) <turaṃ devasya bhojanaṃ vṛdhat svāhā [-, cf. .RV 5.82.1]>_iti pañcamam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].10) The fifth with <turaṃ devasya bhojanaṃ vṛdhat svāhā [-, cf. .RV 5.82.1]>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].11) The sixth with <karat svāhā>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].12) The seventh with <ruhat svāhā>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].13) The eighth with <mahat svāhā>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].14) The ninth with <tat svāhā>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].15) The tenth with <śaṃ svāhā>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].16) The eleventh with <om>.
(KauśS_12,2[91].17) The twelfth silently.

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].18) tasya bhūyomātram iva bhuktvā brāhmaṇāya śrotriyāya prayachet
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].18) Having eaten just the greater portion of it, he should give [the remainder] to a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who is a <s>śrotriya</s> (learned in the Vedas).
(KauśS_12,2[91].19) If no <s>śrotriya</s> (learned brāhmaṇa) is available, he should give it to a <s>vṛṣala</s> (low-caste person).

body.text: (KauśS_12,2[91].20) athāpy ayaṃ nigamo bhavati | <somam etat pibati yat kiṃ cāśnīta brāhmaṇāḥ | mābrāhmaṇāyocchiṣṭaṃ +dāt [em. Falk, m.c.; ed./Lāṭy;SS dāta] mā somaṃ pātv asomapaḥ [cf. Lāṭy;SS 2.12.17]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,2[91].20) And moreover, this scriptural verse is [cited]: <somam etat pibati yat kiṃ cāśnīta brāhmaṇāḥ | mābrāhmaṇāyocchiṣṭaṃ +dāt [em. Falk, m.c.; ed./Lāṭy;SS dāta] mā somaṃ pātv asomapaḥ [cf. Lāṭy;SS 2.12.17]> — thus.
(KauśS_12,3[92].1) Curds and honey — [this is] the <s>brāhma</s> (pertaining to <s>Brahmā</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].2) Milk-rice — [this is] the <s>aindra</s> (pertaining to <s>Indra</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].3) Honey and ghee — [this is] the <s>saumya</s> (pertaining to <s>Soma</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].4) Barley-drink and ghee — [this is] the <s>pauṣṇa</s> (pertaining to <s>Pūṣan</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].5) Milk and ghee — [this is] the <s>sārasvata</s> (pertaining to <s>Sarasvatī</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].6) Liquor and ghee — [this is] the <s>mausala</s> (pertaining to the pestle [rite]) <s>madhuparka</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].7) sa khalu_eṣa dvaye bhavati sautrāmaṇyāṃ ca rājasūye ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].7) This indeed occurs in two [rituals]: in the <s>Sautrāmaṇī</s> and in the <s>Rājasūya</s> (royal consecration).
(KauśS_12,3[92].8) Water and ghee — [this is] the <s>vāruṇa</s> (pertaining to <s>Varuṇa</s>) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].9) Sesame oil and ghee — [this is] the <s>śrāvaṇa</s> (pertaining to the <s>Śrāvaṇa</s> [rite]) <s>madhuparka</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].10) tailaś ca piṇḍaś ca pārivrājako madhuparkaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].10) Sesame oil and a lump [of food] — [this is] the <s>pārivrājaka</s> (pertaining to wandering ascetics) <s>madhuparka</s>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].11) Thus indeed this <s>madhuparka</s> is of nine kinds.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].12) athāsmai gāṃ vedayante gaur bho iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].12) Then they announce a cow to him: "A cow, sir!"

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].13) tān pratimantrayate | <bhūtam asi bhavad asy annaṃ prāṇo bahur bhava | jyeṣṭhaṃ yan nāma nāmata oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om [-]> iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].13) He recites the counter-mantra over them: <bhūtam asi bhavad asy annaṃ prāṇo bahur bhava | jyeṣṭhaṃ yan nāma nāmata oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svar janad om [-]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].14) atisṛjati | <mātādityānāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasā rudrāṇām amṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra ṇo vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gām anāgām aditiṃ vadhiṣṭa || [cf. .RV 8.101.15]> oṃ tṛṇāni gaur attv iti āha
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].14) He releases [the cow]: <mātādityānāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasā rudrāṇām amṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra ṇo vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gām anāgām aditiṃ vadhiṣṭa || [cf. .RV 8.101.15]> — "<s>Om</s>, let the cow eat grass" — thus he says.
(KauśS_12,3[92].15) He blesses [the cow] as she departs with <sūyavasād [7.73.11]>.
(KauśS_12,3[92].16) The <s>madhuparka</s> should not be without blood [i.e., should include an animal offering].
(KauśS_12,3[92].17) "We do not study permission" — one should say just "Do it."
(KauśS_12,3[92].18) He hands over the knife with <svadhite mainaṃ hiṃsīḥ [VSM 6.15, ManB 1.6.6]> ("O axe, do not harm it").
(KauśS_12,3[92].19) "Remove my sin" — thus he blesses the one who performs [the slaughter].
(KauśS_12,3[92].20) They should prepare the <s>vapā</s> (omentum) as an offering to <s>Agni</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].21) api vā brāhmaṇa eva prāśnīyāt tad devataṃ hi tad dhavir bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].21) Or else the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> himself may eat it, for that <s>havis</s> (oblation) belongs to that deity.
(KauśS_12,3[92].22) Then [they offer] him bathing, anointing, a garland, and oil — thus.
(KauśS_12,3[92].23) Whatever additional provisions are to be brought together here, having gathered those,

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].24) atha_upāsakāḥ prāya_upāsakāḥ smo bho iti vedayante
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].24) then the attendants announce: "We are attendants, ready attendants, sir!"

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].25) tān pratimantrayate | <bhūyāṃso bhūyāsma ye ca no bhūyasaḥ kārṣṭāpi ca no 'nye bhūyāṃso jāyantām>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].25) He recites the counter-mantra over them: <bhūyāṃso bhūyāsma ye ca no bhūyasaḥ kārṣṭāpi ca no 'nye bhūyāṃso jāyantām>

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].26) asya ca dātur iti dātāram īkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].26) "And of this giver" — thus he looks at the giver.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].27) athānnāhārāḥ prāpyānnāhārāḥ smo bho iti vedayante
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].27) Then the food-bringers announce: "We are food-bringers, ready food-bringers, sir!"

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].28) tān pratimantrayate | <annādā bhūyāsma ye ca no 'nādān kārṣṭāpi ca no 'nye 'nnādā bhūyāṃso jāyantām>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].28) He recites the counter-mantra over them: <annādā bhūyāsma ye ca no 'nādān kārṣṭāpi ca no 'nye 'nnādā bhūyāṃso jāyantām>

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].29) asya ca dātur iti dātāram īkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].29) "And of this giver" — thus he looks at the giver.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].30) āhṛte_anne juhoti <yat kāma kāmayamānā [19.52.1, sakala follows thus PS 1.30.5]> ity etayā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].30) When the food has been brought, he makes an oblation with <yat kāma kāmayamānā [19.52.1, sakala follows thus PS 1.30.5]>, with this [verse].

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].31) <yat kāma kāmayamānā idaṃ kṛṇmasi te haviḥ | tan naḥ sarvaṃ sam ṛdhyatām athaitasya haviṣo vīhi svāhā [19.52.1, sakala thus PS 1.30.5]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].31) <yat kāma kāmayamānā idaṃ kṛṇmasi te haviḥ | tan naḥ sarvaṃ sam ṛdhyatām athaitasya haviṣo vīhi svāhā [19.52.1, sakala thus PS 1.30.5]> — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_12,3[92].32) eṣa ācāryakalpa eṣa ṛtvikkalpa eṣa saṃyuktakalpa eṣa vivāhakalpa eṣo_atithikalpa eṣo 'tithikalpaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_12,3[92].32) This is the <s>ācāryakalpa</s> (procedure for the teacher), this is the <s>ṛtvikkalpa</s> (procedure for the priest), this is the <s>saṃyuktakalpa</s> (procedure for allied relations), this is the <s>vivāhakalpa</s> (procedure for marriage), this is the <s>atithikalpa</s> (procedure for guest reception), this is the <s>atithikalpa</s> (procedure for guest reception).

body.text: (KauśS 12 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre dvādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS 12 Colophon) Thus ends the twelfth <s>adhyāya</s> (chapter) of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
(KauśS_13,1[93].1) Now [the rites for] <s>adbhuta</s> (portents).
(KauśS_13,1[93].2) [When there is portentous] rain,
(KauśS_13,1[93].3) [when there are portentous appearances of] <s>yakṣas</s>,
(KauśS_13,1[93].4) [when there is] the face of a jackal [howling as an omen],
(KauśS_13,1[93].5) [when] a family is quarrelsome,
(KauśS_13,1[93].6) [when there is] an earthquake,
(KauśS_13,1[93].7) [when there is] an eclipse of the sun,
(KauśS_13,1[93].8) and of the moon,
(KauśS_13,1[93].9) [when] the dawn does not rise,
(KauśS_13,1[93].10) [when] the year is harsh,
(KauśS_13,1[93].11) [when there is] fear of meteors,
(KauśS_13,1[93].12) [when] <s>brāhmaṇas</s> are bearing weapons,
(KauśS_13,1[93].13) [when] divine images dance, drip, laugh, [or] sing,
(KauśS_13,1[93].14) [when there is] the crossing of two ploughs,
(KauśS_13,1[93].15) and of two ropes or two stretched cords,
(KauśS_13,1[93].16) [when there is] the mixing of fires,
(KauśS_13,1[93].17) [when] the sacrificial offering has twin calves,
(KauśS_13,1[93].18) [when] a mare and a donkey [produce offspring with] a human [form],
(KauśS_13,1[93].19) [when] cows yield blood [instead of milk],
(KauśS_13,1[93].20) [when] an ox suckles a cow,
(KauśS_13,1[93].21) [when] a cow suckles [another] cow,
(KauśS_13,1[93].22) [when there is] foam in the sky,
(KauśS_13,1[93].23) [when there is] unusual behavior of ants,
(KauśS_13,1[93].24) [when there is] unusual behavior of blue flies,
(KauśS_13,1[93].25) [when there is] unusual behavior of honey-bees,
(KauśS_13,1[93].26) [when something is] unrecognized [appears],
(KauśS_13,1[93].27) [when something is] split open [as a portent],
(KauśS_13,1[93].28) [when] water springs up in a waterless [place],
(KauśS_13,1[93].29) [when] sesame seeds [appear] mixed with oil,
(KauśS_13,1[93].30) [when] the sacrificial offerings are contaminated,
(KauśS_13,1[93].31) [when there are] counter-clockwise whirlpools,
(KauśS_13,1[93].32) [when] the sacrificial post sprouts,
(KauśS_13,1[93].33) [when there is] a meteor,
(KauśS_13,1[93].34) [when] a comet obscures the Seven Sages [constellation of Ursa Major],
(KauśS_13,1[93].35) [when] stars keep falling,
(KauśS_13,1[93].36) [when] a piece of flesh falls [from the sky] face-down,
(KauśS_13,1[93].37) [when there is] a glow without fire,
(KauśS_13,1[93].38) [when] the fire breathes [hisses],
(KauśS_13,1[93].39) [when] ghee, sesame oil, or honey flow [spontaneously].
(KauśS_13,1[93].40) With village fire he burns the hall.
(KauśS_13,1[93].41) And with fire that has arrived [from outside].
(KauśS_13,1[93].42) In the bamboo it bursts open.
(KauśS_13,1[93].43) In the water-pot storage it opens up, and in the pot containing barley-meal and grain.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].1) atha yatra_etāni varṣāṇi varṣanti ghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ madhu ca yad dhiraṇyaṃ yāni cāpi_anyāni ghorāṇi varṣāṇi varṣanti tat parābhavati kulaṃ vā grāmo vā janapado vā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].1) Now, wherever these rains rain — ghee, meat, honey, gold, and whatever other terrible rains rain — that family or village or country is ruined.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].2) tatra rājā bhūmipatir vidvāṃsaṃ brahmāṇam ichet
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].2) There the king, the lord of the land, should seek a learned <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].3) eṣa ha vai vidvān yad bhṛgvaṅgirovit
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].3) He indeed is learned who knows the <s>Bhṛgu</s> and <s>Aṅgiras</s> [traditions].

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].4) ete ha vā asya sarvasya śamayitāraḥ pālayitāro yad bhṛgvaṅgirasaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].4) These indeed are the pacifiers and protectors of all this — the <s>Bhṛgus</s> and <s>Aṅgirasas</s>.
(KauśS_13,2[94].5) He says: 'Prepare [the requisites].'

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].6) tad upakalpayante kaṃsamahate vasane śuddham ājyaṃ śāntā oṣadhīr navam udakumbham
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].6) They then prepare: a bronze vessel, a large garment, pure ghee, pacified herbs, and a new water-pot.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].7) trīṇi parvāṇi karmaṇaḥ paurṇamāsyamāvāsye puṇyaṃ nakṣatram
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].7) There are three occasions for the rite: full moon, new moon, and an auspicious constellation.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].8) api ced eva yadā kadā ārtāya kuryāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].8) However, if need be, he should perform it at any time for one who is afflicted.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].9) snāto_ahatavasanaḥ surabhir vratavān karmaṇya upavasati_ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ ṣaḍrātraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ vā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].9) Having bathed, wearing an unworn garment, fragrant, observing the vow, fit for the ritual, he stays overnight — one night, three nights, six nights, or twelve nights.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].10) dvādaśyāḥ prātar yatra_evādaḥ patitaṃ bhavati tata uttaram agnim upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].10) On the morning of the twelfth [day], wherever that [ominous rain] has fallen, to the north of that he sets up the fire.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].11) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya paricaraṇenājyaṃ paricarya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].11) Having swept around, sprinkled around, spread the <s>barhis</s> grass, placed a water vessel nearby, and having attended to the ghee with the ladle,
(KauśS_13,2[94].12) having offered the regular preliminary oblations and the two ghee portions,
(KauśS_13,2[94].13) then he offers.

body.text: (KauśS_13,2[94].14) <ghṛtasya dhārā iha yā varṣanti pakvaṃ māṃsaṃ madhu ca yad dhiraṇyam | dviṣantam etā anu yantu vṛṣṭayo 'pāṃ vṛṣṭayo bahulāḥ santu mahyam || lohitavarṣaṃ madhupāṃsuvarṣaṃ yad vā varṣaṃ ghoram aniṣṭam anyat | dviṣantam ete anu yantu sarve parāñco yantu nirvartamānāḥ || agnaye svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,2[94].14) Having offered [with the verse]: 'The streams of ghee that rain here, the cooked meat, the honey, and the gold — may these rains follow the enemy; may the rains of water be abundant for me. || The blood-rain, the honey-dust-rain, whatever other terrible, unwished-for rain — may all these follow the enemy; may they go away, turning back. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>,'
(KauśS_13,2[94].15) with '<s>divyo gandharvo</s>' [AV 2.2.1], he should offer with the names of the mothers.
(KauśS_13,2[94].16) The best draft-ox — a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> should give [it] to the performer.
(KauśS_13,2[94].17) A <s>Vaiśya</s> [gives] a plough, a local chief a horse, a king the best of the village.
(KauśS_13,2[94].18) That is the expiation (<s>prāyaścitti</s>) for that [omen].

body.text: (KauśS_13,3[95].1) atha yatra_etāni yakṣāṇi dṛśyante tad yathā_etat_markaṭaḥ śvāpado vāyasaḥ puruṣarūpam iti tad evam āśaṅkyam eva bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,3[95].1) Now, wherever these apparitions (<s>yakṣa</s>) are seen — such as a monkey, a wild beast, a crow, or a human form — that indeed should be feared.
(KauśS_13,3[95].2) There he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,3[95].3) <yan markaṭaḥ śvāpado vāyaso yadīdaṃ rāṣṭraṃ jātavedaḥ patāti puruṣarakṣasaṃ iṣiraṃ yat patāti | dviṣantam ete anu yantu sarve parāñco yantu nivartamānāḥ || agnaye svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,3[95].3) Having offered [with the verse]: 'Whatever monkey, wild beast, or crow, or whatever human-demon (<s>puruṣarakṣas</s>), swift, falls upon this kingdom, O <s>Jātavedas</s> — may all these follow the enemy; may they go away, turning back. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>,'
(KauśS_13,3[95].4) with '<s>divyo gandharvo</s>' [AV 2.2.1], he should offer with the names of the mothers.
(KauśS_13,3[95].5) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,4[96].1) atha ha gomāyū nāma maṇḍūkau yatra vadatas tad yat_manyante māṃ prati vadato māṃ prati vadata iti tad evam āśaṅkyam eva bhavati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,4[96].1) Now, where the two frogs called <s>gomāyū</s> (jackals) speak — when people think 'they are speaking against me, they are speaking against me' — that indeed should be feared.
(KauśS_13,4[96].2) There he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,4[96].3) <yad gomāyū vadato jātavedo 'nyayā vācābhi jañjabhātaḥ | rathaṃtaraṃ bṛhac ca sāmaitad dviṣantam etāv abhi nānadaitām || rathaṃtareṇa tvā bṛhac chamayāmi bṛhatā tvā rathaṭaraṃ śamayāmi | indrāgnī tvā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāv āyuṣmantāv uttamaṃ tvā karāthaḥ || indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā [-, PS 1.83.4cd]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,4[96].3) Having offered [with the verse]: 'When the two <s>gomāyū</s> speak, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, chattering with another voice — let the <s>Rathantara</s> and the <s>Bṛhat Sāman</s> — let these two cry out against the enemy. || With the <s>Rathantara</s> I pacify you, with the <s>Bṛhat</s> I pacify [you]; with the <s>Rathantara</s> [I pacify] you. May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, strengthened by <s>Brahman</s>, long-lived, make you supreme. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>' [cf. PS 1.83.4cd],
(KauśS_13,4[96].4) with '<s>divyo gandharvo</s>' [AV 2.2.1], he should offer with the names of the mothers.
(KauśS_13,4[96].5) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,5[97].1) atha yatra_etat kulaṃ kalahi bhavati tan nirṛtigṛhītam ity ācakṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,5[97].1) Now, wherever a household becomes quarrelsome, they say it is seized by <s>Nirṛti</s> (destruction).
(KauśS_13,5[97].2) There he should offer.
(KauśS_13,5[97].3) With '<s>ārād arātim</s>' [AV 8.2.12], two [verses].

body.text: (KauśS_13,5[97].4) <ayāś cāgne 'sy anabhiśastiś ca satyam it tvam ayā asi | ayāsā manasā kṛto 'yās +san [ed. 'yāsya] havyam ūhiṣe | ā [+ayā?] no dhehi bheṣajam | [MS 1.4.3:51.10, KS 5.4:57.1-4, KauśS 1.5.12 etc.]> || <svāhā>_ity agnau hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,5[97].4) Having offered into the fire [with the verse]: 'O <s>Agni</s>, you are without affliction (<s>ayā</s>) and without blame; truly you are without affliction; made with an unafflicted mind, being without affliction, you carry the oblation. Bring us medicine. <s>Svāhā</s>.' [MS 1.4.3:51.10, KS 5.4:57.1-4]
(KauśS_13,5[97].5) Right there he should offer these oblations.

body.text: (KauśS_13,5[97].6) <ārād agniṃ kravyādaṃ nirūhañ jivātave te paridhiṃ dadhāmi | indrāgnī tvā brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānāv āyuṣmantāv uttamaṃ tvā karāthaḥ || indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā [8.2.9cd, PS 16.3.8cd; PS 1.83.4cd]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,5[97].6) Having offered [with the verse]: 'Driving away the flesh-eating fire from afar, I place a protective enclosure around you for life. May <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, strengthened by <s>Brahman</s>, long-lived, make you supreme. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>' [AV 8.2.9cd, PS 16.3.8cd; PS 1.83.4cd],

body.text: (KauśS_13,5[97].7) <apeta etu nirṛtir [PS 19.23.4ff.]> ity anena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,5[97].7) with '<s>apeta etu nirṛtir</s>' [PS 19.23.4ff.], with this hymn he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,5[97].8) <apeta etu nirṛtir nehāsyā api kiṃ cana | apāsyāḥ satvanaḥ pāśān mṛtyūn ekaśataṃ nude || ye te pāśā ekaśataṃ mṛtyo martyāya hantave | tāṃs te yajñasya māyayā sarvā;m apa yajāmasi || nir ito yantu nairṛtyā mṛtyava ekaśataṃ paraḥ sedhāmaiṣāṃ yat tamaḥ prāṇaṃ jyotiś ca dadhmahe || [PS 19.23.4-6]> <ye te śataṃ varuṇa ye sahasraṃ yajñiyāḥ pāśā vitatā mahāntaḥ | tebhyo asmān varuṇaḥ soma indro viśve muñcantu marutaḥ svarkāḥ || [PS 18.82.7]> <brahma bhrājad udagād antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca brahmāvādhūṣṭāmṛtena mṛtyum | brahmopadraṣṭā sukṛtasya sākṣād brahmāsmad apa hantu śamalaṃ tamaś ca || [PS 16.150.2]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,5[97].8) [The hymn]: 'May <s>Nirṛti</s> (destruction) depart from here; may nothing of hers remain here. May the bonds of her offspring — I drive away a hundred deaths. || Whatever hundred bonds of yours, O Death, [are set] to slay mortals — all of those we sacrifice away by the power of the sacrifice. || Let the destructive ones depart from here, let a hundred deaths [go] far away; we drive them away, we establish breath and light.' [PS 19.23.4-6] 'Whatever hundred or thousand great, extended sacrificial bonds of yours, O <s>Varuṇa</s> — from those may <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Soma</s>, <s>Indra</s>, the <s>Maruts</s> of good chant, and all release us.' [PS 18.82.7] '<s>Brahman</s> rose up shining into the atmosphere; <s>Brahman</s> shook off death with immortality reaching up to heaven. <s>Brahman</s> is the overseer, the witness of good deeds — may <s>Brahman</s> drive away from us stain and darkness.' [PS 16.150.2]
(KauśS_13,5[97].9) The best draft-ox [as gift] — the same [as before].

body.text: (KauśS_13,6[98].1) atha yatra_etad bhūmicalo bhavati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,6[98].1) Now, wherever there is an earthquake, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,6[98].2) <acyutā dyaur acyutam antarikṣam acyutā bhūmir diśo acyutā imāḥ | acyuto 'yaṃ rodhāvarodhād dhruvo rāṣṭre prati tiṣṭhāmi jiṣṇuḥ || yathā sūryo divi rocate yathāntarikṣaṃ mātariśvābhivaste | yathāgniḥ pṛthivīmā viveśaivāyaṃ dhruvo acyuto astu jiṣṇuḥ || yathā devo divi stanayan vi rājati yathā varṣaṃ varṣakāmāya varṣati | yathāpaḥ pṛthivīmā viviśur evāyaṃ dhruvo acyuto astu jiṣṇuḥ || yathā purīṣaṃ nadyaḥ samudram ahorātre apramādaṃ kṣaranti | evā viśaḥ saṃmanaso havaṃ me 'pramādam ihopa yantu sarvāḥ || dṛṃhatāṃ devī saha devatābhir dhruvā dṛḍhācyutā me astu bhūmiḥ | sarvapāpmānam apanudyāsmad amitrān me dviṣato 'nu vidhyatu || pṛthivyai svāhā [cf. AVPariś 11.1.11]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,6[98].2) Having offered [with the verses]: 'Unshaken is the sky, unshaken the atmosphere, unshaken the earth, unshaken are these directions. Unshaken, this [kingdom] is firm from obstruction and blockade; victorious, I stand firm in the kingdom. || As the sun shines in heaven, as <s>Mātariśvan</s> (wind) pervades the atmosphere, as fire has entered the earth — so may this [kingdom] be firm, unshaken, victorious. || As the god thunders in the sky and shines, as rain rains for one desiring rain, as waters have entered the earth — so may this be firm, unshaken, victorious. || As rivers flow mud to the ocean ceaselessly, day and night — so may all the peoples, of one mind, come here to my call, ceaselessly. || May the goddess earth be firm together with the deities; may she be steady, fixed, unshaken for me. Having driven away all evil from us, may she pierce our enemies and haters. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Pṛthivī</s> (the Earth)' [cf. AVPariś 11.1.11],

body.text: (KauśS_13,6[98].3) <ā tvāhārṣam [6.87.1]>_<dhruvā dyaur [6.88.1]>_<satyaṃ bṛhad [12.1.1]> ity etenānuvākena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,6[98].3) with '<s>ā tvāhārṣam</s>' [AV 6.87.1], '<s>dhruvā dyaur</s>' [AV 6.88.1], '<s>satyaṃ bṛhad</s>' [AV 12.1.1], with this <s>anuvāka</s> (recitation section) he should offer.
(KauśS_13,6[98].4) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,7[99].1) atha yatra_etad ādityaṃ tamo gṛhṇāti tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,7[99].1) Now, wherever darkness seizes the sun (eclipse), there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,7[99].2) <divyaṃ citram ṛtūyā kalpayantam ṛtūnām ugraṃ bhramayann udeti | tad ādityaḥ pratarann etu sarvata āpa imāṃ lokān anusaṃcaranti || oṣadhībhiḥ saṃvidānāv indrāgnī tvābhi rakṣatām | ṛtena satyavākena tena sarvaṃ tamo jahi || ādityāya svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,7[99].2) Having offered [with the verses]: 'The divine, wondrous one, arranging the seasons, rises moving the mighty [forces] of the seasons. May <s>Āditya</s> (the sun), shining forth, pass on from all sides; the waters follow through these worlds. || Being in accord with the herbs, may <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> protect you. With truth and truthful speech, with that destroy all darkness. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun),'
(KauśS_13,7[99].3) with '<s>viṣāsahiṃ sahamānaṃ</s>' [AV 17.1.1], with this hymn he should offer.
(KauśS_13,7[99].4) He worships with the <s>Rohita</s> (red-sun) [hymns].
(KauśS_13,7[99].5) That is the expiation for that.
(KauśS_13,8[100].1) Now, wherever the moon is afflicted (eclipse), there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,8[100].2) <rāhū rājānaṃ tsarati svarantam ainam iha hanti pūrvaḥ | sahasram asya tanva iha nāśyāḥ śataṃ tanvo vi naśyantu || candrāya svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,8[100].2) Having offered [with the verse]: '<s>Rāhu</s> stealthily approaches the king who shines; the first one strikes him here. May a thousand of his bodies be destroyed here; may a hundred bodies perish. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Candra</s> (the Moon),'
(KauśS_13,8[100].3) with '<s>śakadhūmaṃ nakṣatrāṇi</s>' [AV 6.128.1], with this hymn he should offer.
(KauśS_13,8[100].4) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,9[101].1) atha yatra_etad auṣasī na_udeti tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,9[101].1) Now, wherever the dawn (<s>uṣas</s>) does not rise, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,9[101].2) <ud etu śrīr uṣasaḥ kalpayantī pūlyān kṛtvā palita etu cāraḥ | ṛtūn bibhratī bahudhā virūpān mahyaṃ bhavyaṃ viduṣī kalpayāti || auṣasyai svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,9[101].2) Having offered [with the verse]: 'May <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity) rise up, arranging the dawns, having made bundles, let the grey one go as a wanderer. Bearing the seasons in many forms, may she, the wise one, arrange what is to be for me. || <s>Svāhā</s> to the Dawn (<s>Uṣas</s>),'
(KauśS_13,9[101].3) with '<s>divyo gandharvo</s>' [AV 2.2.1], he should offer with the names of the mothers.
(KauśS_13,9[101].4) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,10[102].1) atha yatra_etat samā dāruṇā bhavati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,10[102].1) Now, wherever the year becomes harsh, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,10[102].2) <yā samā ruśaty eti prājāpatyān vi dhūnute | tṛptiṃ yāṃ devatā vidus tāṃ tvā saṃ kalpayāmasi || vyādhakasya mātaraṃ hiraṇyakukṣīṃ hariṇīm | tāṃ tvā saṃ kalpayāmasi || yat te ghoraṃ yat te viṣaṃ tad dviṣatsu ni dadhmasy amuṣminn [-]> iti brūyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,10[102].2) [With the verses]: 'The year that goes forth gleaming shakes the creatures of <s>Prajāpati</s>. The satisfaction that the deities know — with that we set you right. || The mother of the hunter, the golden-bellied, the tawny one — with her we set you right. || Whatever is terrible in you, whatever is poisonous — we place that upon the enemies' — he should name [the enemy].

body.text: (KauśS_13,10[102].3) <śivenāsmākaṃ same śāntyā sahāyuṣā samāyai svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,10[102].3) Having offered [with the verse]: 'With benevolence for us, with peace, with long life — <s>svāhā</s> to the Year,'
(KauśS_13,10[102].4) with '<s>samās tvāgna</s>' [AV 2.6.1], with this hymn he should offer.
(KauśS_13,10[102].5) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,11[103].1) atha yatra_etad upatārakāḥ śaṅkante tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,11[103].1) Now, wherever the meteors cause fear, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,11[103].2) <revatīḥ śubhrā iṣirā madantīs tvaco dhūmam anu tāḥ saṃ viśantu | pareṇāpaḥ pṛthivīṃ saṃ viśantv āpa imāṃ lokān anusaṃcarantu || adbhyaḥ svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,11[103].2) Having offered [with the verse]: 'The brilliant, bright, swift, delighting [meteors] — may they enter the smoke of the skins; beyond, may the waters enter the earth; may the waters follow through these worlds. || <s>Svāhā</s> to the Waters,'
(KauśS_13,11[103].3) with '<s>samutpatantu</s>' [AV 4.15.1], '<s>pra nabhasva</s>' [AV 7.18.1], he should offer the rain [verses].
(KauśS_13,11[103].4) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,12[104].1) atha yatra_etad brāhmaṇā āyudhino bhavanti tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,12[104].1) Now, wherever <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> take up weapons, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,12[104].2) <ya āsurā manuṣyā āttadhanvaḥ puruṣamukhāś carān iha | devā vayaṃ manuṣyās te devāḥ pra viśāmasi || indro no astu purogavaḥ sa no rakṣatu sarvataḥ | indrāya svāhā [-, cf. AVPariś 32.29]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,12[104].2) Having offered [with the verse]: 'Those <s>Asura</s>-like men, bows drawn, with human faces, who wander here — we are the divine men, may we, the gods, enter. || May <s>Indra</s> be our leader; may he protect us from all sides. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s>' [cf. AVPariś 32.29],

body.text: (KauśS_13,12[104].3) <mā no vidan [1.19.1]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13.1]>_iti etābhyāṃ sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,12[104].3) with '<s>mā no vidan</s>' [AV 1.19.1], '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13.1], with these two hymns he should offer.
(KauśS_13,12[104].4) That is the expiation for that.

body.text: (KauśS_13,13[105].1) atha yatra_etad daivatāni nṛtyanti cyotanti hasanti gāyanti vānyāni vā rūpāṇi kurvanti <ya āsurā manuṣyā [-, cf. KauśS 104.2]> <mā no vidan [1.19.1]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13.1]>_iti abhayair juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,13[105].1) Now, wherever divine images dance, drip, laugh, sing, or make other forms — with '<s>ya āsurā manuṣyā</s>' [cf. KauśS 104.2], '<s>mā no vidan</s>' [AV 1.19.1], '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13.1], he should offer with the fearlessness [verses].
(KauśS_13,13[105].2) That is the expiation (<s>prāyaścitti</s>) for that [situation].
(KauśS_13,14[106].1) Now, when in this case [two things] come together at the plough, having cooked a sacrificial cake,
(KauśS_13,14[106].2) having gone halfway into the wilderness,
(KauśS_13,14[106].3) having established the furrow (<s>sītā</s>) facing east,
(KauśS_13,14[106].4) having placed the fuel facing east in the middle of the furrow,

body.text: (KauśS_13,14[106].5) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhiḥ śamyāḥ paridhīn kṛtvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,14[106].5) having swept around, sprinkled around, spread the <s>barhis</s> grass, made the <s>śamī</s>-wood staves and enclosing sticks,

body.text: (KauśS_13,14[106].6) atha juhoti | <vittir asi puṣṭir asi śrīr asi prājāpatyānāṃ tāṃ tvāhaṃ mayi puṣṭikāmo juhomi svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,14[106].6) then he offers: '<s>vittir asi puṣṭir asi śrīr asi prājāpatyānāṃ tāṃ tvāhaṃ mayi puṣṭikāmo juhomi svāhā</s>' — 'You are attainment, you are prosperity, you are splendor; you belong to <s>Prajāpati</s>'s [gifts]; desiring prosperity for myself, I offer you, <s>svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,14[106].7) <kumudvatī puṣkariṇī sītā sarvāṅgaśobhanī | kṛṣiḥ sahasraprakārā pratyaṣṭā śrīr iyaṃ mayi || urvīṃ tvāhur manuṣyāḥ śriyaṃ tvā manaso viduḥ | āśaye 'nnasya no dhehy anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ || [-, cf. ;SāṅkhGS 1.27.7 etc.]> <parjanyapatni hariṇyabhijitāsy abhi no vada | kālanetre haviṣo no juṣasva tṛptiṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade || yābhir devā asurān akalpayan yātūn manūn gandharvān rākṣasāṃś ca | tābhir no adya sumanā upā gahi sahasrāpoṣaṃ subhage rarāṇā || [-, cf. 7.48.2cd]> <hiraṇyasrakpuṣkariṇī śyāmā sarvāṅgaśobhanī | kṛṣir hiraṇyaprakārā pratyaṣṭā śrīr iyaṃ mayi || aśvibhyāṃ devi saha saṃvidānā indreṇa rādhena saha puṣṭyā na ā gahi | viśas tvā rāsantāṃ pradiśo 'nu sarvā ahorātrārdhamāsamāsā ārtavā ṛtubhiḥ saha || bhartrī devānām uta martyānāṃ bhartrī prajānām uta mānuṣāṇām | hastibhir itarāsaiḥ kṣetrasārathibhiḥ saha | hiraṇyair aśvair ā gobhiḥ pratyaṣṭā śrīr iyaṃ mayi || [-]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,14[106].7) '<s>kumudvatī puṣkariṇī sītā sarvāṅgaśobhanī | kṛṣiḥ sahasraprakārā pratyaṣṭā śrīr iyaṃ mayi</s>' — 'The furrow abounding in water-lilies, a lotus-pond, beautiful in all limbs; agriculture of a thousand kinds — this <s>Śrī</s> (prosperity) is established in me.' || '<s>urvīṃ tvāhur manuṣyāḥ śriyaṃ tvā manaso viduḥ | āśaye 'nnasya no dhehy anamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ</s>' — 'Men call you wide; they know you as <s>Śrī</s> from the mind; place in our hope food that is disease-free and vigorous.' || '<s>parjanyapatni hariṇy abhijitāsy abhi no vada</s>' — 'O wife of <s>Parjanya</s>, tawny one, you are victorious; speak favorably to us; O <s>Kālanetri</s>, enjoy our oblation; grant satisfaction to our bipeds and quadrupeds.' || 'With those [powers] by which the gods defeated the <s>Asuras</s>, sorcerers, men, <s>Gandharvas</s>, and <s>Rākṣasas</s> — with those come to us today, well-disposed, O blessed one, granting thousandfold nourishment.' || '<s>hiraṇyasrak puṣkariṇī śyāmā sarvāṅgaśobhanī | kṛṣir hiraṇyaprakārā pratyaṣṭā śrīr iyaṃ mayi</s>' — 'Dark-complexioned one with golden garlands, a lotus-pond, beautiful in all limbs; agriculture with golden ramparts — this <s>Śrī</s> is established in me.' || 'O goddess, coming together with the two <s>Aśvins</s>, come to us with <s>Indra</s>, with wealth, with prosperity; may the peoples grant you, may all the directions [favor you], with days and nights, fortnights, months, seasons, and <s>ṛtus</s>.' || 'Supporter of gods and mortals, supporter of offspring and of humans; with elephants, horses, field-charioteers — with gold, horses, and cows — this <s>Śrī</s> is established in me.'
(KauśS_13,14[106].8) Here he should employ the <s>Śunāsīra</s> [rites].
(KauśS_13,14[106].9) The choice bull [as offering] — the procedure is the same [as before].

body.text: (KauśS_13,15[107].1) atha yatra_etat sṛjantyor vā kṛtantyor vā nānā tantū saṃsṛjato <manāyai tantuṃ prathamaṃ [PS 2.87.1]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,15[107].1) Now, when in this case, while releasing or spinning [threads], different threads become entangled — with '<s>manāyai tantuṃ prathamaṃ</s>' [PS 2.87.1], with this hymn he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,15[107].2) <manāyai tantuṃ prathamaṃ paśyed anyā atanvata | tan nārīḥ pra bravīmi vaḥ sādhvīr vaḥ santūrvarīḥ || sādhur vas tantur bhavatu sādhur etu ratho vṛtaḥ | atho horvarīr yūyaṃ prātar voḍhave dhāvata || khargalā iva patvarīr apām ugram ivāyanam | patantu patvarīr ivorvarīḥ sādhunā pathā || apācyau te totudyete todenāśvatarāv iva | pra stomam urvarīṇāṃ śaśayānām astāviṣam || nārī pañcamayūkhaṃ sūtravat kṛṇute vasu | ariṣṭo asya vastā prendra vāsa utodira || [PS 2.87]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,15[107].2) '<s>manāyai tantuṃ prathamaṃ paśyed anyā atanvata</s>' — 'Let one see the thread first for <s>Manā</s>; the others were extending [theirs].' || '<s>tan nārīḥ pra bravīmi vaḥ sādhvīr vaḥ santūrvarīḥ</s>' — 'This I declare to you, O women; may your fields be good.' || '<s>sādhur vas tantur bhavatu sādhur etu ratho vṛtaḥ</s>' — 'May your thread be good; may the laden chariot go well.' || '<s>atho horvarīr yūyaṃ prātar voḍhave dhāvata</s>' — 'And you field-women, run in the morning to the bridegroom.' || '<s>khargalā iva patvarīr apām ugram ivāyanam</s>' — 'Like <s>khargalā</s> [birds], like the fierce course of waters, may the swift field-women [go] by a good path.' || '<s>apācyau te totudyete todenāśvatarāv iva</s>' — 'Your two western [spindles] prick each other like two mules with a goad.' || '<s>pra stomam urvarīṇāṃ śaśayānām astāviṣam</s>' — 'I have praised forth the praise of the sleeping field-women.' || '<s>nārī pañcamayūkhaṃ sūtravat kṛṇute vasu</s>' — 'The woman makes wealth with the five-rayed [loom], thread-like.' || '<s>ariṣṭo asya vastā prendra vāsa utodira</s>' — 'Unharmed is the weaver of this; put on the garment [and] rise up.' [PS 2.87]
(KauśS_13,15[107].3) He should give a garment to the performer.
(KauśS_13,15[107].4) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,16[108].1) atha yatra_etad agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyate <bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasāv [-]> ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,16[108].1) Now, when in this case fire comes into contact with [another] fire — with '<s>bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasau</s>' — with this hymn he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,16[108].2) <bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasāv arepasau | mā hi;msiṣṭaṃ yajñapatiṃ mā yajñaṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatam adya naḥ [cf. VSM 5.3 etc.]> <agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyase kavir bṛhaspatir yuvā | havyavāṅ juhvāsyaḥ || [cf. .RV 1.12.6 etc.]> <tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā | sakhā sakhyā samidhyase || [cf. .RV 8.43.14]> <pāhi no agna ekayā pāhi na uta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhis tisṛbhir ūrjāṃpate pāhi catasṛbhir vaso || samīcī māhanī pātām āyuṣmatyā ṛco mā satsi | tanūpāt sāmno vasuvidaṃ lokam anusaṃcarāṇi || [PS 20.52.4-5]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,16[108].2) '<s>bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasāv arepasau | mā hiṃsiṣṭaṃ yajñapatiṃ mā yajñaṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatam adya naḥ</s>' [cf. VSM 5.3 etc.] — 'Be of one mind for us, dwelling together, without blemish; do not harm the lord of the sacrifice nor the sacrifice, O two <s>Jātavedas</s>; be auspicious for us today.' || '<s>agnināgniḥ saṃsṛjyase kavir Bṛhaspatir yuvā | havyavāṅ juhvāsyaḥ</s>' [cf. RV 1.12.6 etc.] — 'You, O <s>Agni</s>, are joined with fire; [you are] the wise young <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the oblation-carrier, the offerer.' || '<s>tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā | sakhā sakhyā samidhyase</s>' [cf. RV 8.43.14] — 'For you, O <s>Agni</s>, are kindled by fire, the inspired by the inspired, the true by the true, friend by friend.' || '<s>pāhi no agna ekayā pāhi na uta dvitīyayā | pāhi gīrbhis tisṛbhir ūrjāṃpate pāhi catasṛbhir vaso</s>' — 'Protect us, O <s>Agni</s>, with one [prayer]; protect us also with a second; protect with three songs, O lord of nourishment; protect with four, O beneficent one.' || '<s>samīcī māhanī pātām āyuṣmatyā ṛco mā satsi | tanūpāt sāmno vasuvidaṃ lokam anusaṃcarāṇi</s>' [PS 20.52.4-5] — 'May the two convergent great ones protect me; may I not be destroyed by the life-giving <s>Ṛc</s>; O <s>Tanūnapāt</s>, through the <s>Sāman</s>, may I follow this wealth-finding world.'
(KauśS_13,16[108].3) He should give a gold ornament to the performer.
(KauśS_13,16[108].4) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,17[109].1) atha yatra_etad ayamasūr yamau janayati tāṃ śāntyudakenābhyukṣya dohayitvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,17[109].1) Now, when in this case a cow that has not been yoked bears twins — having sprinkled her with pacificatory water and milked her,

body.text: (KauśS_13,17[109].2) tasyā eva gor dugdhe sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,17[109].2) having cooked a <s>sthālīpāka</s> (pot-cooked offering) in the milk of that very cow,
(KauśS_13,17[109].3) having placed the fuel facing east,

body.text: (KauśS_13,17[109].4) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,17[109].4) having swept around, sprinkled around, spread the <s>barhis</s> grass, placed a water-vessel nearby,

body.text: (KauśS_13,17[109].5) <ekaikayaiṣā sṛṣṭyā saṃ babhūva [3.28.1]> ity etena sūktenājyaṃ juhvan
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,17[109].5) with '<s>ekaikayaiṣā sṛṣṭyā saṃ babhūva</s>' [AV 3.28.1], with this hymn, offering ghee,
(KauśS_13,17[109].6) he brings the residues (<s>saṃpāta</s>) into the water-vessel.
(KauśS_13,17[109].7) The last residue he brings back into the rice-offering.

body.text: (KauśS_13,17[109].8) tato gāṃ ca prāśayati vatsau ca_udapātrād enān ācāmayati ca saṃprokṣati ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,17[109].8) Then he feeds the cow and the calves [from it], and causes them to sip and sprinkles them from the water-vessel.
(KauśS_13,17[109].9) He should give her [the cow] to that very [performer].
(KauśS_13,17[109].10) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,18[110].1) atha ced vaḍavā vā gardabhī vā syād evam eva prāñcam idhmam upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,18[110].1) Now, if it is a mare or a she-donkey, likewise, having placed the fuel facing east,
(KauśS_13,18[110].2) likewise having spread [the <s>barhis</s>],
(KauśS_13,18[110].3) likewise having placed [the water-vessel] nearby,
(KauśS_13,18[110].4) with that very hymn, offering ghee,
(KauśS_13,18[110].5) he brings the residues into the water-vessel.

body.text: (KauśS_13,18[110].6) udapātrād enān ācāmayati ca saṃprokṣati ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,18[110].6) He causes them to sip and sprinkles them from the water-vessel.
(KauśS_13,18[110].7) He should give her to that very [performer].
(KauśS_13,18[110].8) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,19[111].1) atha ced_mānuṣī syād evam eva prāñcam idhmam upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,19[111].1) Now, if it is a human woman, likewise, having placed the fuel facing east,
(KauśS_13,19[111].2) likewise having spread [the <s>barhis</s>],
(KauśS_13,19[111].3) likewise having placed [the water-vessel] nearby,
(KauśS_13,19[111].4) having placed the newborn twins on her lap,
(KauśS_13,19[111].5) with that very hymn, offering ghee,

body.text: (KauśS_13,19[111].6) amīṣāṃ mūrdhni sa mātuḥ putrayor ity anupūrvaṃ saṃpātān ānayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,19[111].6) he brings the residues in order upon their heads — first the mother, then the sons.
(KauśS_13,19[111].7) The remaining residues [go] into the water-vessel.

body.text: (KauśS_13,19[111].8) udapātrād enān ācāmayati ca saṃprokṣati ca
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,19[111].8) He causes them to sip and sprinkles them from the water-vessel.
(KauśS_13,19[111].9) He should give her [a cow] to that very [performer].
(KauśS_13,19[111].10) That is the expiation for that [situation].
(KauśS_13,19[111].11) Her ransom is according to desert or according to ability.

body.text: (KauśS_13,20[112].1) atha yatra_etad dhenavo lohitaṃ duhate <yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte [8.3.15]> ity etābhiś catasṛbhir juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,20[112].1) Now, when in this case cows yield blood [instead of milk] — with '<s>yaḥ pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte</s>' [AV 8.3.15], with these four [verses] he should offer.
(KauśS_13,20[112].2) He should give a choice milch-cow to the performer.
(KauśS_13,20[112].3) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,21[113].1) atha yatra_etad anaḍvān dhenuṃ dhayati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,21[113].1) Now, when in this case a bull suckles a cow, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,21[113].2) <anaḍvān dhenum adhayad indro go rūpam āviśat | sa me bhūtiṃ ca puṣṭiṃ ca dīrgham āyuś ca dhehi naḥ || indrāya svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,21[113].2) '<s>anaḍvān dhenum adhayad Indro go rūpam āviśat | sa me bhūtiṃ ca puṣṭiṃ ca dīrgham āyuś ca dhehi naḥ || Indrāya svāhā</s>' — 'The bull suckled the cow; <s>Indra</s> entered the form of a cow; may he grant me prosperity, nourishment, and long life. To <s>Indra</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,21[113].3) <mā no vidan [1.19.1]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13.1]>_iti etābhyāṃ sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,21[113].3) with '<s>mā no vidan</s>' [AV 1.19.1] and '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13.1], with these two hymns he should offer.
(KauśS_13,21[113].4) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,22[114].1) atha yatra_etad dhenur dhenuṃ dhayati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,22[114].1) Now, when in this case a cow suckles [another] cow, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,22[114].2) <yogakṣemaṃ dhenuṃ vājapatnīm indrāgnibhyāṃ preṣite jañjabhāne | tasmān mām agne pari pāhi ghorāt pra +ṇo jāyantāṃ mithunāni rūpaśaḥ || indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā [-, cf. KauśS 128.2]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,22[114].2) '<s>yogakṣemaṃ dhenuṃ vājapatnīm Indrāgnibhyāṃ preṣite jañjabhāne | tasmān mām agne pari pāhi ghorāt pra ṇo jāyantāṃ mithunāni rūpaśaḥ</s>' — 'The milch-cow, mistress of prizes, [represents] welfare and security; sent forth by <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, munching — from that terrible [omen], O <s>Agni</s>, protect me fully; may pairs be born to us in due form. To <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — having offered thus,
(KauśS_13,22[114].3) with '<s>divyo gandharvo</s>' [AV 2.2.1], he should offer with the names of the mothers.
(KauśS_13,22[114].4) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,23[115].1) atha yatra_etad gaur vāśvo vāśvataro vā puruṣo vākāśaphenam avagandhayati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,23[115].1) Now, when in this case a cow, a horse, a mule, or a person smells sky-foam (<s>ākāśaphena</s>), there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,23[115].2) <payo deveṣu paya oṣadhīṣu paya āśāsu payo 'ntarikṣe | tan me dhātā ca savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu || payo yad apsu paya usriyāsu paya utseṣūta parvateṣu | tan me dhātā ca savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu || yan mṛgeṣu paya āviṣṭam asti yad ejati patati yat patatriṣu [corr. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. patatatriṣu] | tan me dhātā ca savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu || yāni payāṃsi divy ārpitāni yāny antarikṣe bahudhā bahūni | teṣām īśānaṃ vaśinī no adya pra dattā dyāvāpṛthivī ahṛṇīyamānā || [PS 1.91]> ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,23[115].2) '<s>payo deveṣu paya oṣadhīṣu paya āśāsu payo 'ntarikṣe | tan me Dhātā ca Savitā ca dhattāṃ viśve tad devā abhi saṃ gṛṇantu</s>' — 'Milk among the gods, milk in herbs, milk in the directions, milk in the atmosphere; may <s>Dhātṛ</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> grant that to me; may all the gods praise that together.' || '<s>payo yad apsu paya usriyāsu paya utseṣūta parvateṣu</s>' — 'Whatever milk is in the waters, milk in the dawn-cows, milk in the springs and in the mountains — may <s>Dhātṛ</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> grant that to me; may all the gods praise that together.' || '<s>yan mṛgeṣu paya āviṣṭam asti yad ejati patati yat patatriṣu</s>' — 'Whatever milk is present in wild animals, whatever moves, flies, whatever is in birds — may <s>Dhātṛ</s> and <s>Savitṛ</s> grant that to me; may all the gods praise that together.' || '<s>yāni payāṃsi divy ārpitāni yāny antarikṣe bahudhā bahūni | teṣām īśānaṃ vaśinī no adya pra dattā Dyāvāpṛthivī ahṛṇīyamānā</s>' — 'Those milks fixed in heaven, those that are manifold and many in the atmosphere — O <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), being sovereign over those, unangered, graciously bestow [them] upon us today.' [PS 1.91] — with this hymn he should offer.
(KauśS_13,23[115].3) That is the expiation for that [situation].

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].1) atha yatra_etat pipīlikā anācārarūpā dṛśyante tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].1) Now, when in this case ants of unusual appearance are seen, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].2) <bhuvāya svāhā bhuvanāya svāhā bhuvanapataye svāhā bhuvāṃ pataye svāhāvoṣāya svāhā vinatāya svāhā śatāruṇāya svāhā>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].2) '<s>bhuvāya svāhā, bhuvanāya svāhā, bhuvanapataye svāhā, bhuvāṃ pataye svāhā, voṣāya svāhā, vinatāya svāhā, śatāruṇāya svāhā</s>' — 'To <s>Bhuva</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Bhuvana</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of the world, <s>svāhā</s>! To the lord of beings, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Voṣa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Vinata</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! To <s>Śatāruṇa</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].3) <yaḥ prācyāṃ diśi śvetapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | yo dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi kṛṣṇapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | yaḥ pratīcyāṃ diśi rajatapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | ya udīcyāṃ diśi rohitapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | yo dhruvāyāṃ diśi babhrupipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | yo vyadhvāyāṃ diśi haritapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā | ya ūrdhvāyāṃ diśy aruṇapipīlikānāṃ rājā tasmai svāhā>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].3) 'To him who is the king of white ants in the eastern direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of black ants in the southern direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of silver ants in the western direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of red ants in the northern direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of tawny ants in the fixed (nadir) direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of green ants in the intermediate direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>! To him who is the king of reddish-brown ants in the upper (zenith) direction, to him <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].4) tāś ced etāvatā na śāmyeyus tata uttaram agnim upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].4) If they are not pacified by this much, then, having placed a fire further [from them],

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].5) śaramayaṃ barhir ubhayataḥ parichinnaṃ prasavyaṃ paristīrya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].5) having spread reed-grass <s>barhis</s> cut on both ends counter-clockwise,

body.text: (KauśS_13,24[116].6) viṣāvadhvastam iṅgiḍam ājyaṃ śākapalāśena_utpūtaṃ bādhakena sruveṇa juhoti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].6) he offers with a repelling ladle ghee purified with a <s>śākapalāśa</s> leaf, [mixed with] <s>iṅgiḍa</s> (a mineral substance) smeared with poison.

body.text:
(KauśS_13,24[116].7) <ut tiṣṭhata nir dravata na va ihāstv ity añcanam | indro vaḥ sarvāsāṃ sākaṃ garbhān āṇḍāni bhetsyati [PS 17.13.3]> <phaḍ ḍhatāḥ pipīlikāḥ [cf. KauśS 47.21]>_iti
(KauśS_13,24[116].8) <indro vo yamo vo varuṇo vo 'gnir vo vāyur vaḥ sūryo vaś cendro vaḥ prajāpatir va īśāno vaḥ>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,24[116].7-8) '<s>ut tiṣṭhata nir dravata na va ihāstv ity añcanam | Indro vaḥ sarvāsāṃ sākaṃ garbhān āṇḍāni bhetsyati</s>' [PS 17.13.3] — 'Rise up! Run away! Let there be no path for you here! <s>Indra</s> will break the embryos and eggs of all of you.' '<s>phaḍ ḍhatāḥ pipīlikāḥ</s>' [cf. KauśS 47.21] — '<s>Phaṭ</s>! Begone, ants!' || '<s>Indro vo Yamo vo Varuṇo vo 'gnir vo Vāyur vaḥ Sūryo vaś cendro vaḥ Prajāpatir va Īśāno vaḥ</s>' — '<s>Indra</s> is [lord] over you, <s>Yama</s> over you, <s>Varuṇa</s> over you, <s>Agni</s> over you, <s>Vāyu</s> over you, <s>Sūrya</s> over you, and <s>Indra</s> over you, <s>Prajāpati</s> over you, <s>Īśāna</s> over you.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,25[117].1) atha yatra_etat_nīlamakṣā anācārarūpā dṛśyante tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,25[117].1) Now, when in this case blue flies of unusual appearance are seen, there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,25[117].2) <yā matyaiḥ sarathaṃ yānti ghorā mṛtyor dūtyaḥ kraviśaḥ saṃ babhūvuḥ | śivaṃ cakṣur uta ghoṣaḥ śivānāṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || śāntaṃ cakṣur uta vāyasīnāṃ yā cāsāṃ ghorā manaso visṛṣṭiḥ | manasaspate tanvā mā pāhi ghorān mā vi rikṣi tanvā mā prajayā mā paśubhir vāyave svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_13,25[117].2) '<s>yā matyaiḥ sarathaṃ yānti ghorā mṛtyor dūtyaḥ kraviśaḥ saṃ babhūvuḥ</s>' — 'Those terrible ones who go together on a chariot with worms, messengers of death, who have become [eaters of] flesh; may our sight be auspicious, and the sound of auspicious ones; may it be well for our bipeds, well for our quadrupeds.' || '<s>śāntaṃ cakṣur uta vāyasīnāṃ yā cāsāṃ ghorā manaso visṛṣṭiḥ | Manasaspate tanvā mā pāhi ghorān mā vi rikṣi tanvā mā prajayā mā paśubhir Vāyave svāhā</s>' — 'Pacified is the sight of the crow-like ones, and the terrible emanation of their mind; O lord of the mind, protect me with my body from the terrible ones; do not harm [me] in body, nor in offspring, nor in cattle. To <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>svāhā</s>!' — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,25[117].3) <vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ [PS 19.46.7 etc.]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: With '<s>vāta ā vātu bheṣajam</s>' [PS 19.46.7 etc.], with this hymn he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,25[117].4) <vāta ā vātu bheṣajaṃ śaṃbhu mayobhu no hṛde | pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat || uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrātota naḥ sakhā | sa no jīvātave kṛdhi || yad ado vāta te gṛhe nihitaṃ bheṣajaṃ guhā | tasya no dehi jīvase [PS 19.46.7-9, VaitS 38.1 etc.]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: 'May the wind blow healing to us, auspicious, bringing well-being to our hearts; may it extend our life-spans. || You, O wind, are our father, and [our] brother, and our friend; grant us life. || Whatever healing, O wind, is hidden, deposited in your house — of that, give to us for life.' [PS 19.46.7-9, VaitS 38.1 etc.] — with this hymn he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,26[118].1) atha yatra_etat_madhumakṣikā anācārarūpā dṛśyante <madhu vātā [ed. vāta] ṛtāyate [PS 19.45.5, cf. KauśS 90.25-91.1]> ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where honey-bees are seen in an unusual manner — with '<s>madhu vātā ṛtāyate</s>' [PS 19.45.5, cf. KauśS 90.25-91.1], with this hymn he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,27[119].1) atha yatra_etad anājñātam adbhutaṃ dṛśyate tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where an unknown, unprecedented portent (<s>adbhuta</s>) is seen — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,27[119].2) <yad ajñātam anāmnātam arthasya karmaṇo mithaḥ | agne tvaṃ nas tasmāt pāhi sa hi vettha yathāyatham || agnaye svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Whatever is unknown, unrecorded, [arising] from a conflicting matter or action — O <s>Agni</s>, protect us from that, for you know things as they truly are. <s>Agnaye svāhā</s>.'
And '<s>Vāyo</s>, <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Candra</s>' — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_13,27[119].4) <puruṣasaṃmito 'rthaḥ karmārthaḥ puruṣasaṃmitaḥ | vāyur mā tasmāt pātu sa hi vettha yathāyatham || vāyave svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: 'The matter is commensurate with a person; the purpose of action is commensurate with a person. May <s>Vāyu</s> protect me from that, for he knows things as they truly are. <s>Vāyave svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,27[119].5) <agnir mā sūryo mā candro mā>_iti ca
body.translated_text: And '<s>Agni</s>, protect me; <s>Sūrya</s>, protect me; <s>Candra</s>, protect me' — thus.

body.text: (KauśS_13,28[120].1) atha yatra_etad grāme vāvasāne vāgniśaraṇe samajyāyāṃ vāvadīryeta catasro dhenava upakḷptā bhavanti śvetā kṛṣṇā rohiṇī surūpā caturthī
body.translated_text: Now, where in a village, or in a settlement, or in a fire-house, or in an assembly — [the building] collapses: four cows are prepared — a white one, a black one, a reddish one, and a well-formed one as the fourth.

body.text: (KauśS_13,28[120].2) tāsām etad dvādaśarātraṃ saṃdugdhaṃ navanītaṃ nidadhāti
body.translated_text: Of those, the butter collected over twelve nights he deposits.

body.text: (KauśS_13,28[120].3) dvādaśyāḥ prātar yatra_evādo_avadīrṇaṃ bhavati tata uttaram agnim upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: On the morning of the twelfth [day], to the north of the very place where the collapse occurred, having established the fire,

body.text: (KauśS_13,28[120].4) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhiḥ śvetāyā ājyena saṃnīya
body.translated_text: having swept around, having sprinkled around, having spread the sacred grass around — having collected the ghee of the white [cow],
with '<s>agnir bhūmyām</s>' [AV 12.1.19], with three [verses], having consecrated with <s>mantras</s> and touched [the cow],
then he should offer.
Likewise in the southern quarter.
Likewise in the western quarter.
In the northern quarter, having concluded, he should offer with the <s>Vāstoṣpatya</s> (homestead-lord) [hymns].
At the [site of] collapse, having brought the remainders, having concluded the offerings,
having sprinkled the collapsed [structure] with pacificatory water (<s>śāntyudaka</s>),
those very [cows] a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should give [as fee].
A plough [is the fee for] a <s>vaiśya</s>; a horse for a provincial [ruler]; the best of the village for a king.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,29[121].1) atha yatra_etad anudaka udakonmīlo bhavati <hiraṇyavarṇāḥ [1.33.1]>_ity apāṃ sūktair juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where in a waterless [place] a spring of water appears — with '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33.1], with the water hymns, he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,30[122].1) atha yatra_etat tilāḥ samatailā bhavanti tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where sesame seeds become [full of] oil on their own — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,30[122].2) <anūnāya svāhā | akṣitāya svāhā | aparimitāya svāhā | paripūrṇāya svāhā>
body.translated_text: 'To the Undiminished, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Imperishable, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Unlimited, <s>svāhā</s>! To the Completely Full, <s>svāhā</s>!'

body.text: (KauśS_13,30[122].3) sa yaṃ dviṣyāt tasyāśāyāṃ <lohitaṃ te pra siñcāmi>_iti dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ prasiñcet
body.translated_text: And whomever he hates — in that [person's] direction, facing south, he should pour out [saying]: 'I pour out blood upon you.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,31[123].1) atha yatra_etad vapāṃ vā havīṃṣi vā vayāṃsi dvipadacatuṣpadaṃ vābhimṛśyāvagacheyur <ye agnayo [3.21.1]> <namo devavadhebhyo [6.13.1]>_ity etābhyāṃ sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where birds or bipeds or quadrupeds touch and carry off the <s>vapā</s> (omentum) or the oblation materials — with '<s>ye agnayo</s>' [AV 3.21.1] and '<s>namo devavadhebhyo</s>' [AV 6.13.1], with these two hymns he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].1) atha yatra_etat kumārasya kumāryā vā dvau_āvartau mūrdhanyau bhavataḥ savyāvṛd eko deśāvartas tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where a boy or girl has two whorls on the crown of the head, [or] one leftward whorl, [or] a partial whorl — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].2) <tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi bahudhā vikurvañ janayan prajā bahudhā viśvarūpāḥ | sa me karotv aviparītam asmān anupūrvaṃ kalpayatām ihaiva || tvaṣṭre svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: '<s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>, fashioning forms in many ways, generating offspring of many forms — may he make [things] not reversed for us; may he arrange [them] in proper order right here. <s>Tvaṣṭre svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].3) <antar garbheṣu bahudhā saṃ tanoti janayan prajā bahudhā viśvarūpāḥ | sa me karotv aviparītam asmān anupūrvaṃ kalpayatām ihaiva || tvaṣṭre svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Within the embryos he extends in many ways, generating offspring of many forms — may he make [things] not reversed for us; may he arrange [them] in proper order right here. <s>Tvaṣṭre svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].4) <yady unmṛṣṭaṃ yadi vābimṛṣṭaṃ tiraścīn artha uta marmṛjante | śivaṃ tad devaḥ savitā kṛṇotu prajāpatiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ || tvaṣṭre svāhā [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Whether [the hair] is wiped upward or wiped against, or they rub it crosswise — may the god <s>Savitṛ</s> make that auspicious, [and] <s>Prajāpati</s>, in accord with [his] offspring. <s>Tvaṣṭre svāhā</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].5) <savyāvṛttāny uta yā viśvarūpā pratyagvṛttāny uta yā te paruṣaḥ | tāny asya deva bahudhā bahūni syonāni śagmāni śivāni santu || tvaṣṭre svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: 'And those which are turned leftward, and those of many forms, and those turned backward, and those which are your joints — may all those many [features] of his be comfortable, pleasant, and auspicious. <s>Tvaṣṭre svāhā</s>.' — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,32[124].6) <tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ [6.4.1]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ</s>' [AV 6.4.1], with this hymn he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,33[125].1) atha yatra_etad yūpo virohati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where a sacrificial post (<s>yūpa</s>) sprouts — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,33[125].2) <yūpo virohañ chataśākho adhvaraḥ samāvṛto mohayiṣyan yajamānasya lokān | vedābhigupto brahmaṇā parivṛto 'tharvabhiḥ śāntaḥ sukṛtām etu lokān || yūpo hy arukṣad dviṣatāṃ vadhāya na me yajño yajamānaś ca riṣyāt | saptarṣīṇāṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokas tatremaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca dhehi || vanaspate svāhā [-, cf. Kāty;SS 2.2.8]]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: 'The <s>yūpa</s> (sacrificial post), sprouting with a hundred branches, the sacrifice fully enclosed, about to bewilder the worlds of the sacrificer — protected by the <s>Veda</s>, surrounded by <s>Brahman</s>, pacified by the <s>Atharvans</s> — may it go to the worlds of the meritorious. || For the <s>yūpa</s> has grown up for the destruction of enemies; may my sacrifice and the sacrificer not be harmed. Where the world of the meritorious Seven Sages is — place this sacrifice and the sacrificer there. <s>Vanaspataye svāhā</s>.' [cf. KātyŚS 2.2.8] — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,33[125].3) <vanaspatiḥ saha devair na āgann [12.3.15]> iti juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>vanaspatiḥ saha devair na āgann</s>' [AV 12.3.15], he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].1) atha yatra_etad divolkā patati tad ayogakṣemāśaṅkaṃ bhavati_avṛṣṭyāśaṅkaṃ vā
body.translated_text: Now, where a meteor (<s>divolkā</s>) falls — that is a portent of danger to welfare, or a portent of drought.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].2) tatra rājā bhūmipatir vidvāṃsaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vṛṇīyāt
