body.translated_text: There the king, the lord of the land, should choose a learned <s>brāhmaṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].3) sa vṛto_araṇyasyārdham abhivrajya tatra dvādaśarātram anuśuṣyet
body.translated_text: That chosen one, having gone to the middle of the forest, should observe austerity there for twelve nights.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].4) sa khalu pūrvaṃ navarātram āraṇyaśākamūlaphalabhakṣaś cātha_uttaraṃ trirātraṃ nānyad udakāt
body.translated_text: For the first nine nights, he subsists on forest vegetables, roots, and fruits; then for the latter three nights, [he takes] nothing other than water.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].5) śvo bhūte sapta dhenava upakḷptā bhavanti śvetā kṛṣṇā rohiṇī nīlā pāṭalā surūpā bahurūpā saptamī
body.translated_text: On the next day, seven cows are prepared — a white, a black, a reddish, a blue, a pink, a well-formed, and a multi-colored one as the seventh.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].6) tāsām etad dvādaśarātraṃ saṃdugdhaṃ navanītaṃ nidadhāti
body.translated_text: Of those, the butter collected over twelve nights he deposits.

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].7) dvādaśyāḥ prātar yatra_evāsau patitā bhavati tata uttaram agnim upasamādhāya
body.translated_text: On the morning of the twelfth [day], to the north of the very place where that [meteor] fell, having established the fire,
having swept around, having sprinkled around, having spread the sacred grass around,

body.text: (KauśS_13,34[126].9) athāmuṃ navanītaṃ sauvarṇe pātre vilāpya sauvarṇena sruveṇa rakṣoghnaiś ca sūktair <yām āhus tārakaiṣā vikeśīti [5.17.4]>_etena sūktenājyaṃ juhvan
body.translated_text: then having melted that butter in a golden vessel, with a golden ladle and with the demon-slaying hymns, with '<s>yām āhus tārakaiṣā vikeśīti</s>' [AV 5.17.4], with this hymn, he should offer ghee.
At the fallen [meteor site], having brought the remainders, having concluded the offerings,
having sprinkled the fallen [site] with pacificatory water (<s>śāntyudaka</s>),
those very [cows] a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> should give [as fee].
A plough [is the fee for] a <s>vaiśya</s>; a horse for a provincial [ruler]; the best of the village for a king.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].1) atha yatra_etad dhūmaketuḥ saptarṣīn upadhūpayati tad ayogakṣemāśaṅkam ity uktam
body.translated_text: Now, where a comet (<s>dhūmaketu</s>) obscures the Seven Sages [constellation] — that is said to be a portent of danger to welfare.

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].2) pañca paśavas tāyante vāruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo gaur vājo vāvir vā harir vāyavyo bahurūpo diśyo mārutī meṣyāgneyaḥ prājāpatyaś ca kṣīraudano_apāṃ naptra udraḥ
body.translated_text: Five animals are to be [offered]: a black bull sacred to <s>Varuṇa</s>, or a prize [animal], or a ram, or a tawny [animal] sacred to <s>Vāyu</s>, a multi-colored one for the directions, a ewe sacred to the <s>Maruts</s>, and one sacred to <s>Agni</s>; and rice-gruel with milk sacred to <s>Prajāpati</s>; an otter [is offered] to <s>Apāṃ Napāt</s> (Son of Waters).
With '<s>uteyaṃ bhūmir</s>' [AV 4.16.3], having praised <s>Varuṇa</s> three times,

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].4) <apsu te rājann [7.83.1]> iti catasṛbhir vāruṇasya juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>apsu te rājann</s>' [AV 7.83.1], with four [verses], he should offer of the one [sacred] to <s>Varuṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].5) <vāyav ā rundhi no mṛgān asmabhyaṃ mṛgayadbhyaḥ | sa no nediṣṭham ā kṛdhi vāto hi raśanākṛtaḥ [PS 20.51.4]>_iti vāyavyasya
body.translated_text: 'O <s>Vāyu</s>, drive the wild animals to us who are hunting; do you bring [them] closest to us, for the wind acts as a snare.' [PS 20.51.4] — of the one [sacred] to <s>Vāyu</s>.
With '<s>āśānām</s>' [AV 1.31.1], of the one [sacred] to the directions.

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].7) <prati tyaṃ cārum adhvaraṃ gopīthāya pra hūyase | marudbhir agna ā gahi [PS 6.17.1, .RV 1.19.1]>_iti mārutasya
body.translated_text: 'Come to this lovely sacrifice for protection, O <s>Agni</s>, together with the <s>Maruts</s>.' [PS 6.17.1, RV 1.19.1] — of the one [sacred] to the <s>Maruts</s>.
With '<s>apām agnis</s>' [AV 4.15.10], of the one [sacred] to <s>Agni</s>.
With '<s>prajāpatiḥ salilād</s>' [AV 4.15.11], of the one [sacred] to <s>Prajāpati</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_13,35[127].10) apāṃ sūktair hiraṇyaśakalena saha_udram apsu praveśayet
body.translated_text: With the water hymns, together with a gold fragment, he should immerse the otter in the waters.
Indeed, it then rains.
All [one's] possessions are the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (ritual fee) for that.
The redemption of that [fee] is according to worth, or according to one's means.

body.text: (KauśS_13,36[128].1) atha yatra_etat_nakṣatrāṇi patāpatānīva bhavanti tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where the stars appear to be falling — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,36[128].2) <yan nakṣatraṃ patati jātavedaḥ somena rājñeṣiraṃ purastāt | tasmān mām agne pari pāhi ghorāt pra ṇo jāyantāṃ mithunāni rūpaśaḥ || indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā [-, cf. KauśS 114.2]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: 'Whatever star falls, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, [driven] by King <s>Soma</s> as its arrow from the east — from that dreadful [portent], O <s>Agni</s>, protect me; may pairs of offspring be born to us in [proper] form. <s>Indrāgnibhyāṃ svāhā</s>.' — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,36[128].3) <somo rājā savitā ca rājā [PS 19.33.1]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>somo rājā savitā ca rājā</s>' [PS 19.33.1], with this hymn he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,36[128].4) <somo rājā savitā ca rājā bhuvo rājā bhuvanaṃ ca rājā | śarvo rājā śarma ca rājā ta u naḥ śarma yachantu devāḥ || ādityair no bṛhaspatir bhagaḥ somena naḥ saha | viśve devā urv antarikṣaṃ ta u naḥ śarma yachantu devāḥ || utāvidvān niṣkṛdayāthosraghnī yathāyatham | mā no viśve devā maruto hetim ichata [PS 19.33.1-3]>
body.translated_text: 'King <s>Soma</s> and King <s>Savitṛ</s>, King of the Earth and King of the World, King <s>Śarva</s> and King of Peace — may those gods grant us shelter. || May <s>Bṛhaspati</s> with the <s>Ādityas</s>, and <s>Bhaga</s> together with <s>Soma</s>, and the <s>Viśvedevas</s> [grant us] wide space — may those gods grant us shelter. || And may the unknowing make reparation, and may the non-slaying [act] according to its nature; may all the <s>Viśvedevas</s> and <s>Maruts</s> not seek a weapon against us.' [PS 19.33.1-3]
He should give a gold ornament to the performer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].
Now, where a [thunderbolt with a] fleshy face falls — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,37[129].2) <ghoro vajro devasṛṣṭo na āgan yad vā gṛhān ghoram utā jagāma | tan nir jagāma haviṣā ghṛtena śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || rudrāya svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: 'A terrible thunderbolt, sent by the gods, has come to us, or whatever terrible [thing] has come to our homes — may that depart with an oblation of ghee; may there be well-being for our bipeds and quadrupeds. <s>Rudrāya svāhā</s>.' — having offered thus,

body.text: (KauśS_13,37[129].3) <bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ mābhi yātaṃ [11.2.1]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>bhavāśarvau mṛḍataṃ mābhi yātam</s>' [AV 11.2.1], with this hymn he should offer.
That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS_13,38[130].1) atha yatra_etad anagnau_avabhāso bhavati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where a glow appears without fire — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,38[130].2) <yā te 'vadīptir avarūpā jātavedo 'peto rakṣasāṃ bhāga eṣaḥ | rakṣāṃsi tayā daha jātavedo yā naḥ prajāṃ manuṣyāṃ saṃsṛjante || agnaye svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: 'That which is your downward flame, the deformed one, O <s>Jātavedas</s> — that is the share of the <s>Rakṣas</s>-es, [which has] departed. With that [flame], burn the <s>Rakṣas</s>-es, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, those that mingle with our human offspring. <s>Agnaye svāhā</s>.' — having offered thus,
With '<s>agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati</s>' [AV 8.3.26], [that is] the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation).

body.text: (KauśS_13,39[131].1) atha yatra_etad agniḥ śvasatīva tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, where the fire appears to breathe — there he should offer.

body.text: (KauśS_13,39[131].2) <śvetā kṛṣṇā rohiṇī jātavedo yās te tanūs tiraścīnā nirdahantīḥ śvasantīḥ | rakṣāṃsi tābhir daha jātavedo yā naḥ prajāṃ manuṣyāṃ saṃsṛjante || agnaye svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: Having offered [with the verse]: '<s>śvetā kṛṣṇā rohiṇī jātavedo yās te tanūs tiraścīnā nirdahantīḥ śvasantīḥ | rakṣāṃsi tābhir daha jātavedo yā naḥ prajāṃ manuṣyāṃ saṃsṛjante</s>' — 'O <s>Jātavedas</s>, the white, the black, the red — those bodies of yours that burn crosswise, that breathe — with those burn the <s>Rakṣas</s>-demons, O <s>Jātavedas</s>, those who attack our human offspring. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>',
With '<s>agnī rakṣāṃsi sedhati</s>' [AV 8.3.26], that is the expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>),

body.text: (KauśS_13,40[132].1) atha yatra_etat sarpir vā tailaṃ vā madhu vā viṣyandati <yad yāmaṃ cakrur nikhananto [6.116.1]>_ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, wherever ghee, or oil, or honey flows [of its own accord] — with '<s>yad yāmaṃ cakrur nikhananto</s>' [AV 6.116.1], with this hymn he should offer,
That is the expiation for that,

body.text: (KauśS_13,41[133].1) atha yatra_etad grāmyo_agniḥ śālāṃ dahati_<apamityam apratīttaṃ [6.117-119]>_ity etais tribhiḥ sūktair maiśradhānyasya pūrṇāñjaliṃ hutvā
body.translated_text: Now, wherever a domestic fire burns the house — with '<s>apamityam apratīttaṃ</s>' [AV 6.117-119], with these three hymns, having offered a full handful of mixed grains,

body.text: (KauśS_13,41[133].2) <mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā [PS 1.40]> <mahyam āpo madhumad erayantāṃ [6.61.1]>_ity etābhyāṃ sūktābhyāṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: with '<s>mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā</s>' [PS 1.40], '<s>mahyam āpo madhumad erayantāṃ</s>' [AV 6.61.1], with these two hymns he should offer,

body.text: (KauśS_13,41[133].3) <mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā mamobhendrābṛhaspatī | mama tvaṣṭā ca pūṣā ca mamaiva savitā vaśe || mama viṣṇuś ca somaś ca mamaiva maruto bhavan | sarasvāṃś ca bhagaś ca viśve devā vaśe mama || mamobhe [ed. misprint mamobhā] dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ svar mama | mamemāḥ sarvā oṣadhīr āpaḥ sarvā vaśe mama || mama gāvo mamāśvā mamājāś cāvayaś ca mamaiva puruṣā bhavan | mamedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad ejat prāṇad vaśe mama || [PS 1.40]>_iti
body.translated_text: '<s>mamobhā mitrāvaruṇā mamobhendrābṛhaspatī | mama tvaṣṭā ca pūṣā ca mamaiva savitā vaśe</s>' || '<s>mama viṣṇuś ca somaś ca mamaiva maruto bhavan | sarasvāṃś ca bhagaś ca viśve devā vaśe mama</s>' || '<s>mamobhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ svar mama | mamemāḥ sarvā oṣadhīr āpaḥ sarvā vaśe mama</s>' || '<s>mama gāvo mamāśvā mamājāś cāvayaś ca mamaiva puruṣā bhavan | mamedaṃ sarvam ātmanvad ejat prāṇad vaśe mama</s>' [PS 1.40] — 'Both <s>Mitra</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s> are mine, both <s>Indra</s> and <s>Bṛhaspati</s> are mine; <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s> and <s>Pūṣan</s> are mine, <s>Savitṛ</s> himself is in my power' || '<s>Viṣṇu</s> and <s>Soma</s> are mine, the <s>Maruts</s> themselves became mine; <s>Sarasvan</s> and <s>Bhaga</s> and the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> are in my power' || 'Both heaven and earth are mine, the atmosphere and the sky are mine; all these plants and all the waters are in my power' || 'My are the cows, my the horses, my the goats and sheep; the people themselves became mine; all this that is animate, that moves and breathes, is in my power',
Having heated the fire-churning sticks and wiped the hearth-ground,
Then he should generate the fire,

body.text: (KauśS_13,41[133].6) <ita eva prathamaṃ jajñe agnir ābhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedāḥ | sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā jagatyānuṣṭubhā devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānann [-]> iti janitvā
body.translated_text: Having generated [fire with the verse]: '<s>ita eva prathamaṃ jajñe agnir ābhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedāḥ | sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā jagatyānuṣṭubhā devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānann</s>' — 'From here first was born <s>Agni</s>, from these sources <s>Jātavedas</s> [arose]; may that god, knowing, carry the oblation to the gods with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, <s>Triṣṭubh</s>, <s>Jagatī</s>, and <s>Anuṣṭubh</s> [metres]',

body.text: (KauśS_13,41[133].7) <bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasāv [-, cf. KauśS 108.2]> ity etena sūktena juhuyāt
body.translated_text: With '<s>bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau samokasāv</s>' [cf. KauśS 108.2], with this hymn he should offer,
That is the expiation for that,

body.text: (KauśS_13,42[134].1) atha ced āgantur dahati_evam eva kuryāt
body.translated_text: Now, if a stranger's [fire] burns [the house], one should do the same,
That is the expiation for that,

body.text: (KauśS_13,43[135].1) atha yatra_etad vaṃśa sphoṭati kapāle_aṅgārā bhavanti_udapātraṃ barhir ājyaṃ tad ādāya
body.translated_text: Now, wherever a bamboo cracks [and] embers appear in a potsherd — having taken a water-vessel, <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass), and ghee,
He approaches the roof of the house,
There he places embers or a potsherd, [keeping them] until thoroughly heated,
Having placed fuel-sticks facing east,

body.text: (KauśS_13,43[135].5) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya
body.translated_text: Having swept, sprinkled around, strewn <s>barhis</s>, and placed the water-vessel nearby,
Having attended to the ghee with the attending ladle,
Having offered the regular preliminary oblations and the <s>ājyabhāgas</s> (ghee-portions),
Then he offers,

body.text: (KauśS_13,43[135].9) <asau vai nāma te mātāsau vai nāma te pitā | asau vai nāma te dūtaḥ svavaṃśam adhi tiṣṭhati || uttamarātrī ṇāma mṛtyo te mātā tasya te antakaḥ pitā | samaṃdadhānas te dūtaḥ svavaṃśam adhi tiṣṭhati || bahavo 'sya pāśā vitatāḥ pṛthivyām asaṃkhyeyā aparyantā anantāḥ | yābhir vaṃśān abhinidadhāti prāṇināṃ yān kāṃś cemān prāṇabhṛtāṃ jighāṃsan | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśaṃ mṛtyave svāhā || bṛhaspatir āṅgiraso brahmaṇaḥ putro viśve devāḥ pra dadur viśvam ejat | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśaṃ bṛhaspataya āṅgirasāya svāhā || yasya te 'nnaṃ na kṣīyate bhūya evopajātaye | yasmai bhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarvam etat pratiṣṭhitam | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśam indrāya svāhā || mukhaṃ devānām iha yo babhūva yo jānāti vayunānāṃ samīpe | yasmai hutaṃ devatā bhakṣayanti vāyunetraḥ supraṇītiḥ sunītiḥ | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśam agnaye svāhā || yaḥ pṛthivyāṃ cyāvayann eti vṛkṣān prabhañjanena rathena saha saṃvidānaḥ | rasān gandhān bhāvayann eti devo mātariśvā bhūtabhavyasya kartā | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśaṃ vāyave svāhā || brahmacārī carati brahmacaryam ṛcaṃ gāthāṃ brahma paraṃ jigāṃsan | taṃ vighnā anupariyanti sarve ye antarikṣe ye ca divi śritāsaḥ | taṃ viśo anuparyanti sarvāḥ karmāṇi loke parimohayanti | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśam ādityāya svāhā || yo nakṣatraiḥ sarathaṃ yāti devaḥ saṃsiddhena rathena saha saṃvidānaḥ | rūpaṃrūpaṃ kṛṇvānaś citrabhānuḥ subhānuḥ | sa imaṃ dūtaṃ nudatu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśaṃ candrāya svāhā || oṣadhayaḥ somarājñīr yaśasvinīḥ | tā imaṃ dūtaṃ nudantu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśam oṣadhībhyaḥ somarājñībhyaḥ svāhā || oṣadhayo varuṇarājñīr yaśasvinīḥ | tā imaṃ dūtaṃ nudantu vaṃśapṛṣṭhāt sa me gachatu dviṣato niveśam oṣadhībhyo varuṇarājñībhyaḥ svāhā || aṣṭasthūṇo daśapakṣo yadṛchajo vanaspate | putrāṃś caiva paśūṃś cābhi rakṣa vanaspate || yo vanaspatīnām upatāpo babhūva yad vā gṛhān ghoram utā jagāma tan nir jagāma haviṣā ghṛtena śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade || yo vanaspatīnām upatāpo na āgad yad vā yajñaṃ no 'dbhutam ā jagāma | sarvaṃ tad agne hutam astu bhāgaśaḥ śivān vayam ut taremābhi vājān || tvaṣṭre svāhā [-]>_iti hutvā
body.translated_text: Having offered [with the verses]: 'Such-and-such is the name of your mother, such-and-such the name of your father; such-and-such is the name of your messenger — he stands upon his own bamboo-ridge. || <s>Uttamarātrī</s> is the name of your mother, O Death; <s>Antaka</s> (the Ender) is your father; <s>Samaṃdadhāna</s> (the Equalizer) is your messenger — he stands upon his own bamboo-ridge. || Many are his snares spread upon the earth — uncountable, boundless, endless; with which he places [coals] upon the bamboo-ridges of living beings, seeking to slay whichever breathers here — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Mṛtyu</s> (Death). || <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, son of <s>Aṅgiras</s>, son of <s>Brahman</s> — the <s>Viśve Devāḥ</s> bestowed all that moves — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Bṛhaspati Āṅgirasa</s>. || He whose food is not exhausted, [who causes] ever more to be produced; in whom both past and future are established — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Indra</s>. || He who became the face of the gods here, who knows the arrangements close at hand; for whom the deities consume the oblation, led by <s>Vāyu</s>, of good guidance, of good conduct — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Agni</s>. || He who goes shaking the trees upon the earth, united with the chariot of shattering; the god who enlivens essences and fragrances — <s>Mātariśvan</s>, the maker of past and future — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Vāyu</s>. || The <s>brahmacārin</s> (celibate student) wanders practicing <s>brahmacarya</s>, seeking the highest <s>Brahman</s> through <s>Ṛc</s>, <s>Gāthā</s> — all obstacles attend upon him, those in the atmosphere and those established in heaven; all the peoples attend upon him, [yet] the deeds in the world bewilder — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Āditya</s> (the Sun). || The god who rides in the same chariot with the <s>Nakṣatras</s> (constellations), united with the perfected chariot, assuming form after form, of wondrous splendor, of beautiful splendor — may he push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Candra</s> (the Moon). || The plants, ruled by <s>Soma</s>, glorious — may they push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to the plants ruled by <s>Soma</s>. || The plants, ruled by <s>Varuṇa</s>, glorious — may they push this messenger from the bamboo-ridge; may he go to the abode of my enemy. <s>Svāhā</s> to the plants ruled by <s>Varuṇa</s>. || O forest tree with eight pillars and ten wings, self-arising — protect both sons and cattle, O forest tree. || Whatever scorching of the forest trees has occurred, or whatever terrible [omen] has gone to the houses — all that has departed through [this] oblation of ghee; may there be welfare for our two-footed and four-footed [beings]. || Whatever scorching of the forest trees came to us, or whatever portentous [sign] came to our sacrifice — may all that, O <s>Agni</s>, be offered, portion by portion; may we auspiciously cross over to prizes. || <s>Svāhā</s> to <s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>',
With '<s>tvaṣṭā me daivyaṃ vacaḥ</s>' [AV 6.4.1], here he pours the water-vessel,
Having taken the fire in a potsherd, he approaches [the house],
That is the expiation for that,

body.text: (KauśS_13,44[136].1) atha yatra_etat kumbhodadhānaḥ saktudhānī vā_ukhā vāniṅgitā vikasati tatra juhuyāt
body.translated_text: Now, wherever a water-jar, a flour-jar, or a pot cracks by itself without being touched — there he should offer,

body.text:
(KauśS_13,44[136].2) <bhūmir bhūmim agān [ed. em.: avāgān, but note AVPariś 40.6.5 and Keśava] mātā mātaram apy agāt | ṛdhyāsma putraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām [-]> iti
(KauśS_13,44[136].3) sadasi san me bhūyād iti saktūn āvapate
body.translated_text: '<s>bhūmir bhūmim agān mātā mātaram apy agāt | ṛdhyāsma putraiḥ paśubhir yo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatām</s>' — 'Earth has gone to earth, mother has gone to mother; may we prosper with sons and cattle; may he who hates us be shattered' — sitting in the assembly, [thinking] 'may there be prosperity for me,' he pours in barley-flour,

body.text: (KauśS_13,44[136].4) atha ced odanasya_<annam asy annaṃ me dehy annaṃ mā mā hiṃsīr> iti triḥ prāśya
body.translated_text: Now, if [it is] of rice — '<s>annam asy annaṃ me dehy annaṃ mā mā hiṃsīr</s>' ('You are food; give me food; food, do not harm me') — having eaten thrice,
Then he may eat as he wishes,

body.text: (KauśS_13,44[136].6) atha ced udadhānaḥ syāt <samudraṃ vaḥ pra hiṇomi [10.5.23-24]>_ity etābhyām abhimantrya
body.translated_text: Now, if it is a water-jar — with '<s>samudraṃ vaḥ pra hiṇomi</s>' [AV 10.5.23-24], having consecrated with these two [verses],
Having made another [vessel] and strengthened it with the two stability [verses],
There, with '<s>hiraṇyavarṇāḥ</s>' [AV 1.33.1], he should pour in water,

body.text: (KauśS_13,44[136].9) sa khalu_eteṣu karmasu sarvatra śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā sarvatra cātanāni_anuyojayet_mātṛnāmāni ca
body.translated_text: Indeed, in all these rites, having everywhere prepared <s>śāntyudaka</s> (pacificatory water), he should everywhere employ the <s>cātana</s> (expelling) [verses] and the mother-names,
Everywhere he should give the best milch cow to the performer,
Everywhere a cow with a bronze vessel and a garment is the fee (<s>dakṣiṇā</s>),
They serve the <s>brāhmaṇas</s> with food,
And as prescribed in the specified [rites] — [thus ends] the section on expiations (<s>prāyaścitta</s>),

body.text: (KauśS 13 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre trayodaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the thirteenth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>,
He should lay out the sacrificial ground according to the canopy-plan,
The <s>vedi</s> (altar) is of the sacrifice, the <s>uttaravedi</s> (raised altar) is of the fire,
Both are elongated to the east, somewhat wider [in the east], narrower and higher in the west,
He should construct the <s>vedi</s> of proportionate width,
Six <s>śamī</s>-measures in length to the east, four <s>śamī</s>-measures at the hip,
Three in the middle, three and a half in front,
In front of the three, he should construct the <s>uttaravedi</s> (raised altar),
Two <s>śamī</s>-measures in length to the east, straight, one and a half <s>śamī</s>-measures at the hip,
With '<s>grīṣmas te bhūme</s>' [AV 12.1.36], having paid homage,
With '<s>vi mimīṣva payasvatīṃ</s>' [AV 13.1.27], he consecrates with <s>mantras</s> the one who measures,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].11) <bṛhaspate pari gṛhāṇa vediṃ sugā vo devāḥ sadanāni santu | asyāṃ barhiḥ prathatāṃ sādhv antarahiṃsrā ṇaḥ pṛthivī devy astu [Kāty;SS 2.2.12]>_iti parigṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: With '<s>bṛhaspate pari gṛhāṇa vediṃ sugā vo devāḥ sadanāni santu | asyāṃ barhiḥ prathatāṃ sādhv antarahiṃsrā ṇaḥ pṛthivī devy astu</s>' [KātyŚS 2.2.12] — '<s>Bṛhaspati</s>, grasp the <s>vedi</s> all around; may your seats be easy of access, O gods; may the <s>barhis</s> be spread well upon it; may the divine earth be non-injurious to us' — he encloses [the altar],
With '<s>yat te bhūme</s>' [AV 12.1.35], he digs,
With '<s>yat te ūnaṃ</s>' [AV 12.1.61c], he fills in,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].14) <tvam asy āvapanī janānām [12.1.61]> iti tatah pāṃsūn anyatodāhārya [-udāhārya]
body.translated_text: With '<s>tvam asy āvapanī janānām</s>' [AV 12.1.61], from there he carries the dust elsewhere,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].15) <bṛhaspate pari gṛhāṇa vediṃ [Kāty;SS 2.2.12, see KauśS 137.11]>_iti uttaravedim opyamānāṇ parigṛhṇāti
body.translated_text: With '<s>bṛhaspate pari gṛhāṇa vediṃ</s>' [KātyŚS 2.2.12], he encloses the <s>uttaravedi</s> as it is being poured,
With '<s>asaṃbādhaṃ madhyato mānavānāṃ</s>' [AV 12.1.2], he broadens [it],

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].17) <yasyāś catasraḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyā [12.1.4]> iti caturasrāṃ karoti
body.translated_text: With '<s>yasyāś catasraḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyā</s>' [AV 12.1.4], he makes it four-cornered,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].18) <devasya tvā savituḥ prasave aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade [cf. 19.51.2 etc.]>_iti lekhanam ādāya yatrāgniṃ nidhāsyan bhavati tatra lakṣaṇaṃ karoti
body.translated_text: With '<s>devasya tvā savituḥ prasave aśvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade</s>' [cf. AV 19.51.2] — 'At the impulse of the god <s>Savitṛ</s>, with the arms of the <s>Aśvins</s>, with the hands of <s>Pūṣan</s>, I take you' — having taken the marking instrument, he makes a mark where he will place the fire,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].19) <indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu [3.17.4]>_iti dakṣiṇata ārabhya_uttara ālikhati
body.translated_text: With '<s>indraḥ sītāṃ ni gṛhṇātu</s>' [AV 3.17.4], beginning from the south, he draws a line to the north,
Having turned eastward, [he draws] an eastward [line] from the south,
The other three [lines] in the middle,
On that [altar], having poured rice and barley,
With '<s>varṣeṇa bhūmiḥ pṛthivī vṛtāvṛtā</s>' [AV 12.1.52c], having sprinkled with water,
With '<s>yasyām annaṃ vrīhiyavau</s>' [AV 12.1.42], having bowed to the earth,

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].25) athāgniṃ praṇayet | <tvām agne bhṛgavo nayantām aṅgirasaḥ sadanaṃ śreya ehi | viśvakarmā pura etu prajānan dhiṣṇyaṃ panthām anu te diśāma [-]>_iti
body.translated_text: Then he should carry forth the fire: '<s>tvām agne bhṛgavo nayantām aṅgirasaḥ sadanaṃ śreya ehi | viśvakarmā pura etu prajānan dhiṣṇyaṃ panthām anu te diśāma</s>' — 'May the <s>Bhṛgus</s> lead you, O <s>Agni</s>; may the <s>Aṅgirasas</s> [lead you]; come to a better seat; may <s>Viśvakarman</s> go before, knowing; we point out to you the <s>dhiṣṇya</s> (fire-seat) along the path',
Or with [the verse] '<s>bhadra-śreyaḥ-svasti</s>' (auspiciousness, excellence, well-being),
Or with '<s>agne prehi</s>' [AV 4.14.5]
(KauśS_14,1[137].28) With <viśvaṃbharā vasudhānī pratiṣṭhā> ("All-sustaining, wealth-holding, firm foundation") [AV 12.1.6], he establishes [the fire] on the mark,
(KauśS_14,1[137].29) Then he lays on the <s>idhma</s> (fuel-wood).

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].30) <agnir bhūmyām oṣadhīṣv [12.1.19]> <agnir diva ā tapaty [12.1.20]> <agnivāsāḥ pṛthivy asitajñūr [corr. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed.: asitajūr] [12.1.21]> <etam idhmaṃ samāhitaṃ juṣāṇo [10.6.35]>_<asmai kṣatrāṇi dhārayantam agne [7.78.2]>_iti pañcabhi staraṇam
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].30) With <agnir bhūmyām oṣadhīṣv> ("<s>Agni</s> in the earth, in the plants") [AV 12.1.19], <agnir diva ā tapaty> ("<s>Agni</s> shines from heaven") [AV 12.1.20], <agnivāsāḥ pṛthivy asitajñūr> ("The earth clad in fire, dark-kneed") [AV 12.1.21], <etam idhmaṃ samāhitaṃ juṣāṇo> ("Delighting in this fuel-wood that has been placed") [AV 10.6.35], and <asmai kṣatrāṇi dhārayantam agne> ("O <s>Agni</s>, bestow sovereign powers upon him") [AV 7.78.2] — with these five [verses] is the strewing.
(KauśS_14,1[137].31) From here onward [pertains] to the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass).

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].32) <tvaṃ bhūmim aty eṣy ojasā [PS 11.13.3, see KauśS 2.1]>_iti darbhān saṃprokṣya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].32) With <tvaṃ bhūmim aty eṣy ojasā> ("You surpass the earth with your vigor") [PS 11.13.3, cf. KauśS 2.1], having sprinkled the <s>darbha</s> grasses,
(KauśS_14,1[137].33) With <ṛṣīṇāṃ prastaro 'si> ("You are the seat of the <s>ṛṣis</s>") [AV 16.2.6], he places the <s>brahmāsana</s> (seat of the <s>Brahman</s> priest) to the south of the fire.
(KauśS_14,1[137].34) He strews [the <s>barhis</s>] to the east of the fire, northward.
(KauśS_14,1[137].35) Likewise westward.

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].36) pradakṣiṇaṃ barhiṣāṃ mūlāni chādayantottarasyā [-uttarasyā] vediśroṇeḥ pūrvottarataḥ saṃsthāpya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].36) Covering the roots of the sacred grasses in a clockwise direction, he establishes [them] to the northeast of the northern hip of the <s>vedi</s> (altar).

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].37) <ahe daidhiṣavyod atas tiṣṭhāny asya sadane sīda yo 'smat pākataraḥ [TS 3.2.4.4, VaitS 1.20]>_iti brahmāsanam anvīkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].37) With <ahe daidhiṣavyod atas tiṣṭhāny asya sadane sīda yo 'smat pākataraḥ> ("O <s>Daidhiṣavya</s>, stand aside from here; sit in his seat — he who is simpler than us") [TS 3.2.4.4, VaitS 1.20], he looks toward the <s>brahmāsana</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].38) <nirastaḥ parāgvasuḥ saha pāpmanā nirastaḥ so 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ [GobhGS 1.6.14, ;SBM 1.5.1.23 etc.]>_iti dakṣiṇā tṛṇaṃ nirasyati (cf. KauśS 3.5ff.)
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].38) With <nirastaḥ parāgvasuḥ saha pāpmanā nirastaḥ so 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ> ("Cast out is the one whose wealth is gone, cast out along with evil — may he be cast out who hates us and whom we hate") [GobhGS 1.6.14, ŚBM 1.5.1.23 etc.], he throws away a blade of grass to the south (cf. KauśS 3.5ff.).

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].39) tad anvālabhya japati_<idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi_[GB 2.1.1, ;SBM 1.5.1.24]_ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi satyasya sadane sīdāmi_[PB 1.2.2 etc.]_iṣṭasya sadane sīdāmi pūrtasya sadane sīdāmi [-] māmṛṣad eva barhiḥ svāsasthaṃ tvādhyāsadeyam ūrṇamradam anabhiśokam [cf. AAśv;SS 1.4.7]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].39) Having touched that [seat], he murmurs: <idam aham arvāgvasoḥ sadane sīdāmi> ("Here I sit in the seat of one whose wealth is near") [GB 2.1.1, ŚBM 1.5.1.24], <ṛtasya sadane sīdāmi satyasya sadane sīdāmi> ("I sit in the seat of <s>Ṛta</s> (cosmic order), I sit in the seat of <s>Satya</s> (truth)") [PB 1.2.2 etc.], <iṣṭasya sadane sīdāmi pūrtasya sadane sīdāmi> ("I sit in the seat of what has been sacrificed, I sit in the seat of what has been fulfilled"), <māmṛṣad eva barhiḥ svāsasthaṃ tvādhyāsadeyam ūrṇamradam anabhiśokam> ("May the <s>barhis</s> not harm me; may I sit upon you, well-seated, soft as wool, free from affliction") [cf. AĀśvŚS 1.4.7].

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].40) <vimṛgvarīṃ [12.1.29]>_ity upaviśyāsanīyaṃ brahmajapaṃ japati <bṛhaspatir brahmā brahmasadana āsiṣyate [thus Bloomfield] [AAśv;SS 1.12.9]> <bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya [AAśv;SS 1.12.9, TB 3.7.6.3]> <yad ud udvata un nivataḥ śakeyam [TS 3.2.4.4]>
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].40) With <vimṛgvarīṃ> [AV 12.1.29], having sat down, he murmurs the <s>brahma</s>-recitation for sitting: <bṛhaspatir brahmā brahmasadana āsiṣyate> ("<s>Bṛhaspati</s>, the <s>Brahman</s> priest, will sit in the <s>brahma</s>-seat") [AĀśvŚS 1.12.9], <bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya> ("O <s>Bṛhaspati</s>, protect the sacrifice") [AĀśvŚS 1.12.9, TB 3.7.6.3], <yad ud udvata un nivataḥ śakeyam> ("That I might prevail from the height and from the depth") [TS 3.2.4.4].

body.text: (KauśS_14,1[137].41) <pātaṃ mā dyāvāpṛthivī adyāhna [em. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. aghān na] [-]> iti dyāvāpṛthivyau samīkṣate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,1[137].41) With <pātaṃ mā dyāvāpṛthivī adyāhna> ("May <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth) protect me today"), he looks toward Heaven and Earth.

(KauśS_14,1[137].42) With <savitā prasavānām> ("<s>Savitṛ</s> [is lord] of impulsions") [AV 5.24.1], at each and every rite, he should offer <s>ājya</s> (ghee) with the <s>abhyātāna</s> verses recited on both sides.
(KauśS_14,1[137].43) Thus is explained the general <s>tantra</s> (procedure) for all <s>pākayajñas</s> (domestic sacrifices).
(KauśS_14,2[138].1) On the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> (eighth-day rite), one should offer the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> oblations.

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].2) tasyā havīṃṣi dhānāḥ karambhaḥ śaṣkulyaḥ puroḍāśa udaudanaḥ kṣiraudanas tilaudano yathopapādipaśuḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].2) The oblations for it are: <s>dhānā</s> (parched grain), <s>karambha</s> (porridge), <s>śaṣkulī</s> (cakes), <s>puroḍāśa</s> (rice-cake), <s>udaudana</s> (boiled rice with water), <s>kṣīraudana</s> (milk-rice), <s>tilaudana</s> (sesame-rice), and as available, an animal.
(KauśS_14,2[138].3) Having set apart [portions] from all the oblations,

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].4) darvyā juhuyāt <prathamā ha vy uvāsa sā [3.10.1]>_iti pañcabhiḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].4) he should offer with the <s>darvī</s> (ladle), with five [verses beginning] <prathamā ha vy uvāsa sā> ("She indeed first shone forth") [AV 3.10.1].
(KauśS_14,2[138].5) With four [verses beginning] <āyam āgan saṃvatsara> ("This year has come") [AV 3.10.8], it is recognized.
(KauśS_14,2[138].6) With <ṛtubhyas tvā> ("To the seasons, you") [AV 3.10.10], eight [verses] with pauses,
(KauśS_14,2[138].7) With <indraputre> ("O daughter of <s>Indra</s>") [AV 3.10.13], the eighteenth [verse],
(KauśS_14,2[138].8) With <ahorātrābhyāṃ> ("To day and night") [AV 6.128.3], the nineteenth,

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].9) paśau_upapadyamāne dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ nirlomaṃ sacarmaṃ sakhuraṃ prakṣālya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].9) When an animal is available, having washed the right foreleg — hairless, with skin, with hoof —
(KauśS_14,2[138].10) With two [verses beginning] <iḍāyās padaṃ> ("The portion of <s>Iḍā</s>") [AV 3.10.6], the twentieth,
(KauśS_14,2[138].11) When [an animal] is not available, he should offer <s>ājya</s> (ghee).

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].12) haviṣāṃ darviṃ pūrayitvā <pūrṇā darve [3.10.7c]>_iti sadarvīm ekaviṃśīm
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].12) Having filled the <s>darvī</s> (ladle) with the oblations, with <pūrṇā darve> ("Full ladle") [AV 3.10.7c], [this is] the twenty-first, together with the ladle [offering].
(KauśS_14,2[138].13) The sacrifice is recognized as having a twenty-one-fold structure [cf. GB 1.1.12].

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].14) sarvā eva yajñatanūr avarunddhe sarvā evāsya yajñatanūḥ pitaram upajīvanti ya evam aṣṭakām upaiti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].14) He secures all the forms of the sacrifice; all the forms of the sacrifice of the ancestors serve him — one who thus performs the <s>Aṣṭakā</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,2[138].15) na darvihome na hastahome na pūrṇahome tantraṃ kriyeta_ity eke
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,2[138].15) Neither in the <s>darvihoma</s> (ladle-oblation), nor in the <s>hastahoma</s> (hand-oblation), nor in the <s>pūrṇahoma</s> (full-oblation) should the <s>tantra</s> (systematic procedure) be performed — so say some.
(KauśS_14,2[138].16) It should be performed at the <s>Aṣṭakā</s> — so [say] <s>Iṣuphāli</s> and <s>Māṭhara</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].1) abhijiti śiṣyān upanīya śvo bhūte saṃbhārān saṃbharati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].1) Having initiated the students (<s>upanayana</s>) under the <s>Abhijit</s> constellation, on the next day he gathers the requisite materials.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].2) dadhisaktūn pālāśaṃ daṇḍam ahate vasane śuddham ājyaṃ śāntā oṣadhīr navam udakumbham
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].2) Curds mixed with <s>saktu</s> (barley meal), a <s>palāśa</s> (Butea frondosa) staff, two unworn garments, pure <s>ājya</s> (ghee), appeased herbs, and a new water-pot.
(KauśS_14,3[139].3) Outside the <s>śāntavṛkṣa</s> (pacified tree), having laid the <s>idhma</s> (fuel-wood) facing east,

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].4) parisamuhya paryukṣya paristīrya barhir udapātram upasādya paricaraṇenājyaṃ paricarya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].4) having swept around, sprinkled around, strewn the <s>barhis</s> (sacred grass) around, placed the water-vessel nearby, and prepared the <s>ājya</s> (ghee) with the ritual attendances,
(KauśS_14,3[139].5) having offered the regular preliminary oblations and the two <s>ājyabhāga</s> portions,

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].6) paścād agner dadhisaktūñ juhoti_agnaye brahmaprajāpatibhyāṃ bhṛgvaṅgirobhya uśanase kāvyāya
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].6) behind the fire he offers the <s>dadhisaktū</s> (curds with barley meal) — to <s>Agni</s>, to <s>Brahman</s> and <s>Prajāpati</s>, to the <s>Bhṛgus</s> and <s>Aṅgirases</s>, to <s>Uśanas Kāvya</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].7) tato_abhayair aparājitair gaṇakarmabhir viśvakarmabhir āyuṣyaiḥ svastyayanair ājyaṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].7) Then with the <s>abhaya</s> (fearlessness) [hymns], the <s>aparājita</s> (unconquered) [hymns], the <s>gaṇakarman</s> (group-rites) [hymns], the <s>viśvakarman</s> (all-creating) [hymns], the <s>āyuṣya</s> (longevity) [hymns], and the <s>svastyayana</s> (benediction) [hymns], he should offer <s>ājya</s> (ghee).

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].8) <mā no devā ahir vadhīt [6.56.1]>_<arasasya śarkoṭasya [7.56.5]>_<indrasya prathamo ratho [10.4.1]> <yas te sarpo vṛścikas tṛṣṭadaṃśmā [12.1.46]> <namas te astu vidyute [1.13.1]>_<āre 'sāv amad astu [1.26.1]> <yas te pṛthu stanayitnur [7.11.1]> iti saṃsthāpya homān
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].8) With <mā no devā ahir vadhīt> ("May the serpent not slay us, O gods") [AV 6.56.1], <arasasya śarkoṭasya> ("Of the juiceless scorpion") [AV 7.56.5], <indrasya prathamo ratho> ("The first chariot of <s>Indra</s>") [AV 10.4.1], <yas te sarpo vṛścikas tṛṣṭadaṃśmā> ("Whatever serpent or scorpion with sharp bite is yours") [AV 12.1.46], <namas te astu vidyute> ("Homage be to you, O lightning") [AV 1.13.1], <āre 'sāv amad astu> ("May that [harm] be far away") [AV 1.26.1], <yas te pṛthu stanayitnur> ("Your broad thundering") [AV 7.11.1] — with these he concludes the oblations.
(KauśS_14,3[139].9) Having set down the <s>sruva</s> (ladle), having eaten the <s>dadhisaktū</s> (curds with barley meal) and sipped water, they take hold of the water [vessel].

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].10) <avyacasaś ca [19.68.1]>_iti japitvā sāvitrīṃ <brahma jajñānaṃ [4.1.1]>_ity ekāṃ triṣaptīyaṃ ca paccho vācayet
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].10) Having murmured <avyacasaś ca> [AV 19.68.1], he should have [the students] recite the <s>Sāvitrī</s>, <brahma jajñānaṃ> ("<s>Brahman</s> was born first") [AV 4.1.1] as one [verse], and the <s>Triṣaptīya</s> (thrice-seven) [hymn] afterward.
(KauśS_14,3[139].11) They murmur the remainder of the <s>anuvāka</s> (section).

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].12) yoyo bhogaḥ kartavyo bhavati taṃtaṃ kurvate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].12) Whatever observance needs to be performed, that they carry out.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].13) sa khalu_etaṃ pakṣam apakṣīyamāṇaḥ pakṣam adhīyāna upaśrāmyetā darśāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].13) He indeed, studying during this [waning] fortnight as it wanes, should rest from the new-moon day.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].14) dṛṣṭe candramasi phalgunīṣu dvayān rasān upasādayati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].14) When the moon is seen in the <s>Phalgunī</s> [constellation], he sets out two kinds of liquid preparations.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].15) <viśve devā [1.30.1]> <ahaṃ rudrebhir [4.30.1]>_<siṃhe vyāghre [6.38.1]> <yaśo havir [6.39.1]> <yaśasaṃ mendro [6.58.1]> <girāv aragarāṭeṣu (ed.: arāgarāṭeṣu) [6.69.1]> <yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane [9.1.11]> <yac ca varco akṣeṣu [14.1.35]> <yena mahānaghnyā jaghanam [14.1.36]>_svāhā_ity agnau hutvā
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].15) With <viśve devā> ("All the gods") [AV 1.30.1], <ahaṃ rudrebhir> ("I with the <s>Rudras</s>") [AV 4.30.1], <siṃhe vyāghre> ("In the lion, in the tiger") [AV 6.38.1], <yaśo havir> ("Glory [is] the oblation") [AV 6.39.1], <yaśasaṃ mendro> ("May <s>Indra</s> [make] me glorious") [AV 6.58.1], <girāv aragarāṭeṣu> ("On the mountain, among the arāgarāṭas") [AV 6.69.1], <yathā somaḥ prātaḥsavane> ("As <s>Soma</s> at the morning pressing") [AV 9.1.11], <yac ca varco akṣeṣu> ("And whatever splendor is in the dice") [AV 14.1.35], <yena mahānaghnyā jaghanam> ("By which [splendor] the hip of the great cow") [AV 14.1.36] — with <s>svāhā</s>, having offered into the fire,
(KauśS_14,3[139].16) having brought the remainders into the liquid preparations, he concludes the oblations.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].17) tata etān prāśayati rasān madhu ghṛtān_śiṣyān
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].17) Then he feeds the students these liquid preparations — honey and ghee.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].18) yoyo bhogaḥ kartavyo bhavati taṭaṃ kurvate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].18) Whatever observance needs to be performed, that they carry out.
(KauśS_14,3[139].19) He should not accept students who have come from elsewhere, because they have been consecrated by another.
(KauśS_14,3[139].20) He should teach the students for four months with three-night [intervals], or four and a half [months].

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].21) pādaṃ pūrvarātre_adhīyānaḥ pādam apararātre madhyarātre svapan
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].21) Studying a quarter [portion] in the first part of the night, a quarter in the latter part of the night, sleeping during the middle of the night.
(KauśS_14,3[139].22) Studying in the first part of the night without having eaten — so say some.
(KauśS_14,3[139].23) In the latter part of the night according to one's ability; for the quarter [portion] is difficult to measure.
(KauśS_14,3[139].24) During the latter half of the month of <s>Pauṣa</s>, one should not study for three nights.

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].25) tṛtīyasyāḥ prātaḥ samāsaṃ saṃdiśya <yasmāt kośād [19.72.1, PS 19.35.3]> ity antaḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].25) On the morning of the third [day], having given the concluding instruction, [he recites] ending with <yasmāt kośād> [AV 19.72.1, PS 19.35.3].

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].26) <yasmāt kośād udabharāma vedaṃ tasminn antar ava dadhma enam | adhītam [sic!] iṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo vīryeṇa tena mā devās tapasāvateha [19.72.1 (but note sakalapāṭha) = PS 19.35.3]>_iti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].26) <yasmāt kośād udabharāma vedaṃ tasminn antar ava dadhma enam | adhītam iṣṭaṃ brahmaṇo vīryeṇa tena mā devās tapasāvateha> ("From which sheath we drew forth the <s>Veda</s>, into that we place it back again; what has been studied and sacrificed by the power of <s>Brahman</s> — by that austerity may the gods [protect] me here") [AV 19.72.1 = PS 19.35.3].

body.text: (KauśS_14,3[139].27) yoyo bhogaḥ kartavyo bhavati taṃtaṃ kurvate
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,3[139].27) Whatever observance needs to be performed, that they carry out.
(KauśS_14,3[139].28) Those who desire release (<s>parimokṣa</s>) are released.
(KauśS_14,4[140].1) Now we shall explain the procedure of the <s>Indramaha</s> (great festival of <s>Indra</s>) for kings.
(KauśS_14,4[140].2) The entry [into the rite] is on the eighth day of the bright fortnight in [the month of] <s>Proṣṭhapada</s>, or in <s>Āśvayuja</s>.
(KauśS_14,4[140].3) The raising [of <s>Indra</s>] is on [the day of the constellation] <s>Śravaṇa</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].4) saṃbhṛteṣu saṃbhāreṣu brahmā rājā ca_ubhau snātau_ahatavasanau surabhiṇau vratavantau karmaṇyau_upavasataḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].4) When the requisite materials have been gathered, the <s>Brahman</s> priest and the king, both having bathed, wearing unworn garments, anointed with fragrance, observing vows, and ready for the rite, keep vigil.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].5) śvo bhūte śaṃ no devyāḥ pādair ardharcābhyām ṛcā ṣaṭkṛtvā_udakam ācāmataḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].5) On the next day, with the two half-verses of <śaṃ no devyāḥ> ("May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us"), with the verse six times, they sip water.

(KauśS_14,4[140].6) Having offered <s>ājya</s> (ghee) with <arvāñcam indram> ("<s>Indra</s> turned hither") [AV 5.3.11], <trātāram> ("The protector") [AV 7.86.1], and <indraḥ sutrāmā> ("<s>Indra</s> the good protector") [AV 7.91.1],
(KauśS_14,4[140].7) then they raise <s>Indra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].8) <ā tvāhārṣam [6.87.1]>_<dhruvā dyaur [6.88.1]> <viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu [6.87.1c]>_iti sarvato_apramattā dhārayeran
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].8) With <ā tvāhārṣam> ("I have brought you hither") [AV 6.87.1], <dhruvā dyaur> ("Firm is heaven") [AV 6.88.1], and <viśas tvā sarvā vāñchantu> ("May all the clans desire you") [AV 6.87.1c], they should hold [<s>Indra</s>] from all sides, attentively.
(KauśS_14,4[140].9) For a wondrous [sight] — they attend upon [<s>Indra</s>] risen from the platform.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].10) <abhibhūr yajño [6.97.1]>_ity etais tribhiḥ sūktair anvārabdhe rājani pūrṇahomaṃ juhuyāt
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].10) With <abhibhūr yajño> ("The conquering sacrifice") [AV 6.97.1] — with these three hymns, while the king holds on [to the image], he should offer a <s>pūrṇahoma</s> (full oblation).
(KauśS_14,4[140].11) Then [follows] the procedure for the animals.
(KauśS_14,4[140].12) They should be dedicated to <s>Indra</s> as deity.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].13) ye rājño bhṛtyāḥ syuḥ sarve dīkṣitā brahmacāriṇaḥ syuḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].13) All the king's servants should be consecrated (<s>dīkṣita</s>) and observing <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy).
(KauśS_14,4[140].14) Having approached <s>Indra</s> reverentially, they should sacrifice for three nights or five nights.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].15) trir ayanam ahnām upatiṣṭhante haviṣā ca yajante
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].15) Three times a day they attend upon [<s>Indra</s>] and sacrifice with oblations.
(KauśS_14,4[140].16) At the conclusion [they recite] <indram ahaṃ> ("I [invoke] <s>Indra</s>") [AV 3.15.1].

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].17) <indra kṣatram [7.84.2]> iti haviṣo hutvā brāhmaṇān paricareyuḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].17) Having offered the oblation with <indra kṣatram> ("O <s>Indra</s>, [grant] sovereign power") [AV 7.84.2], they should serve the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].18) na saṃsthitahomāñ juhuyād ity āhur ācāryāḥ
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].18) One should not offer the concluding oblations — so say the teachers.
(KauśS_14,4[140].19) From the <s>avabhṛtha</s> (concluding bath) of <s>Indra</s>, they proceed to the <s>avabhṛtha</s> for <s>Indra</s>.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].20) apāṃ sūktair āplutya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyāpa upaspṛśyānavekṣamāṇāḥ pratyudāvrajanti
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].20) Having bathed with the water-hymns, circumambulating clockwise, having touched water, they return without looking back.
(KauśS_14,4[140].21) They honor the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> with food.

body.text: (KauśS_14,4[140].22) śvaḥśvo_asya rāṣṭraṃ jyāyo bhavati_eko_asyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ rājā bhavati na purā jarasaḥ pramīyate ya evaṇ veda yaś ca_evaṃ vidvān indramaheṇa carati
body.translated_text: (KauśS_14,4[140].22) Day by day his kingdom grows greater; he becomes the sole king on this earth; he does not die before old age — one who knows thus and one who, knowing thus, performs the <s>Indramaha</s>.
(KauśS_14,5[141].1) Now we shall state the rules for the study of the <s>Veda</s>.

(KauśS_14,5[141].2) Having performed the <s>upākaraṇa</s> (commencement ceremony) on the <s>Śrāvaṇī</s> (full moon of Śrāvaṇa) or the <s>Prauṣṭhapadī</s> (full moon of Proṣṭhapada), they should study for four and a half months.
(KauśS_14,5[141].3) Likewise [for] the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic meters/hymns).
(KauśS_14,5[141].4) And there is no turning back of the body hair [i.e., the shaving rite is not repeated].

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].5) <ardhamāsaṃ copākṛtya kṣaperaṃs tryaham utsṛjya | ārambhaḥ śrāvaṇyām uktaḥ pauṣyām utsarga ucyate [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Having prepared the half-month and having spent the nights, leaving off for three [days] — the commencement is declared on the <s>Śrāvaṇī</s> [full moon]; the conclusion is declared on the <s>Pauṣī</s> [full moon].'
Now we shall declare the days of non-study (<s>anadhyāya</s>).
He ceases [study] on [the days of] <s>brahmajya</s> (offenses against <s>Brahman</s>).
On [the day of] a <s>śrāddha</s> (ancestor-memorial rite).
On [occasions of] impurity from birth (<s>sūtaka</s>), rising [from illness], and vomiting — three [days] is the observance.

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].10) ācāryāstamite vā yeṣāṃ ca mānuṣī yoniḥ
body.translated_text: On [the death of] the teacher (<s>ācārya</s>), or for those of human birth.
As for the <s>śrāddha</s>, so also for those [cases].
And [having received] any <s>śrāddha</s>-related gift — excluding liquor and [improper] oblation-material — having accepted [it], [there is] non-study.
Both animate and inanimate [gifts].
On [the occasion of] tooth-cleaning.
On contact with a razor.
When the [sacred] fires are kindled.
On lightning at midnight, [and on] thunder.
When it has stopped raining seven times — until the morning meal.
When it has rained.
On [the occurrence of] a loud crash (<s>nirghāta</s>).
On an earthquake.
On an eclipse — even in the [proper] season — until the [specified] time.
On an odd [day], no commencement [of study].

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].24) atha pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ samānaṃ vidyudulkayoḥ | mārgaśīrṣapauṣamāghāparapakṣeṣu tisro_aṣṭakāḥ
body.translated_text: Now we shall declare the duration — the same for lightning and meteors: in the dark fortnights of <s>Mārgaśīrṣa</s>, <s>Pauṣa</s>, and <s>Māgha</s>, [there are] three <s>Aṣṭakā</s> [days].
And on the new-moon day.
And three [days of] non-study.

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].27) <janane maraṇe caiva daśarātro vidhīyate | ācārye daśarātraṃ syāt sarveṣu ca svayoniṣu [-]>
body.translated_text: 'On birth and on death, a ten-night [period] is prescribed; for the teacher, it should be ten nights; and for all those of one's own family.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].28) sūtake tu_eko nādhīyīta trirātram upādhyāyaṃ varjayet
body.translated_text: But on [the occasion of] birth-impurity (<s>sūtaka</s>), one should not study for one [night]; for three nights he should avoid the sub-teacher (<s>upādhyāya</s>).
And the teacher's son and wife [are also avoided].

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].30) atha śiṣyaṃ sahādhyāyinam apradhānaguruṃ ca_upasannam ahorātraṃ varjayet
body.translated_text: Then, for a pupil, a co-student, or a non-primary teacher who has come near — he should avoid [study] for a day and a night.
Likewise for a fellow <s>brahmacārin</s> and a king.
For an out-of-season [celestial event], until the [specified] time.

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].33) <aviśeṣartukālena sarve nirghātādayaḥ smṛtāḥ | yac cānyad daivam adbhutaṃ sarvaṃ nirghātavad bhavet [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Without distinction of season or time, all [events] beginning with the loud crash (<s>nirghāta</s>) are remembered [as causes of non-study]; and whatever other divine portent (<s>adbhuta</s>) [occurs] — all should be [treated] like the loud crash.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].34) <ṛtāv adhyāyaś chāndasaḥ kālpya āpartukaḥ smṛtaḥ | ṛtāv ūrdhvaṃ prātarāśād yas tu kaś cid anadhyāyaḥ | saṃdhyāṃ prāpnoti paścimām [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Study in the [proper] season is Vedic (<s>chāndasa</s>); the prescribed [study] out of season is remembered [as traditional]. In the [proper] season, after the morning meal, whatever non-study [days there are] — [the cessation] extends to the evening twilight.'
In all [cases], the early evening is excluded [from study].

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].36) niśi nigadāyāṃ ca vidyuti śiṣṭaṃ nādhīyīta
body.translated_text: At night, when there is recitation (<s>nigadā</s>) and lightning, one should not study the remainder.

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].37) <astamite dvisattāyāṃ trisattāyāṃ ca pāṭavaḥ | atha tāvat kālaṃ bhuktvā pradoṣa [corr. Bloomfield GGA 1902 514 -- ed. padoṣa] ubhe saṃdhye [-]>
body.translated_text: 'When [the teacher] has departed, [non-study for] the period of two sittings or three sittings is the rule; then for that same duration, having eaten, [non-study at] the early evening [and] both twilights.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].38) <apsu śmaśāne śayyāyām abhiśaste khileṣu ca | antaḥśave rathyāyāṃ grāme cāṇḍālasaṃyute [-]>
body.translated_text: 'In water, in a cremation ground, on a bed, in [a place of] censure, in barren plots, when a corpse is within, on a road, and in a village with <s>Caṇḍālas</s>.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].39) <durgandhe śūdrasaṃśrāve paiṅge śabde bhaye rute | vaidhṛtye nagareṣu ca [-]>
body.translated_text: 'In a foul-smelling [place], within hearing of a <s>śūdra</s>, on a reddish-brown [sound], on [hearing] a sound of fear or crying, on the <s>Vaidhṛti</s> [astronomical conjunction], and in cities.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].40) <aniktena ca vāsasā caritaṃ yena maithunam | śayānaḥ prauḍhapādo cāgratopasthāntike guroḥ [-]>
body.translated_text: 'And with an unwashed garment, [a garment] with which sexual intercourse was performed, while lying down, and with feet stretched out — [non-study in] the presence of a teacher.'

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].41) <viramya mārute śīghre pratyārambho vibhāṣitaḥ | sarveṇāpararātreṇa viramya pratyārambho na vidyute [-]>
body.translated_text: 'Having ceased [study] during a swift wind, the resumption is optional; having ceased for the entire latter part of the night, there is no resumption [in the case of] lightning.'
The <s>Pauṣī</s> [full moon] is the measure for [study during] clouds, if studying out of season.
[If] rain, lightning, or thunder occurs [during study],
they should observe three nights of standing and sitting, <s>brahmacarya</s> (celibacy), and eating tasteless food.

body.text: (KauśS_14,5[141].45) sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ
body.translated_text: That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case]. That is the <s>prāyaścitta</s> (expiation) for that [case].

body.text: (KauśS 14 Colophon) iti atharvavede kauśikasūtre caturdaśo 'dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ
body.translated_text: Thus ends the fourteenth chapter of the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> in the <s>Atharvaveda</s>.
Thus the <s>Kauśikasūtra</s> is complete.
